en: Pursuing a career is an essential part of adolescent development. (10 words)
cn: 追求职业是青少年发展的重要组成部分。

en: 'The adolescent becomes an adult when he undertakes a real job.' (11 words)
cn: ‘青少年在承担真正的工作时才成为成年人。’

en: To cognitive researchers like Piaget, adulthood meant the beginning of an occupation. (12 words)
cn: 对皮亚杰等认知研究者来说，成年意味着职业生涯的开始。

en: Piaget argued that once adolescents enter the world of work, their newly acquired ability to form hypotheses allows them to create representations that are too ideal. (26 words)
cn: 皮亚杰认为，一旦青少年进入职场，他们新获得的提出假设的能力使他们能够创造出过于理想化的图景。

en: The existence of such ideals, without the tempering of the reality of a job or profession, rapidly leads adolescents to become intolerant of the non-idealistic world and to press for reform in a characteristically adolescent way. (36 words)
cn: 这些理想的存在，若未经工作或职业现实的磨炼，会迅速导致青少年变得对非理想化的世界不宽容，并以典型的青少年方式推动改革。

en: Piaget said: 'True adaptation to society comes automatically when the adolescent reformer attempts to put his ideas to work.' (19 words)
cn: 皮亚杰说：‘当青少年改革者试图将他的想法付诸实践时，对社会的真正适应就会自动到来。’

en: Of course, youthful idealism is often courageous, and no one likes to give up dreams. (15 words)
cn: 当然，青春期的理想主义常常是勇敢的，没有人喜欢放弃梦想。

en: Perhaps, taken slightly out of context, Piaget's statement seems harsh. (10 words)
cn: 也许，稍微脱离语境来看，皮亚杰的言论显得苛刻。

en: What he was emphasizing, however, is the way reality can modify idealistic views. (13 words)
cn: 然而，他所强调的是现实能够修正理想主义观点的方式。

en: Some people refer to such modification as maturity. (8 words)
cn: 有些人把这种修正称为成熟。

en: Piaget argued that attaining and accepting a vocation is one of the best ways to modify idealized views and to mature. (21 words)
cn: 皮亚杰认为，获得并接受一种职业是修正理想化观点和走向成熟的最佳途径之一。

en: As careers and vocations become less available during times of recession, adolescents may be especially hard hit. (17 words)
cn: 在经济衰退时期，当职业和工作机会减少时，青少年可能受到的打击尤其严重。

en: Such difficult economic times may leave many adolescents confused about their roles in society. (14 words)
cn: 这样艰难的经济时期可能会让许多青少年对社会中的角色感到困惑。

en: For this reason, community interventions and government job programs that offer summer and vacation work are not only economically beneficial but also help to stimulate the adolescent's sense of worth. (30 words)
cn: 因此，提供暑期和假期工作的社区干预措施和政府就业计划不仅在经济上有益，而且有助于激发青少年的自我价值感。

en: 'If our economies are to flourish, if global poverty is to be eliminated and if the well-being of the world's people enhanced—not just in this generation but in succeeding generations—we must make sure we take care of the natural environment and resources on which our economic activity depends.' (48 words)
cn: ‘如果我们的经济要繁荣，如果全球贫困要消除，如果世界人民的福祉要得到改善——不仅在这一代人，而且在子孙后代——我们必须确保照顾好我们的经济活动所依赖的自然环境和资源。’

en: That statement comes not, as you might imagine, from a stereotypical tree-hugging, save-the-world greenie, but from Gordon Brown, a politician with a reputation for rigour, thoroughness and, above all, caution. (30 words)
cn: 这句话并非如你所想的那样来自一个刻板的环保主义者，而是来自戈登·布朗——一位以严谨、彻底，尤其是谨慎著称的政治家。

en: A surprising thing for the man who runs one of the world's most powerful economies to say? (17 words)
cn: 这对于管理着世界上最强大经济体之一的人来说，是令人惊讶的言论吗？

en: Perhaps: though in the run-up to the five-year review of the Millennium Goals, he is far from alone. (18 words)
cn: 或许吧：尽管在千年目标五年回顾的准备阶段，他并非孤例。

en: The roots of his speech, given in March at the round table meeting of environment and energy ministers from the G20 group of nations, stretch back to 1972, and the United Nations Conference on the Human Environment in Stockholm. (39 words)
cn: 他于3月在G20集团环境与能源部长圆桌会议上发表的演讲，其根源可以追溯到1972年在斯德哥尔摩召开的联合国人类环境会议。

en: 'The protection and improvement of the human environment is a major issue which affects the well-being of peoples and economic development throughout the world,' read the final declaration from this gathering, the first of a sequence which would lead to the Rio de Janeiro Earth Summit in 1992 and the World Development Summit in Johannesburg three years ago. (58 words)
cn: 这次会议的最终宣言写道：‘人类环境的保护和改善是一个影响各国人民福祉和全世界经济发展的重大问题。’这次会议是系列会议中的第一次，其后导致了1992年的里约热内卢地球峰会和三年前的约翰内斯堡世界发展峰会。

en: Hunt through the reports prepared by UN agencies and development groups—many for conferences such as this year's Millennium Goals review—and you will find that the linkage between environmental protection and economic progress is a common thread. (36 words)
cn: 翻阅由联合国机构和发展组织编写的报告——许多是为今年千年目标回顾等会议准备的——你会发现环境保护与经济发展之间的联系是一个共同的主题。

en: Managing ecosystems sustainably is more profitable than exploiting them, according to the Millennium Ecosystem Assessment. (15 words)
cn: 根据千年生态系统评估，可持续地管理生态系统比开发它们更有利可图。

en: But finding hard evidence to support the thesis is not so easy. (12 words)
cn: 但要找到确凿的证据来支持这一论点并不那么容易。

en: Thoughts turn first to some sort of global statistic, some indicator which would rate the wealth of nations in both economic and environmental terms and show a relationship between the two. (31 words)
cn: 人们首先想到的是某种全球统计数据，某种能从经济和环境两方面衡量国家财富并显示两者之间关系的指标。

en: If such an indicator exists, it is well hidden. (9 words)
cn: 如果存在这样的指标，那它隐藏得很好。

en: And on reflection, this is not surprising; the single word 'environment' has so many dimensions, and there are so many other factors affecting wealth—such as the oil deposits—that teasing out a simple economy-environment relationship would be almost impossible. (38 words)
cn: 仔细想想，这并不奇怪：‘环境’这个词有很多维度，而且还有这么多其他因素影响财富——比如石油储量——要梳理出一个简单的经济与环境关系几乎是不可能的。

en: The Millennium Ecosystem Assessment, a vast four-year global study which reported its initial conclusions earlier this year, found reasons to believe that managing ecosystems sustainably—working with nature rather than against it—might be less profitable in the short term, but certainly brings long-term rewards. (43 words)
cn: 千年生态系统评估是一项为期四年的全球性大规模研究，今年早些时候公布了其初步结论。研究发现有理由相信，可持续地管理生态系统——与自然合作而非对抗——短期利润可能较低，但肯定能带来长期的回报。

en: And the World Resources Institute in its World Resources 2005 report, issued at the end of August, produced several such examples from Africa and Asia; it also demonstrated that environmental degradation affects the poor more than the rich, as poorer people derive a much higher proportion of their income directly from the natural resources around them. (56 words)
cn: 世界资源研究所在8月底发布的《2005年世界资源》报告中列举了来自非洲和亚洲的几个此类例子；它还表明，环境退化对穷人的影响大于富人，因为较贫穷的人直接从周围自然资源中获得收入的比重要高得多。

en: But there are also many examples of growing wealth by trashing the environment, in rich and poor parts of the world alike, whether through unregulated mineral extraction, drastic water use for agriculture, slash-and-burn farming, or fossil-fuel-guzzling transport. (37 words)
cn: 但是，在世界各地，无论贫富，也有很多通过破坏环境来增长财富的例子，无论是通过无管制矿产开采、农业大量用水、刀耕火种，还是大量消耗化石燃料的交通运输。

en: Of course, such growth may not persist in the long term—which is what Mr. Brown and the Stockholm declaration were both attempting to point out. (25 words)
cn: 当然，这种增长可能无法长期持续——这正是布朗先生和斯德哥尔摩宣言都试图指出的。

en: Perhaps the best example of boom growth and bust decline is the Grand Banks fishery. (15 words)
cn: 或许繁荣增长与萧条衰退的最佳例子就是大浅滩渔业。

en: For almost five centuries a very large supply of cod provided abundant raw material for an industry which at its peak employed about 40,000 people, sustaining entire communities in Newfoundland. (30 words)
cn: 近五个世纪以来，大量的鳕鱼供应为这一行业提供了丰富的原材料，在其鼎盛时期雇用了约4万人，支撑着纽芬兰的整个社区。

en: Then, abruptly, the cod population collapsed. (6 words)
cn: 然后，鳕鱼种群突然崩溃了。

en: There were no longer enough fish in the sea for the stock to maintain itself, let alone an industry. (19 words)
cn: 海洋中再也没有足够的鱼来维持种群的自我繁衍，更不用说支撑一个产业了。

en: More than a decade later, there was no sign of the ecosystem rebuilding itself. (14 words)
cn: 十多年后，没有任何生态系统自我重建的迹象。

en: It had, apparently, been fished out of existence; and the once mighty Newfoundland fleet now gropes about frantically for crab on the sea floor. (24 words)
cn: 显然，它被捕捞殆尽；曾经强大的纽芬兰船队现在疯狂地在海底搜寻螃蟹。

en: There is a view that modern humans are inevitably sowing the seeds of a global Grand Banks-style disaster. (18 words)
cn: 有一种观点认为，现代人类正在不可避免地播下全球性大浅滩式灾难的种子。

en: The idea is that we are taking more out of what you might call the planet's environmental bank balance than it can sustain; we are living beyond our ecological means. (30 words)
cn: 其观点是，我们从地球的环境银行余额中提取的超过了它所能承受的；我们正在超出我们的生态承受能力。

en: One recent study attempted to calculate the extent of this 'ecological overshoot of the human economy', and found that we are using 1.2 Earths'—worth of environmental goods and services—the implication being that at some point the debt will be called in, and all those services—the things which the planet does for us for free—will grind to a halt. (58 words)
cn: 最近的一项研究试图计算这种‘人类经济的生态超调’的程度，发现我们正在使用相当于1.2个地球的环境商品和服务——这意味着债务终将到期，所有这些服务——地球为我们免费做的事情——都将停止。

en: Whether this is right, and if so where and when the ecological axe will fall, is hard to determine with any precision—which is why governments and financial institutions are only beginning to bring such risks into their economic calculations. (39 words)
cn: 这是否正确，如果是，生态危机将在何时何地降临，都难以精确判断——这就是为什么政府和金融机构才刚刚开始将此类风险纳入其经济计算之中。

en: It is also the reason why development agencies are not united in their view of environmental issues; while some, like the WRI, maintain that environmental progress needs to go hand-in-hand with economic development, others argue that the priority is to build a thriving economy, and then use the wealth created to tackle environmental degradation. (54 words)
cn: 这也是发展机构在环境问题上意见不统一的原因；虽然像世界资源研究所这样的机构坚持认为环境进步需要与经济发展齐头并进，但另一些机构则认为，优先事项是建立繁荣的经济，然后用创造的财富来解决环境退化问题。

en: This view assumes that rich societies will invest in environmental care. (11 words)
cn: 这种观点假设富裕社会将在环境保护上投资。

en: But is this right? (4 words)
cn: 但这正确吗？

en: Do things get better or worse as we get richer? (10 words)
cn: 当我们变得更富有时，情况会变得更好还是更糟？

en: Here the Stockholm declaration is ambiguous. (6 words)
cn: 在这方面，斯德哥尔摩宣言是模棱两可的。

en: 'In the developing countries,' it says, 'most of the environmental problems are caused by under-development.' (15 words)
cn: 它说：‘在发展中国家，大多数环境问题是由不发达造成的。’

en: So it is saying that economic development should make for a cleaner world? (13 words)
cn: 所以它是在说经济发展应该带来一个更清洁的世界？

en: Not necessarily; 'In the industrialised countries, environmental problems are generally related to industrialisation and technological development,' it continues. (18 words)
cn: 不一定；它接着说：‘在工业化国家，环境问题通常与工业化和技术发展有关。’

en: In other words, poor and rich both over-exploit the natural world, but for different reasons. (15 words)
cn: 换句话说，贫穷和富裕国家都过度开发自然界，但原因不同。

en: It's simply not true that economic growth will surely make our world cleaner. (13 words)
cn: 经济增长必定会使我们的世界更清洁这种说法根本不对。

en: Clearly, richer societies are able to provide environmental improvements which lie well beyond the reach of poorer communities. (18 words)
cn: 显然，较富裕的社会能够提供远远超出较贫穷社区能力范围的环境改善。

en: Citizens of wealthy nations demand national parks, clean rivers, clean air and poison-free food. (14 words)
cn: 富裕国家的公民要求国家公园、清洁的河流、清洁的空气和无毒食品。

en: They, however, use far more natural resources—fuel, water and building materials. (11 words)
cn: 然而，他们也消耗更多的自然资源——燃料、水和建筑材料。

en: A case can be made that rich nations export environmental problems, the most graphic example being climate change. (18 words)
cn: 可以提出一种观点认为富裕国家输出环境问题，最生动的例子就是气候变化。

en: As a country's wealth grows, so do its greenhouse gas emissions. (11 words)
cn: 随着一个国家财富的增长，其温室气体排放量也在增加。

en: The figures available will not be completely accurate. (8 words)
cn: 现有数据不会完全准确。

en: Measuring emissions is not a precise science, particularly when it comes to issues surrounding land use; not all nations have released up-to-date data, and in any case, emissions from some sectors such as aviation are not included in national statistics. (40 words)
cn: 测量排放不是一门精确的科学，尤其是在涉及土地使用的问题上；并非所有国家都发布了最新数据，而且无论如何，航空等某些部门的排放量并未被纳入国家统计。

en: But the data is exact enough for a clear trend to be easily discernible. (14 words)
cn: 但这些数据足够精确，足以让人清楚地辨别出一个明显的趋势。

en: As countries become richer, they produce more greenhouse gases; and the impact of those gases will fall primarily in poor parts of the world. (24 words)
cn: 随着国家变得更加富裕，它们产生更多的温室气体；而这些气体的影响将主要落在世界的贫困地区。

en: Wealth is not, of course, the only factor involved. (9 words)
cn: 当然，财富不是唯一的相关因素。

en: The average Norwegian is better off than the average US citizen, but contributes about half as much to climate change. (20 words)
cn: 普通的挪威人比普通的美国公民更富裕，但对气候变化的贡献大约只有美国人的一半。

en: But could Norway keep its standard of living and yet cut its emissions to Moroccan or even Ethiopian levels? (19 words)
cn: 但是，挪威能否保持其生活水平，同时将其排放量削减到摩洛哥甚至埃塞俄比亚的水平？

en: That question, repeated across a dozen environmental issues and across our diverse planet, is what will ultimately determine whether the human race is living beyond its ecological means as it pursues economic revival. (33 words)
cn: 这个问题，在十几个环境问题和我们多样化的星球上反复出现，将最终决定人类在追求经济复兴的过程中是否正在超出其生态承受能力。

en: Interactive television advertising, which allows viewers to use their remote controls to click on advertisements, has been pushed for years. (20 words)
cn: 允许观众使用遥控器点击广告的互动电视广告已经推广多年。

en: Nearly a decade ago it was predicted that viewers of 'Friends', a popular situation comedy, would soon be able to purchase a sweater like Jennifer Aniston's with a few taps on their remote control. (34 words)
cn: 近十年前，有人预测热门情景喜剧《老友记》的观众很快就能通过遥控器点几下就能买到像詹妮弗·安妮斯顿穿的那种毛衣。

en: 'It's been the year of interactive television advertising for the last ten or twelve years,' says Colin Dixon of a digital-media consultancy. (22 words)
cn: 数字媒体咨询公司的科林·迪克森说：‘过去十到十二年里，每一年都是互动电视广告之年。’

en: So the news that Cablevision, an American cable company, was rolling out interactive advertisements to all its customers on October 6th was greeted with some skepticism. (26 words)
cn: 因此，美国有线电视公司Cablevision于10月6日向所有客户推出互动广告的消息受到了一些质疑。

en: During commercials, an overlay will appear at the bottom of the screen, prompting viewers to press a button to request a free sample or order a catalogue. (27 words)
cn: 在广告期间，屏幕底部会出现一个覆盖层，提示观众按一个按钮来索取免费样品或订购目录。

en: Cablevision hopes to allow customers to buy things with their remote controls early next year. (15 words)
cn: Cablevision希望明年初能让客户用遥控器购买商品。

en: Television advertising could do with a boost. (7 words)
cn: 电视广告需要提振。

en: Spending fell by 10% in the first half of the year. (11 words)
cn: 今年上半年广告支出下降了10%。

en: The popularization of digital video recorders has caused advertisers to worry that their commercials will be skipped. (17 words)
cn: 数字录像机的普及使广告商担心他们的广告会被跳过。

en: Some are turning to the Internet, which is cheaper and offers concrete measurements like click-through rates—especially important at a time when marketing budgets are tight. (25 words)
cn: 一些广告商正转向互联网，互联网更便宜，并提供像点击率这样的具体衡量标准——这在营销预算紧张的时候尤其重要。

en: With the launch of interactive advertising, 'many of the dollars that went to the Internet will come back to the TV,' says David Kline of Cablevision. (26 words)
cn: Cablevision的大卫·克莱恩说：‘随着互动广告的推出，许多流向互联网的钱将回到电视。’

en: Or so the industry hopes. (5 words)
cn: 至少该行业是这么希望的。

en: In theory, interactive advertising can engage viewers in a way that 30-second spots do not. (15 words)
cn: 理论上，互动广告能以30秒广告无法做到的方式吸引观众。

en: Unilever recently ran an interactive campaign for its Axe deodorant, which kept viewers engaged for more than three minutes on average. (21 words)
cn: 联合利华最近为其Axe除臭剂开展了一次互动活动，使观众平均参与时间超过三分钟。

en: The amount spent on interactive advertising on television is still small. (11 words)
cn: 电视互动广告的投入仍然很少。

en: Magna, an advertising agency, reckons it will be worth about $138 million this year. (14 words)
cn: 广告公司Magna估计今年其价值约为1.38亿美元。

en: That falls far short of the billions of dollars people once expected it to generate. (15 words)
cn: 这远远低于人们曾经期望它能产生的数十亿美元。

en: But DirecTV, Comcast and Time Warner Cable have all invested in it. (12 words)
cn: 但DirecTV、Comcast和时代华纳有线都对此进行了投资。

en: A new effort led by Canoe Ventures, a coalition of leading cable providers, aims to make interactive advertising available across America later this year. (24 words)
cn: 由主要有线电视供应商联盟Canoe Ventures牵头的一项新努力，旨在今年晚些时候在美国全境推出互动广告。

en: BrightLine iTV, which designs and sells interactive ads, says interest has surged; it expects its revenues almost to triple this year. (21 words)
cn: 设计销售互动广告的BrightLine iTV表示，兴趣激增；预计今年收入几乎翻三倍。

en: BSkyB, Britain's biggest satellite-television service, already provides 9 million customers with interactive ads. (13 words)
cn: 英国最大的卫星电视服务商BSkyB已经为900万客户提供互动广告。

en: Yet there are doubts whether people watching television, a 'lean back' medium, crave interaction. (14 words)
cn: 然而，人们怀疑看电视这种‘后仰式’媒介的观众是否渴望互动。

en: Click-through rates have been high so far, but that may be a result of the novelty. (16 words)
cn: 迄今为止，点击率一直很高，但这可能是新鲜感的结果。

en: Interactive ads and viewers might not go well together. (9 words)
cn: 互动广告和观众可能并不相配。

en: What can be done about mass unemployment? (7 words)
cn: 大规模失业该怎么办？

en: All the wise heads agree: there're no quick or easy answers. (11 words)
cn: 所有聪明人都同意：没有快速或简单的答案。

en: There's work to be done, but workers aren't ready to do it—they're in the wrong places, or they have the wrong skills. (22 words)
cn: 有工作要做，但工人没有准备好去做——他们不在合适的地方，或者他们不具备合适的技能。

en: Our problems are 'structural,' and will take many years to solve. (11 words)
cn: 我们的问题是‘结构性的’，需要很多年才能解决。

en: But don't bother asking for evidence that justifies this bleak view. (11 words)
cn: 但不必费心去找支持这种悲观观点的证据。

en: There isn't any. (3 words)
cn: 根本不存在。

en: On the contrary, all the facts suggest that high unemployment in America is the result of inadequate demand. (18 words)
cn: 相反，所有事实都表明美国的高失业率是需求不足的结果。

en: Saying that there're no easy answers sounds wise, but it's actually foolish: our unemployment crisis could be cured very quickly if we had the intellectual clarity and political will to act. (31 words)
cn: 说没有简单的答案听起来很明智，但实际上很愚蠢：如果我们有清晰的思路和采取行动的政治意愿，我们的失业危机可以很快解决。

en: In other words, structural unemployment is a fake problem, which mainly serves as an excuse for not pursuing real solutions. (20 words)
cn: 换句话说，结构性失业是一个虚假的问题，主要用作不寻求真正解决方案的借口。

en: The fact is job openings have plunged in every major sector, while the number of workers forced into part-time employment in almost all industries has soared. (26 words)
cn: 事实是，每个主要行业的职位空缺都大幅下降，而几乎所有行业被迫从事兼职工作的工人数量却飙升。

en: Unemployment has surged in every major occupational category. (8 words)
cn: 每个主要职业类别的失业率都激增。

en: Only three states, with a combined population not much larger than that of Brooklyn, have unemployment rates below 5%. (19 words)
cn: 只有三个州（总人口不超过布鲁克林区多少）的失业率低于5%。

en: So the evidence contradicts the claim that we're mainly suffering from structural unemployment. (13 words)
cn: 因此，证据与‘我们主要遭受的是结构性失业’的说法相矛盾。

en: Why, then, has this claim become so popular? (8 words)
cn: 那么，为什么这种说法变得如此流行？

en: Part of the answer is that this is what always happens during periods of high unemployment—in part because experts and analysts believe that declaring the problem deeply rooted, with no easy answers, makes them sound serious. (36 words)
cn: 部分答案是，这在高失业率时期总是会发生——部分原因是专家和分析师认为，宣称问题根深蒂固、没有简单答案，会让他们听起来很严肃。

en: I've been looking at what self-proclaimed experts were saying about unemployment during the Great Depression: it was almost identical to what very Serious People are saying now. (27 words)
cn: 我一直在研究那些自称的专家在大萧条时期关于失业的说法：这与现在那些‘非常严肃的人’所说的几乎相同。

en: Unemployment cannot be brought down rapidly, declared one 1935 analysis, because the workforce is 'unadaptable and untrained. (17 words)
cn: 1935年的一项分析宣称，失业率无法迅速下降，因为劳动力‘不适应且未经培训’。

en: It cannot respond to the opportunities which industry may offer.' (10 words)
cn: ‘它无法对工业可能提供的机会做出反应。’

en: A few years later, a large defense buildup finally provided a fiscal stimulus adequate to the economy's needs—and suddenly industry was eager to employ those 'unadaptable and untrained' workers. (29 words)
cn: 几年后，大规模的国防建设终于提供了足以满足经济需求的财政刺激——突然间，工业界急于雇用那些‘不适应且未经培训’的工人。

en: But now, as then, powerful forces are ideologically opposed to the whole idea of government action on a sufficient scale to jump-start the economy. (24 words)
cn: 但现在和那时一样，强大的力量在意识形态上反对政府采取足够规模的行动来启动经济。

en: And that, fundamentally, is why claims that we face huge structural problems have been multiplying: they offer a reason to do nothing about the mass unemployment that is crippling our economy and our society. (34 words)
cn: 而这从根本上解释了为什么我们面临巨大结构性问题的说法越来越多：它们为不采取行动解决正在削弱我们经济和社会的失业问题提供了一个理由。

en: So what you need to know is that there's no evidence whatsoever to back these claims. (16 words)
cn: 所以你需要知道的是，没有任何证据支持这些说法。

en: We aren't suffering from a shortage of needed skills; we're suffering from a lack of policy resolve. (17 words)
cn: 我们不是在遭受所需技能的短缺；我们是在遭受政策决心的缺乏。

en: As I said, structural unemployment isn't a real problem, it's an excuse—a reason not to act on America's problems at a time when action is desperately needed. (27 words)
cn: 正如我所说，结构性失业不是真正的问题，而是一个借口——在迫切需要采取行动的时候，不采取行动解决美国问题的理由。

en: Pursuing a career is an essential part of adolescent development. (10 words)
cn: 追求职业是青少年发展的重要组成部分。

en: 'The adolescent becomes an adult when he undertakes a real job.' (11 words)
cn: ‘青少年在承担真正的工作时才成为成年人。’

en: To cognitive researchers like Piaget, adulthood meant the beginning of an occupation. (12 words)
cn: 对皮亚杰等认知研究者来说，成年意味着职业生涯的开始。

en: Piaget argued that once adolescents enter the world of work, their newly acquired ability to form hypotheses allows them to create representations that are too ideal. (26 words)
cn: 皮亚杰认为，一旦青少年进入职场，他们新获得的提出假设的能力使他们能够创造出过于理想化的图景。

en: The existence of such ideals, without the tempering of the reality of a job or profession, rapidly leads adolescents to become intolerant of the non-idealistic world and to press for reform in a characteristically adolescent way. (36 words)
cn: 这些理想的存在，若未经工作或职业现实的磨炼，会迅速导致青少年变得对非理想化的世界不宽容，并以典型的青少年方式推动改革。

en: Piaget said: 'True adaptation to society comes automatically when the adolescent reformer attempts to put his ideas to work.' (19 words)
cn: 皮亚杰说：‘当青少年改革者试图将他的想法付诸实践时，对社会的真正适应就会自动到来。’

en: Of course, youthful idealism is often courageous, and no one likes to give up dreams. (15 words)
cn: 当然，青春期的理想主义常常是勇敢的，没有人喜欢放弃梦想。

en: Perhaps, taken slightly out of context, Piaget's statement seems harsh. (10 words)
cn: 也许，稍微脱离语境来看，皮亚杰的言论显得苛刻。

en: What he was emphasizing, however, is the way reality can modify idealistic views. (13 words)
cn: 然而，他所强调的是现实能够修正理想主义观点的方式。

en: Some people refer to such modification as maturity. (8 words)
cn: 有些人把这种修正称为成熟。

en: Piaget argued that attaining and accepting a vocation is one of the best ways to modify idealized views and to mature. (21 words)
cn: 皮亚杰认为，获得并接受一种职业是修正理想化观点和走向成熟的最佳途径之一。

en: As careers and vocations become less available during times of recession, adolescents may be especially hard hit. (17 words)
cn: 在经济衰退时期，当职业和工作机会减少时，青少年可能受到的打击尤其严重。

en: Such difficult economic times may leave many adolescents confused about their roles in society. (14 words)
cn: 这样艰难的经济时期可能会让许多青少年对社会中的角色感到困惑。

en: For this reason, community interventions and government job programs that offer summer and vacation work are not only economically beneficial but also help to stimulate the adolescent's sense of worth. (30 words)
cn: 因此，提供暑期和假期工作的社区干预措施和政府就业计划不仅在经济上有益，而且有助于激发青少年的自我价值感。

en: It turns out today's teenagers aren't so scary after all. (10 words)
cn: 事实证明，如今的青少年毕竟没那么可怕。

en: Results of USA WEEKEND's Teens & Parents survey reveal a generation of young people who get along well with their parents and approve of the way they're being raised. (29 words)
cn: 《美国周末》的青少年与父母调查结果显示，这一代年轻人与父母相处融洽，并认可他们的抚养方式。

en: They think of their parents with affection and respect. (9 words)
cn: 他们怀着爱和尊重看待父母。

en: They speak with Mom or Dad when they have a problem. (11 words)
cn: 遇到问题时他们会和父母商量。

en: Most feel that their parents understand them, and they believe their family is the No.1 priority in their parents' lives. (20 words)
cn: 大多数人觉得父母理解他们，并且相信家庭是父母生活中的头等大事。

en: Many even think their parents are cool! (7 words)
cn: 许多人甚至认为他们的父母很酷！

en: Although more than a third have an object in their rooms they would like to keep secret from their parents, rarely is it anything more alarming than a diary or off-color book or CD. (34 words)
cn: 尽管超过三分之一的人房间里有一件不想让父母知道的物品，但很少有什么比日记或低俗的书或CD更令人担忧的了。

en: Such results may seem surprising against the background of shocking incidents that color the way the mass media portray the young. (21 words)
cn: 在大众媒体描绘年轻人的方式被令人震惊的事件所渲染的背景下，这样的结果似乎令人惊讶。

en: In October 2000, the same month the survey was taken, the Washington-based Center for Media and Public Affairs wrote in its publication Media Monitor that, in a recent month of TV news coverage of American youth, just 2% of teens were shown at home, and just 1% were portrayed in a work setting. (53 words)
cn: 2000年10月，也就是进行调查的同一个月，总部位于华盛顿的媒体与公共事务中心在其出版物《媒体监测》中写道，在最近一个月有关美国青年的电视新闻报道中，只有2%的青少年出现在家庭场景中，只有1%被描绘在工作环境中。

en: In contrast, the criminal justice system accounted for nearly one out of every five visual backgrounds. (16 words)
cn: 相比之下，刑事司法系统几乎占每五个视觉背景中的一个。

en: No wonder parents worry their own kids might spin out of control once they hit the turbulent waters of adolescence. (20 words)
cn: 难怪父母担心自己的孩子一旦进入动荡的青春期会失控。

en: The overall facts ought to reassure us. (7 words)
cn: 总体事实应该让我们放心。

en: The survey shows us that today's teens are affectionate, sensible and far happier than the angry and tortured souls that have been painted for us by stereotypes. (27 words)
cn: 调查显示，如今的青少年充满爱心、通情达理，比刻板印象所描绘的愤怒和痛苦的形象快乐得多。

en: From other sources, we also know teenage crime, drug abuse and premarital sex are in general decline. (17 words)
cn: 从其他渠道我们得知，青少年犯罪、吸毒和婚前性行为总体呈下降趋势。

en: We of course need to pay attention to youngsters who are filled with discontent and hostility, but we should not allow these extreme cases to distort our view of most young people. (32 words)
cn: 我们当然需要关注那些充满不满和敌意的年轻人，但不应让这些极端案例扭曲我们对大多数年轻人的看法。

en: My own research at the Stanford Center on Adolescence uses in-depth interviews with small samples of youngsters rather than large-scale surveys. (21 words)
cn: 我自己在斯坦福大学青少年研究中心的研究采用了对小样本年轻人的深入访谈，而非大规模调查。

en: Still, in my studies and others I have read, I find the same patterns as in USA WEEKEND's survey. (19 words)
cn: 尽管如此，在我自己的研究和阅读的其他研究中，我发现了与《美国周末》调查相同的模式。

en: Today's teenagers admire their parents and welcome parental guidance about important matters such as career choice—though certainly not Mom and Dad's advice on matters of personal taste, such as music or fashion. (32 words)
cn: 如今的青少年敬佩父母，并欢迎父母在职业选择等重要问题上的指导——尽管当然不包括父母在个人品味（如音乐或时尚）方面的建议。

en: When we ask teens to choose a hero, they usually select an older family member rather than a remote public figure. (21 words)
cn: 当我们让青少年选择一位英雄时，他们通常会选择一位年长的家庭成员，而不是遥远的公众人物。

en: Most teens say they enjoy the company of both parents and friends. (12 words)
cn: 大多数青少年表示他们喜欢与父母和朋友在一起。

en: Contrary to some stereotypes, most adolescents believe they must be tolerant of differences among individuals (though they do not always find this easy in the cliquish environment of high school). (30 words)
cn: 与某些刻板印象相反，大多数青少年认为他们必须容忍个体之间的差异（尽管在高中拉帮结派的环境中他们并不总是觉得这很容易）。

en: Many of them volunteer for community service with disadvantaged people. (10 words)
cn: 他们中的许多人自愿为弱势群体提供社区服务。

en: One prevalent quality we have found in teens' statements about themselves, their friends and their families is a strikingly positive emotional tone. (22 words)
cn: 我们在青少年关于自己、朋友和家庭的陈述中发现的一个普遍特征是显著积极的情绪基调。

en: By and large, these are very nice kids, and as the band The Who used to sing, 'The kids are alright.' (21 words)
cn: 总的来说，这些孩子非常不错，正如The Who乐队曾经唱的那样：‘孩子们没问题。’

en: How much is today's spirit of harmony a change from our more turbulent past? (14 words)
cn: 今天的和谐精神与我们更为动荡的过去相比有多大变化？

en: A mere generation ago, parent-child relations were described as 'the generation gap'. (12 words)
cn: 仅在一代人之前，亲子关系还被描述为‘代沟’。

en: Yet even then reports of widespread youth rebellion were overdone; most kids in the '60s and '70s shared their parents' basic values. (22 words)
cn: 然而即使在那时，关于普遍青年反叛的报道也被夸大了；60年代和70年代的大多数孩子与父母有共同的价值观。

en: Still, it is true that American families are growing closer at the dawn of this new millennium. (17 words)
cn: 不过，美国家庭在新千年之初确实变得更加亲密。

en: Perhaps there is less to fight about, with the country in a period of tranquility and the dangers of drug abuse and other unwholesome behavior well known. (27 words)
cn: 也许是因为国家处于和平时期，吸毒和其他不良行为的危险众所周知，所以可争吵的事情少了。

en: Perhaps in the face of impersonal and intimidating globalization, a young person's family feels more like a friendly haven than an oppressive trap. (23 words)
cn: 也许面对非个人的、令人生畏的全球化，年轻人的家庭更像一个友好的港湾，而不是一个压抑的陷阱。

en: And perhaps parents are acting more like parents than in the recent past. (13 words)
cn: 也许父母比最近过去表现得更像父母。

en: Within just the past five years, I have noticed parents returning to a belief that teenagers need the guidance of elders rather than the liberal 'anything goes' mode of child-rearing that became popular in the second half of the 20th century. (41 words)
cn: 就在过去五年里，我注意到父母重新相信青少年需要长辈的指导，而不是20世纪下半叶流行的放任‘什么都行’的育儿模式。

en: But missing from all these data is the sense that today's young care very much about their country, about the broader civic and political environment, or about the future of their society. (32 words)
cn: 但所有这些数据中缺失的是：如今的年轻人非常关心自己的国家、更广泛的公民和政治环境，或他们社会的未来的感觉。

en: They seem to be turning inward—generally in a pro-social manner, certainly with positive benefits for intimate relationships, but too often at the expense of a connection with the present and future world beyond, including the society they will one day inherit. (41 words)
cn: 他们似乎在转向内心——通常是以亲社会的方式，当然对亲密关系有积极的好处，但往往是以牺牲与超越当下的未来世界（包括他们终将继承的社会）的联系为代价。

en: Recently, we examined more than 400 essays on the 'laws of life' that teens from two communities had written as part of an educational program initiated by the John Templeton Foundation in Radnor, Pa. (34 words)
cn: 最近，我们审视了来自两个社区的青少年撰写的400多篇关于‘生活法则’的文章，这些文章是宾夕法尼亚州拉德诺的约翰·坦普尔顿基金会发起的一个教育项目的组成部分。

en: In those essays, and in follow-up interviews with a few of the teenagers, we found lots of insight, positive feeling and inspirational thinking. (23 words)
cn: 在这些文章中，以及在对一些青少年的后续采访中，我们发现了很多洞见、积极的情感和启发性的思考。

en: But we also found little interest in civic life beyond the tight circles of their family and immediate friends. (19 words)
cn: 但我们也发现他们对家庭和密友圈子之外的公民生活几乎没有兴趣。

en: For example, only one boy said he would like to be president when he grows up. (16 words)
cn: 例如，只有一个男孩说他长大后想当总统。

en: When I was in high school, dozens in my class alone would have answered differently. (15 words)
cn: 我上高中时，仅我们班就有几十个人会给出不同的答案。

en: In fact, other recent studies have found there has never been a time in American history when so small a proportion of young people have sought or accepted leadership roles in local civic organizations. (34 words)
cn: 事实上，其他近期研究发现，美国历史上从未有过这么少比例的年轻人寻求或接受地方公民组织中的领导角色。

en: It is also troubling that voting rates among our youngest eligible voters—18-to 24-year-olds—are way down: little more than one in four now go to the polls, even in national elections, compared with almost twice that many when 18-year-olds were first given the vote. (43 words)
cn: 同样令人不安的是，最年轻的合格选民（18至24岁）的投票率大幅下降：即使在国家选举中，现在也只有略多于四分之一的人去投票，而18岁刚获得投票权时，这一比例几乎是现在的两倍。

en: In our interviews, many students viewed politics with suspicion and distaste. (11 words)
cn: 在我们的采访中，许多学生对政治持怀疑和厌恶态度。

en: 'Most politicians are kind of crooked,' one student declared. (9 words)
cn: 一个学生宣称：‘大多数政客都有点不诚实。’

en: Another, discussing national politics, said, 'I feel like one person can't do that much, and I get the impression most people don't think a group of people can do that much.' (31 words)
cn: 另一个学生在讨论国家政治时说：‘我觉得一个人做不了那么多，而且我的印象是大多数人也不认为一群人能做那么多。’

en: Asked what they would like to change in the world, the students mentioned only personal concerns such as slowing down the pace of life, gaining good friends, becoming more spiritual, becoming either more materially successful or less materially oriented (depending on the student's values), and being more respectful of the Earth, animals and other people. (55 words)
cn: 当被问及他们想改变世界什么时，学生们只提到了个人关切，如放慢生活节奏、交好朋友、变得更加有精神追求、要么更物质成功要么更少物质导向（取决于学生的价值观），以及更尊重地球、动物和他人。

en: One boy said, 'I'd rather be concentrating on artistic efforts than saving the world or something.' (16 words)
cn: 一个男孩说：‘我宁愿专注于艺术创作，而不是拯救世界什么的。’

en: It is fine and healthy for teens to cultivate their personal interests, and it is good news when young people enjoy harmonious relations with their family and friends. (28 words)
cn: 青少年培养个人兴趣是很好的、健康的，年轻人与家人和朋友关系和谐也是好消息。

en: But there is also a place in a young life for noble purposes that include a dedication to the broader society, a love of country and an aspiration to make their own leadership contributions. (34 words)
cn: 但年轻的生命中也应有崇高目标的位置，包括奉献于更广阔的社会、热爱祖国并渴望做出自己的领导贡献。

en: In the past, the young have eagerly participated in national service and civic affairs, often with lots of energy and idealism. (21 words)
cn: 过去，年轻人曾热切地参与国家服务和公民事务，常常充满活力和理想主义。

en: If this is not happening today, we should ask why. (10 words)
cn: 如果今天这种情况没有发生，我们应该问为什么。

en: Our society needs the full participation of its younger citizens if it is to continue to thrive. (17 words)
cn: 我们的社会要想继续繁荣，就需要年轻公民的充分参与。

en: We know the promise is there—this is a well-grounded, talented, warm-hearted group of youngsters. (14 words)
cn: 我们知道潜力是存在的——这是一群基础扎实、有才华、热心的年轻人。

en: We have everything to gain by encouraging them to explore the world beyond their immediate experience and to prepare themselves for their turn at shaping that world. (27 words)
cn: 鼓励他们探索直接经验之外的世界，并为自己塑造那个世界做好准备，我们会获益良多。

en: Manufacturers of products that claim to be environmentally friendly will face tighter rules on how they are advertised to consumers under changes proposed by the Federal Trade Commission. (28 words)
cn: 根据联邦贸易委员会提出的修改意见，声称环保产品的制造商将面临更严格的广告规则。

en: The commission's revised 'Green Guides' warn marketers against using labels that make broad claims, like 'eco-friendly'. (16 words)
cn: 委员会修订的‘绿色指南’警告营销人员不要使用像‘环保’这样笼统声称的标签。

en: Marketers must qualify their claims on the product packaging and limit them to a specific benefit, such as how much of the product is recycled. (25 words)
cn: 营销人员必须在产品包装上对其声称加以限定，并将其限制在具体好处上，例如产品有多少被回收。

en: 'This is really about trying to cut through the confusion that consumers have when they are buying a product and that businesses have when they are selling a product,' said Jon Leibowitz, chairman of the commission. (36 words)
cn: 委员会主席乔恩·莱博维茨说：‘这实际上是为了消除消费者购买产品时和企业销售产品时所面临的困惑。’

en: The revisions come at a time when green marketing is on the rise. (13 words)
cn: 修订正值绿色营销兴起之际。

en: According to a new study, the number of advertisements with green messages in mainstream magazines has risen since 1987, and peaked in 2008 at 10.4%. (25 words)
cn: 根据一项新研究，主流杂志中带有绿色信息的广告数量自1987年以来有所上升，并在2008年达到10.4%的峰值。

en: In 2009, the number dropped to 9%. (7 words)
cn: 2009年，这一数字降至9%。

en: But while the number of advertisements may have dipped, there has been a rapid spread of eco-labeling. (17 words)
cn: 但尽管广告数量可能有所下降，生态标签却在迅速普及。

en: There are both good and bad players in the eco-labeling game. (11 words)
cn: 在生态标签游戏中，有好的参与者也有坏的参与者。

en: In the last five years or so, there has been an explosion of green claims and environmental claims. (18 words)
cn: 在过去五年左右的时间里，绿色声明和环境声明呈爆炸式增长。

en: It is clear that consumers don't always know what they are getting. (12 words)
cn: 显然，消费者并不总是知道自己得到的是什么。

en: A handful of lawsuits have been filed in recent years against companies accused of using misleading environmental labels. (18 words)
cn: 近年来，已有少数针对被指控使用误导性环境标签的公司的诉讼。

en: In 2008 and 2009, class-action lawsuits were filed against SC Johnson for using 'Greenlist' labels on its cleaning products. (19 words)
cn: 2008年和2009年，庄臣公司因其清洁产品上使用‘Greenlist’标签而面临集体诉讼。

en: The lawsuits said that the label was misleading because it gave the impression that the products had been certified by a third party when the certification was the company's own. (30 words)
cn: 诉讼称，该标签具有误导性，因为它给人的印象是产品已获得第三方认证，而实际上是公司自己的认证。

en: 'We are very proud of our accomplishments under the Greenlist system and we believe that we will prevail in these cases,' Christopher Beard, director of public affairs for SC Johnson, said, while acknowledging that 'this has been an area that is difficult to navigate.' (44 words)
cn: 庄臣公司公共事务总监克里斯托弗·比尔德说：‘我们为在Greenlist体系下取得的成就感到非常自豪，相信我们会在这些案件中胜诉。’同时他也承认‘这是一个难以驾驭的领域’。

en: Companies have also taken it upon themselves to contest each other's green claims. (13 words)
cn: 公司也主动互相质疑对方的绿色声明。

en: David Mallen, associate director of the Council of Better Business Bureau, said in the last two years the organization had seen an increase in the number of claims companies were bringing against each other for false or misleading environmental product claims. (41 words)
cn: 商业改善局协会副主任戴维·马伦表示，在过去两年里，该组织发现公司之间因虚假或误导性环保产品声明而相互投诉的数量有所增加。

en: 'About once a week I have a client that will bring up a new certification I've never even heard of and I'm in this industry,' said Kevin Wilhelm, chief executive officer of Sustainable Business Consulting. (35 words)
cn: 可持续商业咨询公司首席执行官凯文·威廉说：‘大约每周都有一个客户会提出一种我从未听说过的认证，而我本身就是这个行业的。’

en: 'It's kind of a Wild West, anybody can claim themselves to be green.' (13 words)
cn: ‘这有点像狂野西部，任何人都可以声称自己是绿色的。’

en: Mr. Wilhelm said the excess of labels made it difficult for businesses and consumers to know which labels they should pay attention to. (23 words)
cn: 威廉先生表示，过多的标签使企业和消费者难以知道应该关注哪些标签。

en: America's education system has become less a ladder of opportunity than a structure to transmit inequality from one generation to the next. (22 words)
cn: 美国的教育制度与其说是机会的阶梯，不如说是将不平等代代相传的结构。

en: That's why school reform is so critical. (7 words)
cn: 这就是为什么学校改革如此关键。

en: This is an issue of equality, opportunity and national conscience. (10 words)
cn: 这是一个关乎平等、机会和民族良知的问题。

en: It's not just about education, but about poverty and justice. (10 words)
cn: 这不仅仅是教育问题，更是贫困和正义问题。

en: It's true that the main reason inner-city schools do poorly isn't teachers' unions, but poverty. (15 words)
cn: 确实，市中心学校表现不佳的主要原因不是教师工会，而是贫困。

en: Southern states without strong teachers' unions have schools at least as awful as those in union states. (17 words)
cn: 没有强大教师工会的南部各州的学校至少和工会各州的学校一样糟糕。

en: Some Chicago teachers seem to think that they shouldn't be held accountable until poverty is solved. (16 words)
cn: 一些芝加哥教师似乎认为，在贫困问题解决之前，他们不应被追究责任。

en: There're steps we can take that would make some difference, and Mayor Rahm Emanuel is trying some of them—yet the union is resisting. (23 words)
cn: 我们可以采取一些步骤来产生一些影响，市长拉姆·伊曼纽尔正在尝试其中一些——但工会正在抵制。

en: I'd be sympathetic if the union focused solely on higher compensation. (11 words)
cn: 如果工会只专注于提高薪酬，我会表示同情。

en: Teachers need to be much better paid to attract the best college graduates to the nation's worst schools. (18 words)
cn: 教师需要更高的薪酬，才能吸引最优秀的大学毕业生到全国最差的学校。

en: But instead, the Chicago union seems to be using its political capital primarily to protect weak performers. (17 words)
cn: 但相反，芝加哥工会似乎主要是在利用其政治资本保护表现不佳的教师。

en: There's solid evidence that there are huge differences in the effectiveness of teachers. (13 words)
cn: 有确凿证据表明，教师的教学效果存在巨大差异。

en: The gold standard study by Harvard and Columbia University scholars found that even in high-poverty schools, teachers consistently had a huge positive or negative impact. (25 words)
cn: 哈佛大学和哥伦比亚大学学者的黄金标准研究发现，即使在高度贫困的学校，教师也始终产生巨大的正面或负面影响。

en: Get a bottom 1% teacher, and the effect is the same as if a child misses 40% of the school year. (21 words)
cn: 如果遇到垫底1%的教师，其影响相当于孩子缺课一整学年的40%。

en: Get a teacher from the top 20%, and it's as if a child has gone to school for an extra month or two. (23 words)
cn: 如果遇到前20%的教师，则相当于孩子多上了一两个月的学。

en: The study found that strong teachers in the fourth through eighth grades raised the skills of their students in ways that would last for decades. (25 words)
cn: 研究发现，四至八年级的优秀教师提高学生技能的方式会持续数十年。

en: Just having a strong teacher for one elementary year left pupils a bit less likely to become mothers as teenagers, a bit more likely to go to college and earning more money at age 28. (35 words)
cn: 仅仅在小学一年里有一位优秀教师，就会使学生成为少女妈妈的可能性略低，上大学的可能性略高，并在28岁时挣更多钱。

en: How does one figure out who is a weak teacher? (10 words)
cn: 如何判断谁是差劲的老师？

en: Yes, that's a challenge. (4 words)
cn: 是的，那是个挑战。

en: But researchers are improving systems to measure a teacher's performance throughout the year, and with three years of data, it's usually possible to tell which teachers are failing. (28 words)
cn: 但研究人员正在改进系统来衡量教师全年的表现，有了三年的数据，通常可以判断哪些教师是不合格的。

en: Unfortunately, the union in Chicago is insisting that teachers who are laid off—often for being ineffective—should get priority in new hiring. (21 words)
cn: 不幸的是，芝加哥工会坚持认为，被解雇的教师（通常是因为效率低下）应在新的招聘中获得优先权。

en: That's an insult to students. (5 words)
cn: 那是对学生的侮辱。

en: Teaching is so important that it should be like other professions, with high pay and good working conditions but few job protections for bottom performers. (25 words)
cn: 教学如此重要，应该像其他职业一样，薪酬高、工作条件好，但对表现最差的教师几乎没有工作保护。

en: This isn't a battle between garment workers and greedy bosses. (10 words)
cn: 这不是服装工人和贪婪老板之间的斗争。

en: The central figures in the Chicago schools strike are neither strikers nor managers but 350,000 children. (16 words)
cn: 芝加哥学校罢工的核心人物既不是罢工者也不是管理者，而是35万儿童。

en: Protecting the union demand sacrifices those students, in effect turning a blind eye to the injustice in the education system. (20 words)
cn: 保护工会的要求牺牲了这些学生，实际上是对教育体系中的不公正视而不见。

en: The robotics revolution is set to bring humans face to face with an old fear—man-made creations as smart and capable as we are but without a moral compass. (28 words)
cn: 机器人革命将使人类直面一个古老的恐惧——人造的创造物像我们一样聪明能干，却没有道德指南针。

en: As robots take on ever more complex roles, the question naturally arises: Who will be responsible when they do something wrong? (21 words)
cn: 随着机器人承担越来越复杂的角色，问题自然会出现：当它们做错事时，谁将负责？

en: Manufacturers? (1 words)
cn: 制造商？

en: Users? (1 words)
cn: 用户？

en: Software writers? (2 words)
cn: 软件编写者？

en: The answer depends on the robot. (6 words)
cn: 答案取决于机器人。

en: Robots already save us time, money and energy. (8 words)
cn: 机器人已经为我们节省了时间、金钱和精力。

en: In the future, they will improve our health care, social welfare and standard of living. (15 words)
cn: 在未来，它们将改善我们的医疗保健、社会福利和生活水平。

en: The combination of computational power and engineering advances will eventually enable lower-cost in-home care for the disabled, widespread use of driverless cars that may reduce drunk-and distracted-driving accidents and countless home and service-industry uses for robots, from street cleaning to food preparation. (42 words)
cn: 计算能力和工程进步的结合最终将实现为残疾人提供更低成本的家庭护理、广泛使用自动驾驶汽车以减少酒驾和分心驾驶事故，以及机器人在无数家庭和服务行业中的应用，从街道清洁到食品准备。

en: But there are bound to be problems. (7 words)
cn: 但必定会有问题。

en: Robot cars will crash. (4 words)
cn: 机器人汽车会撞车。

en: A drone operator will invade someone's privacy. (7 words)
cn: 无人机操作员会侵犯他人的隐私。

en: A robotic lawn mower will run over a neighbor's cat. (10 words)
cn: 机器人割草机会碾过邻居的猫。

en: Juries sympathetic to the victims of machines will punish entrepreneurs with company-crushing penalties and damages. (15 words)
cn: 同情机器受害者的陪审团将用足以压垮公司的罚款和赔偿金来惩罚企业家。

en: What should governments do to protect people while preserving space for innovation? (12 words)
cn: 政府应该在为创新保留空间的同时，做些什么来保护人民？

en: Big, complicated systems on which much public safety depends, like driverless cars, should be built, programmed and sold by manufacturers who take responsibility for ensuring safety and are liable for accidents. (31 words)
cn: 像自动驾驶汽车这样许多公共安全所依赖的庞大、复杂的系统，应该由对确保安全负责并对事故承担责任的制造商来建造、编程和销售。

en: Governments should set safety requirements and then let insurers price the risk of the robots based on the manufacturer's driving record, not the passenger's. (24 words)
cn: 政府应该制定安全要求，然后让保险公司根据制造商的驾驶记录（而不是乘客的）来为机器人的风险定价。

en: Americans are deeply concerned about the relentless rise in health care costs and health insurance premiums. (16 words)
cn: 美国人对医疗费用和健康保险费持续上涨深感担忧。

en: They need to know if reform will help solve the problem. (11 words)
cn: 他们需要知道改革是否有助于解决这个问题。

en: The answer is that no one has an easy fix for rising medical costs. (14 words)
cn: 答案是，没有人对不断上涨的医疗费用有简单的解决办法。

en: The fundamental fix—reshaping how care is delivered and how doctors are paid in a wasteful, abnormal system—is likely to be achieved only through trial and error and incremental gains. (29 words)
cn: 根本性的解决办法——在一个浪费的、不正常的体系中重塑医疗服务的提供方式和医生的薪酬方式——很可能只能通过反复试验和渐进式进展来实现。

en: The good news is that a bill just approved by the House and a bill approved by the Senate Finance Committee would implement or test many reforms that should help slow the rise in medical costs over the long term. (40 words)
cn: 好消息是，众议院刚刚批准的一项法案和参议院财政委员会批准的一项法案将实施或测试许多改革，这些改革应有助于长期减缓医疗费用的上涨。

en: As a report in The New England Journal of Medicine concluded, 'Pretty much every proposed innovation found in the health policy literature these days is contained in these measures.' (29 words)
cn: 正如《新英格兰医学杂志》的一份报告总结的那样：‘如今健康政策文献中几乎所有提出的创新都包含在这些措施中。’

en: Medical spending, which typically rises faster than wages and the overall economy, is propelled by two things: the high prices charged for medical services in this country and the volume of unnecessary care delivered by doctors and hospitals, which often perform a lot more tests and treatments than a patient really needs. (52 words)
cn: 医疗支出通常比工资和整体经济增长得更快，它由两件事推动：这个国家对医疗服务收取的高价，以及医生和医院提供的不必要的护理数量——他们经常进行比病人实际需要多得多的检查和治疗。

en: Here are some of the important proposals in the House and Senate bills to try to address those problems, and why it is hard to know how well they will work. (31 words)
cn: 以下是众议院和参议院法案中试图解决这些问题的一些重要提案，以及为什么很难知道它们会有多有效。

en: Both bills would reduce the rate of growth in annual Medicare payments to hospitals, nursing homes and other providers by amounts comparable to the productivity savings routinely made in other industries with the help of new technologies and new ways to organize work. (43 words)
cn: 两项法案都将减少医疗保险对医院、疗养院和其他提供者的年度支付增长率，其幅度相当于其他行业在新技术和新工作组织方式的帮助下通常实现的生产率节省。

en: This proposal could save Medicare more than $100 billion over the next decade. (13 words)
cn: 这项提案可以在未来十年为医疗保险节省超过1000亿美元。

en: If private plans demanded similar productivity savings from providers, and refused to let providers shift additional costs to them, the savings could be much larger. (25 words)
cn: 如果私人保险计划也要求提供者实现类似的生产率节省，并且拒绝让提供者将额外成本转嫁给他们，节省的金额可能会大得多。

en: Critics say Congress will give in to lobbyists and let inefficient providers off the hook. (15 words)
cn: 批评者说，国会将向游说者让步，让效率低下的提供者逃脱责任。

en: That is far less likely to happen if Congress also adopts strong 'pay-go' rules requiring that any increase in payments to providers be offset by new taxes or budget cuts. (30 words)
cn: 如果国会同时采取强有力的‘现收现付’规则——要求任何对提供者支付的增加都必须由新税收或预算削减来抵消——这种情况就更不可能发生了。

en: The Senate Finance bill would impose an excise tax on health insurance plans that cost more than $8,000 for an individual or $21,000 for a family. (26 words)
cn: 参议院财政法案将对个人保费超过8000美元或家庭保费超过21000美元的健康保险计划征收消费税。

en: It would most likely cause insurers to redesign plans to fall beneath the threshold. (14 words)
cn: 这很可能会导致保险公司重新设计计划，使其低于门槛。

en: Enrollees would have to pay more money for many services out of their own pockets, and that would encourage them to think twice about whether an expensive or redundant test was worth it. (33 words)
cn: 参保人将不得不为许多服务自掏腰包支付更多的钱，这将鼓励他们三思而后行，考虑昂贵或多余的检查是否值得。

en: Economists project that most employers would shift money from expensive health benefits into wages. (14 words)
cn: 经济学家预测，大多数雇主会将资金从昂贵的健康福利转向工资。

en: The House bill has no similar tax. (7 words)
cn: 众议院法案没有类似的税收。

en: The final legislation should. (4 words)
cn: 最终立法应该包含。

en: Any doctor who has wrestled with multiple forms from different insurers, or patients who have tried to understand their own parade of statements, know that simplification ought to save money. (30 words)
cn: 任何与不同保险公司的多种表格打过交道的医生，或试图理解自己一大堆账单的病人，都知道简化应该能省钱。

en: When the health insurance industry was still cooperating in reform efforts, its trade group offered to provide standardized forms for automated processing. (22 words)
cn: 当健康保险行业还在配合改革努力时，其行业组织曾主动提出提供用于自动化处理的标准化表格。

en: It estimated that step would save hundreds of billions of dollars over the next decade. (15 words)
cn: 据估计，这一步将在未来十年节省数千亿美元。

en: The bills would lock that pledge into law. (8 words)
cn: 这些法案将把这一承诺写入法律。

en: The stimulus package provided money to convert the inefficient, paper-driven medical system to electronic records that can be easily viewed and transmitted. (22 words)
cn: 经济刺激计划提供了资金，将低效的、以纸张为驱动的医疗系统转变为易于查看和传输的电子记录。

en: This requires open investments to help doctors convert. (8 words)
cn: 这需要开放式投资来帮助医生进行转换。

en: In time it should help restrain costs by eliminating redundant tests, preventing drug interactions, and helping doctors find the best treatments. (21 words)
cn: 随着时间的推移，它应该有助于通过消除多余的检查、防止药物相互作用和帮助医生找到最佳治疗方法来抑制成本。

en: Virtually all experts agree that the fee-for-service system—doctors are rewarded for the quantity of care rather than its quality or effectiveness—is a primary reason that the cost of care is so high. (32 words)
cn: 几乎所有专家都同意，按服务收费制度——医生因护理数量而非质量或效果而获得报酬——是护理成本如此之高的主要原因。

en: Most agree that the solution is to push doctors to accept fixed payments to care for a particular illness or for a patient's needs over a year. (27 words)
cn: 大多数人同意解决方案是推动医生接受固定付款，以在一年内照顾特定疾病或患者的需求。

en: No one knows how to make that happen quickly. (9 words)
cn: 没有人知道如何迅速实现这一目标。

en: The bills in both houses would start pilot projects within Medicare. (11 words)
cn: 两院的法案都将在医疗保险内部启动试点项目。

en: They include such measures as accountable care organizations to take charge of a patient's needs with an eye on both cost and quality, and chronic disease management to make sure the seriously ill, who are responsible for the bulk of all health care costs, are treated properly. (47 words)
cn: 它们包括诸如负责任的医疗机构来负责患者的需求，同时关注成本和质量，以及慢性病管理以确保重病患者（他们承担了大部分医疗费用）得到适当治疗。

en: For the most part, these experiments rely on incentive payments to get doctors to try them. (16 words)
cn: 在大多数情况下，这些实验依靠激励性付款来让医生尝试它们。

en: Testing innovations do no good unless the good experiments are identified and expanded and the bad ones are dropped. (19 words)
cn: 除非好的实验被识别和推广，坏的被放弃，否则测试创新没有好处。

en: The Senate bill would create an independent commission to monitor the pilot programs and recommend changes in Medicare's payment policies to urge providers to adopt reforms that work. (28 words)
cn: 参议院法案将成立一个独立委员会来监督试点项目，并建议修改医疗保险的支付政策，以敦促提供者采用有效的改革措施。

en: The changes would have to be approved or rejected as a whole by Congress, making it hard for narrow-interest lobbies to bend lawmakers to their will. (26 words)
cn: 这些修改必须由国会作为一个整体批准或否决，这使得狭隘利益的游说团体难以左右立法者。

en: The bills in both chambers would create health insurance exchanges on which small businesses and individuals could choose from an array of private plans and possibly a public option. (29 words)
cn: 两院的法案都将建立健康保险交易所，小企业和个人可以在那里从一系列私人计划以及可能的公共选择中进行选择。

en: All the plans would have to provide standard benefit packages that would be easy to compare. (16 words)
cn: 所有计划都必须提供易于比较的标准福利套餐。

en: To get access to millions of new customers, insurers would have a strong incentive to sell on the exchange. (19 words)
cn: 为了获得数百万新客户，保险公司将有强烈的动机在交易所上销售。

en: And the head-to-head competition might give them a strong incentive to lower their prices, perhaps by accepting slimmer profit margins or demanding better deals from providers. (26 words)
cn: 而面对面的竞争可能会给他们强烈的动机来降低价格，也许通过接受更薄的利润空间或要求提供者提供更好的交易条件。

en: The final legislation might throw a public plan into the competition, but thanks to the fierce opposition of the insurance industry and Republican critics, it might not save much money. (30 words)
cn: 最终立法可能会将公共计划纳入竞争，但由于保险行业和共和党批评者的强烈反对，它可能省不了多少钱。

en: The one in the House bill would have to negotiate rates with providers, rather than using Medicare rates, as many reformers wanted. (22 words)
cn: 众议院法案中的公共计划必须与提供者谈判费率，而不是像许多改革者希望的那样使用医疗保险费率。

en: The president's stimulus package is pumping money into research to compare how well various treatments work. (16 words)
cn: 总统的经济刺激计划正在向研究投入资金，以比较各种治疗方法的有效性。

en: Is surgery, radiation or careful monitoring best for prostate cancer? (10 words)
cn: 手术、放疗还是仔细监测对前列腺癌最好？

en: Is the latest and most expensive cholesterol-lowering drug any better than its common competitors? (14 words)
cn: 最新、最昂贵的降胆固醇药物是否比其常见的竞争对手更好？

en: The pending bills would spend additional money to accelerate this effort. (11 words)
cn: 待定的法案将花费额外的资金来加速这项工作。

en: Critics have charged that this sensible idea would lead to rationing of care. (13 words)
cn: 批评者指责这个合理的想法会导致医疗配给。

en: As a result, the bills do not require, as they should, that the results of these studies be used to set payment rates in Medicare. (25 words)
cn: 因此，这些法案并没有像应该做的那样，要求将这些研究的结果用于设定医疗保险的支付费率。

en: Congress needs to find the courage to allow Medicare to pay preferentially for treatments proven to be superior. (18 words)
cn: 国会需要找到勇气，允许医疗保险优先支付被证明更优越的治疗方法。

en: But overall, we suspect that a lot of unnecessary or even dangerous tests and treatments are being conducted. (18 words)
cn: 但总的来说，我们怀疑正在进行许多不必要的甚至危险的检查和治疗。

en: The House bill would authorize the secretary of health and human services to negotiate drug prices in Medicare and Medicaid. (20 words)
cn: 众议院法案将授权卫生与公众服务部长在医疗保险和医疗补助中谈判药品价格。

en: Some authoritative analysts doubt that the secretary would get better deals than private insurers already get. (16 words)
cn: 一些权威分析人士怀疑部长能否获得比私人保险公司已经获得的更好的价格。

en: We believe negotiation could work. (5 words)
cn: 我们相信谈判可以奏效。

en: It does in other countries. (5 words)
cn: 在其他国家确实如此。

en: Missing from these bills is any serious attempt to rein in malpractice costs. (13 words)
cn: 这些法案中缺失的是任何控制医疗事故成本的认真尝试。

en: Malpractice awards do drive up insurance premiums for doctors in high-risk specialties, and there is some evidence that doctors engage in 'defensive medicine' by performing tests and treatments primarily to prove they are not negligent should they get sued. (39 words)
cn: 医疗事故赔偿确实推高了高风险专科医生的保险费，并且有一些证据表明医生在进行‘防御性医疗’——进行检查和治疗主要是为了证明如果被起诉他们没有疏忽。

en: Facing water shortages and escalating fertilizer costs, farmers in developing countries are using raw sewage to irrigate and fertilize nearly 49 million acres of cropland, according to a new report—and it may not be a bad thing. (37 words)
cn: 根据一份新的报告，面对水资源短缺和化肥成本不断上升，发展中国家的农民正在使用未经处理的下水道污水来灌溉和施肥近4900万英亩的农田——而这可能不是一件坏事。

en: While the practice carries serious health risks for many, those dangers are outweighed by the social and economic gains for poor urban farmers and consumers who need affordable food. (29 words)
cn: 虽然这种做法给许多人带来了严重的健康风险，但对于需要负担得起的食品的贫困城市农民和消费者来说，这些危险被社会和经济利益所抵消。

en: 'There is a large potential for waste water agriculture to both help and hurt great numbers of urban consumers,' said Liqa Raschid-Sally, who led the study. (26 words)
cn: 该研究的负责人利卡·拉希德-萨利说：‘废水农业既有帮助大量城市消费者的巨大潜力，也有伤害他们的巨大潜力。’

en: The report focused on poor urban areas, where farms in or near cities supply relatively inexpensive food. (17 words)
cn: 该报告聚焦于贫困城市地区，那里城市内或附近的农场供应相对便宜的食品。

en: Most of these operations draw irrigation water from local rivers or lakes. (12 words)
cn: 这些作业大多从当地河流或湖泊抽取灌溉用水。

en: Unlike developed cities, however, these areas lack advanced water-treatment facilities, and rivers effectively become sewers. (15 words)
cn: 然而，与发达城市不同，这些地区缺乏先进的水处理设施，河流实际上变成了下水道。

en: When this water is used for agricultural irrigation, farmers risk absorbing disease-causing bacteria, as do consumers who eat the produce raw and unwashed. (23 words)
cn: 当这些水用于农业灌溉时，农民有吸入致病细菌的风险，直接食用未经清洗的农产品的消费者也是如此。

en: Nearly 2.2 million people die each year because of diarrhea-related diseases, according to WHO statistics. (15 words)
cn: 根据世界卫生组织的统计，每年有近220万人死于与腹泻相关的疾病。

en: More than 80% of those cases can be attributed to contact with contaminated water and a lack of proper sanitation. (20 words)
cn: 这些病例中超过80%可归因于接触受污染的水和缺乏适当的卫生设施。

en: But Pay Drechsel, an environmental scientist, argues that the social and economic benefits of using untreated human waste to grow food outweigh the health risks. (25 words)
cn: 但环境科学家佩·德雷克塞尔认为，使用未经处理的人类排泄物种植粮食的社会和经济利益大于健康风险。

en: Those dangers can be addressed with farmer and consumer education, he said, while the free water and nutrients from human waste can help urban farmers in developing countries to escape poverty. (31 words)
cn: 他说，这些危险可以通过对农民和消费者的教育来解决，而来自人类排泄物的免费水和营养物质可以帮助发展中国家的城市农民摆脱贫困。

en: Agriculture is a water-intensive business, accounting for nearly 70% of global fresh water consumption. (14 words)
cn: 农业是一个耗水量大的行业，占全球淡水消耗量的近70%。

en: In poor, dry regions, untreated waste water is the only viable irrigation source to keep farmers in business. (18 words)
cn: 在贫穷干旱的地区，未经处理的废水是维持农民生计的唯一可行灌溉水源。

en: In some cases, water is so scarce that farmers break open sewage pipes transporting waste to local rivers. (18 words)
cn: 在某些情况下，水资源如此稀缺，以至于农民打破运送废物到当地河流的污水管道。

en: Irrigation is the primary agricultural use of human waste in the developing world. (13 words)
cn: 在发展中国家的农业中，灌溉是人类排泄物的主要用途。

en: But frequently untreated human waste harvested from lavatories is delivered to farms and spread as fertilizer. (16 words)
cn: 但通常，从厕所收集的未经处理的人类排泄物被运送到农场并作为肥料撒播。

en: In most cases, the human waste is used on grain crops, which are eventually cooked, minimizing the risk of transmitting water-borne diseases. (22 words)
cn: 在大多数情况下，人类排泄物用于谷物作物，这些作物最终会被煮熟，从而最大限度地降低了传播水源性疾病的风险。

en: With fertilizer prices jumping nearly 50% per metric ton over the last year in some places, human waste is an attractive, and often necessary, alternative. (25 words)
cn: 随着过去一年某些地方每公吨化肥价格上涨近50%，人类排泄物成为一种有吸引力的、而且往往是必要的替代品。

en: In cases where sewage mud is used, expensive chemical fertilizer use can be avoided. (14 words)
cn: 在使用污水污泥的情况下，可以避免使用昂贵的化肥。

en: The mud contains the same critical nutrients. (7 words)
cn: 污泥含有同样的关键营养物质。

en: 'Overly strict standards often fail,' James Bartram, a WHO water-health expert said. (12 words)
cn: 世界卫生组织水健康专家詹姆斯·巴特拉姆说：‘过于严格的标准常常失败。’

en: 'We need to accept that fact across much of the planet, so waste with little or no treatment will be used in agriculture for good reason.' (26 words)
cn: ‘我们需要接受这个事实——在全球大部分地区，未经或几乎未经处理的废物将有充分的理由用于农业。’

en: These days, nobody needs to cook. (6 words)
cn: 如今，没有人需要做饭。

en: Families graze on high-cholesterol take-aways and microwaved ready-meals. (8 words)
cn: 家庭以高胆固醇的外卖和微波炉加热的即食食品为食。

en: Cooking is an occasional hobby and a vehicle for celebrity chefs. (11 words)
cn: 烹饪是一种偶尔的爱好，也是名厨的载体。

en: Which makes it odd that the kitchen has become the heart of the modern house: what the great hall was to the medieval castle, the kitchen is to the 21st-century home. (31 words)
cn: 这使得厨房已成为现代家庭的核心这一事实显得奇怪：正如大厅之于中世纪城堡，厨房之于21世纪的家庭。

en: The money spent on kitchens has risen with their status. (10 words)
cn: 花在厨房上的钱随着其地位的提升而增加。

en: In America the kitchen market is now worth $170 billion, five times the country's film industry. (16 words)
cn: 在美国，厨房市场目前价值1700亿美元，是该国电影产业的五倍。

en: In the year to August 2007, IKEA, a Swedish furniture chain, sold over one million kitchens worldwide. (17 words)
cn: 在截至2007年8月的一年中，瑞典家具连锁店宜家在全世界售出了超过100万套厨房。

en: The average budget for a 'major' kitchen overhaul in 2006, calculates Remodeling magazine, was a staggering $54,000; even a 'minor' improvement cost on average $18,000. (25 words)
cn: 据《 remodeling》杂志计算，2006年一次‘大型’厨房翻新的平均预算高达54，000美元；即使是‘小型’改进平均也要花费18，000美元。

en: Exclusivity, more familiar in the world of high fashion, has reached the kitchen: Robinson & Cornish, a British manufacturer of custom-made kitchens, offers a Georgian-style one which would cost £145,000-155,000—excluding building, plumbing and electrical work. (35 words)
cn: 在高级时装界更为熟悉的独特性已经延伸到厨房：英国定制厨房制造商Robinson & Cornish提供一种乔治亚风格的厨房，售价为145，000-155，000英镑——不包括建筑、管道和电气工程。

en: Its big selling point is that nobody else will have it: 'You won't see this kitchen anywhere else in the world.' (21 words)
cn: 它的最大卖点是别人都不会拥有它：‘你在世界上任何其他地方都不会看到这个厨房。’

en: The elevation of the room that once belonged only to the servants to that of design showcase for the modern family tells the story of a century of social change. (30 words)
cn: 这个曾经只属于仆人的房间被提升为现代家庭的展示设计，讲述了一个世纪的社会变迁。

en: Right into the early 20th century, kitchens were smoky, noisy places, generally located underground, or to the back of the house, and as far from living space as possible. (29 words)
cn: 直到20世纪初，厨房都是烟雾缭绕、嘈杂的地方，通常位于地下或房子后面，尽可能远离生活空间。

en: That was as it should be: kitchens were for servants, and the aspiring middle classes wanted nothing to do with them. (21 words)
cn: 本应如此：厨房是为仆人准备的，有抱负的中产阶级不愿与厨房有任何关系。

en: But as the working classes prospered and the servant shortage set in, housekeeping became a matter of interest to the educated classes. (22 words)
cn: 但随着工人阶级的繁荣和仆人的短缺，家政管理成为受教育阶层感兴趣的事情。

en: One of the pioneers of a radical new way of thinking about the kitchen was Catharine Esther Beecher, sister of Harriet Beecher Stowe. (23 words)
cn: 对厨房进行彻底新思考的先驱之一是哈丽特·比彻·斯托的姐姐凯瑟琳·埃丝特·比彻。

en: In American Woman's Home, published in 1869, the Beecher sisters recommended a scientific approach to household management, designed to enhance the efficiency of a woman's work and promote order. (29 words)
cn: 在1869年出版的《美国妇女的家》中，比彻姐妹推荐了一种科学的家政管理方法，旨在提高女性工作的效率并促进秩序。

en: Many contemporary ideas about kitchen design can be traced back to another American, Christine Frederick, who set about enhancing the efficiency of the housewife. (24 words)
cn: 许多关于厨房设计的当代理念可以追溯到另一位美国人克里斯汀·弗雷德里克，她着手提高家庭主妇的效率。

en: Her 1919 work, Household Engineering: Scientific Management in the Home, was based on detailed observation of a housewife's daily routine. (20 words)
cn: 她1919年的著作《家庭工程：家庭中的科学管理》基于对家庭主妇日常生活的详细观察。

en: She borrowed the principle of efficiency on the factory floor and applied it to domestic tasks on the kitchen floor. (20 words)
cn: 她借鉴了工厂车间效率的原则，并将其应用于厨房地板上的家务劳动。

en: Frederick's central idea, that 'stove, sink and kitchen table must be placed in such a relation that useless steps are avoided entirely', inspired the first fully fitted kitchen, designed in the 1920s by Margarete Schütter-Lihotsky. (35 words)
cn: 弗雷德里克的核心观点——‘炉灶、水槽和厨房餐桌的摆放必须避免任何无用的走动’——启发了第一个整体厨房的设计，由玛格丽特·舒特-利霍茨基于20世纪20年代设计。

en: It was a modernist triumph, and many elements remain central features of today's kitchen. (14 words)
cn: 这是现代主义的胜利，许多元素至今仍是当今厨房的核心特征。

en: It is important that scientists be seen as normal people asking and answering important questions. (15 words)
cn: 重要的是，科学家应被视为提出和回答重要问题的普通人。

en: Good, sound science depends on hypotheses, experiments and reasoned methodologies. (10 words)
cn: 好的、严谨的科学依赖于假设、实验和合理的 methodology。

en: It requires a willingness to ask new questions and try new approaches. (12 words)
cn: 它需要愿意提出新的问题并尝试新的方法。

en: It requires one to take risks and experience failures. (9 words)
cn: 它需要一个人承担风险并经历失败。

en: But good science also requires contextual understanding, clear explanation and concise presentation. (12 words)
cn: 但好的科学也需要情境理解、清晰的解释和简洁的表述。

en: Our country needs more scientists who are willing to step out in the public arena and offer their opinions on important matters. (22 words)
cn: 我们的国家需要更多愿意走进公共领域、就重要问题发表意见的科学家。

en: We need more scientists who can explain what they are doing in language that is convincing and understandable to the public. (21 words)
cn: 我们需要更多能用令人信服且公众能理解的语言来解释他们所做的事情的科学家。

en: Those of us who are not scientists should also be prepared to support public engagement by scientists, and to incorporate scientific knowledge into our public communications. (26 words)
cn: 我们这些不是科学家的人也应该准备好支持科学家的公众参与，并将科学知识纳入我们的公众交流中。

en: Too many people in this country, including some among our elected leadership, still do not understand how science works or why robust, long-range investments in research vitally matter. (28 words)
cn: 这个国家有太多人，包括我们当选领导层中的一些人，仍然不理解科学是如何运作的，也不理解为什么对研究进行强有力的长期投资至关重要。

en: In the 1960s, the United States devoted nearly 17% of discretionary spending to research and development, reaping decades of economic growth. (21 words)
cn: 在20世纪60年代，美国将可自由支配支出的近17%用于研发，从而收获了几十年的经济增长。

en: By 2008, the figure had fallen into the single digits. (10 words)
cn: 到2008年，这一数字已降至个位数。

en: This occurs at a time when other nations have made significant gains in their own research capabilities. (17 words)
cn: 这发生在其他国家在其自身研究能力方面取得显著进展的时候。

en: At the University of California (UC), we pride ourselves not only on the quality of our research, but also on its contribution to improving our world. (26 words)
cn: 在加利福尼亚大学（UC），我们不仅以研究质量自豪，也以研究对改善我们世界的贡献自豪。

en: To hasten the development of science from the lab bench to the marketplace, UC is investing our own money in our own good ideas. (24 words)
cn: 为了加速科学从实验室到市场的发展，UC正在将我们自己的资金投入到我们自己的好想法中。

en: Scan the highlights of this year's Consumer Electronics Show (CES), and you may get a slight feeling of having seen them before. (22 words)
cn: 浏览今年国际消费电子展（CES）的亮点，你可能会有一丝似曾相识的感觉。

en: Many of the coolest gadgets this year are the same as the coolest gadgets last year—or the year before, even. (20 words)
cn: 今年许多最酷的小玩意儿与去年——甚至前年——最酷的小玩意儿相同。

en: The booths are still exciting, and the demos are still just as crazy. (13 words)
cn: 展台仍然令人兴奋，演示仍然同样疯狂。

en: It is still easy to be dazzled by the display of drones, 3D printers, virtual reality goggles and more 'smart' devices than you could ever hope to catalog. (28 words)
cn: 无人机、3D打印机、虚拟现实眼镜以及比你所能想象的更多的‘智能’设备的展示，仍然容易让人眼花缭乱。

en: Upon reflection, however, it is equally easy to feel like you have seen it all before. (16 words)
cn: 然而，仔细一想，同样容易让人觉得这一切都似曾相识。

en: And it is hard not to think: Are we in an innovation lull? (13 words)
cn: 而且很难不去想：我们是否正处于创新的间歇期？

en: In some ways, the answer is yes. (7 words)
cn: 在某些方面，答案是肯定的。

en: For years, smartphones, televisions, tablets, laptops and desktops have made up a huge part of the market and driven innovation. (20 words)
cn: 多年来，智能手机、电视、平板电脑、笔记本电脑和台式电脑占据了市场的很大一部分并推动了创新。

en: But now these segments are looking at slower growth curves—or shrinking markets in some cases—as consumers are not as eager to spend money on new gadgets. (26 words)
cn: 但现在这些细分市场正面临增长曲线放缓——在某些情况下甚至市场萎缩——因为消费者不再那么热衷于在新 gadget 上花钱。

en: Meanwhile, emerging technologies—the drones, 3D printers and smart-home devices of the world—now seem a bit too old to be called 'the next big thing'. (24 words)
cn: 与此同时，新兴技术——无人机、3D打印机和智能家居设备——现在似乎有点过时，不能再被称为‘下一个大事件’。

en: Basically the tech industry seems to be in an awkward period now. (12 words)
cn: 基本上，科技行业现在似乎正处于一个尴尬的时期。

en: 'There is not any one-hit wonder, and there will not be one for years to come,' said Gary Shapiro, president and chief executive of the Consumer Technology Association (CTA). (29 words)
cn: 消费者技术协会（CTA）总裁兼首席执行官加里·夏皮罗说：‘没有任何一炮而红的产品，未来几年也不会出现。’

en: In his eyes, however, that doesn't necessarily mean that innovation has stopped. (12 words)
cn: 然而，在他看来，这并不一定意味着创新已经停止。

en: It has just grown up a little. (7 words)
cn: 只是它长大了一点。

en: 'Many industries are going out of infancy and becoming adolescents,' Shapiro said. (12 words)
cn: 夏皮罗说：‘许多行业正在走出婴儿期，进入青少年期。’

en: For instance, new technologies that are building upon existing technology have not found their footing well enough to appeal to a mass audience, because, in many cases, they need to work effectively with other devices to realize their full appeal. (40 words)
cn: 例如，在现有技术基础上构建的新技术尚未站稳脚跟以吸引大众受众，因为在许多情况下，它们需要与其他设备有效配合才能实现其全部吸引力。

en: Take the evolution of the smart home, for example. (9 words)
cn: 以智能家居的发展为例。

en: Companies are pushing it hard but make it almost overwhelming even to dip a toe in the water for the average consumer, because there are so many compatibility issues to think about. (32 words)
cn: 公司正在大力推广，但对普通消费者来说，即使只是浅尝辄止也几乎让人不知所措，因为有太多兼容性问题需要考虑。

en: No average person wants to figure out whether their favorite calendar software works with their fridge or whether their washing machine and tablet get along. (25 words)
cn: 普通人不想弄清楚他们最喜欢的日历软件是否与冰箱兼容，或者他们的洗衣机和平板电脑是否合得来。

en: Having to install a different app for each smart appliance in your home is annoying; it would be nicer if you could manage everything together. (25 words)
cn: 必须为家里的每个智能电器安装不同的应用程序很烦人；如果你能一起管理所有东西就好了。

en: And while you may forgive your smartphone an occasional fault, you probably have less patience for error messages from your door lock. (22 words)
cn: 虽然你可能原谅智能手机偶尔的故障，但你可能对来自门锁的错误信息缺乏耐心。

en: Companies are promoting their own standards, and the market has not had time to choose a winner yet as this is still very new. (24 words)
cn: 公司正在推广自己的标准，而市场还没有时间选出赢家，因为这仍然非常新。

en: Companies that have long focused on hardware now have to think of ecosystems instead to give consumers practical solutions to their everyday problems. (23 words)
cn: 长期以来专注于硬件的公司现在必须转而考虑生态系统，为消费者的日常问题提供实用的解决方案。

en: 'The dialogue is changing from what is technologically possible to what is technologically meaningful,' said economist Shawn DuBravac. (18 words)
cn: 经济学家肖恩·杜布拉瓦茨说：‘对话正在从技术上可能什么转向技术上有什么意义。’

en: DuBravac works for CTA—which puts on the show each year—and said that this shift to a search for solutions has been noticeable as he researched his predictions for 2016. (29 words)
cn: 杜布拉瓦茨在CTA工作——该组织每年举办该展会——并表示，在他研究2016年的预测时，这种向寻找解决方案的转变是显而易见的。

en: 'So much of what CES has been about is the cool. (11 words)
cn: ‘CES过去的大部分内容是酷。’

en: It is about the flashiness and the gadgets,' said John Curran, managing director of research at Accenture. (17 words)
cn: 埃森哲研究董事总经理约翰·柯伦说：‘它是关于华丽和小 gadget 的。’

en: 'But over the last couple of years, and in this one in particular, we are starting to see companies shift from what is the largest screen size, the smallest form factor or the shiniest object and more into what all of these devices do that is practical in a consumer's life.' (51 words)
cn: ‘但在过去的几年里，尤其是今年，我们开始看到公司从关注最大的屏幕尺寸、最小的外形或最闪亮的物体，转向关注所有这些设备在消费者生活中有什么实用功能。’

en: Even the technology press conferences, which have been high-profile in the past and reached a level of drama and theatrics fitting for a Las Vegas stage, have a different bent to them. (32 words)
cn: 即使是过去备受关注、达到适合拉斯维加斯舞台的戏剧性和表演水平的技术新闻发布会，也有了不同的倾向。

en: Rather than just dazzling with a high cool factor, there is a focus on the practical. (16 words)
cn: 不仅仅是凭借高酷炫因素令人眼花缭乱，而是更注重实用性。

en: Fitbit, for example, released its first smartwatch Monday, selling with a clear purpose—to improve your fitness—and promoting it as a 'tool, not a toy.' (24 words)
cn: 例如，Fitbit周一发布了其首款智能手表，销售目的明确——改善你的健康状况——并将其推广为‘工具，而非玩具’。

en: Not only that, it supports a number of platforms: Apple's iOS, Google's Android and Microsoft's Windows phone. (17 words)
cn: 不仅如此，它还支持多个平台：苹果的iOS、谷歌的Android和微软的Windows手机。

en: That seems to be what consumers are demanding, after all. (10 words)
cn: 毕竟，这似乎正是消费者所要求的。

en: Consumers are becoming increasingly bored with what companies have to offer: A survey of 28,000 consumers in 28 countries released by Accenture found consumers are not as excited about technology as they once were. (34 words)
cn: 消费者对公司提供的东西越来越厌倦：埃森哲发布的一项对28个国家28000名消费者的调查发现，消费者对技术不再像以前那样兴奋。

en: For example, when asked whether they would buy a new smartphone this year, only 48 percent said yes—a six-point drop from 2015. (22 words)
cn: 例如，当被问及今年是否会购买新智能手机时，只有48%的人表示会——比2015年下降了6个百分点。

en: And when it comes to the hyper-connected super-smart world that technology firms are painting for us, it seems that consumers are growing more uneasy about handing over the massive amounts of consumer data needed to provide the personalized, customized solutions that companies need to improve their services. (47 words)
cn: 当涉及到科技公司为我们描绘的超互联、超智能世界时，消费者似乎对交出提供个性化定制解决方案所需的大量消费者数据越来越不安，而这些解决方案是公司改善服务所需的。

en: That could be another explanation for why companies seem to be strengthening their talk of the practicality of their devices. (20 words)
cn: 这可能是为什么公司似乎正在加强谈论其设备实用性的另一个解释。

en: Companies have already won part of the battle, having driven tech into every part of our lives, tracking our steps and our very heartbeats. (24 words)
cn: 公司已经赢得了部分战役，将技术带入我们生活的方方面面，跟踪我们的脚步甚至心跳。

en: Yet the persistent question of 'Why do I need that?'—or, perhaps more tellingly, 'Why do you need to know that?'—dogs the steps of many new ventures. (26 words)
cn: 然而，‘我为什么需要那个？’——或者，也许更能说明问题的是，‘你为什么需要知道那个？’——这个持续的问题困扰着许多新企业的脚步。

en: Only 13 percent of respondents said that they were interested in buying a smartwatch in 2016, for example—an increase of just one percent from the previous year despite a year of high-profile launches. (33 words)
cn: 例如，只有13%的受访者表示他们对在2016年购买智能手表感兴趣——尽管这一年进行了高调的发布，但仅比前一年增加了一个百分点。

en: That is bad news for any firm that may hope that smartwatches can make up ground for maturing smartphone and tablet markets. (22 words)
cn: 这对任何希望智能手表能为成熟的智能手机和平板电脑市场弥补失地的公司来说都是坏消息。

en: And the survey found flat demand for fitness monitors, smart thermostats and connected home cameras, as well. (17 words)
cn: 调查还发现，对健身监测器、智能恒温器和联网家庭摄像头的需求持平。

en: According to the survey, that lack of enthusiasm could stem from concerns about privacy and security. (16 words)
cn: 根据调查，这种缺乏热情可能源于对隐私和安全的担忧。

en: Even among people who have bought connected devices of some kind, 37 percent said that they are going to be more cautious about using these devices and services in the future. (31 words)
cn: 即使在购买了某种联网设备的人中，37%的人表示他们将来会对使用这些设备和服务更加谨慎。

en: A full 18 percent have even returned devices until they feel they can get safer guarantees against having their sensitive information hacked. (22 words)
cn: 足足有18%的人甚至退回了设备，直到他们觉得自己能获得更安全的保障，防止敏感信息被黑客攻击。

en: That, too, explains the heavy Washington presence at this year's show, as these new technologies intrude upon heavily regulated areas. (20 words)
cn: 这也解释了为什么今年展会上华盛顿方面人员众多，因为这些新技术侵入了受到严格监管的领域。

en: In addition to many senior officials from the Federal Trade and Federal Communications commissions, this year's list of policy makers also includes appearances from Transportation Secretary Anthony Foxx, to talk about smart cities, and Federal Aviation Administration Administrator Michael Huerta, to talk about drones. (44 words)
cn: 除了来自联邦贸易委员会和联邦通信委员会的许多高级官员外，今年的政策制定者名单还包括交通部长安东尼·福克斯（谈论智慧城市）和联邦航空管理局局长迈克尔·韦尔塔（谈论无人机）。

en: Curran, the Accenture analyst, said that increased government interest in the show makes sense as technology becomes a larger part of our lives. (23 words)
cn: 埃森哲分析师柯伦表示，随着技术成为我们生活中更重要的一部分，政府对展会兴趣的增加是有道理的。

en: 'There is an incompatibility in the rate at which these are advancing relative to the way we're digesting it,' he said. (21 words)
cn: 他说：‘这些技术的进步速度与我们消化它们的方式之间存在不匹配。’

en: 'Technology is becoming bigger and more aspirational, and penetrating almost every aspect of our lives. (15 words)
cn: ‘技术正变得更大、更具抱负，并渗透到我们生活的几乎每一个方面。’

en: We have to understand and think about the implications, and balance these great innovations with the potential downsides they naturally carry with them.' (23 words)
cn: ‘我们必须理解和思考其影响，并在这些伟大创新与它们自然带来的潜在负面影响之间取得平衡。’

en: The Paris climate agreement finalised in December last year heralded a new era for climate action. (16 words)
cn: 去年12月最终达成的《巴黎气候协定》预示着气候行动新时代的到来。

en: For the first time, the world's nations agreed to keep global warming well below 2℃. (15 words)
cn: 世界各国首次同意将全球变暖控制在远低于2摄氏度的水平。

en: This is vital for climate-vulnerable nations. (6 words)
cn: 这对气候脆弱国家至关重要。

en: Fewer than 4% of countries are responsible for more than half of the world's greenhouse gas emissions. (17 words)
cn: 不到4%的国家对全球一半以上的温室气体排放负责。

en: In a study published in Nature Scientific Reports, we reveal just how deep this injustice runs. (16 words)
cn: 在发表在《自然·科学报告》上的一项研究中，我们揭示了这种不公正的严重程度。

en: Developed nations such as Australia, the United States, Canada, and European countries are essentially climate 'free-riders': causing the majority of the problems through high greenhouse gas emissions, while incurring few of the costs such as climate change's impact on food and water. (42 words)
cn: 澳大利亚、美国、加拿大和欧洲国家等发达国家本质上是气候的‘搭便车者’：通过高温室气体排放造成了大部分问题，而承担的成本却很少，比如气候变化对粮食和水的影响。

en: In other words, a few countries are benefiting enormously from the consumption of fossil fuels, while at the same time contributing disproportionately to the global burden of climate change. (29 words)
cn: 换句话说，少数国家从化石燃料的消费中获得了巨大利益，同时却对全球气候变化负担做出了不成比例的贡献。

en: On the flip side, there are many 'forced riders', who are suffering from the climate change impacts despite having scarcely contributed to the problem. (24 words)
cn: 另一方面，有许多‘被迫的乘客’，尽管几乎没有对问题做出贡献，却正遭受气候变化的影响。

en: Many of the world's most climate vulnerable countries, the majority of which are African or small island states, produce a very small quantity of emissions. (25 words)
cn: 世界上许多气候最脆弱的国家，其中大多数是非洲或小岛屿国家，产生的排放量非常少。

en: This is much like a non-smoker getting cancer from second-hand smoke, while the heavy smoker is fortunate enough to smoke in good health. (23 words)
cn: 这非常像一个不吸烟者因二手烟患上癌症，而重度吸烟者却幸运地健康吸烟。

en: The Paris agreement has been widely hailed as a positive step forward in addressing climate change for all, although the details on addressing 'climate justice' can be best described as sketchy. (31 words)
cn: 《巴黎协定》被广泛誉为在应对气候变化方面迈出的积极一步，尽管关于‘气候正义’的细节最好被描述为粗略的。

en: The goal of keeping global temperature rise 'well below' 2℃ is commendable but the emissions-reduction pledges submitted by countries leading up to the Paris talks are very unlikely to deliver on this. (32 words)
cn: 将全球气温上升控制在‘远低于’2摄氏度的目标是值得赞扬的，但各国在巴黎会谈前提交的减排承诺很可能无法实现这一目标。

en: More than $100 billion in funding has been put on the table for supporting developing nations to reduce emissions. (19 words)
cn: 已提出超过1000亿美元的资金用于支持发展中国家减少排放。

en: However, the agreement specifies that there is no formal distinction between developed and developing nations in their responsibility to cut emissions, effectively ignoring historical emissions. (25 words)
cn: 然而，该协定规定，在减排责任方面，发达国家和发展中国家之间没有正式区别，这实际上忽略了历史排放。

en: There is also very little detail on who will provide the funds or, importantly, who is responsible for their provision. (20 words)
cn: 关于谁将提供资金，或者重要的是，谁负责提供资金，也几乎没有细节。

en: Securing these funds, and establishing who is responsible for raising them will also be vital for the future of climate-vulnerable countries. (21 words)
cn: 确保这些资金，并确定谁负责筹集这些资金，对气候脆弱国家的未来也至关重要。

en: The most climate-vulnerable countries in the world have contributed very little to creating the global disease from which they now suffer the most. (23 words)
cn: 世界上气候最脆弱的国家对造成它们现在受害最严重的全球问题几乎没有什么贡献。

en: There must urgently be a meaningful mobilisation of the policies outlined in the agreement if we are to achieve national emissions reductions while helping the most vulnerable countries adapt to climate change. (32 words)
cn: 如果我们想要实现国家减排，同时帮助最脆弱的国家适应气候变化，就必须紧急地、有意义地动员协定中概述的各项政策。

en: And it is clearly up to the current generation of leaders from high-emitting nations to decide whether they want to be remembered as climate change tyrants or pioneers. (28 words)
cn: 显然，这取决于高排放国家当前一代的领导人们来决定他们是想被记为气候变化的暴君还是先驱。

en: Teenagers at risk of depression, anxiety and suicide often wear their troubles like a neon sign. (16 words)
cn: 有抑郁、焦虑和自杀风险的青少年常常像霓虹灯标志一样显露他们的烦恼。

en: Their risky behaviors—drinking too much alcohol, using illegal drugs, smoking cigarettes and skipping school—can alert parents and teachers that serious problems are brewing. (23 words)
cn: 他们的危险行为——酗酒、使用非法药物、吸烟和逃学——可以提醒父母和老师严重的问题正在酝酿。

en: But a new study finds that there's another group of adolescents who are in nearly as much danger of experiencing the same psychiatric symptoms: teens who use tons of media, don't get enough sleep and have a sedentary lifestyle. (39 words)
cn: 但一项新的研究发现，还有另一群青少年几乎同样有经历相同精神症状的危险：大量使用媒体、睡眠不足和久坐不动的青少年。

en: Of course, that may sound like a description of every teenager on the planet. (14 words)
cn: 当然，这听起来可能像是对地球上每个青少年的描述。

en: But the study warns that it is teenagers who engage in all three of these practices in the extreme who are truly in jeopardy. (24 words)
cn: 但该研究警告说，是那些在这三种行为上都极端的青少年才真正处于危险之中。

en: Because their behaviors are not usually seen as a red flag, these young people have been dubbed the 'invisible risk' group by the study's authors. (25 words)
cn: 因为他们的行为通常不被视为危险信号，这些年轻人被研究作者称为‘隐形风险’群体。
