en: 'In some ways they're at greater risk of falling through the cracks,' says researcher Vladimir Carli. (16 words)
cn: 研究员弗拉基米尔·卡利说：‘在某些方面，他们更有可能被忽视。’

en: 'While most parents, teachers and clinicians would react to an adolescent using drugs or getting drunk, they may easily overlook teenagers who are engaging in inconspicuous behaviors.' (27 words)
cn: ‘虽然大多数父母、老师和临床医生会对吸毒或酗酒的青少年做出反应，但他们可能会轻易忽视那些从事不显眼行为的青少年。’

en: The study's authors surveyed 12,395 students and analyzed nine risk behaviors, including excessive alcohol use, illegal drug use, heavy smoking, high media use and truancy. (25 words)
cn: 该研究的作者调查了12,395名学生，并分析了九种危险行为，包括酗酒、非法药物使用、重度吸烟、高度媒体使用和逃学。

en: Their aim was to determine the relationship between these risk behaviors and mental health issues in teenagers. (17 words)
cn: 他们的目的是确定这些危险行为与青少年心理健康问题之间的关系。

en: About 58% of the students demonstrated none or few of the risk behaviors. (13 words)
cn: 大约58%的学生没有或很少有危险行为。

en: Some 13% scored high on all nine of the risk behaviors. (11 words)
cn: 大约13%的人在所有九种危险行为上得分都很高。

en: And 29%, the 'invisible risk' group, scored high on three in particular: They spent five hours a day or more on electronic devices. (23 words)
cn: 而29%的‘隐形风险’群体在三个特定方面得分很高：他们每天花五个小时或更多时间在电子设备上。

en: They slept six hours a night or less. (8 words)
cn: 他们每晚睡六个小时或更少。

en: And they neglected 'other healthy activities.' (6 words)
cn: 他们忽视了‘其他健康活动’。

en: The group that scored high on all nine of the risk behaviors was most likely to show symptoms of depression; in all, nearly 15% of this group reported being depressed, compared with just 4% of the low-risk group. (38 words)
cn: 在所有九种危险行为上得分高的群体最有可能表现出抑郁症状；总体而言，这个群体中近15%的人报告抑郁，而低风险群体中只有4%。

en: But the invisible group wasn't far behind the high-risk set, with more than 13% of them exhibiting depression. (18 words)
cn: 但隐形群体并不比高风险群体落后多少，超过13%的人表现出抑郁。

en: The findings caught Carli off guard. (6 words)
cn: 这些发现让卡利措手不及。

en: 'We were very surprised,' he says. (6 words)
cn: 他说：‘我们非常惊讶。’

en: 'The high-risk group and low-risk group are obvious. (8 words)
cn: ‘高风险和低风险群体是显而易见的。’

en: But this third group was not only unexpected, it was so distinct and so large—nearly one third of our sample—that it became a key finding of the study.' (28 words)
cn: ‘但这第三组不仅出乎意料，而且如此独特和庞大——几乎占我们样本的三分之一——以至于它成为了这项研究的一个关键发现。’

en: Carli says that one of the most significant things about his study is that it provides new early-warning signs for parents, teachers and mental health-care providers. (26 words)
cn: 卡利说，他的研究最重要的方面之一是它为父母、教师和心理健康服务提供者提供了新的预警信号。

en: And early identification, support and treatment for mental health issues, he says, are the best ways to keep them from turning into full-blown disorders. (24 words)
cn: 他说，对心理健康问题的早期识别、支持和治疗是防止它们发展成严重障碍的最佳方式。

en: The tree people in the Lord of the Rings—the Ents—can get around by walking. (14 words)
cn: 《指环王》中的树人——恩特——可以通过行走来移动。

en: But for real trees, it's harder to uproot. (8 words)
cn: 但对于真正的树木来说，连根拔起要困难得多。

en: Because they're literally rooted into the ground, they are unable to leave and go elsewhere. (15 words)
cn: 因为它们确实扎根于土壤之中，无法离开去别处。

en: When a tree first starts growing in a certain area, it's likely that the climatic envelope—the temperature, humidity, rainfall patterns and so on—suits it. (24 words)
cn: 当一棵树最初在某个区域开始生长时，很可能气候环境——温度、湿度、降雨模式等——适合它。

en: Otherwise, it would be unable to grow from a seedling. (10 words)
cn: 否则，它无法从幼苗成长起来。

en: But as it ages, these conditions may change and the area around it may no longer be suitable for its offspring. (21 words)
cn: 但随着树龄增长，这些条件可能会发生变化，其周围的区域可能不再适合它的后代。

en: When that happens, many trees like walnuts, oaks and pines, rely exclusively on so-called 'scatter hoarders,' such as birds, to move their seeds to new localities. (26 words)
cn: 当这种情况发生时，许多树木如核桃树、橡树和松树，完全依赖所谓的‘分散贮藏者’，如鸟类，将它们的种子带到新的地方。

en: Many birds like to store food for the winter, which they subsequently retrieve. (13 words)
cn: 许多鸟类喜欢为冬天储存食物，随后再取回。

en: When the birds forget to retrieve their food—and they do sometimes—a seedling has a chance to grow. (17 words)
cn: 当鸟类忘记取回它们的食物时——它们确实有时会忘记——幼苗就有机会生长。

en: The bird Clark's nutcracker, for example, hides up to 100,000 seeds per year, up to 30 kilometers away from the seed source, and has a very close symbiotic relationship with several pine species, most notably the whitebark pine. (38 words)
cn: 例如，克拉克氏星鸦每年藏匿多达10万颗种子，距离种子来源最远可达30公里，并且与几种松树物种有着非常密切的共生关系，尤其是白皮松。

en: As trees outgrow their ideal habitats in the face of climate change, these flying ecosystem engineers could be a big help in replanting trees. (24 words)
cn: 当树木因气候变化而超出其理想的栖息地时，这些飞行的生态系统工程师可能在重新植树方面提供很大帮助。

en: It's a solution for us—getting birds to do the work is cheap and effective—and it could give vulnerable oaks and pines the option to truly 'make like a tree and leave.' (31 words)
cn: 这对我们来说是一个解决方案——让鸟类来做这项工作既便宜又有效——它可能给脆弱的橡树和松树一个真正‘像树一样离开’的选择。

en: Americans are working longer and harder hours than ever before. (10 words)
cn: 美国人工作时间比以往任何时候都更长、更辛苦。

en: 83% of workers say they're stressed about their jobs, nearly 50% say work-related stress is interfering with their sleep, and 60% use their smartphones to check in with work outside of normal working hours. (34 words)
cn: 83%的工人表示他们对工作感到压力，近50%的人表示工作压力正在干扰他们的睡眠，60%的人在正常工作时间之外使用智能手机处理工作。

en: No wonder only 13% of employees worldwide feel engaged in their occupation. (12 words)
cn: 难怪全球只有13%的员工对自己的工作感到投入。

en: Glimmers of hope, however, are beginning to emerge in this bruising environment: Americans are becoming aware of the toll their jobs take on them, and employers are exploring ways to alleviate the harmful effects of stress and overwork. (38 words)
cn: 然而，在这种艰难的环境中，希望的光芒开始闪现：美国人正在意识到工作对他们的损害，雇主们也在探索缓解压力和过度工作有害影响的方法。

en: Yet much more work remains to be done. (8 words)
cn: 然而，还有更多工作要做。

en: To call stress an epidemic isn't exaggeration. (7 words)
cn: 称压力为流行病并非夸张。

en: The 83% of American employees who are stressed about their jobs—up from 73% just a year before—say that poor compensation and an unreasonable workload are their number-one sources of stress. (30 words)
cn: 83%对美国工作感到压力的员工——高于一年前的73%——表示低薪酬和不合理的工作量是他们压力的首要来源。

en: And if you suspected that the workplace had gotten more stressful than it was just a few decades ago, you're right. (21 words)
cn: 如果你怀疑工作场所比几十年前压力更大，你是对的。

en: Stress levels increased 18% for women and 24% for men from 1983 to 2009. (14 words)
cn: 从1983年到2009年，女性的压力水平增加了18%，男性增加了24%。

en: Stress is also starting earlier in life, with some data suggesting that today's teens are even more stressed than adults. (20 words)
cn: 压力在生命中也更早开始，一些数据表明今天的青少年甚至比成年人压力更大。

en: Stress is taking a significant toll on our health, and the collective public health cost may be enormous. (18 words)
cn: 压力对我们的健康造成重大损害，集体公共卫生成本可能巨大。

en: Occupational stress increases the risk of heart attack and diabetes, accelerates the aging process, decreases longevity, and contributes to depression and anxiety, among numerous other negative health outcomes. (28 words)
cn: 职业压力增加心脏病发作和糖尿病的风险，加速衰老过程，缩短寿命，并导致抑郁和焦虑，以及许多其他负面健康后果。

en: Overall, stress-related health problems account for up to 90% of hospital visits, many of them preventable. (16 words)
cn: 总体而言，与压力相关的健康问题占医院就诊量的90%，其中许多是可以预防的。

en: Your job is 'literally killing you,' as The Washington Post put it. (12 words)
cn: 正如《华盛顿邮报》所说，你的工作‘真的在杀死你’。

en: It's also hurting our relationships. (5 words)
cn: 它也在伤害我们的人际关系。

en: Working parents say they feel stressed, tired, rushed and short on quality time with their children, friends and partners. (19 words)
cn: 有工作的父母表示他们感到压力、疲惫、匆忙，缺乏与孩子、朋友和伴侣共度的优质时光。

en: Seven in 10 workers say they struggle to maintain work-life balance. (11 words)
cn: 十分之七的工人表示他们难以保持工作与生活的平衡。

en: As technology (and with it, work emails) seeps into every aspect of our lives, work-life balance has become an almost meaningless term. (22 words)
cn: 随着技术（以及随之而来的工作邮件）渗入我们生活的方方面面，工作与生活的平衡已变成一个几乎毫无意义的术语。

en: Add a rapidly changing economy and an uncertain future to this 24/7 connectivity, and you've got a recipe for overwork, according to Phyllis Moen. (24 words)
cn: 据菲利斯·莫恩说，将快速变化的经济和不确定的未来添加到这种全天候连接中，你就得到了过度工作的配方。

en: 'There's rising work demand coupled with the insecurity of mergers, takeovers, downsizing and other factors,' Moen said. (17 words)
cn: 莫恩说：‘工作需求不断上升，再加上并购、接管、裁员和其他因素带来的不安全感。’

en: 'Part of the work-life issue has to talk about uncertainty about the future.' (13 words)
cn: ‘工作与生活问题的部分必须涉及对未来的不确定性。’

en: These factors have converged to create an increasingly impossible situation with many employees overworking to the point of burnout. (19 words)
cn: 这些因素汇聚在一起，造成了一种越来越难以承受的局面，许多员工过度工作到了精疲力竭的地步。

en: It's not only unsustainable for workers, but also for the companies that employ them. (14 words)
cn: 这不仅对工人不可持续，对雇佣他们的公司也不可持续。

en: Science has shown a clear correlation between high stress levels in workers and absenteeism, reduced productivity, disengagement and high turnover. (20 words)
cn: 科学已表明工人高压力水平与缺勤、生产力下降、工作投入度降低和高离职率之间存在明确的关联。

en: Too many workplace policies effectively prohibit employees from developing a healthy work-life balance by barring them from taking time off, even when they need it most. (26 words)
cn: 太多的工作场所政策实际上禁止员工发展健康的工作与生活平衡，阻止他们休假，即使在他们最需要的时候。

en: The U.S. trails far behind every wealthy nation and many developing ones that have family-friendly work policies including paid parental leave, paid sick days and breast-feeding support, according to a 2007 study. (32 words)
cn: 根据2007年的一项研究，美国远远落后于每个富裕国家和许多发展中国家，这些国家有家庭友好型工作政策，包括带薪育儿假、带薪病假和母乳喂养支持。

en: The U.S. is also the only advanced economy that does not guarantee workers paid vacation time, and it's one of only two countries in the world that does not offer guaranteed paid maternity leave. (34 words)
cn: 美国也是唯一不保证工人带薪休假时间的发达经济体，也是世界上仅有的两个不提供有保障的带薪产假的国家之一。

en: But even when employees are given paid time off, workplace norms and expectations that pressure them to overwork often prevent them from taking it. (24 words)
cn: 但即使员工获得带薪休假，工作场所迫使他们过度工作的规范和期望往往阻止他们休假。

en: Fulltime employees who do have paid vacation days only use half of them on average. (15 words)
cn: 确实拥有带薪假期的全职员工平均只使用一半。

en: Our modern workplaces also operate based on outdated time constraints. (10 words)
cn: 我们现代的工作场所也基于过时的时间限制运作。

en: The practice of clocking in for an eight-hour workday is a leftover from the days of the Industrial Revolution, as reflected in the then-popular saying, 'Eight hours labor, eight hours recreation, eight hours rest.' (34 words)
cn: 每天工作八小时打卡上班的做法是工业革命时代的遗留，正如当时流行的说法所反映的：‘八小时劳动，八小时娱乐，八小时休息。’

en: We've held on to this workday structure—but thanks to our digital devices, many employees never really clock out. (18 words)
cn: 我们坚持这种工作日结构——但由于我们的数字设备，许多员工从未真正下班。

en: Today, the average American spends 8.8 hours at work daily, and the majority of working professionals spend additional hours checking in with work during evenings, weekends and even vacations. (29 words)
cn: 如今，美国人平均每天工作8.8小时，大多数在职专业人士在晚上、周末甚至假期还要花额外时间处理工作。

en: The problem isn't the technology itself, but that the technology is being used to create more flexibility for the employer rather than the employee. (24 words)
cn: 问题不在于技术本身，而在于技术被用来为雇主而非员工创造更多灵活性。

en: In a competitive work environment, employers are able to use technology to demand more from their employees rather than motivating workers with flexibility that benefits them. (26 words)
cn: 在竞争激烈的工作环境中，雇主能够利用技术对员工提出更多要求，而不是用有利于员工的灵活性来激励他们。

en: In a study published last year, psychologists coined the term 'workplace telepressure' to describe an employee's urge to immediately respond to emails and engage in obsessive thoughts about returning an email to one's boss, colleagues or clients. (37 words)
cn: 在去年发表的一项研究中，心理学家创造了‘工作场所远程压力’一词来描述员工立即回复电子邮件并沉迷于回复老板、同事或客户邮件的冲动。

en: The researchers found that telepressure is a major cause of stress at work, which over time contributes to physical and mental burnout. (22 words)
cn: 研究人员发现，远程压力是工作压力的主要原因，久而久之会导致身心疲惫。

en: Of the 300 employees participating in the study, those who experienced high levels of telepressure were more likely to agree with statements assessing burnout, like 'I've no energy for going to work in the morning,' and to report feeling fatigued and unfocused. (42 words)
cn: 在参与研究的300名员工中，那些经历高水平远程压力的人更可能同意评估倦怠的陈述，如‘我早上没有精力去上班’，并报告感到疲劳和注意力不集中。

en: Telepressure was also correlated with sleeping poorly and missing work. (10 words)
cn: 远程压力也与睡眠不佳和缺勤相关。

en: Harvard Business School professor Leslie Perlow explains that when people feel the pressure to be always 'on,' they find ways to accommodate that pressure, including altering their schedules, work habits and interactions with family and friends. (36 words)
cn: 哈佛商学院教授莱斯利·珀洛解释说，当人们感到必须随时待命的压力时，他们会找到适应这种压力的方法，包括改变日程、工作习惯以及与家人和朋友的互动。

en: Perlow calls this vicious cycle the 'cycle of responsiveness': Once bosses and colleagues experience an employee's increased responsiveness, they increase their demands on the employee's time. (26 words)
cn: 珀洛称这种恶性循环为‘响应循环’：一旦老板和同事感受到员工响应速度的提高，他们就会增加对员工时间的要求。

en: And because a failure to accept these increased demands indicates a lack of commitment to one's work, the employee complies. (20 words)
cn: 因为不满足这些增加的要求意味着对工作缺乏投入，员工不得不服从。

en: To address skyrocketing employee stress levels, many companies have implemented workplace wellness programs, partnering with health care providers that have created programs to promote employee health and well-being. (28 words)
cn: 为了解决员工压力水平飙升的问题，许多公司实施了工作场所健康计划，与医疗服务提供者合作，这些提供者创建了促进员工健康和福祉的计划。

en: Some research does suggest that these programs hold promise. (9 words)
cn: 一些研究确实表明这些计划有希望。

en: A study of employees at health insurance provider Aetna revealed that roughly one quarter of those taking in-office yoga and mindfulness classes reported a 28% reduction in their stress levels and a 20% improvement in sleep quality. (37 words)
cn: 一项对健康保险公司安泰员工的研究显示，参加办公室瑜伽和正念课程的员工中约有四分之一报告压力水平降低了28%，睡眠质量改善了20%。

en: These less-stressed workers gained an average of 62 minutes per week of productivity. (13 words)
cn: 这些压力较小的工人平均每周增加了62分钟的生产力。

en: While yoga and meditation are scientifically proven to reduce stress levels, these programs do little to target the root causes of burnout and disengagement. (24 words)
cn: 虽然瑜伽和冥想被科学证明可以降低压力水平，但这些计划对解决倦怠和投入度降低的根本原因作用甚微。

en: The conditions creating the stress are long hours, unrealistic demands and deadlines, and work-life conflict. (15 words)
cn: 造成压力的条件是长时间工作、不切实际的要求和截止日期，以及工作与生活的冲突。

en: Moen and her colleagues may have found the solution. (9 words)
cn: 莫恩和她的同事可能找到了解决方案。

en: In a 2011 study, she investigated the effects of implementing a Results Only Work Environment (ROWE) on the productivity and well-being of employees at Best Buy's corporate headquarters. (28 words)
cn: 在2011年的一项研究中，她调查了在百思买公司总部实施只问结果的工作环境对员工生产力和福祉的影响。

en: For the study, 325 employees spent six months taking part in ROWE, while a control group of 334 employees continued with their normal workflow. (24 words)
cn: 在这项研究中，325名员工花了六个月时间参与ROWE，而334名员工的对照组继续他们的正常工作流程。

en: The ROWE participants were allowed to freely determine when, where and how they worked—the only thing that mattered was that they got the job done. (25 words)
cn: ROWE参与者被允许自由决定何时、何地以及如何工作——唯一重要的是他们完成了工作。

en: The results were striking. (4 words)
cn: 结果令人震惊。

en: After six months, the employees who participated in ROWE reported reduced work-family conflict and a better sense of control of their time, and they were getting a full hour of extra sleep each night. (34 words)
cn: 六个月后，参与ROWE的员工报告工作与家庭冲突减少，对时间的控制感更好，而且他们每晚多睡整整一个小时。

en: The employees were less likely to leave their jobs, resulting in reduced turnover. (13 words)
cn: 员工离职的可能性降低，从而减少了人员流动。

en: It's important to note that the increased flexibility didn't encourage them to work around the clock. (16 words)
cn: 值得注意的是，灵活性的增加并没有鼓励他们夜以继日地工作。

en: 'They didn't work anywhere and all the time—they were better able to manage their work,' Moen said. (17 words)
cn: 莫恩说：‘他们没有随时随地工作——他们能更好地管理工作。’

en: 'Flexibility and control is key,' she continued. (7 words)
cn: 她继续说：‘灵活性和控制力是关键。’

en: Dr. Donald Sadoway at MIT started his own battery company with the hope of changing the world's energy future. (19 words)
cn: 麻省理工学院的唐纳德·萨多维博士创办了自己的电池公司，希望改变世界的能源未来。

en: It's a dramatic endorsement for a technology most people think about only when their smartphone goes dark. (17 words)
cn: 这是对一项技术的戏剧性背书，大多数人只在智能手机没电时才会想到它。

en: But Sadoway isn't alone in trumpeting energy storage as a missing link to a cleaner, more efficient, and more equitable energy future. (22 words)
cn: 但萨多维并不是唯一一个将储能吹捧为通往更清洁、更高效、更公平能源未来缺失环节的人。

en: Scientists and engineers have long believed in the promise of batteries to change the world. (15 words)
cn: 科学家和工程师长期以来相信电池改变世界的潜力。

en: Advanced batteries are moving out of specialized markets and creeping into the mainstream, signaling a tipping point for forward-looking technologies such as electric cars and rooftop solar propels. (28 words)
cn: 先进电池正走出专业市场，逐渐进入主流，标志着电动汽车和屋顶太阳能等前瞻性技术的转折点。

en: The ubiquitous battery has already come a long way, of course. (11 words)
cn: 当然，无所不在的电池已经走过了漫长的道路。

en: For better or worse, batteries make possible our mobile-first lifestyles, our screen culture, our increasingly globalized world. (17 words)
cn: 无论好坏，电池使我们的移动优先生活方式、屏幕文化、日益全球化的世界成为可能。

en: Still, as impressive as all this is, it may be trivial compared with what comes next. (16 words)
cn: 尽管如此，尽管这一切令人印象深刻，但与即将到来的相比，这可能微不足道。

en: Having already enabled a communications revolution, the battery is now poised to transform just about everything else. (17 words)
cn: 在已经引发了一场通信革命之后，电池现在正准备改变几乎所有其他事物。

en: The wireless age is expanding to include not just our phones, tablets, and laptops, but also our cars, homes, and even whole communities. (23 words)
cn: 无线时代正在扩展，不仅包括我们的手机、平板电脑和笔记本电脑，还包括我们的汽车、家庭，甚至整个社区。

en: In emerging economies, rural communities are bypassing the wires and wooden poles that spread power. (15 words)
cn: 在新兴经济体中，农村社区正在绕过输电的电线和木杆。

en: Instead, some in Africa and Asia are seeing their first lightbulbs illuminated by the power of sunlight stored in batteries. (20 words)
cn: 相反，非洲和亚洲的一些人第一次看到灯泡被储存在电池中的太阳能照亮。

en: Today, energy storage is a $33 billion global industry that generates nearly 100 gigawatt-hours of electricity per year. (18 words)
cn: 如今，储能是一个330亿美元的全球产业，每年发电近100吉瓦时。

en: By the end of the decade, it's expected to be worth over $50 billion and generate 160 gigawatt-hours, enough to attract the attention of major companies that might not otherwise be interested in a decidedly pedestrian technology. (37 words)
cn: 到本十年末，预计其价值将超过500亿美元，发电量达到160吉瓦时，足以吸引那些原本可能对一种相当普通的技术不感兴趣的大公司的注意。

en: Even utility companies, which have long viewed batteries and alternative forms of energy as a threat, are learning to embrace the technologies as enabling rather than disrupting. (27 words)
cn: 甚至长期以来将电池和替代能源视为威胁的公用事业公司，也在学着接受这些技术，认为它们是赋能而非破坏性的。

en: Today's battery breakthroughs come as the world looks to expand modern energy access to the billion or so people without it, while also cutting back on fuels that warm the planet. (31 words)
cn: 今天的电池突破恰逢世界寻求将现代能源扩展到大约十亿没有能源的人，同时减少导致全球变暖的燃料。

en: Those simultaneous challenges appear less overwhelming with increasingly better answers to a centuries-old question: how to make power portable. (19 words)
cn: 随着对如何使电力便携这一古老问题有了越来越好的答案，这些同时出现的挑战显得不那么难以应对了。

en: To be sure, the battery still has a long way to go before the nightly recharge completely replaces the weekly trip to the gas station. (25 words)
cn: 诚然，在夜间充电完全取代每周去加油站的行程之前，电池还有很长的路要走。

en: A battery-powered world comes with its own risks, too. (9 words)
cn: 一个由电池驱动的世界也有其自身的风险。

en: What happens to the centralized electric grid, which took decades and billions of dollars to build, as more and more people become 'prosumers,' who produce and consume their own energy onsite? (31 words)
cn: 随着越来越多的人成为‘产消者’——在现场生产和消费自己的能源——花费数十年和数十亿美元建造的集中式电网会发生什么？

en: No one knows which—if any—battery technology will ultimately dominate, but one thing remains clear. (14 words)
cn: 没有人知道哪种电池技术最终会占主导地位，但有一点仍然清楚。

en: The future of energy is in how we store it. (10 words)
cn: 能源的未来在于我们如何储存它。

en: More than 100 years ago, American sociologist W. E. B. Du Bois was concerned that race was being used as a biological explanation for what he understood to be social and cultural differences between different populations of people. (38 words)
cn: 一百多年前，美国社会学家W.E.B.杜博伊斯担心种族被用来作为他所理解的不同人群之间社会和文化差异的生物学解释。

en: He spoke out against the idea of 'white' and 'black' as distinct groups, claiming that these distinctions ignored the scope of human diversity. (23 words)
cn: 他公开反对将‘白人’和‘黑人’视为不同群体的观点，声称这些区分忽视了人类多样性的范围。

en: Science would favor Du Bois. (5 words)
cn: 科学会支持杜博伊斯。

en: Today, the mainstream belief among scientists is that race is a social construct without biological meaning. (16 words)
cn: 如今，科学家的主流观点是种族是一种没有生物学意义的社会建构。

en: In an article published in the journal Science, four scholars say racial categories need to be phased out. (18 words)
cn: 在《科学》杂志发表的一篇文章中，四位学者表示种族分类需要逐步淘汰。

en: 'Essentially, I could not agree more with the authors,' said Svante Pääbo, a biologist and director of the Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology in Germany. (26 words)
cn: 德国马克斯·普朗克进化人类学研究所所长、生物学家斯万特·帕博说：‘从本质上讲，我完全同意作者的观点。’

en: In one example that demonstrated genetic differences were not fixed along racial lines, the full genomes of James Watson and Craig Venter, two famous American scientists of European ancestry, were compared to that of a Korean scientist, Seong-Jin Kim. (39 words)
cn: 在一个证明遗传差异并非固定于种族界限的例子中，两位欧洲血统的美国著名科学家詹姆斯·沃森和克雷格·文特尔的全基因组与韩国科学家金成镇的全基因组进行了比较。

en: It turned out that Watson and Venter shared fewer variations in their genetic sequences than they each shared with Kim. (20 words)
cn: 结果表明，沃森和文特尔的基因序列变异相似度低于他们各自与金的相似度。

en: Michael Yudell, a professor of public health at Drexel University in Philadelphia, said that modern genetics research is operating in a paradox: on the one hand, race is understood to be a useful tool to illuminate human genetic diversity, but on the other hand, race is also understood to be a poorly defined marker of that diversity. (57 words)
cn: 费城德雷塞尔大学公共卫生教授迈克尔·尤德尔表示，现代遗传学研究正处在一个悖论中：一方面，种族被理解为揭示人类遗传多样性的有用工具；另一方面，种族也被理解为这种多样性界定不清的标志。

en: Assumptions about genetic differences between people of different races could be particularly dangerous in a medical setting. (17 words)
cn: 关于不同种族人群之间遗传差异的假设在医疗环境中可能特别危险。

en: 'If you make clinical predictions based on somebody's race, you're going to be wrong a good chunk of the time,' Yudell told Live Science. (24 words)
cn: 尤德尔告诉《生活科学》说：‘如果你根据某人的种族做出临床预测，你会在很多时候犯错。’

en: In the paper, he and his colleagues used the example of cystic fibrosis, which is underdiagnosed in people of African ancestry because it is thought of as a 'white' disease. (30 words)
cn: 在这篇论文中，他和同事使用了囊性纤维化的例子，该病在非洲裔人群中诊断不足，因为它被认为是一种‘白人’疾病。

en: So what other variables could be used if the racial concept is thrown out? (14 words)
cn: 那么如果抛弃种族概念，可以使用哪些其他变量呢？

en: Yudell said scientists need to get more specific with their language, perhaps using terms like 'ancestry' or 'population' that might more precisely reflect the relationship between humans and their genes, on both the individual and population level. (37 words)
cn: 尤德尔表示，科学家需要在语言上更加精确，或许使用‘血统’或‘人群’等术语，这些术语可能在个体和群体层面更准确地反映人类与其基因之间的关系。

en: The researchers also acknowledged that there are a few areas where race as a construct might still be useful in scientific research: as a political and social, but not biological, variable. (31 words)
cn: 研究人员也承认，在少数领域，种族作为一种建构在科学研究中可能仍然有用：作为政治和社会变量，而非生物学变量。

en: 'While we argue phasing out racial terminology in the biological sciences, we also acknowledge that using race as a political or social category to study racism, although filled with lots of challenges, remains necessary given our need to understand how structural inequities and discrimination produce health disparities between groups.' Yudell said. (51 words)
cn: 尤德尔说：‘虽然我们主张在生物科学中逐步淘汰种族术语，但我们也承认，将种族作为政治或社会范畴来研究种族主义，尽管充满挑战，但鉴于我们需要理解结构性不平等和歧视如何导致群体之间的健康差异，仍然是必要的。’

en: Small communities, with their distinctive character—where life is stable and intensely human—are disappearing. (13 words)
cn: 那些具有独特特色的小社区——生活稳定、充满人情味——正在消失。

en: Some have vanished from the face of the earth, others are dying slowly, but all have undergone changes as they have come into contact with an expanding machine civilization. (29 words)
cn: 有些已从地球上消失，另一些则在缓慢消亡，但所有社区在接触不断扩张的机器文明时都经历了变化。

en: The merging of diverse peoples into a common mass has produced tension among members of the minorities and the majority alike. (21 words)
cn: 不同民族融合为一个共同群体，在少数族裔和多数族裔成员中都产生了紧张关系。

en: The Old Order Amish, who arrived on American shores in colonial times, have survived in the modern world in distinctive, small communities. (22 words)
cn: 在殖民时期到达美国海岸的旧秩序阿米什人，在现代世界中以独特的小社区形式存活下来。

en: They have resisted the homogenization process more successfully than others. (10 words)
cn: 他们比其他人更成功地抵制了同质化进程。

en: In planting and harvest time one can see their bearded men working the fields with horses and their women hanging out the laundry in neat rows to dry. (28 words)
cn: 在播种和收获时节，人们可以看到他们留着胡须的男人用马在田间劳作，女人把洗好的衣服整齐地挂成一排晾干。

en: Many American people have seen Amish families, with the men wearing broad-brimmed black hats and the women in long dresses, in railway or bus terminals. (25 words)
cn: 许多美国人在火车站或汽车站见过阿米什人家庭——男人戴着宽边黑帽，女人穿着长裙。

en: Although the Amish have lived with industrialized America for over two and a half centuries, they have moderated its influence on their personal lives, their families, communities, and their values. (30 words)
cn: 尽管阿米什人与工业化的美国共存了两个半世纪以上，但他们削弱了它对个人生活、家庭、社区和价值观的影响。

en: The Amish are often perceived by other Americans to be relics of the past who live a simple, inflexible life dedicated to inconvenient outdated customs. (25 words)
cn: 阿米什人常被其他美国人视为过去的遗物，过着简单、刻板的生活，固守着不便的过时习俗。

en: They are seen as abandoning both modern conveniences and the American dream of success and progress. (16 words)
cn: 他们被视为既放弃了现代便利，也放弃了美国梦中的成功与进步。

en: But most people have no quarrel with the Amish for doing things the old-fashioned way. (15 words)
cn: 但大多数人并不反对阿米什人按照传统方式做事。

en: Their conscientious objection was tolerated in wartime, for after all, they are good farmers who practice the virtues of work and thrift. (22 words)
cn: 他们在战争时期因良心拒服兵役得到容忍，毕竟他们是践行勤劳和节俭美德的好农民。

en: On a glacier-filled island with fjords and elephant seals, Russia has built Antarctica's first Orthodox church on a hill overlooking its research base. (23 words)
cn: 在一个布满冰川、有峡湾和海象的岛屿上，俄罗斯在一座俯瞰其研究基地的山上建造了南极洲第一座东正教教堂。

en: Less than an hour away by snowmobile, Chinese labourers have updated the Great Wall Station, a vital part of China's plan to operate five bases on Antarctica, complete with an indoor badminton court and sleeping quarters for 150 people. (39 words)
cn: 乘雪地摩托不到一小时的路程，中国工人已经翻新了长城站，这是中国在南极运营五个基地计划的重要组成部分，配有室内羽毛球场和可容纳150人的宿舍。

en: Not to be outdone, India's futuristic new Bharathi base, built on stilts using 134 interlocking shipping containers, resembles a spaceship. (20 words)
cn: 不甘示弱的印度新建的未来派巴拉蒂基地，用134个互锁的集装箱建在桩子上，看起来像一艘宇宙飞船。

en: Turkey and Iran have announced plans to build bases, too. (10 words)
cn: 土耳其和伊朗也宣布了建造基地的计划。

en: More than a century has passed since explorers raced to plant their flags at the bottom of the world, and for decades to come this continent is supposed to be protected as a scientific preserve, shielded from intrusions like military activities and mining. (43 words)
cn: 自从探险家们争先恐后地在世界最南端插上旗帜以来，一个多世纪已经过去，在未来的几十年里，这片大陆本应作为科学保护区受到保护，不受军事活动和采矿等入侵的干扰。

en: But an array of countries are rushing to assert greater influence here, with an eye not just towards the day those protective treaties expire, but also for the strategic and commercial opportunities that already exist. (35 words)
cn: 但一系列国家正急于在这里施加更大的影响力，不仅着眼于那些保护性条约到期的那一天，也着眼于已经存在的战略和商业机会。

en: The newer players are stepping into what they view as a treasure house of resources. (15 words)
cn: 新加入的国家正在踏入他们视为资源宝库的地方。

en: Some of the ventures focus on the Antarctic resources that are already up for grabs, like abundant sea life. (19 words)
cn: 一些项目聚焦于南极洲已有的可获取资源，如丰富的海洋生物。

en: South Korea, which operates state-of-the-art bases here, is increasing its fishing of krill, found in abundance in the Southern Ocean, while Russia recently frustrated efforts to create one of the world's largest ocean sanctuaries here. (35 words)
cn: 在这里运营着最先进基地的韩国正在增加对南大洋中储量丰富的磷虾的捕捞，而俄罗斯最近挫败了在这里建立世界上最大海洋保护区之一的努力。

en: Some scientists are examining the potential for harvesting icebergs from Antarctica, which is estimated to have the biggest reserves of fresh water on the planet. (25 words)
cn: 一些科学家正在研究从南极洲开采冰山的潜力，据估计南极洲拥有地球上最大的淡水储量。

en: Nations are also pressing ahead with space research and satellite projects to expand their global navigation abilities. (17 words)
cn: 各国也在推进太空研究和卫星项目，以扩展其全球导航能力。

en: Building on a Soviet-era foothold, Russia is expanding its monitoring stations for Glonass, its version of the Global Positioning System (GPS). (21 words)
cn: 在苏联时代的立足点上，俄罗斯正在扩大其格洛纳斯系统的监测站，这是其版本的全球定位系统。

en: At least three Russian stations are already operating in Antarctica, part of its effort to challenge the dominance of the American GPS, and new stations are planned for sites like the Russian base, in the shadow of the Orthodox Church of the Holy Trinity. (44 words)
cn: 至少有三个俄罗斯监测站已经在南极洲运行，这是其挑战美国GPS主导地位努力的一部分，并计划在俄罗斯基地等地建立新站，就在圣三一东正教堂的附近。

en: Elsewhere in Antarctica, Russian researchers boast of their recent discovery of a freshwater reserve the size of Lake Ontario after drilling through miles of solid ice. (26 words)
cn: 在南极洲的其他地方，俄罗斯研究人员吹嘘他们最近在钻穿数英里厚的冰层后，发现了一个安大略湖大小的淡水储量。

en: 'You can see that we're here to stay,' said Vladimir Cheberdak, 57, chief of the Bellingshausen Station, as he sipped tea under a portrait of Fabian Gottlieb von Bellingshausen, a high-ranking officer in the Imperial Russian Navy who explored the Antarctic coast in 1820. (44 words)
cn: 57岁的别林斯高晋站站长弗拉基米尔·切贝尔达克一边喝茶，一边说：‘你可以看到我们会一直在这里。’他身后挂着法比安·戈特利布·冯·别林斯高晋的肖像，这位俄国帝国海军高级军官曾在1820年探索南极海岸。

en: Antarctica's mineral, oil and gas wealth are a longer-term prize. (10 words)
cn: 南极洲的矿产、石油和天然气财富是更长远的奖励。

en: The treaty banning mining here, shielding coveted reserves of iron ore, coal and chromium, comes up for review in 2048. (20 words)
cn: 禁止在此采矿、保护令人垂涎的铁矿石、煤炭和铬储量的条约将于2048年接受审议。

en: Researchers recently found kimberlite deposits hinting at the existence of diamonds. (11 words)
cn: 研究人员最近发现了金伯利岩矿床，暗示着钻石的存在。

en: And while assessments vary widely, geologists estimate that Antarctica holds at least 36 billion barrels of oil and natural gas. (20 words)
cn: 虽然评估差异很大，但地质学家估计南极洲至少拥有360亿桶石油和天然气储量。

en: Beyond the Antarctic treaties, huge obstacles persist to tapping these resources, like drifting icebergs that could jeopardise offshore platforms. (19 words)
cn: 除了南极条约之外，开采这些资源仍然存在巨大障碍，比如可能危及海上平台的漂移冰山。

en: Then there is Antarctica's remoteness, with some mineral deposits found in windswept locations on a continent that is larger than Europe and where winter temperatures hover around minus 55 degrees Celsius. (31 words)
cn: 还有南极洲的偏远性，一些矿藏位于这片比欧洲还大的大陆上风大的地方，冬季气温徘徊在零下55摄氏度左右。

en: But advances in technology might make Antarctica a lot more accessible three decades from now. (15 words)
cn: 但技术进步可能使南极洲在三十年后变得更加容易到达。

en: And even before then, scholars warn, the demand for resources in an energy-hungry world could raise pressure to renegotiate Antarctica's treaties, possibly allowing more commercial endeavours here well before the prohibitions against them expire. (34 words)
cn: 甚至在更早之前，学者们警告说，一个渴求能源的世界对资源的需求可能会增加重新谈判南极条约的压力，可能在禁令到期之前就允许更多的商业活动。

en: The research stations on King George Island offer a glimpse into the long game on this ice-blanketed continent as nations assert themselves, eroding the sway long held by countries like the United States, Britain, Australia and New Zealand. (38 words)
cn: 乔治王岛上的研究站提供了一窥这片冰雪覆盖大陆上长期博弈的机会，各国正在展现自己的力量，削弱了美国、英国、澳大利亚和新西兰等国长期拥有的影响力。

en: Being stationed in Antarctica involves adapting to life on the planet's driest, windiest and coldest continent, yet each nation manages to make itself at home. (25 words)
cn: 驻扎在南极洲需要适应地球上最干燥、最多风、最寒冷大陆的生活，但每个国家都设法让自己安顿下来。

en: Bearded Russian priests offer regular services at the Orthodox church for the 16 or so Russian speakers who spend the winter at the base, largely polar scientists in fields like glaciology and meteorology. (33 words)
cn: 留着胡须的俄罗斯神父在东正教教堂为大约16名在基地过冬的俄语人士定期举行礼拜，他们主要是冰川学和气象学等领域的极地科学家。

en: Their number climbs to about 40 in the warmer summer months. (11 words)
cn: 在较暖和的夏季月份，这一数字上升到约40人。

en: China has arguably the fastest-growing operations in Antarctica. (8 words)
cn: 中国可以说是南极洲增长最快的运营国。

en: It opened its fourth station last year and is pressing ahead with plans to build a fifth. (17 words)
cn: 去年它开设了第四个考察站，并正在推进建设第五个的计划。

en: It is building its second ice-breaking ship and setting up research drilling operations on an ice dome 13,422 feet above sea level that is one of the planet's coldest places. (30 words)
cn: 它正在建造第二艘破冰船，并在海拔13，422英尺的冰穹上开展研究钻探作业，那里是地球上最寒冷的地方之一。

en: Chinese officials say the expansion in Antarctica prioritises scientific research, but they also acknowledge that concerns about 'resource security' influence their moves. (22 words)
cn: 中国官员表示，在南极洲的扩张优先考虑科学研究，但他们也承认对‘资源安全’的担忧影响了他们的行动。

en: China's newly renovated Great Wall Station on King George Island makes the Russian and Chilean bases here seem outdated. (19 words)
cn: 中国在乔治王岛上新翻修的长城站让这里的俄罗斯和智利基地显得过时。

en: 'We do weather monitoring here and other research,' Ning Xu, 53, the chief of the Chinese base, said over tea during a fierce blizzard in late November. (27 words)
cn: 53岁的中国基地站长徐宁在11月下旬的一场猛烈暴风雪中边喝茶边说：‘我们在这里进行天气监测和其他研究。’

en: The large base he leads resembles a snowed-in college campus on holiday break, with the capacity to sleep more than 10 times the 13 people who were staying on through the Antarctic winter. (33 words)
cn: 他领导的这个大型基地就像一个被雪覆盖的假期中的大学校园，其住宿容量是在南极冬季留守的13人的十倍以上。

en: Yong Yu, a Chinese microbiologist, showed off the spacious building, with empty desks under an illustrated timeline detailing the rapid growth of China's Antarctic operations since the 1980s. (28 words)
cn: 中国微生物学家于勇展示了这座宽敞的建筑，在配有插图的时间线下是空荡荡的书桌，时间线详细展示了自20世纪80年代以来中国南极活动的快速增长。

en: 'We now feel equipped to grow,' he said. (8 words)
cn: 他说：‘我们现在感觉有能力发展壮大了。’

en: As some countries expand operations in Antarctica, the United States maintains three year-round stations on the continent with more than 1,000 people during the southern hemisphere's summer, including those at the Amundsen-Scott station, built in 1956 at an elevation of 9,301 feet on a plateau at the South Pole. (49 words)
cn: 随着一些国家在南极洲扩大运营，美国在这片大陆上维持着三个全年站，在南半球夏季有超过1000人，包括阿蒙森-斯科特站的人员，该站建于1956年，位于南极高原上海拔9，301英尺处。

en: But US researchers quietly complain about budget restraints and having far fewer icebreakers than Russia, limiting the reach of the United States in Antarctica. (24 words)
cn: 但美国研究人员私下抱怨预算限制和破冰船数量远少于俄罗斯，这限制了美国在南极洲的影响力。

en: Scholars warn that Antarctica's political drift could blur the distinction between military and civilian activities long before the continent's treaties come up for renegotiation, especially in parts of Antarctica that are ideal for intercepting signals from satellites or retasking satellite systems, potentially enhancing global electronic intelligence operations. (47 words)
cn: 学者们警告说，在这片大陆的条约重新谈判之前很久，南极洲的政治走向就可能模糊军事和民用活动之间的界限，尤其是在南极洲那些适合拦截卫星信号或重新分配卫星系统任务的区域，这可能增强全球电子情报行动。

en: Some countries have had a hard time here. (8 words)
cn: 一些国家在这里度过了一段艰难时期。

en: Brazil opened a research station in 1984, but it was largely destroyed by a fire that killed two members of the navy in 2012, the same year that a diesel-laden Brazilian barge sank near the base. (36 words)
cn: 巴西于1984年开设了一个研究站，但在2012年的一场大火中大部分被毁，火灾造成两名海军成员死亡，同年一艘满载柴油的巴西驳船在基地附近沉没。

en: As if that were not enough, a Brazilian C-130 Hercules military transport plane has remained stranded near the runway of Chile's air base here since it crash-landed in 2014. (29 words)
cn: 好像这还不够，一架巴西C-130大力神军用运输机自2014年迫降以来，一直搁浅在智利空军基地跑道附近。

en: However, Brazil's stretch of misfortune has created opportunities for China, with a Chinese company winning the $100 million contract in 2015 to rebuild the Brazilian station. (26 words)
cn: 然而，巴西的一连串不幸为中国创造了机会，一家中国公司在2015年赢得了1亿美元的合同来重建巴西站。

en: Amid all the changes, Antarctica maintains its allure. (8 words)
cn: 在所有这些变化中，南极洲保持着它的吸引力。

en: South Korea opened its second Antarctic research base in 2014, describing it as a way to test robots developed by Korean researchers for use in extreme conditions. (27 words)
cn: 韩国于2014年开设了第二个南极研究基地，将其描述为测试韩国研究人员开发的用于极端条件下机器人的方式。

en: With Russia's help, Belarus is preparing to build its first Antarctic base. (12 words)
cn: 在俄罗斯的帮助下，白俄罗斯正准备建造其第一个南极基地。

en: Colombia said this year that it planned to join other South American nations with bases in Antarctica. (17 words)
cn: 哥伦比亚今年表示计划加入其他在南极洲设有基地的南美国家。

en: 'The old days of the Antarctic being dominated by the interests and wishes of white men from European, Australasian and North American states are over,' said Klaus Dodds, a politics scholar at the University of London who specialises in Antarctica. (40 words)
cn: 伦敦大学专攻南极研究的政治学者克劳斯·多兹说：‘南极被来自欧洲、澳大利亚和新西兰以及北美国家的白人的利益和愿望所主导的日子已经结束了。’

en: 'The reality is that Antarctica is geopolitically contested.' (8 words)
cn: ‘现实是南极洲在地缘政治上是有争议的。’

en: Any veteran nicotine addict will testify that fancy packaging plays no role in the decision to keep smoking. (18 words)
cn: 任何资深尼古丁成瘾者都会证明，花哨的包装在决定是否继续吸烟方面不起作用。

en: So, it is argued, stripping cartons of their branding will trigger no mass movement to quit. (16 words)
cn: 因此，有人认为，去除烟盒上的品牌标识不会引发大规模戒烟运动。

en: But that isn't why the government—under pressure from cancer charities, health workers and the Labour party—has agreed to legislate for standardised packaging. (22 words)
cn: 但这并不是政府在癌症慈善机构、卫生工作者和工党的压力下同意立法规范包装的原因。

en: The theory is that smoking should be stripped of any appeal to discourage new generations from starting in the first place. (21 words)
cn: 其理论是应该去除吸烟的任何吸引力，以阻止新一代人从一开始就吸烟。

en: Plain packaging would be another step in the reclassification of cigarettes from inviting consumer products to narcotics. (17 words)
cn: 平装将是香烟从诱人的消费品重新分类为麻醉剂的又一步。

en: Naturally, the tobacco industry is violently opposed. (7 words)
cn: 自然，烟草行业强烈反对。

en: No business likes to admit that it sells addictive poison as a lifestyle choice. (14 words)
cn: 没有企业喜欢承认它把会上瘾的毒药当作一种生活方式选择来销售。

en: That is why government has historically intervened, banning advertising, imposing health warnings and punitive duties. (15 words)
cn: 这就是为什么政府历史上一直在干预，禁止广告、强制健康警告和惩罚性关税。

en: This approach has led over time to a fall in smoking with numbers having roughly halved since the 1970s. (19 words)
cn: 这种方法随着时间的推移导致了吸烟率的下降，自20世纪70年代以来数字大致减半。

en: Evidence from Australia suggests plain packaging pushes society further along that road. (12 words)
cn: 来自澳大利亚的证据表明，平装推动社会沿着那条路走得更远。

en: Since tobacco is one of the biggest causes of premature death in the UK, a measure that tames the habit even by a fraction is worth trying. (27 words)
cn: 由于烟草是英国过早死亡的最大原因之一，即使只是稍微控制吸烟习惯的措施也值得一试。

en: So why has it taken so long? (7 words)
cn: 那么为什么花了这么长时间？

en: The Department of Health declared its intention to consider the move in November 2010 and consulted through 2012. (18 words)
cn: 卫生部于2010年11月宣布考虑这一举措的意图，并在2012年进行了咨询。

en: But the plan was suspended in July 2013. (8 words)
cn: 但该计划于2013年7月被暂停。

en: It did not escape notice that a lobbying firm set up by Lynton Crosby, David Cameron's election campaign director, had previously acted for Philip Morris International. (26 words)
cn: 人们注意到，戴维·卡梅伦的竞选总监林顿·克罗斯比成立的游说公司曾为菲利普·莫里斯国际公司工作。

en: The prime minister denied there was a connection between his new adviser's outside interests and the change in legislative programme. (20 words)
cn: 首相否认他的新顾问的外部利益与立法计划的改变之间存在联系。

en: In November 2013, after an unnecessary round of additional consultation, health minister Jane Ellison said the government was minded to proceed after all. (23 words)
cn: 2013年11月，在不必要的一轮额外咨询之后，卫生部长简·埃里森表示政府终究还是打算推进。

en: Now we are told Members of Parliament will have a free vote before parliament is dissolved in March. (18 words)
cn: 现在我们知道议员们将在三月议会解散前进行自由投票。

en: Parliament has in fact already authorised the government to tame the tobacco trade. (13 words)
cn: 事实上，议会已经授权政府管制烟草贸易。

en: MPs voted overwhelmingly in favour of Labour amendments to the children and families bill last February that included the power to regulate for plain packaging. (25 words)
cn: 去年二月，议员们以压倒性多数投票支持工党对儿童和家庭法案的修正案，其中包括对平装进行监管的权力。

en: With sufficient will in Downing Street this would have been done already. (12 words)
cn: 如果唐宁街有足够的意愿，这早就完成了。

en: But strength of will is the missing ingredient where Mr. Cameron and public health are concerned. (16 words)
cn: 但在卡梅伦先生和公共卫生方面，意志力是缺失的因素。

en: His attitude to state intervention has looked confused ever since his bizarre 2006 lament that chocolate oranges placed seductively at supermarket checkouts fuelled obesity. (24 words)
cn: 自从他在2006年奇怪地感叹超市收银台诱人摆放的巧克力橙助长了肥胖以来，他对国家干预的态度就一直显得混乱。

en: The government has moved reluctantly into a sensible public health policy, but with such obvious over-cautiousness that any political credit due belongs to the opposition. (25 words)
cn: 政府勉强地转向了一项明智的公共卫生政策，但明显过于谨慎，以至于任何应得的政治功劳都属于反对党。

en: Without sustained external pressure it seems certain Mr. Cameron would still be hooked on the interests of big tobacco companies. (20 words)
cn: 如果没有持续的外部压力，卡梅伦先生似乎肯定仍会沉迷于大烟草公司的利益。

en: What a waste of money! (5 words)
cn: 真是浪费钱！

en: In return for an average of ~￡44,000 of debt, students get an average of only 14 hours of lecture and tutorial time a week in Britain. (26 words)
cn: 在英国，学生平均背负约44，000英镑的债务，但每周平均只有14小时的讲座和辅导时间。

en: Annual fees have risen from ￡1,000 to ￡9,000 in the last decade, but contact time at university has barely risen at all. (22 words)
cn: 在过去十年里，年费从1，000英镑上涨到9，000英镑，但大学的接触时间几乎没有增加。

en: And graduating doesn't even provide any guarantee of a decent job: six in ten graduates today are in non-graduate jobs. (20 words)
cn: 毕业甚至不能保证一份体面的工作：如今十分之六的毕业生从事不需要学位的工作。

en: No wonder it has become fashionable to denounce many universities as little more than elaborate con-tricks. (16 words)
cn: 难怪指责许多大学不过是精心设计的骗术已成为一种时尚。

en: There's a lot for students to complain about: the repayment threshold for paying back loans will be frozen for five years, meaning that lower-paid graduates have to start repaying their loans; and maintenance grants have been replaced by loans, meaning that students from poorer backgrounds face higher debt than those with wealthier parents. (53 words)
cn: 学生有很多可以抱怨的地方：偿还贷款的门槛将冻结五年，意味着收入较低的毕业生必须开始偿还贷款；生活补助金已被贷款取代，意味着来自贫困家庭的学生比父母更富裕的学生面临更高的债务。

en: Yet it still pays to go to university. (8 words)
cn: 然而上大学仍然是值得的。

en: If going to university doesn't work out, students pay very little—if any—of their tuition fees back: you only start repaying when you are earning ￡21,000 a year. (27 words)
cn: 如果上大学不成功，学生只需偿还很少的学费——如果有的话：你只有在年收入达到21，000英镑时才开始偿还。

en: Almost half of graduates—those who go on to earn less—will have a portion of their debt written off. (18 words)
cn: 几乎一半的毕业生——那些收入较低的人——将会有部分债务被勾销。

en: It's not just the lectures and tutorials that are important. (10 words)
cn: 重要的不仅仅是讲座和辅导课。

en: Education is the sum of what students teach each other in between lectures and seminars. (15 words)
cn: 教育是学生在讲座和研讨会之间相互教学的总和。

en: Students do not merely benefit while at university; studies show they go on to be healthier and happier than non-graduates, and also far more likely to vote. (27 words)
cn: 学生不仅在大学期间受益；研究表明他们毕业后比非毕业生更健康、更快乐，也更有投票倾向。

en: Whatever your talents, it is extraordinarily difficult to get a leading job in most fields without having been to university. (20 words)
cn: 无论你有什么才能，在大多数领域没有上过大学就获得一份领导职位是极其困难的。

en: Recruiters circle elite universities like vultures. (6 words)
cn: 招聘人员像兀鹰一样在精英大学周围盘旋。

en: Many top firms will not even look at applications from those who lack a 2.1, i.e., an upper-second class degree, from an elite university. (24 words)
cn: 许多顶级公司甚至不会看那些没有精英大学二等一级荣誉学位的人的申请。

en: Students at university also meet those likely to be in leading jobs in the future, forming contacts for life. (19 words)
cn: 大学里的学生还会遇到那些将来可能从事领导工作的人，建立终身联系。

en: This might not be right, but school-leavers who fail to acknowledge as much risk making the wrong decision about going to university. (22 words)
cn: 这也许不对，但那些未能认识到这一点的离校生可能会在是否上大学的问题上做出错误的决定。

en: Perhaps the reason why so many universities offer their students so little is they know studying at a top university remains a brilliant investment even if you don't learn anything. (30 words)
cn: 也许这么多大学给学生的东西如此之少的原因是它们知道在顶尖大学学习即使什么都没学到仍然是一项极好的投资。

en: Studying at university will only become less attractive if employers shift their focus away from where someone went to university—and there is no sign of that happening anytime soon. (29 words)
cn: 只有当雇主把注意力从某人上过哪所大学转移开时，上大学才会变得不那么有吸引力——而且没有迹象表明这种情况会很快发生。

en: School-leavers may moan, but they have little choice but to embrace university and the student debt that comes with it. (20 words)
cn: 离校生可能会抱怨，但他们别无选择，只能接受大学及其伴随的学生债务。

en: After becoming president of Purdue University in 2013, Mitch Daniels asked the faculty to prove that their students have actually achieved one of higher education's most important goals: critical thinking skills. (31 words)
cn: 2013年成为普渡大学校长后，米奇·丹尼尔斯要求教师们证明他们的学生确实实现了高等教育最重要的目标之一：批判性思维能力。

en: Two years before, a nationwide study of college graduates had shown that more than a third had made no significant gains in such mental abilities during their school years. (29 words)
cn: 两年前，一项针对大学毕业生的全国性研究表明，超过三分之一的人在大学期间在这种心智能力方面没有取得显著进步。

en: Mr. Daniels needed to justify the high cost of attending Purdue to its students and their families. (17 words)
cn: 丹尼尔斯先生需要向学生及其家庭证明就读普渡大学的高昂费用是合理的。

en: After all, the percentage of Americans who say a college degree is 'very important' has fallen drastically in the last 5-6 years. (22 words)
cn: 毕竟，在过去五六年里，认为大学学位“非常重要”的美国人比例急剧下降。

en: Purdue now has a pilot test to assess students' critical thinking skills. (12 words)
cn: 普渡大学现在有一项试点测试来评估学生的批判性思维能力。

en: Yet like many college teachers around the U.S., the faculty remain doubtful that their work as educators can be measured by a 'learning outcome' such as a graduate's ability to investigate and reason. (33 words)
cn: 然而，与美国各地的许多大学教师一样，普渡大学的教师们仍然怀疑他们作为教育者的工作能否用“学习成果”来衡量，比如毕业生调查和推理的能力。

en: However, the professors need not worry so much. (8 words)
cn: 然而，教授们不必太担心。

en: The results of a recent experiment showed that professors can use standardized metrics to measure how well students do in three key areas: critical thinking, written communication, and quantitative literacy. (30 words)
cn: 最近一项实验的结果表明，教授可以使用标准化指标来衡量学生在三个关键领域的表现：批判性思维、书面沟通和数量素养。

en: Despite the success of the experiment, the actual results are worrisome, and mostly confirm earlier studies. (16 words)
cn: 尽管实验取得了成功，但实际结果令人担忧，并且大多证实了早期的研究。

en: The organizers of the experiment concluded that far fewer students were achieving at high levels on critical thinking than they were doing for written communication or quantitative literacy. (28 words)
cn: 实验的组织者得出结论，在批判性思维方面达到高水准的学生远少于在书面沟通或数量素养方面达到高水准的学生。

en: And that conclusion is based only on students nearing graduation. (10 words)
cn: 而这一结论仅基于即将毕业的学生。

en: American universities, despite their global reputation for excellence in teaching, have only begun to demonstrate what they can produce in real-world learning. (22 words)
cn: 尽管美国大学在全球享有卓越教学的声誉，但它们才刚刚开始展示在现实学习中的成果。

en: Knowledge-based degrees are still important, but employers are demanding advanced thinking skills from college graduates. (15 words)
cn: 基于知识的学位仍然重要，但雇主正在要求大学毕业生具备高级思维能力。

en: If the intellectual worth of a college degree can be accurately measured, more people will seek higher education—and come out better thinkers. (22 words)
cn: 如果大学学位的智力价值能够被准确衡量，更多的人将寻求高等教育——并成为更好的思考者。

en: Fossil fuel prices are likely to stay 'low for long'. (10 words)
cn: 化石燃料价格可能会长期处于低位。

en: Notwithstanding important recent progress in developing renewable fuel sources, low fossil fuel prices could discourage further innovation in, and adoption of, cleaner energy technologies. (24 words)
cn: 尽管最近在开发可再生燃料方面取得了重要进展，但化石燃料价格低廉可能会阻碍清洁能源技术的进一步创新和采用。

en: The result would be higher emissions of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases. (13 words)
cn: 其结果将是二氧化碳和其他温室气体排放量增加。

en: Policymakers should not allow low energy prices to derail the clean energy transition. (13 words)
cn: 政策制定者不应让低能源价格破坏清洁能源转型。

en: Action to restore appropriate price incentives, notably through corrective carbon pricing, is urgently needed to lower the risk of irreversible and potentially devastating effects of climate change. (27 words)
cn: 迫切需要采取行动恢复适当的价格激励，特别是通过纠正性碳定价，以降低气候变化带来不可逆转且可能造成毁灭性影响的风险。

en: That approach also offers fiscal benefits. (6 words)
cn: 这种方法还能带来财政收益。

en: Oil prices have dropped by over 60% since June 2014. (10 words)
cn: 自2014年6月以来，油价已下跌超过60%。

en: A commonly held view in the oil industry is that 'the best cure for low oil prices is low oil prices'. (21 words)
cn: 石油行业普遍认为：‘低油价的最好解药就是低油价’。

en: The reasoning behind this saying is that low oil prices discourage investment in new production capacity, eventually shifting the oil supply curve backward and bringing prices back up as existing oil fields—which can be tapped at relatively low marginal cost—are depleted. (41 words)
cn: 这句话背后的逻辑是，低油价抑制了对新产能的投资，最终使石油供给曲线后移，随着现有油田（可以以相对较低的边际成本开采）的枯竭，价格回升。

en: In fact, in line with past experience, capital expenditure in the oil sector has dropped sharply in many producing countries, including the United States. (24 words)
cn: 事实上，与过去的经验一致，包括美国在内的许多产油国的石油行业资本支出已经大幅下降。

en: The dynamic adjustment to low oil prices may, however, be different this time around. (14 words)
cn: 然而，这次对低油价的动态调整可能有所不同。

en: Oil prices are expected to remain lower for longer. (9 words)
cn: 预计油价将在更长时间内保持较低水平。

en: The advent of new technologies has added about 4.2 million barrels per day to the crude oil market, contributing to a global over-supply. (23 words)
cn: 新技术的出现使原油市场每天增加约420万桶的供应量，导致全球供应过剩。

en: In addition, other factors are putting downward pressure on oil prices: change in the strategic behavior of the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries, the projected increase in Iranian exports, the scaling-down of global demand (especially from emerging markets), the long-term drop in petroleum consumption in the United States, and some displacement of oil by substitutes. (55 words)
cn: 此外，其他因素也在对油价施加下行压力：石油输出国组织战略行为的改变、伊朗出口的预期增长、全球需求（尤其是新兴市场的需求）的缩减、美国石油消费的长期下降，以及替代品对石油的部分替代。

en: These likely persistent forces, like the growth of shale oil, point to a 'low for long' scenario. (17 words)
cn: 这些可能持续的力量，如页岩油的增长，都指向‘长期低位’的 scenario。

en: Futures markets, which show only a modest recovery of prices to around $60 a barrel by 2019, support this view. (20 words)
cn: 期货市场显示，到2019年价格仅温和回升至每桶60美元左右，这支持了这一观点。

en: Natural gas and coal—also fossil fuels—have similarly seen price declines that look to be long-lived. (15 words)
cn: 天然气和煤炭——同样属于化石燃料——也出现了看似长期的价格下跌。

en: Coal and natural gas are mainly used for electricity generation, whereas oil is used mostly to power transportation, yet the prices of all these energy sources are linked. (28 words)
cn: 煤炭和天然气主要用于发电，而石油主要用于交通运输，但这些能源的价格是相互关联的。

en: The North American shale gas boom has resulted in record low prices there. (13 words)
cn: 北美页岩气的繁荣使那里的价格创下历史新低。

en: The recent discovery of the giant Zohr gas field off the Egyptian coast will eventually have impact on pricing in the Mediterranean region and Europe, and there is significant development potential in many other places, notably Argentina. (37 words)
cn: 最近在埃及海岸发现的巨型Zohr气田最终将影响地中海地区和欧洲的定价，而且在许多其他地方，尤其是阿根廷，也有巨大的开发潜力。

en: Coal prices also are low, owing to over-supply and the scaling-down of demand, especially from China, which burns half of the world's coal. (23 words)
cn: 煤炭价格也很低，原因是供应过剩和需求缩减，尤其是来自中国的需求——中国消耗了世界上一半的煤炭。

en: Technological innovations have unleashed the power of renewables such as wind, hydro, solar, and geothermal. (15 words)
cn: 技术创新释放了风能、水能、太阳能和地热能等可再生能源的力量。

en: Even Africa and the Middle East, home to economies that are heavily dependent on fossil fuel exports, have enormous potential to develop renewables. (23 words)
cn: 即使是严重依赖化石燃料出口的非洲和中东经济体，也有巨大的可再生能源开发潜力。

en: For example, the United Arab Emirates has endorsed an ambitious target to draw 24% of its primary energy consumption from renewable sources by 2021. (24 words)
cn: 例如，阿拉伯联合酋长国已经批准了一个雄心勃勃的目标，即到2021年将其24%的一次能源消费来自可再生能源。

en: Progress in the development of renewables could be fragile, however, if fossil fuel prices remain low for long. (18 words)
cn: 然而，如果化石燃料价格长期保持低位，可再生能源的发展进展可能会很脆弱。

en: Renewables account for only a small share of global primary energy consumption, which is still dominated by fossil fuels—30% each for coal and oil, 25% for natural gas. (28 words)
cn: 可再生能源仅占全球一次能源消费的一小部分，化石燃料仍占主导地位——煤炭和石油各占30%，天然气占25%。

en: But renewable energy will have to displace fossil fuels to a much greater extent in the future to avoid unacceptable climate risks. (22 words)
cn: 但为了避免不可接受的气候风险，可再生能源未来必须更大程度地取代化石燃料。

en: Unfortunately, the current low prices for oil, gas, and coal may provide little incentive for research to find even cheaper substitutes for those fuels. (24 words)
cn: 不幸的是，目前石油、天然气和煤炭的低价可能无法为研究寻找更便宜的替代燃料提供足够动力。

en: There is strong evidence that both innovation and adoption of cleaner technology are strongly encouraged by higher fossil fuel prices. (20 words)
cn: 有强有力的证据表明，更高的化石燃料价格会极大地促进清洁技术的创新和采用。

en: The same is true for new technologies for alleviating fossil fuel emissions. (12 words)
cn: 减少化石燃料排放的新技术也是如此。

en: The current low fossil fuel price environment will thus certainly delay the energy transition from fossil fuel to clean energy sources. (21 words)
cn: 因此，当前化石燃料价格低迷的环境肯定会延缓从化石燃料向清洁能源的转型。

en: Unless renewables become cheap enough that substantial carbon deposits are left underground for a very long time, if not forever, the planet will likely be exposed to potentially catastrophic climate risks. (31 words)
cn: 除非可再生能源变得足够便宜，使大量碳储量长期（如果不是永远）留在地下，否则地球很可能面临潜在的灾难性气候风险。

en: Some climate impacts may already be discernible. (7 words)
cn: 一些气候影响可能已经可以辨别出来。

en: For example, the United Nations Children's Fund estimates that some 11 million children in Africa face hunger, disease, and water shortages as a result of the strongest El Nino weather phenomenon in decades. (33 words)
cn: 例如，联合国儿童基金会估计，由于几十年来最强的厄尔尼诺天气现象，非洲约有1100万儿童面临饥饿、疾病和缺水。

en: Many scientists believe that El Nino events, caused by warming in the Pacific, are becoming more intense as a result of climate change. (23 words)
cn: 许多科学家认为，由太平洋变暖引起的厄尔尼诺现象正因气候变化而变得更加强烈。

en: Nations from around the world have gathered in Paris for the United Nations Climate Change Conference, COP 21, with the goal of a universal and potentially legally-binding agreement on reducing greenhouse gas emissions. (33 words)
cn: 世界各国齐聚巴黎参加联合国气候变化大会COP21，目标是达成一项普遍且可能具有法律约束力的减少温室气体排放协议。

en: We need very broad participation to fully address the global tragedy that results when countries fail to take into account the negative impact of their carbon emissions on the rest of the world. (33 words)
cn: 我们需要非常广泛的参与来彻底解决这一全球性悲剧——即各国未能考虑其碳排放对世界其他地区的负面影响时所造成的悲剧。

en: Moreover, non-participation by nations, if sufficiently widespread, can undermine the political will of participating countries to act. (17 words)
cn: 此外，如果各国不参与的情况足够普遍，可能会削弱参与国采取行动的政治意愿。

en: The nations participating at COP 21 are focusing on quantitative emissions-reduction commitments. (12 words)
cn: 参与COP21的国家正专注于量化减排承诺。

en: Economic reasoning shows that the least expensive way for each country is to put a price on carbon emissions. (19 words)
cn: 经济推理表明，对每个国家来说，成本最低的方式是对碳排放定价。

en: The reason is that when carbon is priced, those emissions reductions that are least costly to implement will happen first. (20 words)
cn: 原因在于，当碳被定价时，那些实施成本最低的减排将首先发生。

en: The International Monetary Fund calculates that countries can generate substantial fiscal revenues by eliminating fossil fuel subsidies and levying carbon charges that capture the domestic damage caused by emissions. (29 words)
cn: 国际货币基金组织计算，各国可以通过取消化石燃料补贴和征收碳税来获得可观的财政收入，这些碳税反映了排放造成的国内损害。

en: A tax on upstream carbon sources is one easy way to put a price on carbon emissions, although some countries may wish to use other methods, such as emissions trading schemes. (31 words)
cn: 对上游碳源征税是对碳排放定价的一种简单方式，尽管一些国家可能希望使用其他方法，如排放交易计划。

en: In order to maximize global welfare, every country's carbon pricing should reflect not only the purely domestic damage from emissions, but also the damage to foreign countries. (27 words)
cn: 为了实现全球福利最大化，每个国家的碳定价不仅应反映排放造成的纯国内损害，还应反映对国外造成的损害。

en: Setting the right carbon price will therefore efficiently align the costs paid by carbon users with the true social opportunity cost of using carbon. (24 words)
cn: 因此，设定正确的碳价将有效地使碳使用者支付的成本与使用碳的真实社会机会成本保持一致。

en: By raising relative demand for clean energy sources, a carbon price would also help align the market return to clean-energy innovation with its social return, spurring the refinement of existing technologies and the development of new ones. (37 words)
cn: 通过提高对清洁能源的相对需求，碳价还将有助于使清洁能源创新的市场回报与其社会回报保持一致，从而促进现有技术的改进和新技术的开发。

en: And it would raise the demand for technologies such as carbon capture and storage, spurring their further development. (18 words)
cn: 它还将提高对碳捕获和储存等技术的需求，促进其进一步发展。

en: If not corrected by the appropriate carbon price, low fossil fuel prices are not accurately signaling to markets the true social profitability of clean energy. (25 words)
cn: 如果不通过适当的碳价加以纠正，低化石燃料价格就不能准确地向市场传递清洁能源的真实社会效益。

en: While alternative estimates of the damage from carbon emissions differ, and it's especially hard to reckon the likely costs of possible catastrophic climate events, most estimates suggest substantial negative effects. (30 words)
cn: 虽然对碳排放损害的替代估算各不相同，而且特别难以估算可能的灾难性气候事件的潜在成本，但大多数估算都表明存在重大的负面影响。

en: Direct subsidies to research and development have been adopted by some governments but are a poor substitute for a carbon price: they do only part of the job, leaving in place market incentives to over-use fossil fuels and thereby add to the stock of atmospheric greenhouse gases without regard to the collateral costs. (53 words)
cn: 一些政府采取了直接补贴研发的措施，但这远不能替代碳价：它们只完成了部分工作，留下了过度使用化石燃料的市场激励，从而增加了大气温室气体的存量，而没有考虑附带成本。

en: The hope is that the success of COP 21 opens the door to future international agreement on carbon prices. (19 words)
cn: 希望COP21的成功能为未来国际碳价协议打开大门。

en: Agreement on an international carbon-price floor would be a good starting point in that process. (15 words)
cn: 就国际碳价下限达成协议将是这一进程的良好起点。

en: Failure to address comprehensively the problem of greenhouse gas emissions, however, exposes all generations, present and future, to incalculable risks. (20 words)
cn: 然而，未能全面解决温室气体排放问题，将使现在和未来的所有世代面临无法估量的风险。

en: Open data sharers are still in the minority in many fields. (11 words)
cn: 在许多领域，开放数据共享者仍然是少数。

en: Although many researchers broadly agree that public access to raw data would accelerate science, most are reluctant to post the results of their own labors online. (26 words)
cn: 尽管许多研究人员普遍认为公开原始数据会加速科学进步，但大多数人仍然不愿将他们的研究成果发布到网上。

en: Some communities have agreed to share online—geneticists, for example, post DNA sequences at the GenBank repository, and astronomers are accustomed to accessing images of galaxies and stars from, say, the Sloan Digital Sky Survey, a telescope that has observed some 500 million objects—but these remain the exception, not the rule. (50 words)
cn: 一些群体已经同意在线分享——例如，遗传学家在GenBank存储库发布DNA序列，天文学家习惯于从斯隆数字巡天（一架已观测约5亿个天体的望远镜）获取星系和恒星图像——但这些仍然是例外，而非惯例。

en: Historically, scientists have objected to sharing for many reasons: it is a lot of work; until recently, good databases did not exist; grant funders were not pushing for sharing; it has been difficult to agree on standards for formatting data; and there is no agreed way to assign credit for data. (51 words)
cn: 从历史上看，科学家反对共享的原因有很多：工作量很大；直到最近，好的数据库还不存在；资助机构没有推动共享；很难就数据格式标准达成一致；而且没有公认的数据署名方式。

en: But the barriers are disappearing, in part because journals and funding agencies worldwide are encouraging scientists to make their data public. (21 words)
cn: 但这些障碍正在消失，部分原因是世界各地的期刊和资助机构正在鼓励科学家公开他们的数据。

en: Last year, the Royal Society in London said in its report that scientists need to 'shift away from a research culture where data is viewed as a private preserve'. (29 words)
cn: 去年，伦敦皇家学会在其报告中指出，科学家需要‘摆脱将数据视为私人领域的研究文化’。

en: Funding agencies note that data paid for with public money should be public information, and the scientific community is recognizing that data can now be shared digitally in ways that were not possible before. (34 words)
cn: 资助机构指出，用公共资金资助的数据应该属于公共信息，科学界也认识到，数据现在可以以以前不可能的方式以数字形式共享。

en: To match the growing demand, services are springing up to make it easier to publish research products online and enable other researchers to discover and cite them. (27 words)
cn: 为了满足日益增长的需求，各种服务如雨后春笋般涌现，使在线发布研究成果变得更加容易，并使其他研究人员能够发现和引用它们。

en: Although calls to share data often concentrate on the moral advantages of sharing, the practice is not purely altruistic. (19 words)
cn: 尽管共享数据的呼声通常集中在共享的道德优势上，但这种做法并非纯粹出于利他主义。

en: Researchers who share get plenty of personal benefits, including more connections with colleagues, improved visibility and increased citations. (18 words)
cn: 共享数据的研究人员会获得许多个人好处，包括与同事更多的联系、更高的知名度和更多的引用。

en: The most successful sharers—those whose data are downloaded and cited the most often—get noticed, and their work gets used. (19 words)
cn: 最成功的分享者——那些数据被下载和引用最多的人——会得到关注，他们的工作也会被使用。

en: For example, one of the most popular data sets on multidisciplinary repository Dryad is about wood density around the world; it has been downloaded 5,700 times. (26 words)
cn: 例如，多学科存储库Dryad上最受欢迎的数据集之一是关于全球木材密度的；它已被下载5700次。

en: Co-author Amy Zanne thinks that users probably range from climate-change researchers wanting to estimate how much carbon is stored in biomass, to foresters looking for information on different grades of timber. (31 words)
cn: 合著者艾米·赞恩认为，用户可能包括希望估算生物量中储存了多少碳的气候变化研究人员，以及寻找不同等级木材信息的林务员。

en: 'I'd much prefer to have my data used by the maximum number of people to ask their own questions,' she says. (21 words)
cn: 她说：‘我更希望我的数据能被最多的人使用，让他们提出自己的问题。’

en: 'It's important to allow readers and reviewers to see exactly how you arrive at your results. (16 words)
cn: ‘让读者和审稿人准确地看到你是如何得出结果的，这很重要。’

en: Publishing data and code allows your science to be reproducible.' (10 words)
cn: ‘发布数据和代码能让你的科学研究具有可重复性。’

en: Even people whose data are less popular can benefit. (9 words)
cn: 即使是数据不太受欢迎的人也能从中受益。

en: By making the effort to organize and label files so others can understand them, scientists become more organized and better disciplined themselves, thus avoiding confusion later on. (27 words)
cn: 通过努力组织和标记文件以便他人理解，科学家自己也变得更有条理、更自律，从而避免日后出现混乱。

en: Macy's reported its sales plunged 5.2% in November and December at stores open more than a year, a disappointing holiday season performance that capped a difficult year for a department store chain facing wide-ranging challenges. (35 words)
cn: 梅西百货报告称，其开业一年以上的门店在11月和12月的销售额暴跌了5.2%，这个令人失望的假日季表现为这家面临广泛挑战的连锁百货公司的艰难一年画上了句号。

en: Its flagship stores in major U.S. cities depend heavily on international tourist spending, which shrank at many retailers due to a strong dollar. (23 words)
cn: 其在美国主要城市的旗舰店严重依赖国际游客消费，而由于美元走强，许多零售商的国际游客消费都出现了萎缩。

en: Meanwhile, Macy's has simply struggled to lure consumers who are more interested in spending on travel or dining out than on new clothes or accessories. (25 words)
cn: 与此同时，梅西百货很难吸引那些更愿意把钱花在旅游或外出就餐上而不是新衣服或配饰上的消费者。

en: The company blamed much of the poor performance in November and December on unseasonably warm weather. (16 words)
cn: 该公司将其在11月和12月业绩不佳很大程度上归咎于反常的温暖天气。

en: 'About 80% of our company's year-over-year declines in comparable sales can be attributed to shortfalls in cold-weather goods,' said chief executive Terry Lundgren in a press release. (27 words)
cn: 首席执行官特里·伦德格伦在新闻稿中表示：‘本公司可比销售额同比下降的约80%可归因于御寒商品的短缺。’

en: This prompted the company to cut its forecasts for the full fourth quarter. (13 words)
cn: 这促使该公司下调了对整个第四季度的预测。

en: However, it's clear that Macy's believes its troubles run deeper than a temporary aberration off the thermometer. (17 words)
cn: 然而，很明显，梅西百货认为其问题远比温度计的暂时偏差更为深层。

en: The retail giant said the poor financial performance this year has pushed it to begin implementing $400 million in cost-cutting measures. (21 words)
cn: 这家零售巨头表示，今年的糟糕财务表现已促使其开始实施4亿美元的成本削减措施。

en: The company pledged to cut 600 back-office positions, though some 150 workers in those roles would be reassigned to other jobs. (21 words)
cn: 该公司承诺削减600个后台职位，但其中约150名员工将被重新分配到其他岗位。

en: It also plans to offer 'voluntary separation' packages to 165 senior executives. (12 words)
cn: 它还计划向165名高管提供‘自愿离职’方案。

en: It will slash staffing at its fleet of 770 stores, a move affecting some 3,000 employees. (16 words)
cn: 它还将削减其770家门店的人员配置，此举将影响约3000名员工。

en: The retailer also announced the locations of 36 stores it will close in early 2016. (15 words)
cn: 这家零售商还公布了将于2016年初关闭的36家门店的位置。

en: The company had previously announced the planned closures, but had not said which locations would be affected. (17 words)
cn: 该公司此前曾宣布计划关闭门店，但并未说明哪些门店将受影响。

en: None of the chain's stores in the Washington metropolitan area are to be closed. (14 words)
cn: 该连锁店在华盛顿大都会区的门店都不会关闭。

en: Macy's has been moving aggressively to try to remake itself for a new era of shopping. (16 words)
cn: 梅西百货一直在积极行动，试图为新的购物时代重塑自身。

en: It has plans to open more locations of Macy's Backstage, a newly-developed off-price concept which might help it better compete with ambitious T.J. Maxx. (24 words)
cn: 它计划开设更多的Macy's Backstage门店，这是一种新开发的折扣零售概念，可能有助于它更好地与雄心勃勃的T.J. Maxx竞争。

en: It's also pushing ahead in 2016 with an expansion of Bluemercury, the beauty chain it bought last year. (18 words)
cn: 它还在2016年推进去年收购的美妆连锁店Bluemercury的扩张。

en: At a time when young beauty shoppers are often turning to Sephora or Ulta instead of department store beauty counters, Macy's hopes Bluemercury will help strengthen its position in the category. (31 words)
cn: 在年轻的美妆消费者经常转向Sephora或Ulta而非百货公司美妆柜台之际，梅西百货希望Bluemercury能帮助加强其在美妆品类中的地位。

en: One relative bright spot for Macy's during the holiday season was the online channel, where it rang up 'double-digit' increases in sales and a 25% increase in the number of orders it filled. (33 words)
cn: 梅西百货在假日季的一个相对亮点是在线渠道，其销售额实现了‘两位数的增长’，完成的订单数量增加了25%。

en: That relative strength would be consistent with what was seen in the wider retail industry during the early part of the holiday season. (23 words)
cn: 这一相对优势与假日季初期更广泛的零售业情况一致。

en: While Thanksgiving, Black Friday and Cyber Monday all saw record spending online, in-store sales plunged over the holiday weekend. (19 words)
cn: 虽然感恩节、黑色星期五和网络星期一的在线消费都创下了纪录，但实体店销售额在假日周末暴跌。

en: Half of your brain stays alert and prepared for danger when you sleep in a new place, a study has revealed. (21 words)
cn: 一项研究揭示，当你在一个新地方睡觉时，你的一半大脑会保持警觉并为危险做好准备。

en: This phenomenon is often referred to as the 'first-night-effect'. (9 words)
cn: 这种现象通常被称为‘第一夜效应’。

en: Researchers from Brown University found that a network in the left hemisphere of the brain 'remained more active' than the network in the right side of the brain. (28 words)
cn: 布朗大学的研究人员发现，大脑左半球的一个网络比右半球的网络‘保持更活跃’。

en: Playing sounds into the right ears (stimulating the left hemisphere) of volunteers was more likely to wake them up than if the noises were played into their left ear. (29 words)
cn: 与将噪音播放到左耳相比，将声音播放到志愿者的右耳（刺激左半球）更可能唤醒他们。

en: It was specifically observed that the left side of the brain was more active during deep sleep. (17 words)
cn: 特别观察到，在深度睡眠期间，大脑左侧更加活跃。

en: When the researchers repeated the laboratory experiment on the second and third nights they found the left hemisphere could not be stimulated in the same way during deep sleep. (29 words)
cn: 当研究人员在第二和第三个晚上重复实验室实验时，他们发现左半球在深度睡眠期间不能被同样地刺激。

en: The researchers explained that the study demonstrated when we are in a novel environment the brain partly remains alert so that humans can defend themselves against any potential danger. (29 words)
cn: 研究人员解释说，这项研究表明，当我们处于新环境时，大脑部分保持警觉，以便人类能够抵御任何潜在危险。

en: The researchers believe this is the first time that the 'first-night-effect' of different brain states has been identified in humans. (20 words)
cn: 研究人员认为，这是首次在人类身上识别出不同大脑状态的‘第一夜效应’。

en: It isn't, however, the first time it has ever been seen. (11 words)
cn: 然而，这并非第一次被观察到。

en: Some animal species also display this phenomenon. (7 words)
cn: 一些动物物种也表现出这种现象。

en: For example, dolphins, as well as other marine animals, shut down one hemisphere of the brain when they go to sleep. (21 words)
cn: 例如，海豚以及其他海洋动物在睡觉时会关闭大脑的一个半球。

en: A previous study noted that dolphins always consciously control their breathing. (11 words)
cn: 此前的一项研究指出，海豚总是有意识地控制呼吸。

en: Without keeping the brain active while sleeping, they would probably drown. (11 words)
cn: 如果在睡觉时不保持大脑活跃，它们可能会淹死。

en: But, as the human study suggests, another reason for dolphins keeping their eyes open during sleep is that they can look out for predators while asleep. (26 words)
cn: 但是，正如人类研究所表明的，海豚在睡觉时睁着眼睛的另一个原因是它们可以在睡觉时留意捕食者。

en: It also keeps their physiological processes working. (7 words)
cn: 这也使它们的生理过程保持运作。

en: Interest in elite high school math competitions has grown in recent years, and in light of last summer's U.S. win at the International Math Olympiad (IMO)—the first for an American team in more than two decades—the trend is likely to continue. (41 words)
cn: 近年来，对精英高中数学竞赛的兴趣有所增长，鉴于去年夏天美国在国际数学奥林匹克竞赛（IMO）中获胜——这是美国队二十多年来的首次胜利——这一趋势可能会继续下去。

en: But will such contests, which are overwhelmingly dominated by Asian and white students from middle-class and affluent families, become any more diverse? (22 words)
cn: 但是，这些主要由来自中产阶级和富裕家庭的亚洲和白人学生主导的竞赛，会变得更加多样化吗？

en: Many social and cultural factors play roles in determining which promising students get on the path toward international math recognition. (20 words)
cn: 许多社会和文化因素在决定哪些有前途的学生走上国际数学认可之路方面发挥着作用。

en: But efforts are in place to expose more black, Hispanic, and low-income students to advanced math, in the hope that the demographic pool of high-level contenders will eventually begin to shift and become less exclusive. (35 words)
cn: 但已经采取了努力，让更多的黑人、西班牙裔和低收入学生接触高等数学，希望高水平竞争者的群体最终会开始转变，变得不那么排外。

en: 'The challenge is if certain types of people are doing something, it's difficult for other people to break into it,' said Po-Shen Loh, the head coach of last year's winning U.S. Math Olympiad team. (34 words)
cn: 去年获胜的美国数学奥林匹克队主教练罗博深说：‘挑战在于，如果某些类型的人在做某件事，其他人就很难打入其中。’

en: Participation grows through friends and networks and if 'you realize that's how they're growing, you can start to take action' and bring in other students, he said. (27 words)
cn: 他说，参与度通过朋友和网络增长，如果‘你意识到他们就是这样增长的，你就可以开始采取行动’，引入其他学生。

en: Most of the training for advanced-math competitions happens outside the confines of the normal school day. (16 words)
cn: 高等数学竞赛的大部分培训都发生在正常上课时间之外。

en: Students attend after-school clubs, summer camps, online forums and classes, and university-based 'math circles', to prepare for the competitions. (19 words)
cn: 学生参加课后俱乐部、夏令营、在线论坛和课程以及大学‘数学圈’来为竞赛做准备。

en: One of the largest feeders for high school math competitions—including those that eventually lead to the IMO—is a middle school program called Math Counts. (24 words)
cn: 高中数学竞赛（包括那些最终进入IMO的竞赛）最大的输送渠道之一是一个名为Math Counts的中学项目。

en: About 100,000 students around the country participate in the program's competition series, which culminates in a national game-show-style contest held each May. (22 words)
cn: 全国约有10万名学生参加该项目的系列竞赛，该系列竞赛每年五月以全国性的游戏节目式竞赛达到高潮。

en: The most recent one took place last week in Washington, D.C. (11 words)
cn: 最近的一次于上周在华盛顿特区举行。

en: Students join a team through their schools, which provide a volunteer coach and pay a nominal fee to send students to regional and state competitions. (25 words)
cn: 学生通过学校加入团队，学校提供志愿者教练并支付象征性费用送学生参加地区性和州级比赛。

en: The 224 students who make it to the national competition get an all-expenses-paid trip. (14 words)
cn: 进入全国比赛的224名学生将获得全额资助的行程。

en: Nearly all members of last year's winning U.S. IMO team took part in Math Counts as middle school students, as did Loh, the coach. (24 words)
cn: 去年获胜的美国IMO队几乎所有成员在中学时都参加过Math Counts，教练罗也是如此。

en: 'Middle school is an important age because students have enough math capability to solve advanced problems, but they haven't really decided what they want to do with their lives,' said Loh. (31 words)
cn: 罗说：‘中学是一个重要的年龄，因为学生有足够的数学能力来解决高级问题，但他们还没有真正决定他们想要做什么。’

en: 'They often get hooked then.' (5 words)
cn: ‘他们经常在那时就被吸引住了。’

en: Another influential feeder for advanced-math students is an online school called Art of Problem Solving, which began about 13 years ago and now has 15,000 users. (26 words)
cn: 另一个有影响力的高等数学学生输送渠道是一所名为Art of Problem Solving的在线学校，该学校大约13年前开始，现在有15000名用户。

en: Students use forums to chat, play games, and solve problems together at no cost, or they can pay a few hundred dollars to take courses with trained teachers. (28 words)
cn: 学生使用论坛聊天、玩游戏并免费一起解决问题，或者他们可以支付几百美元参加由训练有素的教师授课的课程。

en: According to Richard Rusczyk, the company founder, the six U.S. team members who competed at the IMO last year collectively took more than 40 courses on the site. (28 words)
cn: 据公司创始人理查德·鲁斯奇克称，去年参加IMO的六名美国队员在该网站上总共学习了40多门课程。

en: Parents of advanced-math students and Math Counts coaches say the children are on the website constantly. (16 words)
cn: 高等数学学生的家长和Math Counts教练说，孩子们经常上这个网站。

en: There are also dozens of summer camps—many attached to universities—that aim to prepare elite math students. (16 words)
cn: 还有数十个夏令营——许多附属于大学——旨在培养精英数学学生。

en: Some are pricey—a three-week intensive program can cost $4,500 or more—but most offer scholarships. (14 words)
cn: 有些价格昂贵——为期三周的强化课程可能花费4500美元或更多——但大多数提供奖学金。

en: The Math Olympiad Summer Training Program is a three-week math camp held by the Mathematical Association of America that leads straight to the international championship and is free for those who make it. (33 words)
cn: 数学奥林匹克暑期培训项目是美国数学协会举办的为期三周的数学夏令营，直接通往国际锦标赛，对入选者免费。

en: Only about 50 students are invited based on their performance on written tests and at the USA Math Olympiad. (19 words)
cn: 只有大约50名学生根据他们在笔试和美国数学奥林匹克中的表现被邀请。

en: Students in university towns may also have access to another lever for involvement in accelerated math: math circles. (18 words)
cn: 大学城的学生也可能有机会通过另一种方式参与加速数学：数学圈。

en: In these groups, which came out of an Eastern European tradition of developing young talent, professors teach promising K-12 students advanced mathematics for several hours after school or on weekends. (30 words)
cn: 在这些源于东欧培养年轻人才传统的团体中，教授们在课后或周末为有前途的K-12学生教授高等数学几个小时。

en: The Los Angeles Math Circle, held at the University of California, Los Angeles, began in 2007 with 20 students and now has more than 250. (25 words)
cn: 在加州大学洛杉矶分校举办的洛杉矶数学圈始于2007年，有20名学生，现在有250多名。

en: 'These math circles cost nothing, or they're very cheap for students to get involved in, but you have to know about them,' said Rusczyk. (24 words)
cn: 鲁斯奇克说：‘这些数学圈不收费，或者学生参与的费用很低，但你必须知道它们。’

en: 'Most people would love to get students from more underserved populations, but they just can't get them in the door. (20 words)
cn: ‘大多数人都希望从更多服务不足的人群中招收学生，但他们就是无法让他们进门。’

en: Part of it is communication; part of it is transportation.' (10 words)
cn: ‘部分是沟通问题；部分是交通问题。’

en: It's no secret in the advanced-math community that diversity is a problem. (12 words)
cn: 在高等数学界，多样性是个问题，这不是秘密。

en: According to Mark Saul, the director of competitions for the Mathematical Association of America, not a single African-American or Hispanic student—and only a handful of girls—has ever made it to the Math Olympiad team in its 50 years of existence. (40 words)
cn: 据美国数学协会竞赛主任马克·索尔称，在其50年的历史中，没有一名非裔美国人或西班牙裔学生——只有少数女孩——曾进入数学奥林匹克队。

en: Many schools simply don't prioritize academic competitions. (7 words)
cn: 许多学校根本不优先考虑学术竞赛。

en: 'Do you know who we have to beat?' asked Saul. (10 words)
cn: 索尔问道：‘你知道我们必须打败谁吗？’

en: 'The football team, the basketball team—that's our competition for resources, student time, attention, school dollars, parent efforts, school enthusiasm.' (19 words)
cn: ‘足球队、篮球队——那是我们在资源、学生时间、注意力、学校资金、家长努力、学校热情方面的竞争者。’

en: Teachers in low-income urban and rural areas with no history of participating in math competitions may not know about advanced-math opportunities like Math Counts—and those who do may not have support or feel trained to lead them. (37 words)
cn: 低收入城市和农村地区没有参加过数学竞赛历史的教师可能不知道像Math Counts这样的高等数学机会——而知道的人可能没有支持或觉得没有受过培训来带领他们。

en: But there are initiatives in place to try to get more underrepresented students involved in accelerated math. (17 words)
cn: 但已有一些举措试图让更多代表性不足的学生参与加速数学。

en: A New York City-based nonprofit called Bridge to Enter Mathematics runs a residential summer program aimed at getting underserved students, mostly black and Hispanic, working toward math and science careers. (30 words)
cn: 一家总部位于纽约的非营利组织Bridge to Enter Mathematics举办住宿暑期项目，旨在让服务不足的学生——主要是黑人和西班牙裔——朝着数学和科学职业方向发展。

en: The summer after 7th grade, students spend three weeks on a college campus studying advanced math for seven hours a day. (21 words)
cn: 在七年级后的暑假，学生在大学校园里度过三周，每天学习高等数学七个小时。

en: Over the next five years, the group helps the students get into other elite summer math programs, high-performing high schools, and eventually college. (23 words)
cn: 在接下来的五年里，该组织帮助学生进入其他精英暑期数学项目、优质高中，并最终进入大学。

en: About 250 students so far have gone through the program, which receives funding from the Jack Kent Cooke Foundation. (19 words)
cn: 到目前为止，大约有250名学生参加了这个项目，该项目获得杰克·肯特·库克基金会的资助。

en: 'If you look at a lot of low-income communities in the United States, there are programs that are serving them, but they're primarily centered around 'Let's get these kids' grades up', and not around 'Let's get these kids access to the same kinds of opportunities as more-affluent kids,'' said Daniel Zaharopol, the founder and executive director of the program. (59 words)
cn: 该项目的创始人兼执行董事丹尼尔·扎哈罗波尔说：‘如果你看看美国的许多低收入社区，有服务他们的项目，但它们主要围绕“让这些孩子的成绩提高”，而不是“让这些孩子获得与更富裕孩子相同的机会”。’

en: 'We're trying to create that pathway.' (6 words)
cn: ‘我们正试图创建那条途径。’

en: Students apply to the program directly through their schools. (9 words)
cn: 学生直接通过他们的学校申请该项目。

en: 'We want to reach parents who are not plugged into the system,' said Zaharopol. (14 words)
cn: 扎哈罗波尔说：‘我们想接触到那些不熟悉这个系统的家长。’

en: In the past few years, Math Counts added two new middle school programs to try to diversify its participant pool—the National Math Club and the Math Video Challenge. (28 words)
cn: 在过去的几年里，Math Counts增加了两个新的中学项目，试图使其参与者多样化——国家数学俱乐部和数学视频挑战赛。

en: Schools or teachers who sign up for the National Math Club receive a kit full of activities and resources, but there's no special teacher training and no competition attached. (29 words)
cn: 报名参加国家数学俱乐部的学校或教师会收到一套包含活动和资源的工具包，但没有特别的教师培训，也没有附带竞赛。

en: The Math Video Challenge is a competition, but a collaborative one. (11 words)
cn: 数学视频挑战赛是一项竞赛，但它是协作性的。

en: Teams of four students make a video illustrating a math problem and its real-world application. (15 words)
cn: 四名学生组成的小组制作一个视频，说明一个数学问题及其在现实世界中的应用。

en: After the high-pressure Countdown round at this year's national Math Counts competition, in which the top 12 students went head to head solving complex problems in rapid fire, the finalists for the Math Video Challenge took the stage to show their videos. (42 words)
cn: 在今年全国Math Counts竞赛的高压倒计时环节之后——在该环节中，前12名学生快速轮流解决复杂问题——数学视频挑战赛的决赛选手登台展示了他们的视频。

en: The demographics of that group looked quite different from those in the competition round—of the 16 video finalists, 13 were girls and eight were African-American students. (26 words)
cn: 该群体的人口统计数据与竞赛轮的群体看起来大不相同——在16名视频决赛选手中，13名是女孩，8名是非裔美国学生。

en: The video challenge does not put individual students on the hot seat—so it's less intimidating by design. (17 words)
