cn: 根据一份新报告，在南极洲周围未受破坏水域进行的工业磷虾捕捞正在威胁着世界上最后一片大荒野的未来。

en: The study by Greenpeace analysed the movements of krill fishing vessels in the region and found they were increasingly operating 'in the immediate vicinity of penguin colonies and whale-feeding grounds'. (30 words)
cn: 绿色和平组织的这项研究分析了该地区磷虾捕捞船只的动向，发现它们越来越多地‘在企鹅栖息地和鲸鱼觅食地附近’作业。

en: It also highlights incidents of fishing boats being involved in groundings, oil spills and accidents, which posed a serious threat to the Antarctic ecosystem. (24 words)
cn: 它还强调了渔船搁浅、漏油和事故等事件，这些事件对南极生态系统构成了严重威胁。

en: The report, published on Tuesday, comes amid growing concern about the impact of fishing and climate change on the Antarctic. (20 words)
cn: 这份于周二发布的报告，正值人们对捕捞和气候变化对南极影响日益担忧之际。

en: A global campaign has been launched to create a network of ocean sanctuaries to protect the seas in the region and Greenpeace is calling for an immediate halt to fishing in areas being considered for sanctuary status. (37 words)
cn: 一项全球运动已经发起，旨在建立海洋保护区网络以保护该地区的海洋，绿色和平组织呼吁立即停止在被考虑作为保护区的区域进行捕捞。

en: Frida Bengtsson from Greenpeace's Protect the Antarctic campaign said: 'If the krill industry wants to show it's a responsible player, then it should be voluntarily getting out of any area which is being proposed as an ocean sanctuary, and should instead be backing the protection of these huge tracts of the Antarctic.' (52 words)
cn: 绿色和平组织‘保护南极’运动的弗里达·本特松说：‘如果磷虾产业想表明自己是一个负责任的参与者，那么它应该自愿退出任何被提议作为海洋保护区的区域，并转而支持保护南极这些大片区域。’

en: A global campaign has been launched to turn a huge tract of Antarctic seas into ocean sanctuaries protecting wildlife and banning not just krill fishing, but all fishing. (28 words)
cn: 一项全球运动已经发起，旨在将南极大片海域转变为海洋保护区，保护野生动物，不仅禁止磷虾捕捞，而且禁止所有捕捞。

en: One was created in the Ross Sea in 2016, another reserve is being proposed in a vast area of the Weddell Sea, and a third sanctuary is under consideration in the area west of the Antarctic Peninsula—a key krill fishing area. (41 words)
cn: 一个保护区于2016年在罗斯海建立，另一个保护区正在威德尔海的大片区域提议中，第三个保护区正在南极半岛以西区域——一个关键的磷虾捕捞区——考虑中。

en: The Commission for the Conservation of Antarctic Marine Living Resources (CCAMLR) manages the seas around Antarctica. (16 words)
cn: 南极海洋生物资源养护委员会（CCAMLR）负责管理南极周边的海域。

en: It will decide on the Weddell Sea sanctuary proposal at a conference in Australia in October, although a decision on the peninsula sanctuary is not expected until later. (28 words)
cn: 它将在10月于澳大利亚举行的会议上决定威德尔海保护区的提议，尽管关于半岛保护区的决定预计要到晚些时候才会做出。

en: Keith Reid, a science manager at CCAMLR, said that the organisation sought 'a balance between protection, conservation and sustainable fishing in the Southern Ocean'. (24 words)
cn: CCAMLR的科学经理基思·里德表示，该组织寻求‘在南大洋保护、养护和可持续捕捞之间取得平衡’。

en: He said although more fishing was taking place nearer penguin colonies it was often happening later in the season when these colonies were empty. (24 words)
cn: 他说，尽管更多的捕捞活动在企鹅栖息地附近进行，但通常发生在季节后期，那时这些栖息地已经空了。

en: The creation of a system of marine protected areas is a key part of ongoing scientific and policy discussions in CCAMLR, he added. (23 words)
cn: 他补充说：‘建立海洋保护区系统是CCAMLR正在进行的科学和政策讨论的关键部分。’

en: Our long-term operation in the region depends on a healthy and thriving Antarctic marine ecosystem, which is why we have always had an open dialogue with the environmental non-governmental organisations. (30 words)
cn: ‘我们在该地区的长期运营取决于一个健康繁荣的南极海洋生态系统，这就是为什么我们一直与环境非政府组织保持公开对话。’

en: We strongly intend to continue this dialogue, including talks with Greenpeace, to discuss improvements based on the latest scientific data. (20 words)
cn: ‘我们强烈打算继续这种对话，包括与绿色和平组织的会谈，以讨论基于最新科学数据的改进措施。’

en: We are not the ones to decide on the establishment of marine protected areas, but we hope to contribute positively with our knowledge and experience. (25 words)
cn: ‘我们不是决定建立海洋保护区的人，但我们希望用我们的知识和经验做出积极贡献。’

en: Though he didn't come from a farming family, from a young age Tim Joseph was fascinated by the idea of living off the land. (24 words)
cn: 虽然蒂姆·约瑟夫并非出身于农场家庭，但他从小就对靠土地生活的想法着迷。

en: Reading magazines like The Stockman Grass Farmer and Graze, he got hooked on the idea of grass-fed agriculture. (18 words)
cn: 阅读《牧场主草饲农夫》和《放牧》等杂志后，他对草饲农业的理念产生了浓厚兴趣。

en: The idea that all energy and wealth comes from the sun really intrigued him. (14 words)
cn: 所有能量和财富都来自太阳这一想法真正引起了他的兴趣。

en: He thought the shorter the distance between the sun and the end product, the higher the profit to the farmer. (20 words)
cn: 他认为太阳与最终产品之间的距离越短，农民的利润就越高。

en: Joseph wanted to put this theory to the test. (9 words)
cn: 约瑟夫想把这个理论付诸实践。

en: In 2009, he and his wife Laura launched Maple Hill Creamery, an organic, all grass-fed yogurt company in northern New York. (21 words)
cn: 2009年，他和妻子劳拉在纽约北部创办了Maple Hill Creamery，一家有机全草饲酸奶公司。

en: He quickly learned what the market has demonstrated: Demand for grass-fed products currently exceeds supply. (15 words)
cn: 他很快了解到市场已经证明的事实：目前对草饲产品的需求超过了供应。

en: Grass-fed beef is enjoying a 25-30% annual growth rate. (9 words)
cn: 草饲牛肉的年增长率达到25-30%。

en: Sales of grass-fed yogurt and kefir, on the other hand, have in the last year increased by over 38%. (19 words)
cn: 另一方面，草饲酸奶和开菲尔奶的销售额在过去一年增长了超过38%。

en: This is in comparison with a drop of just under 1% in the total yogurt and kefir market, according to natural and organic market research company SPINS. (27 words)
cn: 据天然和有机市场研究公司SPINS的数据，相比之下，整个酸奶和开菲尔奶市场下降了不到1%。

en: Joseph's top priority became getting his hands on enough grass-fed milk to keep customers satisfied, since his own 64-cow herd wasn't going to suffice. (24 words)
cn: 约瑟夫的首要任务变成了获取足够的草饲牛奶以满足客户需求，因为他自己64头奶牛的产奶量远远不够。

en: His first partnership was with Paul and Phyllis Amburgh, owners of the Dharma Lea farm in New York. (18 words)
cn: 他的第一个合作伙伴是保罗和菲利斯·安伯格，他们是纽约Dharma Lea农场的所有者。

en: The Amburghs, too, were true believers in grass-fed. (8 words)
cn: 安伯格夫妇也是草饲农业的忠实信徒。

en: In addition to supplying milk from their own 85-head herd, they began to help other farmers in the area convert from conventional to certified organic and grass-fed in order to enter the Maple Hill supply chain. (36 words)
cn: 除了供应自己85头奶牛产的牛奶外，他们开始帮助该地区的其他农民从传统农业转向认证有机和草饲农业，以加入Maple Hill的供应链。

en: Since 2010, the couple has helped 125 small dairy farms convert to grass-fed, with more than 80% of those farms coming on board during the last two years. (28 words)
cn: 自2010年以来，这对夫妇已帮助125家小型奶牛场转向草饲农业，其中超过80%是在过去两年中加入的。

en: All this conversion has helped Maple Hill grow 40-50% every year since it began, with no end in sight. (19 words)
cn: 所有这些转型帮助Maple Hill自成立以来每年增长40-50%，而且增长势头未见放缓。

en: Joseph has learned that a farmer has to have a certain mindset to successfully convert. (15 words)
cn: 约瑟夫认识到，农民必须具备一定的思维模式才能成功转型。

en: But convincing open-minded dairy people is actually not that hard, when you look at the economics. (16 words)
cn: 但从经济角度看，说服思想开放的奶农实际上并不那么困难。

en: Grass-fed milk can fetch up 2.5 times the price of conventional milk. (12 words)
cn: 草饲牛奶的价格可以达到传统牛奶的2.5倍。

en: Another factor is the squeeze that conventional dairy farmers have felt as the price of grain they feed their cows has gone up, tightening their profit margins. (27 words)
cn: 另一个因素是传统奶农因喂养奶牛的谷物价格上涨而感受到的压力，这压缩了他们的利润空间。

en: By replacing expensive grain feed with regenerative management practices, grass-fed farmers are insulated from jumps in the price of feed. (20 words)
cn: 通过用再生管理实践替代昂贵的谷物饲料，草饲农民免受饲料价格飙升的影响。

en: These practices include grazing animals on grasses grown from the pastureland's natural seed bank, and fertilized by the cows' own fertilizer. (21 words)
cn: 这些做法包括让动物在牧场天然种子库中生长的牧草上放牧，并用奶牛自身的粪便作为肥料。

en: Champions of this type of regenerative grazing also point to its animal welfare, climate and health benefits: Grass-fed animals live longer out of confinement. (24 words)
cn: 这种再生放牧的支持者还指出了其在动物福利、气候和健康方面的益处：草饲动物在非圈养环境中寿命更长。

en: Grazing herds stimulate microbial activity in the soil, helping to capture water and separate carbon. (15 words)
cn: 放牧的畜群能刺激土壤中的微生物活动，有助于保水和固碳。

en: And grass-fed dairy and meat have been shown to be higher in certain nutrients and healthy fats. (17 words)
cn: 而且草饲乳制品和肉类已被证明含有更高的某些营养素和健康脂肪。

en: In the grass-fed system, farmers are also not subject to the wildly fluctuating milk prices of the international commodity market. (20 words)
cn: 在草饲体系中，农民也不受国际商品市场牛奶价格剧烈波动的影响。

en: The unpredictability of global demand and the lag-time it takes to add more cows to a herd to meet demand can result in events like the recent cheese surplus. (29 words)
cn: 全球需求的不可预测性以及增加奶牛数量以满足需求所需的时间滞后，可能会导致像近期奶酪过剩这样的事件。

en: Going grass-fed is a safe refuge, a way for family-scale farms to stay viable. (14 words)
cn: 转向草饲是一个安全的避风港，是家庭规模农场保持生存能力的一种方式。

en: Usually a farmer will get to the point where financially, what they're doing is not working. (16 words)
cn: 通常，农民会走到一个地步——从经济上看，他们正在做的事情行不通了。

en: That's when they call Maple Hill. (6 words)
cn: 那就是他们打电话给Maple Hill的时候。

en: If the farm is well managed and has enough land, and the desire to convert is sincere, a relationship can begin. (21 words)
cn: 如果农场管理良好、拥有足够的土地，并且转型意愿真诚，合作关系就可以开始。

en: Through regular regional educational meetings, a large annual meeting, individual farm visits and thousands of phone calls, the Amburghs pass on the principles of pasture management. (26 words)
cn: 通过定期的区域教育会议、大型年度会议、个别农场访问和数千通电话，安伯格夫妇传授牧场管理的原则。

en: Maple Hill signs a contract pledging to buy the farmer's milk at a guaranteed base price, plus quality premiums and incentives for higher protein, butter-fat and other solids. (28 words)
cn: Maple Hill签署合同，承诺以保证基价收购农民的牛奶，外加质量溢价和针对更高蛋白质、乳脂和其他固形物的激励。

en: While Maple Hill's conversion program is unusually hands-on and comprehensive, it's just one of a growing number of businesses committed to slowly changing the way America farms. (27 words)
cn: 虽然Maple Hill的转型计划异常务实且全面，但它只是越来越多致力于逐步改变美国农业方式的企业之一。

en: Joseph calls sharing his knowledge network through peer-to-peer learning a core piece of the company's culture. (16 words)
cn: 约瑟夫称，通过同伴学习分享他的知识网络是公司文化的核心组成部分。

en: Last summer, Massachusetts grass-fed beef advocate John Smith launched Big Picture Beef, a network of small grass-fed beef farms in New England and New York that is projected to bring to market 2,500 head of cattle from 125 producers this year. (41 words)
cn: 去年夏天，马萨诸塞州草饲牛肉倡导者约翰·史密斯推出了Big Picture Beef，这是一个由新英格兰和纽约州小型草饲牛肉农场组成的网络，预计今年将为来自125家生产商的2500头牛推向市场。

en: Early indications are that Smith will have no shortage of farm members. (12 words)
cn: 早期迹象表明，史密斯不会缺少农场成员。

en: Since he began to informally announce the network at farming conferences and on social media, he's received a steady stream of inquiries from interested farmers. (25 words)
cn: 自从他开始在农业会议和社交媒体上非正式地宣布该网络以来，他不断收到感兴趣农民的咨询。

en: Shinn says he'll provide services ranging from formal seminars to on-farm workshops on holistic management, to one-on-one hand-holding and an almost 24/7 phone hotline for farmers who are converting. (29 words)
cn: 希恩表示，他将提供从正式研讨会到关于整体管理的农场现场研讨会、一对一指导以及几乎全天候的电话热线等服务，面向正在转型的农民。

en: In exchange, he guarantees an above-market price for each animal and a calf-to-customer electronic ear tag ID system like that used in the European Union. (25 words)
cn: 作为交换，他保证每头牲畜的价格高于市场价，并提供从牛犊到客户的电子耳标身份识别系统，类似于欧盟使用的系统。

en: Though advocates portray grass-fed products as a win-win situation for all, they do have downsides. (15 words)
cn: 尽管倡导者将草饲产品描绘成对所有人双赢的局面，但它们确实有缺点。

en: Price, for one, is an issue. (6 words)
cn: 价格就是一个问题。

en: Joseph says his products are priced 10-20% above organic versions, but depending on the product chosen, compared to non-organic conventional yogurt, consumers could pay a premium of 30-50% or more for grass-fed. (32 words)
cn: 约瑟夫说他的产品定价比有机版本高出10-20%，但根据所选产品的不同，与非有机传统酸奶相比，消费者可能需要为草饲产品支付30-50%甚至更高的溢价。

en: As for the meat, Smith says his grass-fed hamburger will be priced 20-25% over the conventional alternative. (17 words)
cn: 至于肉类，史密斯说他的草饲汉堡定价将比传统替代品高出20-25%。

en: But a look at the prices on online grocer Fresh Direct suggests a grass-fed premium of anywhere from 35-60%. (19 words)
cn: 但看看在线食品杂货商Fresh Direct上的价格，草饲产品的溢价在35%到60%之间。

en: And not every farmer has the option of going grass-fed. (10 words)
cn: 而且并非每个农民都有选择转向草饲的余地。

en: For both beef and dairy production it requires, at least in the beginning, more pastureland. (15 words)
cn: 无论是牛肉还是乳制品生产，至少在一开始都需要更多的牧场。

en: Grass-fed beef production tends to be more labor-intensive as well. (10 words)
cn: 草饲牛肉生产往往也更加劳动密集。

en: But Smith counters that if you factor in the hidden cost of government corn subsidies, environment degradation, and decreased human health and animal welfare, grass-fed is the more cost-effective model. (30 words)
cn: 但史密斯反驳说，如果考虑到政府玉米补贴、环境退化以及人类健康和动物福利下降等隐性成本，草饲是更具成本效益的模式。

en: The sun provides the lowest cost of production and the cheapest meat, he says. (14 words)
cn: 他说：‘太阳提供了最低的生产成本和最便宜的肉类。’

en: Another grass-fed booster spurring farmers to convert is EPIC, which makes meat-based protein bars. (14 words)
cn: 另一个促使农民转向草饲的推动者是EPIC，该公司生产肉类蛋白棒。

en: Founders Taylor Collins and his wife, Katie Forrest, used to be endurance athletes; now they're advocates of grass-fed meat. (19 words)
cn: 创始人泰勒·柯林斯和他的妻子凯蒂·福雷斯特曾经是耐力运动员；现在他们是草饲肉类的倡导者。

en: Soon after launching EPIC's most successful product—the Bison Bacon Cranberry Bar—Collins and Forrest found they'd exhausted their sources for bison raised exclusively on pasture. (24 words)
cn: 在推出EPIC最成功的产品——野牛培根蔓越莓棒后不久，柯林斯和福雷斯特发现他们已经耗尽了纯牧场饲养野牛的供应源。

en: When they started researching the supply chain, they learned that only 2-3% of all bison is actually grass-fed. (18 words)
cn: 当他们开始研究供应链时，他们了解到实际上只有2-3%的野牛是草饲的。

en: The rest is feed-lot confined and fed grain and corn. (10 words)
cn: 其余的则被圈养在饲养场，喂食谷物和玉米。

en: But after General Mills bought EPIC in 2016, Collins and Forrest suddenly had the resources they needed to expand their supply chain. (22 words)
cn: 但在2016年通用磨坊收购EPIC后，柯林斯和福雷斯特突然拥有了扩展供应链所需的资源。

en: So the company teamed up with Wisconsin-based rancher Northstar Bison. (10 words)
cn: 因此，该公司与威斯康星州的牧场主Northstar Bison合作。

en: EPIC fronted the money for the purchase of $2.5 million worth of young bison that will be raised according to its grass-fed protocols, with a guaranteed purchase price. (28 words)
cn: EPIC预付了购买价值250万美元的幼年野牛的资金，这些野牛将按照其草饲标准饲养，并有保证的购买价格。

en: The message to young people who might not otherwise be able to afford to break into the business is, 'You can purchase this $3 million piece of land here, because I'm guaranteeing you today you'll have 1,000 bison on it. (40 words)
cn: 柯林斯解释说：‘向那些原本可能无力进入这一行业的年轻人传达的信息是——你可以购买这块价值300万美元的土地，因为我今天向你保证，你将拥有1000头野牛。’

en: We're bringing new blood into the old, conventional farming ecosystem, which is really cool to see,' Collins explains. (18 words)
cn: ‘我们正在为古老的、传统的农业生态系统注入新鲜血液，这真的很酷。’

en: Schools are not just a microcosm of society; they mediate it too. (12 words)
cn: 学校不仅是社会的缩影；它们也调节着社会。

en: The best seek to alleviate the external pressures on their pupils while equipping them better to understand and handle the world outside—at once sheltering them and broadening their horizons. (29 words)
cn: 最好的学校致力于减轻学生的外部压力，同时让他们更好地理解和应对外部世界——既保护他们又开阔他们的视野。

en: This is ambitious in any circumstances, and in a divided and unequal society the two ideals can clash outright. (19 words)
cn: 这在任何情况下都是雄心勃勃的，在一个分裂和不平等的社会中，这两种理想可能会直接冲突。

en: Trips that many adults would consider the adventure of a lifetime—treks in Borneo, a sports tour to Barbados—appear to have become almost routine at some state schools. (27 words)
cn: 许多成年人认为是终生冒险的旅行——婆罗洲徒步、巴巴多斯体育之旅——在一些公立学校几乎已成为常规活动。

en: Parents are being asked for thousands of pounds. (8 words)
cn: 家长被要求支付数千英镑。

en: Though schools cannot profit from these trips, the companies that arrange them do. (13 words)
cn: 虽然学校不能从这些旅行中获利，但安排旅行的公司可以。

en: Meanwhile, pupils arrive at school hungry because their families can't afford breakfast. (12 words)
cn: 与此同时，学生因为家庭负担不起早餐而饿着肚子来到学校。

en: The Child Poverty Action Group says nine out of 30 in every classroom fall below the poverty line. (18 words)
cn: 儿童贫困行动组织表示，每个教室30名学生中有9名生活在贫困线以下。

en: The discrepancy is startlingly apparent. (5 words)
cn: 这种差距惊人地明显。

en: Introducing a fundraising requirement for students does not help, as better-off children can tap up richer aunts and neighbours. (19 words)
cn: 对学生提出筹款要求也无济于事，因为家境较好的孩子可以向更富有的姑妈和邻居寻求帮助。

en: Probing the rock pools of a local beach or practising French on a language exchange can fire children's passions, boost their skills and open their eyes to life's possibilities. (29 words)
cn: 探索当地海滩的岩池或在语言交流中练习法语可以激发孩子们的热情，提升他们的技能，并开阔他们的眼界，让他们看到生活的可能性。

en: Educational outings help bright but disadvantaged students to get better scores in A-level tests. (14 words)
cn: 教育性郊游有助于聪明但处于不利地位的学生在A-level考试中取得更好的成绩。

en: In this globalised age, there is a good case for international travel, and some parents say they can manage the cost of a school trip abroad more easily than a family holiday. (32 words)
cn: 在这个全球化的时代，国际旅行有充分的理由，一些家长表示，他们比安排家庭度假更容易承担学校出国旅行的费用。

en: Even in the face of immense and mounting financial pressures, some schools have shown remarkable determination and ingenuity in ensuring that all their pupils are able to take up opportunities that may be truly life-changing. (35 words)
cn: 即使面临巨大且不断增加的经济压力，一些学校在确保所有学生都能抓住可能真正改变人生的机会方面表现出了非凡的决心和 ingenuity。

en: They should be applauded. (4 words)
cn: 它们值得赞扬。

en: Methods such as whole-school fundraising, with the proceeds pooled, can help to extend opportunities and fuel community spirit. (18 words)
cn: 全校筹款（收益集中使用）等方法有助于扩大机会并激发社区精神。

en: But £3,000 trips cannot be justified when the average income for families with children is just over £30,000. (18 words)
cn: 但当有子女家庭的平均收入仅略高于30,000英镑时，3,000英镑的旅行就说不过去了。

en: Such initiatives close doors for many pupils. (7 words)
cn: 这样的举措为许多学生关上了大门。

en: Some parents pull their children out of school because of expensive field trips. (13 words)
cn: 一些家长因为昂贵的实地考察旅行而让孩子退学。

en: Even parents who can see that a trip is little more than a party or celebration may well feel guilt that their child is left behind. (26 words)
cn: 即使那些能看出一次旅行不过是一场聚会或庆祝活动的家长，也可能会因为孩子被落下而感到内疚。

en: The Department for Education's guidance says schools can charge only for board and lodging if the trip is part of the syllabus, and that students receiving government aid are exempt from these costs. (33 words)
cn: 教育部的指导意见指出，如果旅行是教学大纲的一部分，学校只能收取食宿费，而且接受政府资助的学生免交这些费用。

en: However, many schools seem to ignore the advice; and it does not cover the kind of glamorous, exotic trips, which are becoming increasingly common. (24 words)
cn: 然而，许多学校似乎忽视了这一建议；而且该建议并不涵盖那些越来越常见的、充满魅力的异国旅行。

en: Schools cannot be expected to bring together communities single-handed. (9 words)
cn: 不能指望学校单枪匹马地把社区团结在一起。

en: But the least we should expect is that they do not foster divisions and exclude those who are already disadvantaged. (20 words)
cn: 但我们至少应该期望的是，它们不要助长分裂，不要排斥那些已经处于不利地位的人。

en: Rising temperatures and overfishing in the pristine waters around the Antarctic could see king penguin populations pushed to the brink of extinction by the end of the century, according to a new study. (33 words)
cn: 根据一项新研究，南极洲周围未受污染水域的气温上升和过度捕捞可能导致帝企鹅种群在本世纪末被推向灭绝的边缘。

en: The study's report states that as global warming transforms the environment in the world's last great wilderness, 70 percent of king penguins could either disappear or be forced to find new breeding grounds. (33 words)
cn: 研究报告指出，随着全球变暖改变世界最后一片大荒野的环境，70%的帝企鹅可能会消失或被迫寻找新的繁殖地。

en: Co-author Celine Le Bohec, from the University of Strasbourg in France, warned: 'If there're no actions aimed at halting or controlling global warming, and the pace of the current human-induced changes such as climate change and overfishing stays the same, the species may soon disappear.' (45 words)
cn: 法国斯特拉斯堡大学的合著者席琳·勒·博赫克警告说：‘如果没有旨在遏制或控制全球变暖的行动，而且目前人为引起的变化（如气候变化和过度捕捞）的速度保持不变，该物种可能很快就会消失。’

en: The findings come amid growing concern over the future of the Antarctic. (12 words)
cn: 这些发现正值人们对南极未来的日益关注之际。

en: Earlier this month a separate study found that a combination of climate change and industrial fishing is threatening the krill population in Antarctic waters, with a potentially disastrous impact on whales, seals and penguins. (34 words)
cn: 本月早些时候，另一项研究发现，气候变化和工业捕捞的结合正在威胁南极水域的磷虾种群，对鲸鱼、海豹和企鹅可能产生灾难性影响。

en: But today's report is the starkest warning yet of the potentially devastating impact of climate change and human exploitation on the Antarctic's delicate ecosystems. (24 words)
cn: 但今天的报告是对气候变化和人类开发对南极脆弱生态系统可能造成的毁灭性影响的最严厉警告。

en: Le Bohec said: 'Unless current greenhouse gas emissions drop, 70 percent of king penguins—1.1 million breeding pairs—will be forced to relocate their breeding grounds, or face extinction by 2100.' (29 words)
cn: 勒·博赫克说：‘除非目前的温室气体排放量下降，否则70%的帝企鹅——110万对繁殖对——将被迫迁移繁殖地，或在2100年前面临灭绝。’

en: King penguins are the second-largest type of penguin and only breed on specific isolated islands in the Southern Ocean where there is no ice cover and easy access to the sea. (31 words)
cn: 帝企鹅是第二大企鹅种类，只在南大洋特定孤立的岛屿上繁殖，这些岛屿没有冰盖且方便出海。

en: As the ocean warms, a body of water called the Antarctic Polar Front—an upward movement of nutrient-rich sea that supports a huge abundance of marine life—is being pushed further south. (30 words)
cn: 随着海洋变暖，被称为南极极地锋的水体——一种营养丰富的海水上升运动，支撑着大量海洋生物——正被推向更南的地方。

en: This means that king penguins, which feed on fish and krill in this body of water, have to travel further to their feeding grounds, leaving their hungry chicks for longer. (30 words)
cn: 这意味着以这片水域中的鱼类和磷虾为食的帝企鹅必须到更远的地方觅食，让饥饿的幼鸟等待更长时间。

en: And as the distance between their breeding grounds and their food grows, entire colonies could be wiped out. (18 words)
cn: 随着繁殖地与食物来源之间距离的增加，整个种群可能会被消灭。

en: Le Bohec said: 'The plight of the king penguin should serve as a warning about the future of the entire marine environment in the Antarctic. (25 words)
cn: 勒·博赫克说：‘帝企鹅的困境应该成为对整个南极海洋环境未来的警示。’

en: Penguins, like other seabirds and marine mammals, occupy higher levels in the food chain and they are what we call bio-indicators of their ecosystems.' (24 words)
cn: ‘企鹅像其他海鸟和海洋哺乳动物一样，占据食物链的较高层次，它们是我们所说的生态系统生物指示物。’

en: Penguins are sensitive indicators of changes in marine ecosystems. (9 words)
cn: 企鹅是海洋生态系统变化的敏感指示器。

en: As such, they are key species for understanding and predicting impacts of global change on Antarctic and sub-Antarctic marine ecosystems. (20 words)
cn: 因此，它们是理解和预测全球变化对南极和亚南极海洋生态系统影响的关键物种。

en: The report found that although some king penguins may be able to relocate to new breeding grounds closer to their retreating food source, suitable new habitats would be scarce. (29 words)
cn: 报告发现，尽管一些帝企鹅可能能够迁移到离退缩的食物来源更近的新繁殖地，但适合的新栖息地将很稀缺。

en: Only a handful of islands in the Southern Ocean are suitable for sustaining large breeding colonies. (16 words)
cn: 南大洋中只有少数岛屿适合维持大型繁殖群落。

en: The United Nations issued a report last week warning that humans are destroying nature at such a rate that life on Earth is at risk. (25 words)
cn: 联合国上周发布了一份报告，警告人类正在以如此之快的速度破坏自然，以至于地球上的生命处于危险之中。

en: When the report came out, it naturally grabbed headlines. (9 words)
cn: 这份报告发布时，自然登上了头条。

en: But obviously it didn't hijack the news agenda in the manner of a major terrorist attack or declaration of war. (20 words)
cn: 但显然，它并没有像重大恐怖袭击或宣战那样劫持新闻议程。

en: The report from the Intergovernmental Science-Policy Platform on Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services (IPBES) is clear on what's at stake and what needs to change. (24 words)
cn: 生物多样性和生态系统服务政府间科学政策平台（IPBES）的报告清楚地说明了什么是危险所在以及需要改变什么。

en: IPBES chair Robert Watson says the 'overwhelming evidence' presents an 'ominous picture'. (12 words)
cn: IPBES主席罗伯特·沃森表示，‘压倒性的证据’呈现了一幅‘不祥的图景’。

en: The health of ecosystems on which we and all other species depend is deteriorating more rapidly than ever, Robert Watson said. (21 words)
cn: 罗伯特·沃森说：‘我们和所有其他物种所依赖的生态系统的健康正在以前所未有的速度恶化。’

en: We are eroding the very foundations of our economies, livelihoods, food security, health and quality of life worldwide. (18 words)
cn: ‘我们正在侵蚀全球经济的根基、生计、粮食安全、健康和生活质量。’

en: The report says it's not too late if we make 'transformative change'—fundamental, system-wide reorganization—at every level from local to global, and we need to focus on how to make that happen. (31 words)
cn: 报告称，如果我们在从地方到全球的各个层面进行‘变革性变革’——根本性的、全系统的重组——还为时不晚，我们需要关注如何实现这一目标。

en: First, don't indulge in despair, because despair leads to inertia and doing nothing means certain stagnation. (16 words)
cn: 首先，不要沉溺于绝望，因为绝望导致惰性，而无所作为则意味着一定程度的停滞。

en: Every action to save nature will improve our collective and personal futures and the only way to respond to a threat of this scale is with urgent action rooted in headstrong optimism. (32 words)
cn: 每一项拯救自然的行动都将改善我们集体和个人的未来，而应对这种规模威胁的唯一方式，是以坚定的乐观主义为根基，采取紧急行动。

en: Second, we need relentless focus, just like when paramedics arrive on a scene and use the concept of 'triage' to ensure the most urgent cases get treated first. (28 words)
cn: 第二，我们需要不懈的专注，就像救护人员到达现场后使用‘伤员鉴别分类’的概念，确保最紧急的病例首先得到救治。

en: Saving the natural world needs that kind of thinking. (9 words)
cn: 拯救自然世界需要那种思维。

en: We don't have the capacity to do everything at once. (10 words)
cn: 我们没有能力同时做所有事情。

en: We need to make hard choices. (6 words)
cn: 我们需要做出艰难的选择。

en: Until a few decades ago, scholars believed that young children know very little, if anything, about what others are thinking. (20 words)
cn: 直到几十年前，学者们还认为幼儿对他人的想法知之甚少。

en: Swiss psychologist Jean Piaget, who is credited with founding the scientific study of children's thinking, was convinced that preschool children cannot consider what goes on in the minds of others. (30 words)
cn: 瑞士心理学家让·皮亚杰被誉为开创了儿童思维科学研究，他确信学龄前儿童无法考虑他人头脑中发生的事情。

en: The interviews and experiments he conducted with kids in the middle of the 20th century suggested that they were trapped in their subjective viewpoints, incapable of imagining what others think, feel or believe. (33 words)
cn: 他在20世纪中叶与孩子们进行的访谈和实验表明，他们被困在自己的主观视角中，无法想象他人的想法、感受或信念。

en: Much of the subsequent research on early childhood thinking was highly influenced by Piaget's ideas. (15 words)
cn: 随后许多关于幼儿早期思维的研究深受皮亚杰思想的影响。

en: Scholars sought to refine his theory and empirically confirm his views. (11 words)
cn: 学者们试图完善他的理论并从经验上证实他的观点。

en: But it became increasingly clear that Piaget seemed to have gravely underestimated the intellectual powers of very young kids before they can make themselves understood by speech. (27 words)
cn: 但越来越清楚的是，皮亚杰似乎严重低估了幼童在能够用语言表达自己之前的智力能力。

en: Researchers began to devise ever more ingenious ways of figuring out what goes on in the minds of babies, and the resulting picture of their abilities shows subtle variations. (29 words)
cn: 研究人员开始设计越来越巧妙的方法来弄清楚婴儿头脑中发生的事情，由此得出的他们能力图景显示出细微的差异。

en: Consequently, the old view of children's egocentric nature and intellectual weaknesses has increasingly fallen out of favor and become replaced by a more generous position that sees a budding sense not only of the physical world but also of other minds, even in the 'youngest young.' (46 words)
cn: 因此，关于儿童自我中心性质和智力弱点的旧观点越来越不受欢迎，取而代之的是一种更宽容的立场，认为即使在‘最年幼的孩子’身上，不仅对物理世界有萌芽的意识，对他人的心智也有萌芽的意识。

en: Historically, children didn't receive much respect for their mental powers. (10 words)
cn: 从历史上看，儿童的智力能力并未得到太多尊重。

en: Piaget not only believed that children were 'egocentric' in the sense that they were unable to differentiate between their own viewpoint and that of others; he was also convinced that their thinking was characterized by systematic errors and confusions. (39 words)
cn: 皮亚杰不仅相信儿童是‘自我中心’的——即他们无法区分自己的观点和他人的观点；他还确信他们的思维以系统性的错误和混乱为特征。

en: When playing with others, they don't cooperate because they do not realize there are different roles and perspectives. (18 words)
cn: 当与他人玩耍时，他们不合作，因为他们没有意识到有不同的角色和视角。

en: He was convinced that children literally cannot 'get their act together': instead of playing cooperatively and truly together, they play side by side, with little regard for others. (28 words)
cn: 他确信儿童简直无法‘协调一致’：他们不是合作地、真正地在一起玩耍，而是并排玩耍，很少顾及他人。

en: And when speaking with others, a young child supposedly cannot consider the listener's viewpoint but 'talks to himself without listening to others.' (22 words)
cn: 而在与他人交谈时，幼儿据称无法考虑听者的观点，而是‘自言自语，不听他人说话’。

en: Piaget and his followers maintained that children go through something like a dark age of intellectual development before slowly and gradually becoming enlightened by reason and rationality as they reach school age. (32 words)
cn: 皮亚吉特和他的追随者认为，儿童在达到学龄时，会经历一段类似于智力发展的黑暗时代，然后缓慢而逐渐地被理性和合理性所启发。

en: Alongside this enlightenment develops an ever growing understanding of other persons, including their attitudes and views of the world. (19 words)
cn: 伴随着这种启蒙而来的是对他人（包括他们的态度和世界观）日益增长的理解。

en: Today, a very different picture of children's mental development emerges. (10 words)
cn: 如今，一幅关于儿童心理发展的截然不同的图景出现了。

en: Psychologists continually reveal new insights into the depth of young children's knowledge of the world, including their understanding of other minds. (21 words)
cn: 心理学家不断揭示出关于幼儿世界知识深度——包括他们对他人的心智的理解——的新见解。

en: Recent studies suggest that even infants are sensitive to others' perspectives and beliefs. (13 words)
cn: 最近的研究表明，即使是婴儿也对他人的视角和信念敏感。

en: Part of the motivation to revise some of Piaget's conclusions stemmed from an ideological shift about the origin of human knowledge that occurred in the second half of the 20th century. (31 words)
cn: 修正皮亚杰某些结论的部分动机源于20世纪下半叶关于人类知识起源的意识形态转变。

en: It became increasingly unpopular to assume that a basic understanding of the world can be built entirely from experience. (19 words)
cn: 认为对世界的基本理解可以完全从经验中建立起来的观点越来越不受欢迎。

en: This was in part prompted by theorist Noam Chomsky, who argued that something as complex as the rules of grammar cannot be picked up from exposure to speech, but is supplied by an inborn 'language faculty.' (36 words)
cn: 这在部分程度上是由理论家诺姆·乔姆斯基推动的，他认为像语法规则这样复杂的东西不能从接触语言中习得，而是由先天的‘语言官能’提供的。

en: Others followed suit and defined further 'core areas' in which knowledge allegedly cannot be pieced together from experience but must be possessed at birth. (24 words)
cn: 其他人也纷纷效仿，并进一步界定了其他‘核心领域’，在这些领域中，知识据称不能从经验中拼凑而成，而必须在出生时就具备。

en: One such area is our knowledge of others' minds. (9 words)
cn: 其中一个这样的领域就是我们对他人心智的认识。

en: Some even argue that a basic knowledge of others' minds is not only possessed by human infants, but must be evolutionarily old and hence shared by our nearest living relatives, the great apes. (33 words)
cn: 有些人甚至认为，对他人的心智的基本认识不仅为人类婴儿所拥有，而且必然在进化上古老，因此也为我们在世的最亲近亲属——类人猿所共享。

en: To prove that infants know more in this realm than had been acknowledged, researchers needed to come up with innovative ways of showing it. (24 words)
cn: 为了证明婴儿在这一领域的知识比以往所承认的更多，研究人员需要想出创新的方法来证明这一点。

en: A big part of why we now recognize so much more of kids' intellectual capacities is the development of much more sensitive research tools than Piaget had at his disposal. (30 words)
cn: 我们现在之所以能认识到儿童更多的智力能力，很大一部分原因是开发了比皮亚杰所能使用的更为敏感的研究工具。

en: Instead of engaging babies in dialog or having them execute complex motor tasks, the newer methods capitalize on behaviors that have a firm place in infants' natural behavior repertoire: looking, listening, sucking, making facial expressions, gestures and simple manual actions. (40 words)
cn: 新的方法不是让婴儿参与对话或让他们执行复杂的运动任务，而是利用在婴儿自然行为中具有稳固地位的行为：注视、倾听、吸吮、做出面部表情、手势和简单的手部动作。

en: The idea of focusing on these 'small behaviors' is that they give kids the chance to demonstrate their knowledge implicitly and spontaneously without having to respond to questions or instructions. (30 words)
cn: 关注这些‘小行为’的想法是，它们让孩子们有机会内隐地、自发地展示他们的知识，而无需回答问题或听从指令。

en: For example, children might look longer at an event that they did not expect to happen, or they might show facial expressions indicating that they have sympathetic concern for others. (30 words)
cn: 例如，孩子们可能会更长时间地注视他们没想到会发生的事件，或者他们可能会表现出面部表情，表明他们对他人有同情的关切。

en: When researchers measure these less demanding, and often involuntary, behaviors, they can detect a sensitivity to others' mental states at a much younger age than with the more taxing methods that Piaget and his followers deployed. (36 words)
cn: 当研究人员测量这些要求较低且往往是不自觉的行为时，他们可以在比皮亚杰及其追随者所使用的更费力的方法更早的年龄上，检测到对他人的心理状态的敏感性。

en: In the 1980s, these kinds of implicit measures became customary in developmental psychology. (13 words)
cn: 在20世纪80年代，这类内隐测量成为发展心理学的惯常做法。

en: But it took a while longer before these tools were employed to measure children's grasp of the mental lives of others. (21 words)
cn: 但这些工具被用于衡量儿童对他人心理生活的掌握程度，还需要更长的时间。

en: In a set of experiments, my colleagues at the University of Southern California and I found evidence that babies can even anticipate how others will feel when their expectations are disappointed. (31 words)
cn: 在一组实验中，我和南加州大学的同事们发现了证据，表明婴儿甚至能预知当期望落空时他人的感受。

en: We acted out several puppet shows in front of two-year-old children. (11 words)
cn: 我们在两岁儿童面前表演了几出木偶剧。

en: In these puppet shows, a protagonist (Cookie Monster) left his precious belongings (cookies) on stage and later returned to fetch them. (21 words)
cn: 在这些木偶剧中，主角（饼干怪兽）将他珍贵的物品（饼干）留在舞台上，后来回来取它们。

en: What the protagonist did not know was that an antagonist had come and messed with his possessions. (17 words)
cn: 主角不知道的是，一个反派来过并弄乱了他的物品。

en: The children had witnessed these acts and attentively watched the protagonist return. (12 words)
cn: 孩子们目睹了这些行为，并聚精会神地看着主角回来。

en: We recorded children's facial and bodily expressions. (7 words)
cn: 我们记录了儿童的面部和身体表情。

en: Children bit their lips, wrinkled their nose or wiggled in their chair when the protagonist came back, as if they anticipated the bewilderment and disappointment he was about to experience. (30 words)
cn: 当主角回来时，孩子们咬嘴唇、皱鼻子或在椅子上扭动，仿佛他们预见到了他即将经历的困惑和失望。

en: Importantly, children showed no such reactions and remained calm when the protagonist had seen the events himself and thus knew what to expect. (23 words)
cn: 重要的是，当主角亲眼目睹了事件并因此知道会发生什么时，孩子们没有表现出这样的反应，而是保持平静。

en: Our study reveals that by the tender age of two, kids not only track what others believe or expect; they can even foresee how others will feel when they discover reality. (31 words)
cn: 我们的研究表明，到两岁这个幼小的年龄，孩子们不仅追踪他人的信念或期望；他们甚至能预见当他人在发现真相时会有什么感受。

en: Studies like this reveal that there is much more going on in small kids' and even infants' minds than was previously believed. (22 words)
cn: 像这样的研究表明，在幼儿甚至婴儿的头脑中发生的比之前认为的要复杂得多。

en: With the explicit measures used by Piaget and successors, these deeper layers of kids' understanding cannot be accessed. (18 words)
cn: 使用皮亚杰及其后继者所使用的显式测量方法，无法触及儿童理解中这些更深的层次。

en: The new investigative tools demonstrate that kids know more than they can say: when we scratch beneath the surface, we find an emerging understanding of relations and perspectives that Piaget probably did not dream of. (35 words)
cn: 新的研究工具表明，孩子们知道的比他们能说出来的要多：当我们深入表面之下时，我们会发现一种皮亚杰可能做梦都想不到的对关系和视角的新兴理解。

en: Despite these obvious advances in the study of young children's thinking, it would be a grave mistake to dismiss the careful and systematic analyses compiled by Piaget and others before the new tests dominated the scene because the original methods revealed essential facts about how children think that the new methods cannot uncover. (53 words)
cn: 尽管在幼儿思维研究方面取得了这些明显的进展，但忽视皮亚杰等人在新测试占据主导地位之前所编制的谨慎而系统的分析，将是一个严重的错误，因为原有的方法揭示了关于儿童如何思考的基本事实，而这些事实是新方法无法揭示的。

en: There's no consensus in today's science community about how much we can infer from a look, a facial expression or a hand gesture. (23 words)
cn: 在当今的科学界，关于我们能从一个眼神、一个面部表情或一个手势中推断出多少信息，并没有共识。

en: These behaviors clearly indicate a curiosity about what goes on in the mind of others, and probably a set of early intuitions coupled with a willingness to learn more. (29 words)
cn: 这些行为清楚地表明了对他人的头脑中发生着什么的好奇心，可能还包含一套早期的直觉以及学习更多的意愿。

en: They pave the way to richer and more explicit forms of understanding of the minds of others. (17 words)
cn: 它们为更丰富、更明确地理解他人的心智铺平了道路。

en: But they can in no way replace the child's growing ability to articulate and refine her understanding of how people behave and why. (23 words)
cn: 但它们绝不能取代孩子日益增长的阐述和完善其对人行为方式及其原因的理解的能力。

en: People often discuss the dangers of too much stress, but lately a very different view of stress is gaining popularity: this view of stress, held by members of the positive stress movement, argues that stress might actually be beneficial. (39 words)
cn: 人们经常讨论压力过大的危害，但最近一种截然不同的压力观点正在流行：这种由积极压力运动成员持有的观点认为，压力实际上可能是有益的。

en: The positive stress movement is made up of people such as Zachary Rapp who are looking for an edge in a competitive world, and Rapp's routine is a good example of followers of the movement. (35 words)
cn: 积极压力运动由像扎卡里·拉普这样在竞争激烈的世界中寻求优势的人组成，拉普的日常作息是运动追随者的一个很好的例子。

en: He wakes up most mornings at dawn, goes for a run, sips black coffee while ripping through emails, and then steps into a freezing cold shower. (26 words)
cn: 他大多数早晨黎明即起，去跑步，一边喝黑咖啡一边快速处理电子邮件，然后冲一个冰冷的淋浴。

en: This is a routine designed to reduce the stress of running simultaneously three different health and biotechnology companies for 18 hours a day. (23 words)
cn: 这是一种旨在减轻每天18小时同时运营三家不同的健康与生物技术公司所带来的压力的日常安排。

en: Although Rapp's practices may sound extreme, he is part of a growing movement, consisting largely of tech industry workers who claim that such radical tactics will help them live better and longer. (32 words)
cn: 尽管拉普的做法听起来可能很极端，但他是一个不断壮大的运动的一部分，该运动主要由科技行业工作者组成，他们声称这种激进的策略将帮助他们活得更好、更长寿。

en: Inspired by influential figures in different fields, including entertainers, athletes, entrepreneurs and scientists, positive stress practitioners seek out some combination of extreme temperatures, restrictive diets, punishing exercise routines and general discomfort. (31 words)
cn: 受到包括艺人、运动员、企业家和科学家在内不同领域有影响力人物的启发，积极压力实践者寻求极端温度、限制性饮食、惩罚性锻炼方案和普遍不适的某种组合。

en: Rapp argues that positive stress keeps him balanced. (8 words)
cn: 拉普认为，积极压力让他保持平衡。

en: In addition to running and freezing showers, Rapp uses ice baths, hot yoga, and unconventional eating practices such as eliminating dairy, sugar, alcohol and various other foods high in carbohydrates. (30 words)
cn: 除了跑步和冷水淋浴，拉普还使用冰浴、热瑜伽，以及不寻常的饮食方式，如排除乳制品、糖、酒精和各种其他高碳水化合物食物。

en: He believes that these practices, which put stress on his body, actually make him feel less stress from work. (19 words)
cn: 他相信，这些给身体带来压力的做法，实际上让他感觉来自工作的压力更小。

en: However, Rapp does not credit anyone in particular for his choices: he said he started using these methods in college, where he got into the habit of taking ice baths to recover from sports. (34 words)
cn: 然而，拉普并不把他的选择归功于任何特定的人：他说他是在大学开始使用这些方法的，那时他养成了用冰浴来从运动中恢复的习惯。

en: He got back into it while trying to get his three companies off the ground. (15 words)
cn: 他在试图创办他的三家公司时又重新开始了这种做法。

en: Rapp works long hours and sleeps only five to seven hours a night but he said he only gets sick once a year. (23 words)
cn: 拉普工作时间长，每晚只睡五到七个小时，但他说他每年只生病一次。

en: For him, the difference between day-to-day stress, like the kind we feel when moving apartments, and positive stress is that the latter involves pushing the body to extremes and forcing it to build up a tolerance. (36 words)
cn: 对他来说，日常压力（比如搬公寓时感受到的那种）和积极压力之间的区别在于，后者涉及将身体推向极端并迫使其建立耐受力。

en: One thought leader in the positive stress world is Dutch extreme athlete Wim Hof, who earned the name 'ice man' for his ability to withstand severe cold using deep breathing exercises. (31 words)
cn: 积极压力领域的一位思想领袖是荷兰极限运动员维姆·霍夫，他因通过深呼吸练习抵御严寒的能力而获得了‘冰人’的称号。

en: Hof's ideas have become popular among tech industry elites and, thanks to Hof, cold showers are now a trend; indeed, some even call it a form of therapy. (28 words)
cn: 霍夫的想法在科技行业精英中变得流行，多亏了霍夫，冷水淋浴现在成了一种趋势；事实上，有些人甚至称之为一种疗法。

en: But it is important to note that not everyone agrees with these practitioners; indeed, some medical professionals argue that positive stress is not for everyone, and that it might even be dangerous for people who are unhealthy or older. (39 words)
cn: 但重要的是要注意，并非所有人都同意这些实践者的做法；事实上，一些医学专业人士认为，积极压力并不适合所有人，甚至可能对不健康或年长的人是危险的。

en: Is hunting good or bad for the environment? (8 words)
cn: 狩猎对环境是好是坏？

en: Like so many hot button issues, the answer to this question depends upon who you ask. (16 words)
cn: 像许多热点问题一样，这个问题的答案取决于你问谁。

en: On the one hand, some say, nothing could be more natural than hunting, and indeed just about every animal species—including humans—has been either predator or prey at some point in its evolution. (32 words)
cn: 一方面，有人说，没有什么比狩猎更自然了，事实上，几乎每一种动物物种——包括人类——在其进化过程中的某个阶段都曾是捕食者或猎物。

en: And, ironic as it sounds, since humans have wiped out many animal predators, some see hunting as a natural way to reduce the herds of prey animals that now reproduce beyond the environment's carrying capacity. (35 words)
cn: 而且，尽管听起来很讽刺，由于人类已经消灭了许多食肉动物，一些人将狩猎视为减少猎物群（它们现在的繁殖已超出环境承载能力）的自然方式。

en: On the other hand, many environmental and animal advocates see hunting as savage, arguing that it is morally wrong to kill animals, regardless of practical considerations. (26 words)
cn: 另一方面，许多环保和动物保护倡导者视狩猎为野蛮行为，认为无论实际考虑如何，杀戮动物在道德上是错误的。

en: According to Glenn Kirk of the California-based The Animals' Voice, hunting 'causes immense suffering to individual wild animals ...' and is 'irrationally cruel because unlike natural predation, hunters kill for pleasure ...' (32 words)
cn: 根据总部位于加利福尼亚的《动物之声》的格伦·柯克的说法，狩猎‘给个体野生动物带来了巨大的痛苦……’并且‘是不理性的残忍，因为与自然捕食不同，猎人为了娱乐而杀戮……’

en: He adds that, despite hunters' claims that hunting keeps wildlife populations in balance, hunters' license fees are used to 'manipulate a few game species into overpopulation at the expense of a much larger number of non-game species, resulting in the loss of biological diversity, genetic integrity and ecological balance.' (49 words)
cn: 他补充说，尽管猎人声称狩猎使野生动物种群保持平衡，但猎人的执照费被用来‘以牺牲大量非猎物种为代价，操纵少数猎物种使其数量过剩，从而导致生物多样性、遗传完整性和生态平衡的丧失。’

en: Beyond moral issues, others contend that hunting is not practical. (10 words)
cn: 除了道德问题，其他人认为狩猎并不实际。

en: According to the Humane Society of the United States, the vast majority of hunted species—such as waterfowl, rabbits, upland birds and mourning doves—'provide minimal nutrition and do not require population control.' (31 words)
cn: 根据美国人道协会的说法，绝大多数被狩猎的物种——如水禽、兔子、高地鸟类和哀鸽——‘提供极少的营养，并且不需要种群控制。’

en: Author Gary E. Varner suggests in his book, In Nature's Interests, that some types of hunting may be morally justifiable while others may not be. (25 words)
cn: 作家加里·E·瓦纳在他的《自然的利益》一书中提出，某些类型的狩猎在道德上可能是合理的，而另一些则不是。

en: Hunting 'designed to secure the aggregate welfare of the target species, the integrity of its ecosystem, or both'—what Varner terms 'therapeutic hunting'—is defensible, while subsistence and sport hunting—both of which only benefit human beings—is not. (35 words)
cn: ‘旨在确保目标物种的整体福利、其生态系统的完整性，或两者兼而有之’的狩猎——瓦纳称之为‘治疗性狩猎’——是可以辩护的，而生存狩猎和运动狩猎——两者都只对人类有益——则不然。

en: Regardless of one's individual stance, fewer Americans hunt today than in recent history. (13 words)
cn: 无论个人的立场如何，如今狩猎的美国人比近代史上要少。

en: Data gathered by the U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service in 2006 show that only five percent of Americans—some 12.5 million individuals—consider themselves hunters today, down from nine percent in 2001 and 15 percent in 1996. (35 words)
cn: 美国鱼类和野生动物管理局2006年收集的数据显示，如今只有5%的美国人——约1250万人——认为自己是猎人，低于2001年的9%和1996年的15%。

en: Public support for hunting, however, is on the rise. (9 words)
cn: 然而，公众对狩猎的支持正在上升。

en: A 2007 survey by Responsive Management Inc. found that eighty percent of respondents agreed that 'hunting has a legitimate place in modern society,' and the percentage of Americans indicating disapproval of hunting declined from 22 percent in 1995 to 16 percent in 2007. (43 words)
cn: Responsive Management Inc. 2007年的一项调查发现，80%的受访者同意‘狩猎在现代社会中有一席之地’，表示不赞成狩猎的美国人的比例从1995年的22%下降到2007年的16%。

en: Perhaps matching the trend among the public, green leaders are increasingly advocating cooperation between hunters and environmental groups: After all, both deplore urban sprawl and habitat destruction. (27 words)
cn: 或许是与公众趋势相呼应，环保领袖们越来越倡导猎人之间以及与环境组织的合作：毕竟，双方都对城市扩张和栖息地破坏感到痛惜。

en: Overall, men are more likely than women to make excuses. (10 words)
cn: 总体而言，男性比女性更容易找借口。

en: Several studies suggest that men feel the need to appear competent in all realms, while women worry only about the skills in which they've invested heavily. (26 words)
cn: 几项研究表明，男性觉得有必要在所有领域都显得有能力，而女性只担心她们投入了大量精力的技能。

en: Ask a man and a woman to go diving for the first time, and the woman is likely to jump in, while the man is likely to say he's not feeling too well. (33 words)
cn: 让一个男人和一个女人第一次去潜水，女人很可能会跳下水，而男人很可能会说他感觉不太舒服。

en: Ironically, it is often success that leads people to flirt with failure. (12 words)
cn: 具有讽刺意味的是，往往是成功导致人们与失败调情。

en: Praise won for mastering a skill suddenly puts one in the position of having everything to lose. (17 words)
cn: 因掌握一项技能而获得的赞誉突然使人处于可能失去一切的位置。

en: Rather than putting their reputation on the line again, many successful people develop a handicap—drinking, fatigue, depression—that allows them to keep their status no matter what the future brings. (29 words)
cn: 许多成功人士不再拿自己的名誉冒险，而是发展出一种障碍——饮酒、疲劳、抑郁——无论未来发生什么，都能让他们保持自己的地位。

en: An advertising executive hospitalized for depression shortly after winning an award put it this way: 'Without my depression, I'd be a failure now; with it, I'm a success 'on hold.' (30 words)
cn: 一位广告高管在获奖后不久因抑郁症住院，他这样说道：‘没有抑郁症，我现在会是个失败者；有了它，我是一个‘待定’的成功者。’

en: In fact, the people most likely to become chronic excuse makers are those obsessed with success. (16 words)
cn: 事实上，最有可能成为习惯性找借口者的人是那些痴迷于成功的人。

en: Such people are so afraid of being labeled a failure at anything that they constantly develop one handicap or another in order to explain away failure. (26 words)
cn: 这些人非常害怕在任何事情上被贴上失败者的标签，以至于他们不断制造这样或那样的障碍来为失败开脱。

en: Though self-handicapping can be an effective way of coping with performance anxiety now and then, in the end, researchers say, it will lead to ruin. (25 words)
cn: 尽管自我设障有时可以成为应对表现焦虑的有效方式，但研究人员表示，最终它会导致毁灭。

en: In the long run, excuse makers fail to live up to their true potential and lose the status they care so much about. (23 words)
cn: 从长远来看，找借口者未能发挥自己的真正潜力，并失去了他们如此在意的地位。

en: And despite their protests to the contrary, they have only themselves to blame. (13 words)
cn: 尽管他们极力辩驳，但也只能怪自己。

en: Brains, brains, brains. (3 words)
cn: 大脑，大脑，大脑。

en: People are fascinated by brain research. (6 words)
cn: 人们对大脑研究着迷。

en: And yet it can be hard to point to places where our education system is really making use of the latest neuroscience findings. (23 words)
cn: 然而，很难指出我们的教育系统真正在利用最新神经科学发现的地方。

en: But there is one happy link where research is meeting practice: bilingual education. (13 words)
cn: 但有一个研究与实践相结合的美好联系：双语教育。

en: In the last 20 years or so, there's been a virtual explosion of research on bilingualism, says Judith Kroll, a professor at the University of California, Riverside. (27 words)
cn: 加州大学河滨分校教授朱迪思·克罗尔说：‘在过去大约20年里，关于双语的研究几乎出现了爆炸式增长。’

en: Again and again, researchers have found, 'bilingualism is an experience that shapes our brain for life,' in the words of Gigi Luk, an associate professor at Harvard's Graduate School of Education. (31 words)
cn: 哈佛大学教育研究生院副教授吉吉·卢克说：‘研究人员一次又一次地发现，双语是一种终其一生塑造我们大脑的体验。’

en: At the same time, one of the hottest trends in public schooling is what's often called dual-language or two-way immersion programs. (21 words)
cn: 与此同时，公立学校教育中最热门的趋势之一是通常被称为双语或双向沉浸式课程的项目。

en: Traditional programs for English-language learners, or ELLs, focus on assimilating students into English as quickly as possible. (17 words)
cn: 传统的英语学习者课程侧重于让学生尽快融入英语。

en: Dual-language classrooms, by contrast, provide instruction across subjects to both English natives and English learners, in both English and a target language. (22 words)
cn: 相比之下，双语课堂用英语和目标语言向英语母语者和英语学习者提供各学科的教学。

en: The goal is functional bilingualism and biliteracy for all students by middle school. (13 words)
cn: 目标是让所有学生在中学阶段实现功能性双语和双文能力。

en: New York City, North Carolina, Delaware, Utah, Oregon and Washington state are among the places expanding dual-language classrooms. (18 words)
cn: 纽约市、北卡罗来纳州、特拉华州、犹他州、俄勒冈州和华盛顿州都在扩大双语课堂的规模。

en: The trend flies in the face of some of the culture wars of two decades ago, when advocates insisted on 'English first' education. (23 words)
cn: 这一趋势与二十年前的一些文化战争背道而驰，当时倡导者坚持‘英语优先’的教育。

en: Most famously, California passed Proposition 227 in 1998. (8 words)
cn: 最著名的是，加利福尼亚州于1998年通过了227号提案。

en: It was intended to sharply reduce the amount of time that English-language learners spent in bilingual settings. (17 words)
cn: 该提案旨在大幅减少英语学习者在双语环境中度过的时间。

en: Proposition 58, passed by California voters on November 8, largely reversed that decision, paving the way for a huge expansion of bilingual education in the state that has the largest population of English-language learners. (34 words)
cn: 加州选民于11月8日通过的58号提案在很大程度上推翻了这一决定，为该州（拥有最多英语学习者人口）的双语教育大规模扩展铺平了道路。

en: Some of the insistence on English-first was founded on research produced decades ago, in which bilingual students underperformed monolingual English speakers and had lower IQ scores. (26 words)
cn: 对英语优先的部分坚持是基于几十年前的研究，这些研究发现双语学生的表现不如单语英语使用者，且智商分数较低。

en: Today's scholars, like Ellen Bialystok at York University in Toronto, say that research was 'deeply flawed.' (16 words)
cn: 如今的多伦多约克大学学者埃伦·比亚利斯托克等学者表示，那项研究‘存在严重缺陷’。

en: Earlier research looked at socially disadvantaged groups, agrees Antonella Sorace at the University of Edinburgh in Scotland. (17 words)
cn: 苏格兰爱丁堡大学的安东内拉·索拉切也同意：‘早期研究关注的是社会弱势群体。’

en: This has been completely contradicted by recent research that compares groups more similar to each other. (16 words)
cn: ‘最近对更为相似的群体进行比较的研究已经完全推翻了这一点。’

en: So what does recent research say about the potential benefits of bilingual education? (13 words)
cn: 那么，最近的研究对双语教育的潜在好处有什么看法呢？

en: It turns out that, in many ways, the real trick to speaking two languages consists in managing not to speak one of those languages at a given moment—which is fundamentally a feat of paying attention. (35 words)
cn: 事实证明，在许多方面，说两种语言的真正诀窍在于在特定时刻设法不说其中一种语言——这从根本上说是一种专注的壮举。

en: Saying 'Goodbye' to mom and then 'Guten tag' to your teacher, or managing to ask for a crayola roja instead of a red crayon, requires skills called 'inhibition' and 'task switching.' (31 words)
cn: 对妈妈说‘再见’然后对老师说‘Guten tag’，或者设法要一支‘crayola roja’而不是红色蜡笔，都需要被称为‘抑制’和‘任务切换’的技能。

en: These skills are subsets of an ability called executive function. (10 words)
cn: 这些技能是一种被称为执行功能的能力的子集。

en: People who speak two languages often outperform monolinguals on general measures of executive function. (14 words)
cn: 说两种语言的人在执行功能的一般测量上往往优于单语者。

en: Bilinguals can pay focused attention without being distracted and also improve in the ability to switch from one task to another, says Sorace. (23 words)
cn: 索拉切说：‘双语者能够集中注意力而不分心，并且在从一项任务切换到另一项任务的能力上也有所提高。’

en: Do these same advantages benefit a child who begins learning a second language in kindergarten instead of as a baby? (20 words)
cn: 这些同样的优势是否有利于一个从幼儿园而不是从婴儿时期开始学习第二语言的孩子？

en: We don't yet know. (4 words)
cn: 我们还不知道。

en: Patterns of language learning and language use are complex. (9 words)
cn: 语言学习和语言使用的模式是复杂的。

en: But Gigi Luk at Harvard cites at least one brain-imaging study on adolescents that shows similar changes in brain structure when compared with those who are bilingual from birth, even when they didn't begin practicing a second language in earnest before late childhood. (43 words)
cn: 但哈佛大学的吉吉·卢克引用了一项关于青少年的脑成像研究，该研究显示，与从出生起就是双语者的人相比，即使他们在童年晚期之前没有认真开始练习第二语言，大脑结构也出现了类似的变化。

en: Young children being raised bilingual have to follow social cues to figure out which language to use with which person and in what setting. (24 words)
cn: 在双语环境中长大的幼儿必须遵循社交线索，弄清楚在什么场合对什么人使用哪种语言。

en: As a result, says Sorace, bilingual children as young as age 3 have demonstrated a head start on tests of perspective-taking and theory of mind—both of which are fundamental social and emotional skills. (33 words)
cn: 索拉切说，因此，年仅3岁的双语儿童在换位思考和心理理论测试中表现出领先优势——这两者都是基本的社交和情感技能。

en: About 10 percent of students in the Portland, Oregon public schools are assigned by lottery to dual-language classrooms that offer instruction in Spanish, Japanese or Mandarin, alongside English. (28 words)
cn: 俄勒冈州波特兰公立学校中约10%的学生通过抽签被分配到双语课堂，这些课堂除英语外还提供西班牙语、日语或普通话教学。

en: Jennifer Steele at American University conducted a four-year, randomized trial and found that the dual-language students outperformed their peers in English-reading skills by a full school-year's worth of learning by the end of middle school. (35 words)
cn: 美国大学的詹妮弗·斯蒂尔进行了一项为期四年的随机试验，发现双语学生在中学结束时的英语阅读技能方面领先同龄人整整一个学年的学习量。

en: Because the effects are found in reading, not in math or science where there were few differences, Steele suggests that learning two languages make students more aware of how language works in general. (33 words)
cn: 由于效果体现在阅读上，而不是在数学或科学上（这些科目差异很小），斯蒂尔认为学习两种语言让学生更普遍地意识到语言是如何运作的。

en: The research of Gigi Luk at Harvard offers a slightly different explanation. (12 words)
cn: 哈佛大学吉吉·卢克的研究提供了一个略有不同的解释。

en: She has recently done a small study looking at a group of 100 fourth-graders in Massachusetts who had similar reading scores on a standard test, but very different language experiences. (30 words)
cn: 她最近做了一项小型研究，观察了马萨诸塞州100名四年级学生，他们在标准化测试中阅读分数相似，但语言经历却大不相同。

en: Some were foreign-language dominant and others were English natives. (9 words)
cn: 有些以外语为主，有些则以英语为母语。

en: Here's what's interesting. (3 words)
cn: 有趣的是：

en: The students who were dominant in a foreign language weren't yet comfortably bilingual; they were just starting to learn English. (20 words)
cn: 那些以外语为主的学生还不能自如地使用双语；他们刚刚开始学习英语。

en: Therefore, by definition, they had a much weaker English vocabulary than the native speakers. (14 words)
cn: 因此，按定义，他们的英语词汇量比母语者弱得多。

en: Yet they were just as good at interpreting a text. (10 words)
cn: 然而他们在解读文本方面同样出色。

en: This is very surprising, Luk says. (6 words)
cn: 卢克说：‘这非常令人惊讶。’

en: You would expect the reading comprehension performance to mirror the vocabulary—it's a cornerstone of comprehension. (15 words)
cn: ‘你会期望阅读理解的表现与词汇量相匹配——这是理解力的基石。’

en: How did the foreign-language dominant speakers manage this feat? (9 words)
cn: 这些以外语为主的学习者是如何做到这一点的呢？

en: Well, Luk found, they also scored higher on tests of executive functioning. (12 words)
cn: 卢克发现，他们在执行功能测试中也得分更高。

en: So, even though they didn't have huge mental dictionaries to draw on, they may have been great puzzle-solvers, taking into account higher-level concepts such as whether a single sentence made sense within an overall storyline. (35 words)
cn: 因此，尽管他们没有庞大的心理词典可以依赖，但他们可能是出色的解谜者，能够考虑到更高层次的概念，比如单个句子在整个故事情节中是否有意义。

en: They got to the same results as the monolinguals, by a different path. (13 words)
cn: 他们通过不同的路径达到了与单语者相同的结果。

en: American public school classrooms as a whole are becoming more segregated by race and class. (15 words)
cn: 美国公立学校的课堂总体上正变得越来越按种族和阶级隔离。

en: Dual-language programs can be an exception. (6 words)
cn: 双语课程可能是一个例外。

en: Because they are composed of native English speakers deliberately placed together with recent immigrants, they tend to be more ethnically and economically balanced. (23 words)
cn: 因为它们是由英语母语者与新移民有意组合在一起的，所以它们往往在种族和经济上更加平衡。

en: And there is some evidence that this helps kids of all backgrounds gain comfort with diversity and different cultures. (19 words)
cn: 而且有一些证据表明，这有助于各种背景的孩子适应多样性和不同的文化。

en: Several of the researchers also pointed out that, in bilingual education, non-English-dominant students and their families tend to feel that their home language is heard and valued, compared with a classroom where the home language is left at the door in favor of English. (44 words)
cn: 几位研究人员还指出，在双语教育中，非英语主导的学生和他们的家庭往往感到他们的家庭语言被倾听和重视，而与之相比，在那些家庭语言被留在门外、只讲英语的课堂中则不然。

en: This can improve students' sense of belonging and increase parents' involvement in their children's education, including behaviors like reading to children. (21 words)
cn: 这可以增强学生的归属感，并增加家长对孩子教育的参与，包括给孩子读书等行为。

en: Many parents fear their language is an obstacle, a problem, and if they abandon it their child will integrate better, says Antonella Sorace of the University of Edinburgh. (28 words)
cn: 爱丁堡大学的安东内拉·索拉切说：‘许多父母担心他们的语言是一种障碍、一个问题，如果他们放弃它，孩子会更好地融入。’

en: We tell them they're not doing their child a favor by giving up their language. (15 words)
cn: ‘我们告诉他们，放弃自己的语言对孩子并没有好处。’

en: One theme that was striking in speaking to all these researchers was just how strongly they advocated for dual-language classrooms. (20 words)
cn: 在与所有这些研究人员交谈时，一个引人注目的主题是他们强烈倡导双语课堂。

en: Thomas and Collier have advised many school systems on how to expand their dual language programs, and Sorace runs 'bilingualism Matters,' an international network of researchers who promote bilingual education projects. (31 words)
cn: 托马斯和科利尔为许多学校系统提供了如何扩大双语项目的建议，索拉切则运营着‘双语很重要’——一个推广双语教育项目的国际研究人员网络。

en: This type of advocacy among scientists is unusual; even more so because the 'bilingual advantage hypothesis' is being challenged once again. (21 words)
cn: 科学家中这种类型的倡导是不寻常的；更因为‘双语优势假说’再次受到挑战。

en: A review of studies published last year found that cognitive advantages failed to appear in 83 percent of published studies, though in a separate analysis, the sum of effects was still significantly positive. (33 words)
cn: 去年发表的一项研究综述发现，在83%的已发表研究中，认知优势未能显现，尽管在另一项分析中，总体效应仍然显著为正。

en: One potential explanation offered by the researchers is that advantages that are measurable in the very young and very old tend to fade when testing young adults at the peak of their cognitive powers. (34 words)
cn: 研究人员提供的一个潜在解释是，在婴幼儿和老年人中可测量的优势，在测试处于认知能力巅峰期的年轻人时往往会消失。

en: And, they countered that no negative effects of bilingual education have been found. (13 words)
cn: 而且，他们反驳说没有发现双语教育的负面影响。

en: So, even if the advantages are small, they are still worth it. (12 words)
cn: 所以，即使优势很小，它们仍然值得。

en: Not to mention one obvious, outstanding fact: 'Bilingual children can speak two languages!' (13 words)
cn: 更不用说一个显而易见的事实：‘双语孩子能说两种语言！’

en: It is not controversial to say that an unhealthy diet causes bad health. (13 words)
cn: 说不健康的饮食会导致健康状况不佳，这并无争议。

en: Nor are the basic elements of healthy eating disputed. (9 words)
cn: 健康饮食的基本要素也无可争议。

en: Obesity raises susceptibility to cancer, and Britain is the sixth most obese country on Earth. (15 words)
cn: 肥胖增加了患癌的易感性，而英国是全球第六大肥胖国家。

en: That is a public health emergency. (6 words)
cn: 这是一个公共卫生紧急事件。

en: But naming the problem is the easy part. (8 words)
cn: 但指出问题只是最简单的一步。

en: No one disputes the costs in quality of life and depleted health budgets of an obese population, but the quest for solutions gets diverted by ideological arguments around responsibility and choice. (31 words)
cn: 没有人质疑肥胖人群在生活质量和消耗的卫生预算方面的代价，但对解决方案的探索被围绕责任和选择的意识形态争论所干扰。

en: And the water is muddied by lobbying from the industries that profit from consumption of obesity-inducing products. (17 words)
cn: 而且，从致肥产品消费中获利的行业的游说也混淆了视听。

en: Historical precedent suggests that science and politics can overcome resistance from businesses that pollute and poison but it takes time, and success often starts small. (25 words)
cn: 历史先例表明，科学和政治可以克服污染和有毒企业的阻力，但这需要时间，成功往往始于小事。

en: So it is heartening to note that a programme in Leeds has achieved a reduction in childhood obesity, becoming the first UK city to reverse a fattening trend. (28 words)
cn: 因此，令人振奋的是，利兹的一项计划已经实现了儿童肥胖率的降低，成为英国第一个扭转肥胖趋势的城市。

en: The best results were among younger children and in more deprived areas. (12 words)
cn: 最好的效果出现在年幼儿童和更贫困的地区。

en: When 28% of English children aged 2 to 15 are obese, a national shift on the scale achieved by Leeds would lengthen hundreds of thousands of lives. (27 words)
cn: 当28%的2至15岁英国儿童肥胖时，利兹所达到的全国性转变将延长数十万人的生命。

en: A significant factor in the Leeds experience appears to be a scheme called HENRY, which helps parents reward behaviours that prevent obesity in children. (24 words)
cn: 利兹经验中的一个重要因素似乎是一个名为HENRY的计划，该计划帮助父母奖励预防儿童肥胖的行为。

en: Many members of parliament are uncomfortable even with their own government's anti-obesity strategy, since it involves a 'sugar tax' and abandons the sale of energy drinks to under-16s. (28 words)
cn: 许多议员甚至对他们自己政府的反肥胖战略感到不安，因为它涉及‘糖税’和放弃向16岁以下青少年出售能量饮料。

en: Bans and taxes can be blunt instruments, but their harshest critics can rarely suggest better methods. (16 words)
cn: 禁令和税收可能是粗略的工具，但最严厉的批评者也很少能提出更好的方法。

en: These critics just oppose regulation itself. (6 words)
cn: 这些批评者只是反对监管本身。

en: The relationship between poor health and inequality is too pronounced for governments to be passive about large-scale intervention. (18 words)
cn: 健康状况不佳与不平等之间的关系过于明显，政府不能对大规模干预采取被动态度。

en: People living in the most deprived areas are four times more prone to die from avoidable causes than counterparts in more affluent places. (23 words)
cn: 生活在最贫困地区的人死于可避免原因的可能性是较富裕地区同龄人的四倍。

en: As the structural nature of public health problems becomes harder to ignore, the complaint about overprotective government loses potency. (19 words)
cn: 随着公共卫生问题的结构性本质越来越难以忽视，对政府过度保护的抱怨也失去了效力。

en: In fact, the polarised debate over public health interventions should have been abandoned long ago. (15 words)
cn: 事实上，关于公共卫生干预的两极化辩论早就应该放弃。

en: Government action works when individuals are motivated to respond. (9 words)
cn: 当个人有动力做出回应时，政府行动才会起作用。

en: Individuals need governments that expand access to good choices. (9 words)
cn: 个人需要能扩大良好选择渠道的政府。

en: The HENRY programme was delivered in part through children's centres. (10 words)
cn: HENRY计划部分通过儿童中心实施。

en: Closing such centres and cutting council budgets doesn't magically increase reserves of individual self-reliance. (14 words)
cn: 关闭这样的中心和削减议会预算并不能神奇地增加个人自力更生的储备。

en: The function of a well-designed state intervention is not to deprive people of liberty but to build social capacity and infrastructure that helps people take responsibility for their wellbeing. (29 words)
cn: 精心设计的国家干预的功能不是剥夺人们的自由，而是建设社会能力和基础设施，帮助人们为自己的福祉承担责任。

en: The obesity crisis will not have a solution devised by left or right ideology—but experience indicates that the private sector needs the incentive of regulation before it starts taking public health emergencies seriously. (33 words)
cn: 肥胖危机不会有一个由左翼或右翼意识形态设计的解决方案——但经验表明，私营部门需要监管的激励，才会开始认真对待公共卫生紧急事件。

en: Home to virgin reefs, rare sharks and vast numbers of exotic fish, the Coral Sea is a unique haven of biodiversity off the northeastern coast of Australia. (27 words)
cn: 珊瑚海拥有原始的珊瑚礁、稀有的鲨鱼和大量的外来鱼类，是澳大利亚东北海岸外一个独特的生物多样性天堂。

en: If a proposal by the Australian government goes ahead, the region will also become the world's largest marine protected area, with restrictions or bans on fishing, mining and marine farming. (30 words)
cn: 如果澳大利亚政府的一项提议得以实施，该地区还将成为世界上最大的海洋保护区，对捕鱼、采矿和海洋养殖实行限制或禁止。

en: The Coral Sea reserve would cover almost 990,000 square kilometres and stretch as far as 1,100 kilometres from the coast. (20 words)
cn: 珊瑚海保护区将覆盖近99万平方公里，从海岸延伸至1,100公里远。

en: Unveiled recently by environment minister Tony Burke, the proposal would be the last in a series of proposed marine reserves around Australia's coast. (23 words)
cn: 该提议最近由环境部长托尼·伯克公布，将是澳大利亚海岸周围一系列拟议海洋保护区中的最后一个。

en: But the scheme is attracting criticism from scientists and conservation groups, who argue that the government hasn't gone far enough in protecting the Coral Sea, or in other marine reserves in the coastal network. (34 words)
cn: 但该计划正受到科学家和环保组织的批评，他们认为政府在保护珊瑚海或沿海网络中其他海洋保护区方面做得还不够。

en: Hugh Possingham, director of the Centre of Excellence for Environmental Decisions at the University of Queensland, points out that little more than half of the Coral Sea reserve is proposed as 'no take' area, in which all fishing would be banned. (41 words)
cn: 昆士兰大学环境决策卓越中心主任休·波辛厄姆指出，珊瑚海保护区中只有略多于一半的区域被提议为‘禁捕’区，所有捕鱼活动都将被禁止。

en: The world's largest existing marine reserve, established last year by the British government in the Indian Ocean, spans 554,000 km² and is a no-take zone throughout. (26 words)
cn: 目前世界上最大的海洋保护区是去年由英国政府在印度洋建立的，面积达55.4万平方公里，整个区域都是禁捕区。

en: An alliance of campaigning conservation groups argues that more of the Coral Sea should receive this level of protection. (19 words)
cn: 一个由环保活动团体组成的联盟认为，珊瑚海的更多区域应该得到这种程度的保护。

en: I would like to have seen more protection for coral reefs, says Terry Hughes, director of the Centre of Excellence for Coral Reef Studies at James Cook University in Queensland. (30 words)
cn: 昆士兰詹姆斯库克大学珊瑚礁研究卓越中心主任特里·休斯说：‘我希望看到对珊瑚礁更多的保护。’

en: More than 20 of them would be outside the no-take area and vulnerable to catch-and-release fishing. (16 words)
cn: ‘其中20多个珊瑚礁将位于禁捕区之外，容易受到捕获并释放式捕鱼的影响。’

en: As Nature went to press, the Australian government had not responded to specific criticisms of the plan. (17 words)
cn: 截至《自然》杂志发稿时，澳大利亚政府尚未回应对该计划的具体批评。

en: But Robin Beaman, a marine geologist at James Cook University, says that the reserve does 'broadly protect the range of habitats' in the sea. (24 words)
cn: 但詹姆斯库克大学的海洋地质学家罗宾·比曼表示，该保护区确实‘广泛保护了海中的栖息地范围’。

en: I can testify to the huge effort that government agencies and other organisations have put into trying to understand the ecological values of this vast area, he says. (28 words)
cn: 他说：‘我可以证明政府机构和其他组织为了解这一广阔区域的生态价值所付出的巨大努力。’

en: Reserves proposed earlier this year for Australia's southwestern and northwestern coastal regions have also been criticised for failing to give habitats adequate protection. (23 words)
cn: 今年早些时候为澳大利亚西南部和西北部沿海地区提议的保护区也因未能给予栖息地充分保护而受到批评。

en: In August, 173 marine scientists signed an open letter to the government saying they were 'greatly concerned' that the proposals for the southwestern region had not been based on the 'core science principles' of reserves—the protected regions were not, for instance, representative of all the habitats in the region, they said. (51 words)
cn: 8月，173名海洋科学家签署了一封致政府的公开信，表示他们‘非常担心’西南地区的提议没有基于保护区的‘核心科学原则’——例如，他们说，保护区并不能代表该地区的所有栖息地。

en: Critics say that the southwestern reserve offers the greatest protection to the offshore areas where commercial opportunities are fewest and where there is little threat to the environment, a contention also levelled at the Coral Sea plan. (37 words)
cn: 批评者表示，西南保护区为商业机会最少、环境威胁最小的近海区域提供了最大程度的保护，这一论点也被用于批评珊瑚海计划。

en: It was perhaps when my parents—who also happen to be my housemates—left to go travelling for a couple of months recently that it dawned on me why I had not yet left the family home. (35 words)
cn: 也许就是在最近我父母——他们也恰好是我的室友——离开家去旅行几个月的时候，我才明白为什么我还没有离开这个家。

en: It wasn't that I relied on them for logistical reasons, or to keep my life in order, or to ease the chaos of the home. (25 words)
cn: 并不是因为我在后勤上依赖他们，或者需要他们来维持我生活的秩序，或者缓解家中的混乱。

en: These days, I rely on them for their company. (9 words)
cn: 如今，我依赖的是他们的陪伴。

en: I missed coming home and talking about my day at work, and I missed being able to read their faces and sense how their day was. (26 words)
cn: 我想念回家后谈论我一天工作的时光，也想念能看懂他们的表情、感知他们一天过得如何的感觉。

en: I missed having unique insight into tiny details that make a life. (12 words)
cn: 我想念对构成生活的那些微小细节所拥有的独特洞察。

en: While the conversation about young adults staying longer at home is saturated by talk of laziness, of dependence, of an inability for young people to pull themselves together, rarely do we talk of the way, in my case at least, my relationship with my parents has undoubtedly strengthened the longer we have lived together. (54 words)
cn: 虽然关于年轻人待在家里时间更长的讨论充斥着懒惰、依赖、年轻人无法振作起来的言论，但我们很少谈论——至少就我而言——我们在一起生活的时间越长，我与父母的关系无疑变得越紧密。

en: Over the years the power dynamic has changed and is no longer defined by one being the giver and another, the taker. (22 words)
cn: 多年来，权力动态已经改变，不再由一方是给予者、另一方是接受者来定义。

en: So, what does this say for our relationships within the family home? (12 words)
cn: 那么，这对我们在家庭中的关系意味着什么呢？

en: According to psychologist Sabina Read, there are 'some very positive possible outcomes when adult children share the family home', noting the 'parent-child relationship may indeed strengthen and mature' in the process. (31 words)
cn: 根据心理学家萨宾娜·里德的说法，‘成年子女与父母同住时，会产生一些非常积极的可能结果’，并指出‘亲子关系在这一过程中确实可能得到加强和成熟’。

en: But, she notes, a strong bond doesn't simply come with time. (11 words)
cn: 但她指出，牢固的纽带不会仅仅随着时间的推移而产生。

en: The many changing factors of the relationship need to be acknowledged, rather than hoping that the mere passage of time will magically connect parents to their adult children. (28 words)
cn: 需要承认关系中许多变化的因素，而不是仅仅希望时间的流逝就能神奇地将父母与他们成年子女联系在一起。

en: It's important to acknowledge that the relationship parameters have changed to avoid falling back into patterns from the teen years. (20 words)
cn: 承认关系的参数已经改变是很重要的，以避免重蹈青少年时期的模式。

en: After years of big promises, telemedicine is finally living up to its potential. (13 words)
cn: 在多年的宏大承诺之后，远程医疗终于开始发挥其潜力。

en: Driven by faster internet connections, ubiquitous smartphones and changing insurance standards, more health providers are turning to electronic communications to do their jobs—and it's dramatically changing the delivery of healthcare. (30 words)
cn: 在更快的互联网连接、无处不在的智能手机和不断变化的保险标准的推动下，越来越多的医疗服务提供者正在转向电子通信来完成工作——这正在极大地改变医疗服务的提供方式。

en: Doctors are linking up with patients by phone, email and webcam. (11 words)
cn: 医生正在通过电话、电子邮件和网络摄像头与患者联系。

en: They're also consulting with each other electronically—sometimes to make split second decisions on heart attacks and strokes. (17 words)
cn: 他们还在以电子方式相互咨询——有时是为了在心脏病发作和中风问题上做出瞬间决定。

en: Patients, meanwhile, are using new devices to relay their blood pressure, heart rate and other vital signs to their doctors so they can manage chronic conditions at home. (28 words)
cn: 与此同时，患者正在使用新设备将他们的血压、心率和其他生命体征传送给医生，以便他们可以在家中管理慢性病。

en: Telemedicine also allows for better care in places where medical expertise is hard to come by. (16 words)
cn: 远程医疗也使得在难以获得医疗专业知识的地区能够提供更好的护理。

en: Five to 10 times a day, Doctors Without Borders relays questions about tough cases from its physicians in Niger, South Sudan and elsewhere to its network of 280 experts around the world, and back again via internet. (37 words)
cn: 无国界医生组织每天五到十次通过互联网将其在尼日尔、南苏丹和其他地方的医生关于疑难病例的问题转达给其全球280名专家网络，然后再将答案传回。

en: As a measure of how rapidly telemedicine is spreading, consider: More than 15 million Americans received some kind of medical care remotely last year, according to the American Telemedicine Association, a trade group, which expects those numbers to grow by 30% this year. (43 words)
cn: 作为衡量远程医疗传播速度的一个指标，请考虑：根据美国远程医疗协会（一个行业组织）的数据，去年有超过1500万美国人接受了某种形式的远程医疗护理，该协会预计今年这一数字将增长30%。

en: None of this is to say that telemedicine has found its way into all corners of medicine. (17 words)
cn: 这一切并不是说远程医疗已经进入了医学的各个角落。

en: A recent survey of 500 tech-savvy consumers found that 39% hadn't heard of telemedicine, and of those who haven't used it, 42% said they preferred in-person doctor visits. (28 words)
cn: 最近一项对500名精通技术的消费者的调查发现，39%的人没有听说过远程医疗，而在那些没有使用过远程医疗的人中，42%的人表示他们更喜欢亲自去看医生。

en: In a poll of 1,500 family physicians, only 15% had used it in their practices—but 90% said they would if it were appropriately reimbursed. (24 words)
cn: 在一项对1500名家庭医生的调查中，只有15%的人在执业中使用过远程医疗——但90%的人表示，如果能得到适当的补偿，他们会使用。

en: What's more, for all the rapid growth, significant questions and challenges remain. (12 words)
cn: 更重要的是，尽管增长迅速，但仍存在重大问题和挑战。

en: Rules defining and regulating telemedicine differ widely from state to state. (11 words)
cn: 定义和规范远程医疗的规则因州而异，差异很大。

en: Physicians groups are issuing different guidelines about what care they consider appropriate to deliver and in what form. (18 words)
cn: 医生团体正在就他们认为适合提供的护理及其形式发布不同的指南。

en: Some critics also question whether the quality of care is keeping up with the rapid expansion of telemedicine. (18 words)
cn: 一些批评者还质疑护理质量是否跟得上远程医疗的快速扩张。

en: And there's the question of what services physicians should be paid for: Insurance coverage varies from health plan to health plan, and a big federal plan covers only a narrow range of services. (33 words)
cn: 还有一个问题是医生应该为哪些服务收费：保险覆盖范围因健康计划而异，一项大型联邦计划只覆盖一小部分服务。

en: Telemedicine's future will depend on how—and whether—regulators, providers, payers and patients can address these challenges. (15 words)
cn: 远程医疗的未来将取决于监管机构、提供者、支付方和患者如何——以及是否——能够应对这些挑战。

en: Here's a closer look at some of these issues: (9 words)
cn: 下面让我们更仔细地看看其中一些问题：

en: Do patients trade quality for convenience? (6 words)
cn: 患者是用质量换取便利吗？

en: The fastest-growing services in telemedicine connect consumers with clinicians they've never met for a phone, video or email visit—on-demand, 24/7. (20 words)
cn: 远程医疗中增长最快的服务是将消费者与他们从未见过的临床医生联系起来，进行电话、视频或电子邮件问诊——按需提供，全天候服务。

en: Typically, these are for nonemergency issues such as colds, flu, ear-aches and skin rashes, and they cost around $45, compared with approximately $100 at a doctor's office, $160 at an urgent-care clinic or $750 and up at an emergency room. (40 words)
cn: 通常，这些是针对感冒、流感、耳痛和皮疹等非紧急问题，费用约为45美元，而医生办公室约100美元，紧急护理诊所约160美元，急诊室750美元起。

en: Many health plans and employers have rushed to offer the services and promote them as a convenient way for plan members to get medical care without leaving home or work. (30 words)
cn: 许多健康计划和雇主已经争先恐后地提供这些服务，并将其宣传为计划成员无需离开家或工作即可获得医疗护理的便捷方式。

en: Nearly three-quarters of large employers will offer virtual doctor visits as a benefit to employees this year, up from 48% last year. (22 words)
cn: 今年近四分之三的大型雇主将提供虚拟医生问诊作为员工福利，高于去年的48%。

en: Web companies such as Teladoc and American Well are expected to host some 1.2 million such virtual doctor visits this year, up 20% from last year, according to the American Telemedicine Association. (32 words)
cn: 根据美国远程医疗协会的数据，Teladoc和American Well等网络公司预计今年将提供约120万次此类虚拟医生问诊，比去年增长20%。

en: But critics worry that such services may be sacrificing quality for convenience. (12 words)
cn: 但批评者担心，这类服务可能是在牺牲质量换取便利。

en: Consulting a random doctor patients will never meet, they say, further fragments the health-care system, and even minor issues such as upper respiratory infections can't be thoroughly evaluated by a doctor who can't listen to your heart or feel your swollen glands. (42 words)
cn: 他们说，咨询一个患者永远不会见面的随机医生，会进一步碎片化医疗保健系统，即使是上呼吸道感染等小问题，也无法由一位无法听诊心脏或触摸肿胀腺体的医生进行全面评估。

en: In a recent study, researchers posing as patients with skin problems sought help from 16 telemedicine sites—with unsettling results. (19 words)
cn: 在最近的一项研究中，伪装成患有皮肤问题的研究人员从16个远程医疗网站寻求帮助——结果令人不安。

en: In 62 encounters, fewer than one-third disclosed clinicians' credentials or let patients choose; only 32% discussed potential side effects of prescribed medications. (22 words)
cn: 在62次问诊中，不到三分之一披露了临床医生的资质或让患者选择；只有32%讨论了处方药物的潜在副作用。

en: Several sites misdiagnosed serious conditions, largely because they failed to ask basic follow-up questions, the researchers said. (17 words)
cn: 研究人员说，几个网站误诊了严重疾病，主要是因为它们未能提出基本的后续问题。

en: Telemedicine holds enormous promise, but these sites are just not ready for prime time, says Jack Resneck, the study's lead author. (21 words)
cn: 该研究的主要作者杰克·雷斯内克说：‘远程医疗有着巨大的前景，但这些网站还没有准备好进入黄金时段。’

en: The American Telemedicine Association and other organizations have started accreditation programs to identify top-quality telemedicine sites. (16 words)
cn: 美国远程医疗协会和其他组织已经启动了认证项目，以识别高质量的远程医疗网站。

en: The American Medical Association this month approved new ethical guidelines for telemedicine, calling for participating doctors to recognize the limitations of such services and ensure that they have sufficient information to make clinical recommendations. (34 words)
cn: 美国医学协会本月批准了新的远程医疗伦理指南，要求参与医生认识到此类服务的局限性，并确保他们有足够的信息来提出临床建议。

en: Who pays for the services? (5 words)
cn: 谁来为这些服务付费？

en: While employers and health plans have been eager to cover virtual urgent-care visits, insurers have been far less willing to pay for telemedicine when doctors use phone, email or video to consult with existing patients about continuing issues. (38 words)
cn: 虽然雇主和健康计划一直热衷于覆盖虚拟紧急护理问诊，但当医生使用电话、电子邮件或视频与现有患者就持续性问题进行咨询时，保险公司远不愿意为远程医疗付费。

en: It's very hard to get paid unless you physically see the patient, says Peter Rasmussen, medical director of distance health at the Cleveland Clinic. (24 words)
cn: 克利夫兰诊所远程健康医疗主任彼得·拉斯穆森说：‘除非你亲眼见到患者，否则很难获得报酬。’

en: Some 32 states have passed 'parity' laws requiring private insurers to reimburse doctors for services delivered remotely if the same service would be covered in person, though not necessarily at the same rate or frequency. (35 words)
cn: 约有32个州通过了‘等同’法律，要求私人保险公司对医生远程提供的服务进行补偿，如果同样的服务面对面提供时会被覆盖的话，尽管不一定以相同的费率或频率。

en: Medicare lags further behind. (4 words)
cn: 联邦医疗保险更加落后。

en: The federal health plan for the elderly covers a small number of telemedicine services—only for beneficiaries in rural areas and only when the services are received in a hospital, doctor's office or clinic. (33 words)
cn: 针对老年人的联邦健康计划只覆盖少数远程医疗服务——仅面向农村地区的受益人，且仅当服务在医院、医生办公室或诊所接受时才覆盖。

en: Bills to expand Medicare coverage of telemedicine have bipartisan support in Congress. (12 words)
cn: 扩大联邦医疗保险远程医疗覆盖范围的法案在国会获得了跨党派支持。

en: Opponents worry that such expansion would be costly for taxpayers, but advocates say it would save money in the long run. (21 words)
cn: 反对者担心这种扩张会给纳税人带来高昂成本，但支持者表示从长远来看它会省钱。

en: Experts say more hospitals are likely to invest in telemedicine systems as they move away from fee-for-service payments and into managed-care-type contracts that give them a set fee to provide care for patients and allow them to keep any savings they achieve. (42 words)
cn: 专家表示，随着医院从按服务收费支付转向管理式护理合同，更多医院可能会投资远程医疗系统，这种合同给予他们为患者提供护理的固定费用，并允许他们保留任何节省下来的费用。

en: Is the state-by-state regulatory system outdated? (6 words)
cn: 各州各自的监管体系是否过时了？

en: Historically, regulation of medicine has been left to individual states. (10 words)
cn: 从历史上看，医疗监管一直由各州自行负责。

en: But some industry members contend that having 50 different sets of rules, licensing fees and even definitions of 'medical practice' makes less sense in the era of telemedicine and is hampering its growth. (33 words)
cn: 但一些业内人士认为，在远程医疗时代，拥有50套不同的规则、许可费甚至‘医疗实践’的定义，意义不大，并且正在阻碍其发展。

en: Currently, doctors must have a valid license in the state where the patient is located to provide medical care, which means virtual-visit companies can match users only with locally licensed clinicians. (31 words)
cn: 目前，医生必须在患者所在州拥有有效执照才能提供医疗服务，这意味着虚拟问诊公司只能将用户与当地有执照的临床医生匹配。

en: It also causes administrative hassles for world-class medical centers that attract patients from across the country. (16 words)
cn: 这也给吸引全国患者的世界级医疗中心带来了行政上的麻烦。

en: At the Mayo Clinic, doctors who treat out-of-state patients can follow up with them via phone, email or web chats when they return home, but they can only discuss the conditions they treated in person. (35 words)
cn: 在梅奥诊所，治疗外州患者的医生可以在患者回家后通过电话、电子邮件或网络聊天进行跟进，但他们只能讨论他们当面治疗的病症。

en: If the patient wants to talk about a new problem, the doctor has to be licensed in that state to discuss it. (22 words)
cn: 如果患者想谈论一个新问题，医生必须在该州获得执照才能讨论。

en: If not, the patient should talk to his primary-care physician about it, says Steve Ommen, who runs Mayo's Connected Care program. (21 words)
cn: 梅奥互联医疗项目负责人史蒂夫·奥曼说：‘如果没有，患者应该与他的初级保健医生讨论。’

en: To date, 17 states have joined a compact that will allow a doctor licensed in one member state to quickly obtain a license in another. (25 words)
cn: 迄今为止，已有17个州加入了一项协议，允许在一个成员州获得执照的医生快速在另一个州获得执照。

en: While welcoming the move, some telemedicine advocates would prefer states to automatically honor one another's licenses, as they do with drivers' licenses. (22 words)
cn: 在欢迎这一举措的同时，一些远程医疗倡导者更希望各州像对待驾驶执照一样自动承认彼此的执照。

en: But states aren't likely to surrender control of medical practice, and most are considering new regulations. (16 words)
cn: 但各州不太可能放弃对医疗实践的监管控制，大多数州正在考虑新的法规。

en: This year, more than 200 telemedicine-related bills have been introduced in 42 states, many regarding what services Medicaid will cover and whether payers should reimburse for remote patient monitoring. (29 words)
cn: 今年，42个州提出了200多项与远程医疗相关的法案，其中许多涉及医疗补助计划将覆盖哪些服务，以及支付方是否应为远程患者监控提供补偿。

en: A lot of states are still trying to define telemedicine, says Lisa Robbin, chief advocacy officer for the Federation of State Medical Boards. (23 words)
cn: 州医学委员会联合会首席宣传官丽莎·罗宾说：‘很多州仍在试图定义远程医疗。’

en: Danielle Steel, the 71-year-old romance novelist is notoriously productive, having published 179 books at a rate of up to seven a year. (22 words)
cn: 71岁的浪漫小说家丹妮尔·斯蒂尔以高产著称，已出版了179本书，速度高达每年七本。

en: But a passing reference in a recent profile by Glamour magazine to her 20-hour workdays prompted an outpouring of admiration. (20 words)
cn: 但《魅力》杂志最近一篇人物特写中顺便提到她每天工作20小时，引发了大量的赞赏。
