en: Steel has given that 20-hour figure when describing her 'exhausting' process in the past: 'I start the book and don't leave my desk until the first draft is finished.' (29 words)
cn: 斯蒂尔在过去描述她‘令人筋疲力尽’的创作过程时曾给出过20小时这个数字：‘我开始写书，在初稿完成之前不会离开我的书桌。’

en: She goes from bed, to desk, to bath, to bed, avoiding all contact aside from phone calls with her nine children. (21 words)
cn: 她从床上到书桌，再到浴室，再回到床上，除了与她的九个孩子通电话外，避免一切接触。

en: I don't comb my hair for weeks, she says. (9 words)
cn: 她说：‘我几周都不梳头。’

en: Meals are brought to her desk, where she types until her fingers swell and her nails bleed. (17 words)
cn: 饭菜送到她的书桌上，她在那里打字，直到手指肿胀、指甲出血。

en: The business news website Quartz held Steel up as an inspiration, writing that if only we all followed her 'actually extremely liberating' example of industrious sleeplessness, we would be quick to see results. (33 words)
cn: 商业新闻网站Quartz将斯蒂尔视为榜样，写道只要我们所有人都遵循她‘实际上极其解放’的勤奋无眠的榜样，我们很快就会看到成果。

en: Well, indeed. (2 words)
cn: 嗯，确实如此。

en: With research results showing the cumulative effects of sleep loss and its impact on productivity, doubt has been voiced about the accuracy of Steel's self-assessment. (25 words)
cn: 由于研究结果表明了睡眠不足的累积效应及其对生产力的影响，人们对斯蒂尔自我评估的准确性提出了质疑。

en: Her output may be undeniable, but sceptics have suggested that she is guilty of erasing the role of ghost writers at worst, gross exaggeration at best. (26 words)
cn: 她的产出也许不可否认，但怀疑论者认为，往坏处说，她有抹去代笔人作用的嫌疑；往好处说，也有严重夸张之嫌。

en: Steel says working 20 hours a day is 'pretty brutal physically.' (11 words)
cn: 斯蒂尔说每天工作20小时‘对身体相当残酷’。

en: But is it even possible? (5 words)
cn: 但这有可能吗？

en: No, says Maryanne Taylor of the Sleep Works. (8 words)
cn: 睡眠工作坊的玛丽安妮·泰勒说：‘不。’

en: While you could work that long, the impact on productivity would make it hardly worthwhile. (15 words)
cn: 虽然你可以工作那么长时间，但对生产力的影响会使其几乎不值得。

en: If Steel was routinely sleeping for four hours a night, she would be drastically underestimating the negative impact, says Alison Gardiner, founder of the sleep improvement programme Sleepstation. (28 words)
cn: 睡眠改善项目Sleepstation的创始人艾莉森·加德纳说，如果斯蒂尔经常每晚只睡四个小时，那她就大大低估了负面影响。

en: It's akin to being drunk. (5 words)
cn: ‘这就像醉酒一样。’

en: It's possible that Steel is exaggerating the demands of her schedule. (11 words)
cn: 斯蒂尔有可能夸大了她日程安排的要求。

en: Self-imposed sleeplessness has 'become a bit of a status symbol', says Taylor, a misguided measure to prove how powerful and productive you are. (23 words)
cn: 泰勒说，自我强加的睡眠不足‘已经成为一种身份象征’，这是一种错误的衡量标准，用来证明你有多强大和高效。

en: Margaret Thatcher was also said to get by on four hours a night, while the 130-hour workweeks endured by tech heads has been held up as key to their success. (30 words)
cn: 据说玛格丽特·撒切尔也是每晚只睡四个小时，而科技领袖们所承受的每周130小时的工作时间一直被当作他们成功的关键。

en: That is starting to change with increased awareness of the importance of sleep for mental health. (16 words)
cn: 随着人们对睡眠对心理健康重要性的认识不断提高，这种情况正在开始改变。

en: People are starting to realise that sleep should not be something that you fit in between everything else, says Taylor. (20 words)
cn: 泰勒说：‘人们开始意识到，睡眠不应该是你在其他事情之间硬塞进去的东西。’

en: But it is possible—if statistically extremely unlikely—that Steel could be born a 'short sleeper' with an unusual body clock, says sleep expert Dr. Sophie Bostock. (25 words)
cn: 但睡眠专家索菲·博斯托克博士说，斯蒂尔有可能天生就是一个‘短睡眠者’，拥有不寻常的生物钟——尽管从统计上看极不可能。

en: It's probably present in fewer than 1% of the population. (10 words)
cn: ‘这种情况可能存在于不到1%的人口中。’

en: Even if Steel does happen to be among that tiny minority, says Bostock, it's 'pretty irresponsible' to suggest that 20-hour days are simply a question of discipline for the rest of us. (32 words)
cn: 博斯托克说，即使斯蒂尔确实碰巧属于那极少数人，暗示每天工作20小时对我们其他人来说只是一个自律的问题，也是‘相当不负责任的’。

en: Organic agriculture is a relatively untapped resource for feeding the Earth's population, especially in the face of climate change and other global challenges. (23 words)
cn: 有机农业是养活地球人口的一种相对未充分利用的资源，尤其是在面临气候变化和其他全球挑战的情况下。

en: That's the conclusion I reached in reviewing 40 years of science comparing the long-term prospects of organic and conventional farming. (20 words)
cn: 这是我在回顾40年来比较有机农业和传统农业长期前景的科学研究所得出的结论。

en: The review study, 'Organic Agriculture in the 21st Century,' is featured as the cover story for the February issue of the journal Nature Plants. (24 words)
cn: 这篇综述研究《21世纪的有机农业》被列为《自然·植物》杂志2月号的封面故事。

en: It is the first to compare organic and conventional agriculture across the main goals of sustainability identified by the National Academy of Sciences: productivity, economics, and environment. (27 words)
cn: 这是第一个在可持续性的主要目标——生产力、经济和环境——方面比较有机农业和传统农业的研究，这些目标由美国国家科学院确定。

en: Critics have long argued that organic agriculture is inefficient, requiring more land to yield the same amount of food. (19 words)
cn: 长期以来，批评者一直认为有机农业效率低下，需要更多的土地才能产出同样数量的粮食。

en: It's true that organic farming produces lower yields, averaging 10 to 20 percent less than conventional. (16 words)
cn: 确实，有机农业的产量较低，平均比传统农业低10%到20%。

en: Advocates contend that the environmental advantages of organic agriculture far outweigh the lower yields, and that increasing research and breeding resources for organic systems would reduce the yield gap. (29 words)
cn: 支持者认为，有机农业的环境优势远远超过较低的产量，增加对有机系统的研究和育种资源将缩小产量差距。

en: Sometimes excluded from these arguments is the fact that we already produce enough food to more than feed the world's 7.4 billion people but do not provide adequate access to all individuals. (32 words)
cn: 这些争论有时忽略了一个事实：我们生产的粮食已经足以养活全球74亿人口，但并没有让所有人都能获得足够的粮食。

en: In some cases, organic yields can be higher than conventional. (10 words)
cn: 在某些情况下，有机产量可能高于传统农业。

en: For example, in severe drought conditions, which are expected to increase with climate change in many areas, organic farms can produce as good, if not better, yields because of the higher water-holding capacity of organically farmed soils. (37 words)
cn: 例如，在严重干旱条件下——预计气候变化将在许多地区加剧这种情况——有机农场可以产生同样好甚至更好的产量，因为有机耕作土壤具有更高的保水能力。

en: What science does tell us is that mainstream conventional farming systems have provided growing supplies of food and other products but often at the expense of other sustainability goals. (29 words)
cn: 科学确实告诉我们的是，主流的传统农业系统提供了不断增长的粮食和其他产品供应，但往往以牺牲其他可持续性目标为代价。

en: Conventional agriculture may produce more food, but it often comes at a cost to the environment. (16 words)
cn: 传统农业可能生产更多的粮食，但它往往以环境为代价。

en: Biodiversity loss, environmental degradation, and severe impacts on ecosystem services have not only accompanied conventional farming systems but have often extended well beyond their field boundaries. (26 words)
cn: 生物多样性丧失、环境退化以及对生态系统服务的严重影响不仅伴随着传统农业系统，而且往往远远超出了其田地的边界。

en: With organic agriculture, environmental costs tend to be lower and the benefits greater. (13 words)
cn: 在有机农业中，环境成本往往更低，效益更大。

en: Overall, organic farms tend to store more soil carbon, have better soil quality, and reduce soil erosion compared to their conventional counterparts. (22 words)
cn: 总体而言，与传统农场相比，有机农场往往储存更多的土壤碳，土壤质量更好，并减少水土流失。

en: Organic agriculture also creates less soil and water pollution and lower greenhouse gas emissions. (14 words)
cn: 有机农业也产生更少的土壤和水污染，以及更低的温室气体排放。

en: And it's more energy-efficient because it doesn't rely on synthetic fertilizers or pesticides. (13 words)
cn: 而且它更节能，因为它不依赖合成肥料或杀虫剂。

en: Organic agriculture is also associated with greater biodiversity of plants, animals, insects and microorganisms as well as genetic diversity. (19 words)
cn: 有机农业还与植物、动物、昆虫和微生物的更大生物多样性以及遗传多样性有关。

en: Biodiversity increases the services that nature provides and improves the ability of farming systems to adapt to changing conditions. (19 words)
cn: 生物多样性增加了自然提供的服务，并提高了农业系统适应变化条件的能力。

en: Despite lower yields, organic agriculture is more profitable for farmers because consumers are willing to pay more. (17 words)
cn: 尽管产量较低，但有机农业对农民来说更有利可图，因为消费者愿意支付更多。

en: Higher prices, called price premiums, can be justified as a way to compensate farmers for providing ecosystem services and avoiding environmental damage or external costs. (25 words)
cn: 更高的价格，即价格溢价，可以合理化为一种补偿农民提供生态系统服务和避免环境损害或外部成本的方式。

en: The idea of taxing things that are bad for society has a powerful allure. (14 words)
cn: 对对社会有害的事物征税这一想法具有强大的吸引力。

en: It offers the possibility of a double benefit—discouraging harmful activities, while also providing the government with revenue. (17 words)
cn: 它提供了双重收益的可能性——一方面抑制有害活动，同时为政府提供财政收入。

en: Take sin taxes. (3 words)
cn: 以罪恶税为例。

en: Taxes on alcohol make it more expensive to get drunk, which reduces excessive drinking and impaired driving. (17 words)
cn: 对酒精征税使醉酒变得更加昂贵，从而减少了过量饮酒和酒后驾驶。

en: At the same time, they provide state and local governments with billions of dollars of revenue. (16 words)
cn: 同时，它们为州和地方政府提供了数十亿美元的收入。

en: Tobacco taxes, which generate more than twice as much, have proven instrumental in the decline of smoking, which has saved millions of lives. (23 words)
cn: 烟草税产生的收入是其两倍多，已被证明在吸烟率下降方面发挥了重要作用，挽救了数百万人的生命。

en: Taxes can also be an important tool for environmental protection, and many economists say taxing carbon would be the best way to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. (26 words)
cn: 税收也可以成为环境保护的重要工具，许多经济学家表示，征收碳税将是减少温室气体排放的最佳方式。

en: Economic theory says that unlike income or sales taxes, carbon taxes can actually increase economic efficiency; because companies that pump carbon dioxide into the sky don't pay the costs of the climate change they cause, carbon taxes would restore the proper incentives to the market. (45 words)
cn: 经济理论认为，与所得税或销售税不同，碳税实际上可以提高经济效率；因为将二氧化碳排放到空中的公司并未为其造成的气候变化付出代价，碳税将恢复市场的适当激励。

en: In reality, carbon taxes alone won't be enough to halt global warming, but they would be a useful part of any climate plan. (23 words)
cn: 实际上，仅靠碳税不足以遏制全球变暖，但它们将成为任何气候计划中有用的一部分。

en: What's more, the revenue from this tax, which would probably be hundreds of billions of dollars per year, could be handed out to citizens as a dividend or used to fund green infrastructure projects. (34 words)
cn: 更重要的是，这项税收的收入——每年可能有数千亿美元——可以作为红利分发给公民，或用于资助绿色基础设施项目。

en: Similarly, a wealth tax has been put forward as a way to reduce inequality while raising revenue. (17 words)
cn: 同样，财富税也被提出作为减少不平等同时增加收入的一种方式。

en: The revenue from this tax, which some experts predict will be over $4 trillion per decade, would be designated for housing, child care, health care and other government benefits. (29 words)
cn: 一些专家预测，这项税收的收入每十年将超过4万亿美元，将用于住房、儿童保育、医疗保健和其他政府福利。

en: If you believe, as many do, that wealth inequality is inherently bad, then these taxes improve society while also swelling government coffers. (22 words)
cn: 如果你像许多人一样相信财富不平等本质上是坏的，那么这些税收在改善社会的同时也充实了政府的金库。

en: A group of corn farmers stands huddled around an agronomist and his computer on the side of an irrigation machine in central South Africa. (24 words)
cn: 一群玉米种植者挤在南非中部一台灌溉机旁的农艺师和他的电脑周围。

en: The agronomist has just flown over the field with a hybrid unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) that takes off and lands using propellers yet maintains distance and speed for scanning vast hectares of land through the use of its fixed wings. (40 words)
cn: 农艺师刚刚用一架混合动力无人机飞过田野，该无人机使用螺旋桨起降，同时通过其固定翼保持扫描广阔土地所需的距离和速度。

en: The UAV is fitted with a four spectral band precision sensor that conducts onboard processing immediately after the flight, allowing farmers and field staff to address, almost immediately, any crop abnormalities that the sensor may have recorded, making the data collection truly real-time. (43 words)
cn: 该无人机配备了四光谱带精密传感器，可在飞行后立即进行机载处理，使农民和田间工作人员几乎可以立即处理传感器可能记录的任何作物异常情况，使数据收集真正实现实时化。

en: In this instance, the farmers and agronomist are looking to specialized software to give them an accurate plant population count. (20 words)
cn: 在这种情况下，农民和农艺师正依赖专业软件来给他们提供准确的植物种群计数。

en: It's been 10 days since the corn emerged and the farmer wants to determine if there are any parts of the field that require replanting due to a lack of emergence or wind damage, which can be severe in the early stages of the summer rainy season. (47 words)
cn: 玉米出苗已经10天了，农民想知道是否由于出苗不足或风灾（在夏季雨季初期可能很严重）而需要补种田地的任何部分。

en: At this growth stage of the plant's development, the farmer has another 10 days to conduct any replanting before the majority of his fertilizer and chemical applications need to occur. (30 words)
cn: 在植物生长的这个阶段，农民还有10天的时间进行补种，之后就需要施用大部分肥料和化学品。

en: Once these have been applied, it becomes economically unviable to take corrective action, making any further collected data historical and useful only to inform future practices for the season to come. (31 words)
cn: 一旦施用了这些，采取纠正措施在经济上就变得不可行了，任何进一步收集的数据就只具有历史意义，仅能为未来季节的实践提供参考。

en: The software completes its processing in under 15 minutes producing a plant population count map. (15 words)
cn: 该软件在15分钟内完成处理，生成植物种群计数图。

en: It's difficult to grasp just how impressive this is, without understanding that just over a year ago it would have taken three to five days to process the exact same data set, illustrating the advancements that have been achieved in precision agriculture and remote sensing in recent years. (48 words)
cn: 很难理解这有多么令人印象深刻，除非你了解到就在一年多以前，处理完全相同的数据集需要三到五天，这说明了近年来精准农业和遥感领域取得的进步。

en: With the software having been developed in the United States on the same variety of crops in seemingly similar conditions, the agronomist feels confident that the software will produce a near accurate result. (33 words)
cn: 由于该软件是在美国针对相同作物品种在看似相似的条件下开发的，农艺师对软件将产生接近准确的结果充满信心。

en: As the map appears on the screen, the agronomist's face begins to drop. (13 words)
cn: 随着地图出现在屏幕上，农艺师的脸开始沉了下来。

en: Having walked through the planted rows before the flight to gain a physical understanding of the situation on the ground, he knows the instant he sees the data on his screen that the plant count is not correct, and so do the farmers, even with their limited understanding of how to read remote sensing maps. (55 words)
cn: 他在飞行前曾走过种植行，以获得对地面情况的直观了解，因此当他看到屏幕上的数据时，他立刻就知道了植物计数是不正确的，农民们也知道，尽管他们对如何阅读遥感地图的理解有限。

en: Hypothetically, it is possible for machines to learn to solve any problem on earth relating to the physical interaction of all things within a defined or contained environment by using artificial intelligence and machine learning. (35 words)
cn: 从理论上讲，机器有可能通过使用人工智能和机器学习，学会解决地球上与特定或封闭环境中所有事物的物理互动有关的任何问题。

en: Remote sensors enable algorithms to interpret a field's environment as statistical data that can be understood and useful to farmers for decision-making. (22 words)
cn: 遥感器使算法能够将田地的环境解读为统计数据，这些数据可以被理解并对农民的决策有用。

en: Algorithms process the data, adapting and learning based on the data received. (12 words)
cn: 算法处理数据，根据收到的数据进行调整和学习。

en: The more inputs and statistical information collected, the better the algorithm will be at predicting a range of outcomes. (19 words)
cn: 收集的输入数据和统计信息越多，算法预测一系列结果的能力就越强。

en: And the aim is that farmers can use this artificial intelligence to achieve their goal of a better harvest through making better decisions in the field. (26 words)
cn: 目标是农民可以利用这种人工智能，通过在田间做出更好的决策来实现更好收成的目标。

en: In 2011, IBM, through its R&D Headquarters in Haifa, Israel, launched an agricultural cloud-computing project. (15 words)
cn: 2011年，IBM通过其在以色列海法的研发总部启动了一个农业云计算项目。

en: The project, in collaboration with a number of specialized IT and agricultural partners, had one goal in mind—to take a variety of academic and physical data sources from an agricultural environment and turn these into automatic predictive solutions for farmers that would assist them in making real-time decisions in the field. (51 words)
cn: 该项目与多家专业的IT和农业合作伙伴合作，只有一个目标——从农业环境中获取各种学术和物理数据源，并将其转化为农民的自动预测解决方案，帮助他们在田间做出实时决策。

en: Interviews with some of the IBM project team members at the time revealed that the team believed it was entirely possible to 'algorithm' agriculture, meaning that algorithms could solve any problem in the world. (34 words)
cn: 当时对IBM项目团队一些成员的采访显示，该团队认为完全有可能将农业‘算法化’，这意味着算法可以解决世界上的任何问题。

en: Earlier that year, IBM's cognitive learning system, Watson, competed in the game Jeopardy against former winners Brad Rutter and Ken Jennings with astonishing results. (24 words)
cn: 那年早些时候，IBM的认知学习系统Watson在《危险边缘》节目中与前冠军布拉德·拉特和肯·詹宁斯比赛，取得了惊人的成绩。

en: Several years later, Watson went on to produce ground-breaking achievements in the field of medicine. (15 words)
cn: 几年后，Watson在医学领域取得了开创性的成就。

en: So why did the project have such success in medicine but not agriculture? (13 words)
cn: 那么，为什么该项目在医学上取得了如此成功，但在农业上却没有呢？

en: Because it is one of the most difficult fields to contain for the purpose of statistical quantification. (17 words)
cn: 因为它是为了统计量化目的而最难控制的领域之一。

en: Even within a single field, conditions are always changing from one section to the next. (15 words)
cn: 即使在同一块田地里，不同区域的条件也总是在变化。

en: There's unpredictable weather, changes in soil quality, and the ever-present possibility that pests and diseases may pay a visit. (19 words)
cn: 有不可预测的天气、土壤质量的变化，以及虫害和疾病随时可能造访的可能性。

en: Growers may feel their prospects are good for an upcoming harvest, but until that day arrives, the outcome will always be uncertain. (22 words)
cn: 种植者可能觉得即将到来的收成前景不错，但在那一天到来之前，结果总是不确定的。

en: By comparison, our bodies are a contained environment. (8 words)
cn: 相比之下，我们的身体是一个封闭的环境。

en: Agriculture takes place in nature, among ecosystems of interacting organisms and activity, and crop production takes place within that ecosystem environment. (21 words)
cn: 农业发生在自然界中，处于相互作用的生物体和活动的生态系统之中，作物生产就发生在该生态系统环境内。

en: But these ecosystems are not contained. (6 words)
cn: 但这些生态系统并非封闭的。

en: They are subject to climatic occurrences such as weather systems, which impact upon hemispheres as a whole, and from continent to continent. (22 words)
cn: 它们受到气候现象的影响，如天气系统，这些系统影响整个半球，以及从大陆到大陆。

en: Therefore, understanding how to manage an agricultural environment means taking literally many hundreds if not thousands of factors into account. (20 words)
cn: 因此，理解如何管理农业环境意味着需要考虑成百上千个因素。

en: What may occur with the same seed and fertilizer program in the United States' Midwest region is almost certainly unrelated to what may occur with the same seed and fertilizer program in Australia or South Africa. (36 words)
cn: 在美国中西部地区使用相同种子和肥料计划可能发生的情况，几乎肯定与在澳大利亚或南非使用相同种子和肥料计划可能发生的情况无关。

en: A few factors that could impact on variation would typically include the measurement of rain per unit of a crop planted, soil type, patterns of soil degradation, daylight hours, temperature and so forth. (33 words)
cn: 一些可能影响差异的因素通常包括每单位种植作物的降雨量、土壤类型、土壤退化模式、日照时数、温度等等。

en: So the problem with deploying machine learning and artificial intelligence in agriculture is not that scientists lack the capacity to develop programs and protocols to begin to address the biggest of growers' concerns; the problem is that in most cases, no two environments will be exactly alike, which makes the testing, validation and successful rollout of such technologies much more laborious than in most other industries. (66 words)
cn: 因此，在农业中部署机器学习和人工智能的问题不在于科学家缺乏开发程序和协议来开始解决种植者最大关切的能力；问题在于在大多数情况下，没有两个环境会是完全相同的，这使得这类技术的测试、验证和成功推广比大多数其他行业要费力得多。

en: Practically, to say that AI and Machine Learning can be developed to solve all problems related to our physical environment is to basically say that we have a complete understanding of all aspects of the interaction of physical or material activity on the planet. (44 words)
cn: 实际上，说可以开发AI和机器学习来解决与我们的物理环境相关的所有问题，基本上就是说我们完全理解了地球上物理或物质活动互动的所有方面。

en: After all, it is only through our understanding of 'the nature of things' that protocols and processes are designed for the rational capabilities of cognitive systems to take place. (29 words)
cn: 毕竟，只有通过我们对‘事物本质’的理解，才能为认知系统的理性能力设计协议和流程。

en: And, although AI and Machine Learning are teaching us many things about how to understand our environment, we are still far from being able to predict critical outcomes in fields like agriculture purely through the cognitive ability of machines. (39 words)
cn: 而且，尽管AI和机器学习正在教会我们很多关于如何理解环境的知识，但我们仍然远远无法仅通过机器的认知能力来预测农业等领域的重大结果。

en: Backed by the venture capital community, which is now investing billions of dollars in the sector, most agricultural technology startups today are pushed to complete development as quickly as possible and then encouraged to flood the market as quickly as possible with their products. (44 words)
cn: 在风险投资界的支持下——该行业目前正在向该领域投入数十亿美元——如今大多数农业科技初创公司都被迫尽快完成开发，然后被鼓励尽快用其产品充斥市场。

en: This usually results in a failure of a product, which leads to skepticism from the market and delivers a blow to the integrity of Machine Learning technology. (27 words)
cn: 这通常会导致产品失败，进而引起市场的怀疑，并对机器学习技术的完整性造成打击。

en: In most cases, the problem is not that the technology does not work, the problem is that industry has not taken the time to respect that agriculture is one of the most uncontained environments to manage. (36 words)
cn: 在大多数情况下，问题不在于技术不起作用，而在于行业没有花时间认识到农业是最难管理的开放环境之一。

en: For technology to truly make an impact on agriculture, more effort, skills, and funding is needed to test these technologies in farmers' fields. (23 words)
cn: 为了让技术真正对农业产生影响，需要更多的努力、技能和资金来在农民的田地里测试这些技术。

en: There is huge potential for artificial intelligence and machine learning to revolutionize agriculture by integrating these technologies into critical markets on a global scale. (24 words)
cn: 人工智能和机器学习通过将这些技术整合到全球关键市场，具有彻底改变农业的巨大潜力。

en: Only then can it make a difference to the grower, where it really counts. (14 words)
cn: 只有在那时，它才能对种植者产生真正重要的影响。

en: What is the place of art in a culture of inattention? (11 words)
cn: 在一种注意力缺失的文化中，艺术处于什么位置？

en: Recent visitors to the Louvre report that tourists can now spend only a minute in front of the Mona Lisa before being asked to move on. (26 words)
cn: 最近参观卢浮宫的游客报告说，游客现在只能在《蒙娜丽莎》前停留一分钟，然后就被要求继续前行。

en: Much of that time, for some of them, is spent taking photographs not even of the painting but of themselves with the painting in the background. (26 words)
cn: 对他们中的一些人来说，大部分时间都花在拍照上——甚至不是拍画作本身，而是以画作为背景自拍。

en: One view is that we have democratised tourism and gallery-going so much that we have made it effectively impossible to appreciate what we've travelled to see. (26 words)
cn: 一种观点认为，我们使旅游业和参观美术馆变得如此大众化，以至于实际上使得欣赏我们长途跋涉去看的东西变得不可能了。

en: In this oversubscribed society, experience becomes a commodity like any other. (11 words)
cn: 在这个过度订阅的社会中，体验变成了像其他任何东西一样的商品。

en: There are queues to climb Mt. Jolmo Lungma as well as to see famous paintings. (15 words)
cn: 攀登珠穆朗玛峰和观看名画一样需要排队。

en: Leisure, thus conceived, is hard labour, and returning to work becomes a well-earned break from the ordeal. (17 words)
cn: 因此，这样设想的休闲变成了苦差事，而回去工作反而成了从这种折磨中应得的休息。

en: What gets lost in this industrialised haste is the quality of looking. (12 words)
cn: 在这种工业化的匆忙中失去的是观看的质量。

en: Consider an extreme example, the late philosopher Richard Wollheim. (9 words)
cn: 考虑一个极端的例子，已故哲学家理查德·沃尔海姆。

en: When he visited the Louvre he could spent as much as four hours sitting before a painting. (17 words)
cn: 当他参观卢浮宫时，他可以在画作前坐上长达四个小时。

en: The first hour, he claimed, was necessary for misperceptions to be eliminated. (12 words)
cn: 他声称，第一个小时是必要的，以消除错误的感知。

en: It was only then that the picture would begin to disclose itself. (12 words)
cn: 只有到那时，画作才会开始展现自己。

en: This seems unthinkable today, but it is still possible to organise. (11 words)
cn: 这在今天看来是不可想象的，但仍然是可以安排的。

en: Even in the busiest museums there are many rooms and many pictures worth hours of contemplation which the crowds largely ignore. (21 words)
cn: 即使在最繁忙的博物馆里，也有很多房间和许多画作值得数小时的沉思，而人群大多忽略了它们。

en: Sometimes the largest crowds are partly the products of bad management; the Mona Lisa is such a hurried experience today partly because the museum is being reorganised. (27 words)
cn: 有时，最大的人潮部分是不良管理的产物；《蒙娜丽莎》如今之所以是如此匆忙的体验，部分原因是博物馆正在进行重组。

en: The Uffizi in Florence, another site of cultural pilgrimage, has cut its entry queues down to seven minutes by clever management. (21 words)
cn: 佛罗伦萨的乌菲兹美术馆——另一个文化朝圣地——通过巧妙的管理将入场排队时间缩短到了七分钟。

en: And there are some forms of art, those designed to be spectacles as well as objects of contemplation, which can work perfectly well in the face of huge crowds. (29 words)
cn: 而且有些艺术形式——那些既被设计成景观又被设计成沉思对象的艺术——在面对大量人群时也能很好地发挥作用。

en: Olafur Eliasson's current Tate Modern show, for instance, might seem nothing more than an entertainment, overrun as it is with kids romping in fog rooms and spray mist installations. (29 words)
cn: 例如，奥拉维尔·埃利亚松目前在泰特现代美术馆的展览可能看起来不过是一种娱乐，因为孩子们在雾室和喷雾装置中喧闹玩耍。

en: But it's more than that: where Eliasson is at his most entertaining, he is at his most serious too, and his disorienting installations bring home the reality of the destructive effects we are having on the planet—not least what we are doing to the glaciers of Eliasson's beloved Iceland. (49 words)
cn: 但它不止于此：在埃利亚松最具娱乐性的地方，他也最严肃，他令人迷失方向的装置让人们深刻体会到我们对地球造成的破坏性影响的现实——尤其是我们对埃利亚松深爱的冰岛冰川所做的一切。

en: Marcel Proust, another lover of the Louvre, wrote: 'It is only through art that we can escape from ourselves and know how another person sees the universe, whose landscapes would otherwise have remained as unknown as any on the moon.' (40 words)
cn: 另一位卢浮宫的爱好者马塞尔·普鲁斯特写道：‘只有通过艺术，我们才能逃离自我，了解另一个人如何看待宇宙，否则其景象将像月球上的任何景象一样不为人知。’

en: If any art remains worth seeing, it must lead us to such escapes. (13 words)
cn: 如果还有任何艺术值得观看，它必须引导我们走向这样的逃离。

en: But a minute in front of a painting in a hurried crowd won't do that. (15 words)
cn: 但在匆忙的人群中在一幅画前停留一分钟是做不到这一点的。

en: Every five years, the government tries to tell Americans what to put in their bellies. (15 words)
cn: 每五年，政府都会试图告诉美国人应该吃什么。

en: Eat more vegetables. (3 words)
cn: 多吃蔬菜。

en: Dial back the fats. (4 words)
cn: 减少脂肪摄入。

en: It's all based on the best available science for leading a healthy life. (13 words)
cn: 这一切都是基于现有的最佳科学依据，以引导健康生活。

en: But the best available science also has a lot to say about what those food choices do to the environment, and some researchers are annoyed that new dietary recommendations of the USDA (United States Department of Agriculture) released yesterday seem to utterly ignore that fact. (45 words)
cn: 但现有的最佳科学依据对食物选择对环境的影响也有很多论述，一些研究人员对昨日发布的美国农业部（USDA）新膳食指南似乎完全忽视了这一事实感到恼火。

en: Broadly, the 2016-2020 dietary recommendations aim for balance: More vegetables, leaner meats and far less sugar. (16 words)
cn: 总的来说，2016-2020年膳食指南旨在实现平衡：多吃蔬菜、更瘦的肉类和大大减少糖的摄入。

en: But Americans consume more calories per capita than almost any other country in the world. (15 words)
cn: 但美国的人均卡路里消耗量几乎高于世界上任何其他国家。

en: So the things Americans eat have a huge impact on climate change. (12 words)
cn: 因此，美国人的饮食对气候变化有着巨大影响。

en: Soil tilling releases carbon dioxide, and delivery vehicles emit exhaust. (10 words)
cn: 翻耕土壤释放二氧化碳，运输车辆排放废气。

en: The government's dietary guidelines could have done a lot to lower that climate cost. (14 words)
cn: 政府的膳食指南本可以在降低气候成本方面发挥很大作用。

en: Not just because of their position of authority: The guidelines drive billions of dollars of food production through federal programs like school lunches and nutrition assistance for the needy. (29 words)
cn: 不仅仅是因为它们的权威地位：这些指南通过联邦项目（如学校午餐和贫困者营养援助）推动了数十亿美元的食品生产。

en: On its own, plant and animal agriculture contributes 9 percent of all the country's greenhouse gas emissions. (17 words)
cn: 仅种植业和畜牧业本身就贡献了该国全部温室气体排放的9%。

en: That's not counting the fuel burned in transportation, processing, refrigeration, and other waypoints between farm and belly. (17 words)
cn: 这还不包括运输、加工、冷藏以及从农场到餐桌之间其他环节所燃烧的燃料。

en: Red meats are among the biggest and most notorious emitters, but trucking a salad from California to Minnesota in January also carries a significant burden. (25 words)
cn: 红肉是最大、最臭名昭著的排放源之一，但在一月份将沙拉从加利福尼亚州运到明尼苏达州也会带来显著的负担。

en: And greenhouse gas emissions aren't the whole story. (8 words)
cn: 而温室气体排放还不是全部。

en: Food production is the largest user of fresh water, largest contributor to the loss of biodiversity, and a major contributor to using up natural resources. (25 words)
cn: 粮食生产是淡水的最大用户，是生物多样性丧失的最大因素，也是消耗自然资源的主要因素。

en: All of these points and more showed up in the Dietary Guidelines Advisory Committee's scientific report, released last February. (19 words)
cn: 所有这些要点以及更多内容都出现在去年2月发布的膳食指南咨询委员会的科学报告中。

en: Miriam Nelson chaired the subcommittee in charge of sustainability for the report, and is disappointed that eating less meat and buying local food aren't in the final product. (28 words)
cn: 米里亚姆·纳尔逊担任了该报告负责可持续性的小组委员会主席，她对最终版本中没有包含少吃肉和购买本地食品的建议感到失望。

en: Especially if you consider that eating less meat, especially red and processed, has health benefits, she says. (17 words)
cn: 她说：‘尤其是考虑到少吃肉——特别是红肉和加工肉类——对健康有益。’

en: So what happened? (3 words)
cn: 那么发生了什么？

en: The official response is that sustainability falls too far outside the guidelines' official scope, which is to provide 'nutritional and dietary information.' (22 words)
cn: 官方的回应是，可持续性远远超出了指南的官方范围——即提供‘营养和饮食信息’。

en: Possibly the agencies in charge of drafting the decisions are too close to the industries they are supposed to regulate. (20 words)
cn: 可能负责起草决策的机构与它们本应监管的行业关系过于密切。

en: On one hand, the USDA is compiling dietary advice. (9 words)
cn: 一方面，美国农业部正在编制饮食建议。

en: On the other, their clients are US agriculture companies. (9 words)
cn: 另一方面，它们的客户是美国农业公司。

en: The line about keeping the guidelines' scope to nutrition and diet doesn't ring quite right with researchers. (17 words)
cn: 关于将指南范围限制在营养和饮食方面的说法，研究人员并不完全认同。

en: David Wallinga, for example, says, ' In previous guidelines, they've always been concerned with things like food security—which is presumably the mission of the USDA. (25 words)
cn: 例如，戴维·沃林加说：‘在以往的指南中，他们一直关注诸如食品安全之类的问题——这大概就是美国农业部的使命。’

en: You absolutely need to be worried about climate impacts and future sustainability if you want secure food in the future.' (20 words)
cn: ‘如果你想要未来的食品安全，你绝对需要担心气候影响和未来的可持续性。’

en: Virtually every activity that entails or facilitates in-person human interaction seems to be in the midst of a total meltdown as the coronavirus outbreak erases Americans' desire to travel. (29 words)
cn: 随着新冠病毒的爆发抹去了美国人的旅行欲望，几乎所有涉及或促进人与人之间面对面互动的活动似乎都处于全面崩溃之中。

en: Amtrak says bookings are down 50 percent and cancelations are up 300 percent. (13 words)
cn: 美国铁路公司表示，预订量下降了50%，取消量上升了300%。

en: Hotels in San Francisco are experiencing vacancy rates between 70 and 80 percent. (13 words)
cn: 旧金山的酒店空置率在70%到80%之间。

en: Broadway goes dark on Thursday night. (6 words)
cn: 百老汇在周四晚上熄灯停演。

en: Universities, now emptying their campuses, have never tried online learning on this scale. (13 words)
cn: 大学现在正在清空校园，从未尝试过如此规模的在线学习。

en: White-collar companies like Amazon, Apple, and the New York Times are asking employees to work from home for the foreseeable future. (21 words)
cn: 亚马逊、苹果和《纽约时报》等白领公司要求员工在可预见的未来在家工作。

en: But what happens after the coronavirus? (6 words)
cn: 但在新冠病毒之后会发生什么？

en: In some ways, the answer is: All the old normal stuff. (11 words)
cn: 在某些方面，答案是：所有旧有的正常事物。

en: The pandemic will take lives, strangle economies and destroy routines, but it will pass. (14 words)
cn: 大流行病将夺走生命、扼杀经济并摧毁常规，但它终将过去。

en: Americans will never stop going to basketball games. (8 words)
cn: 美国人永远不会停止去看篮球比赛。

en: They won't stop going on vacation. (6 words)
cn: 他们不会停止去度假。

en: They'll meet to do business. (5 words)
cn: 他们会见面谈生意。

en: No decentralizing technology so far—not telephones, not television, and not the internet—has dented that human desire to shake hands, despite technologists' predictions to the contrary. (25 words)
cn: 迄今为止，还没有任何去中心化的技术——电话、电视和互联网都没有——削弱了人类握手的愿望，尽管技术专家的预测与此相反。

en: Yet there are real reasons to think that things will not return to the way they were last week. (19 words)
cn: 然而，有真正的理由认为事情不会回到上周的样子。

en: Small disruptions create small societal shifts; big ones change things for good. (12 words)
cn: 小的干扰带来小的社会转变；大的干扰则会永久地改变事物。

en: The New York transit strike of 1980 is credited with prompting several long-term changes in the city, including bus and bike lanes, and women wearing sports shoes to work. (29 words)
cn: 1980年的纽约交通罢工被认为推动了该市的几项长期变化，包括公交车道和自行车道，以及女性穿运动鞋上班。

en: The Spanish flu pandemic of 1918 prompted the development of national health care in Europe. (15 words)
cn: 1918年的西班牙流感大流行推动了欧洲国家医疗保健的发展。

en: Here and now, this might not even be a question of preference. (12 words)
cn: 此时此刻，这甚至可能不是一个偏好的问题。

en: It's not clear that the cruise industry will survive. (9 words)
cn: 邮轮行业能否生存还不清楚。

en: Or that public transit won't go broke without federal assistance. (10 words)
cn: 或者公共交通在没有联邦援助的情况下不会破产。

en: The infrastructure might not even be in place to do what we were doing in 2019. (16 words)
cn: 基础设施甚至可能还没有到位，无法做我们在2019年所做的事情。

en: Our world is full of—mostly untold—stories of slow hope, driven by the idea that change is possible. (17 words)
cn: 我们的世界充满了——大多未被讲述的——关于缓慢希望的故事，它们由‘改变是可能的’这一理念驱动。

en: They are 'slow' in their unfolding, and they are slow because they come with setbacks. (15 words)
cn: 它们在展开过程中是‘缓慢的’，而且它们之所以缓慢，是因为它们伴随着挫折。

en: At the beginning of time—so goes the myth—humans suffered, shivering in the cold and dark until the titan Prometheus stole fire from the gods. (24 words)
cn: 在时间的开端——神话是这样说的——人类遭受苦难，在寒冷和黑暗中颤抖，直到巨人普罗米修斯从众神那里偷来了火。

en: Just as in the myth, technology—first fire and stone tools, and later farming, the steam engine and industry, fossil fuels, chemicals and nuclear power—has allowed us to alter and control the natural world. (33 words)
cn: 就像在神话中一样，技术——首先是火和石制工具，后来是农业、蒸汽机和工业、化石燃料、化学品和核能——使我们能够改变和控制自然世界。

en: The myth also reminds us that these advances have come at a price: as a punishment for Prometheus' crime, the gods created Pandora, and they gave her a box filled with evils and curses. (34 words)
cn: 这个神话也提醒我们，这些进步是有代价的：作为对普罗米修斯罪行的惩罚，众神创造了潘多拉，并给了她一个装满邪恶和诅咒的盒子。

en: When Pandora's box was opened, it unleashed swarms of diseases and disasters upon humankind. (14 words)
cn: 当潘多拉的盒子被打开时，它向人类释放了成群的疾病和灾难。

en: Today we can no longer ignore the ecological curses that we have released in our search for warmth and comfort. (20 words)
cn: 今天，我们不能再忽视我们在寻求温暖和舒适的过程中释放的生态诅咒。

en: In engineering and exploiting and transforming our habitat, we have opened tens of thousands of Pandora's boxes. (17 words)
cn: 在设计、开发和改造我们的栖息地的过程中，我们已经打开了成千上万个潘多拉盒子。

en: In recent decades, environmental threats have expanded beyond regional boundaries to have global reach and, most hauntingly, are multiplying at a dizzying rate. (23 words)
cn: 近几十年来，环境威胁已经超越了区域边界，具有全球影响力，而且最令人不安的是，它们正以令人目眩的速度倍增。

en: On a regular basis, we are reminded that we are running out of time. (14 words)
cn: 我们经常被提醒，我们正在耗尽时间。

en: Year after year, faster and faster, consumption outpaces the biological capacity of our planet. (14 words)
cn: 年复一年，越来越快，消费超过了我们地球的生物承载力。

en: Stories of accelerated catastrophe multiply. (5 words)
cn: 加速灾难的故事在增多。

en: We fear the breakdown of the electric grid, the end of non-renewable resources, the expansion of deserts, the loss of islands, and the pollution of our air and water. (29 words)
cn: 我们害怕电网的崩溃、不可再生资源的枯竭、沙漠的扩张、岛屿的消失以及空气和水的污染。

en: Acceleration is the signature of our time. (7 words)
cn: 加速是我们这个时代的特征。

en: Populations and economic activity grew slowly for much of human history. (11 words)
cn: 在人类历史的大部分时间里，人口和经济活动增长缓慢。

en: For thousands of years and well into early modern times, world economies saw no growth at all, but from around the mid-19th century and again, in particular, since the mid-20th, the real GDP has increased at an enormous speed, and so has human consumption. (44 words)
cn: 数千年来，一直到近代早期，世界经济根本没有增长，但从19世纪中叶左右开始，特别是20世纪中叶以来，实际GDP以巨大的速度增长，人类消费也是如此。

en: In the Middle Ages, households in Central Europe might have owned fewer than 30 objects on average; in 1900, this number had increased to 400, and in 2020 to 15,000. (30 words)
cn: 在中世纪，中欧的家庭平均可能拥有不到30件物品；在1900年，这个数字增加到400件，而在2020年则达到15,000件。

en: The acceleration of human production, consumption and travel has changed the animate and inanimate spheres. (15 words)
cn: 人类生产、消费和旅行的加速已经改变了有生命和无生命的领域。

en: It has echoed through natural processes on which humans depend. (10 words)
cn: 它已经通过人类所依赖的自然过程产生了回响。

en: Species extinction, deforestation, damming of rivers, occurrence of floods, the depletion of ozone, the degradation of ocean systems and many other areas are all experiencing acceleration. (26 words)
cn: 物种灭绝、森林砍伐、河流筑坝、洪水发生、臭氧消耗、海洋系统退化以及许多其他领域都在经历加速。

en: If represented graphically, the curve for all these changes looks rather like that well-known hockey stick: with little change over millennia and a dramatic upswing over the past decades. (29 words)
cn: 如果用图形表示，所有这些变化的曲线看起来很像那个著名的曲棍球棒：数千年来变化很小，而在过去几十年中急剧上升。

en: Some of today's narratives about the future seem to suggest that we too, like Prometheus, will be saved by a new Hercules, a divine engineer, someone who will mastermind, manoeuvre and manipulate our planet. (34 words)
cn: 今天一些关于未来的叙述似乎表明，我们也像普罗米修斯一样，将由一个新的赫拉克勒斯——一位神圣的工程师——来拯救，他将策划、操纵和控制我们的星球。

en: They suggest that geoengineering, cold fusion or faster-than-light spaceships might transcend once and for all the terrestrial constraints of rising temperatures, lack of energy, scarcity of food, lack of space, mountains of waste, polluted water—you name it. (37 words)
cn: 他们认为，地球工程、冷聚变或超光速飞船可能会一劳永逸地超越地球上所有的限制——气温上升、能源短缺、食物稀缺、空间不足、堆积如山的废物、水污染——你能想到的一切。

en: Yet, if we envisage our salvation to come from a deus ex machina, from a divine engineer or a tech solutionist who will miraculously conjure up a new source of energy or another cure-all with revolutionary potency, we might be looking in the wrong place. (45 words)
cn: 然而，如果我们设想我们的拯救来自一个解围之神——来自一位神圣的工程师或一位技术解决主义者，他将奇迹般地召唤出新的能源或另一种具有革命性效力的万灵药——我们可能找错了方向。

en: The fact that we now imagine our planet as a whole does not mean that the 'rescue' of our planet will come with one big global stroke of genius and technology. (31 words)
cn: 我们现在把地球看作一个整体这一事实，并不意味着地球的‘拯救’将伴随着一次大规模的全球天才和技术杰作而来。

en: It will more likely come by many small acts. (9 words)
cn: 它更有可能通过许多小的行动来实现。

en: Global heating and environmental degradation are not technological problems. (9 words)
cn: 全球变暖和环境退化不是技术问题。

en: They are highly political issues that are informed by powerful interests. (11 words)
cn: 它们是由强大利益所驱动的高度政治化问题。

en: Moreover, if history is a guide, then we can assume that any major transformations will once again be followed by a huge set of unintended consequences. (26 words)
cn: 此外，如果以历史为鉴，那么我们可以假设，任何重大变革都将再次伴随一系列巨大的意想不到的后果。

en: So what do we do? (5 words)
cn: 那么我们该怎么做呢？

en: This much is clear: we need to find ways that help us flatten the hockey-stick curves that reflect our ever-faster pace of ecological destruction and social acceleration. (27 words)
cn: 有一点是明确的：我们需要找到方法来帮助我们拉平那些反映我们日益加快的生态破坏和社会加速的曲棍球棒曲线。

en: If we acknowledge that human manipulation of the Earth has been a destructive force, we can also imagine that human endeavours can help us build a less destructive world in the centuries to come. (34 words)
cn: 如果我们承认人类对地球的操控一直是一种破坏性力量，那么我们也可以想象，人类的努力可以帮助我们在未来的几个世纪里建立一个破坏性更小的世界。

en: We might keep making mistakes. (5 words)
cn: 我们可能会继续犯错。

en: But we will also keep learning from our mistakes. (9 words)
cn: 但我们也会继续从错误中学习。

en: To counter the fears of disaster, we need to identify stories, visions and actions that work quietly towards a more hopeful future. (22 words)
cn: 为了对抗对灾难的恐惧，我们需要识别那些默默朝着更有希望的未来努力的故事、愿景和行动。

en: Instead of one big narrative, a story of unexpected rescue by a larger-than-life hero, we need multiple stories: we need stories, not only of what Rob Nixon of Princeton University has called the 'slow violence' of environmental degradation (that is, the damage that is often invisible at first and develops slowly and gradually), but also stories of what I call 'slow hope'. (62 words)
cn: 我们需要的不是一个宏大的叙事——一个由超凡英雄意外拯救的故事——而是多个故事：我们不仅需要普林斯顿大学罗布·尼克松所说的环境退化的‘缓慢暴力’（即最初往往看不见、缓慢而渐进发展的损害）的故事，还需要我所说的‘缓慢希望’的故事。

en: We need an acknowledgement of our present ecological plight but also a language of positive change, visions of a better future. (21 words)
cn: 我们需要承认我们当前的生态困境，但也需要一种积极变化的语言和对更美好未来的愿景。

en: In The Principle of Hope (1954-1959), Ernst Bloch, one of the leading philosophers of the future, wrote that 'the most tragic form of loss...is the loss of the capacity to imagine that things could be different'. (36 words)
cn: 在《希望原理》（1954-1959）中，未来哲学的主要思想家之一恩斯特·布洛赫写道：‘最悲惨的损失形式……是丧失了想象事物可以不同的能力。’

en: We need to identify visions and paths that will help us imagine a different, more just and more ecological world. (20 words)
cn: 我们需要识别那些能帮助我们想象一个不同的、更公正、更生态的世界的愿景和路径。

en: Hope, for Bloch, has its starting point in fear, in uncertainty, and in crisis: it is a creative force that goes hand in hand with utopian 'wishful images'. (28 words)
cn: 对布洛赫来说，希望的起点在于恐惧、不确定性和危机：它是一种与乌托邦的‘愿望图景’相辅相成的创造性力量。

en: It can be found in cultural products of the past—in fairy tales, in fiction, in architecture, in music, in the movie—in products of the human mind that contain 'the outlines of a better world'. (34 words)
cn: 它可以在过去的文化产品中找到——在童话、小说、建筑、音乐、电影中——在包含‘更美好世界的轮廓’的人类精神产物中。

en: What makes us 'authentic' as humans are visions of our 'potential'. (11 words)
cn: 使我们作为人类‘真实’的是我们对‘潜能’的愿景。

en: In other words: living in hope makes us human. (9 words)
cn: 换句话说：生活在希望中使我们成为人。

en: The power of small, grassroots movements to make changes that spread beyond their place of origin can be seen with the Slow Food movement, which began in Italy in the 1980s. (31 words)
cn: 草根小运动能够带来超越其起源地的变革，这种力量可以从始于20世纪80年代意大利的慢食运动中看到。

en: The rise of fast-food restaurants after the Second World War produced a society full of cheap, industrially made foodstuffs. (19 words)
cn: 二战后快餐店的兴起产生了一个充斥着廉价工业化食品的社会。

en: Under the leadership of Carlo Petrini, the Slow Food movement began in Piedmont, a region of Italy with a long history of poverty, violence and resistance to oppression. (28 words)
cn: 在卡罗·佩特里尼的领导下，慢食运动始于皮埃蒙特——意大利一个有着悠久贫困、暴力和反抗压迫历史的地区。

en: The movement transformed it into a region hospitable to traditional food cultures—based on native plants and breeds of animals. (19 words)
cn: 该运动将其转变为一个对基于本土植物和动物品种的传统饮食文化友好的地区。

en: Today, Slow Food operates in more than 160 countries, poor and rich. (12 words)
cn: 如今，慢食运动在160多个国家开展活动，包括穷国和富国。

en: It has given rise to thousands of projects around the globe, representing democratic politics, food sovereignty, biodiversity and sustainable agriculture. (20 words)
cn: 它在全球催生了数千个项目，代表了民主政治、食物主权、生物多样性和可持续农业。

en: The unscrupulous commodification of food and the destruction of foodstuffs will continue to devastate soils, livelihoods and ecologies. (18 words)
cn: 肆无忌惮的食品商品化和对食品的破坏将继续摧毁土壤、生计和生态。

en: Slow Food cannot undo the irresistible developments of the global food economy, but it can upset its theorists, it can 'speak differently', and it can allow people and their local food traditions and environments to flourish. (36 words)
cn: 慢食运动无法逆转全球食品经济的不可阻挡的发展，但它可以动摇其理论家，它可以‘用不同的方式说话’，它可以让人们及其当地的饮食传统和环境繁荣发展。

en: Even in the United States—the fast-food nation—small farms and urban gardens are on the rise. (15 words)
cn: 即使在快餐之国美国，小型农场和城市花园也在兴起。

en: The US Department of Agriculture provides an Urban Agriculture Toolkit and, according to a recent report, American millennials are changing their diets. (22 words)
cn: 美国农业部提供了一个城市农业工具包，而且根据最近的一份报告，美国千禧一代正在改变他们的饮食。

en: In 2017, 6 per cent of US consumers claimed to be strictly vegetarian, up from 1 per cent in 2014. (20 words)
cn: 2017年，6%的美国消费者声称自己是严格的素食者，高于2014年的1%。

en: As more people realise that 'eating is an agricultural act', as the US poet and environmental activist Wendell Berry put it in 1989, slow hope advances. (26 words)
cn: 随着越来越多的人意识到‘吃饭是一种农业行为’——正如美国诗人兼环保活动家温德尔·贝瑞在1989年所说的那样——缓慢希望正在前进。

en: Vegetarians would prefer not to be compelled to eat meat. (10 words)
cn: 素食者宁愿不被强迫吃肉。

en: Yet the reverse compulsion is hidden in the proposals for a new plant-based 'planetary diet'. (15 words)
cn: 然而，反向的强迫却隐藏在新的以植物为基础的‘地球饮食’提案中。

en: Nowhere is this more visible than in India. (8 words)
cn: 这一点在印度表现得最为明显。

en: Earlier this year, the EAT-Lancet Commission released its global report on nutrition and called for a global shift to a more plant-based diet and for 'substantially reducing consumption of animal source foods.' (32 words)
cn: 今年早些时候，EAT-柳叶刀委员会发布了其全球营养报告，呼吁全球转向更多的植物性饮食，并‘大幅减少动物源食品的消费’。

en: In countries like India, that call could become a tool to aggravate an already tense political situation and stress already undernourished populations. (22 words)
cn: 在印度这样的国家，这一呼吁可能成为加剧本已紧张的政治局势和使本已营养不良的人口雪上加霜的工具。

en: The EAT report presumes that 'traditional diets' in countries like India include little red meat, which might be consumed only on special occasions or as minor ingredients in mixed dishes. (30 words)
cn: EAT报告假设，印度等国的‘传统饮食’包含很少的红肉，可能只在特殊场合食用或作为混合菜肴中的次要配料。

en: In India, however, there is a vast difference between what people would wish to consume and what they have to consume because of innumerable barriers around class, religion, culture, cost, geography, etc. (32 words)
cn: 然而，在印度，由于阶级、宗教、文化、成本、地理等无数障碍，人们希望消费的食物和他们不得不消费的食物之间存在巨大差异。

en: Policymakers in India have traditionally pushed for a cereal-heavy 'vegetarian diet' on a meat-eating population as a way of providing the cheapest sources of food. (25 words)
cn: 印度的政策制定者传统上一直向肉食人口推行以谷物为主的‘素食’，以此作为提供最廉价食物来源的方式。

en: Currently, under an aggressive Hindu nationalist government, Muslims, Christians, disadvantaged classes and indigenous communities are being compelled to give up their traditional foods. (23 words)
cn: 目前，在一个激进的印度教民族主义政府领导下，穆斯林、基督徒、弱势阶层和土著社区正被迫放弃他们的传统食物。

en: None of these concerns seem to have been appreciated by the EAT-Lancet Commission's representative, Brent Loken, who said 'India has got such a great example' in sourcing protein from plants. (30 words)
cn: EAT-柳叶刀委员会的代表布伦特·洛肯似乎没有意识到这些担忧中的任何一个，他说印度‘在从植物中获取蛋白质方面树立了很好的榜样’。

en: But how much of a model for the world is India's vegetarianism? (12 words)
cn: 但印度的素食主义在多大程度上能成为世界的榜样呢？

en: In the Global Hunger Index 2019, the country ranks 102nd out of 117. (13 words)
cn: 在2019年全球饥饿指数中，该国在117个国家中排名第102位。

en: Data from the National Family Health Survey indicate that only 10 percent of infants of 6 to 23 months are adequately fed. (22 words)
cn: 来自全国家庭健康调查的数据表明，只有10%的6至23个月大的婴儿得到了充足的喂养。

en: Which is why calls for a plant-based diet modeled on India risk offering another whip with which to beat already vulnerable communities in developing countries. (25 words)
cn: 这就是为什么仿效印度推行植物性饮食的呼吁，可能会成为打击发展中国家本已脆弱群体的另一条鞭子。

en: A diet directed at the affluent West fails to recognize that in low-income countries undernourished children are known to benefit from the consumption of milk and other animal source foods, improving cognitive functions, while reducing the prevalence of nutritional deficiencies as well as mortality. (44 words)
cn: 针对富裕西方国家的饮食未能认识到，在低收入国家，营养不足的儿童已知可以从牛奶和其他动物源食品的消费中获益，改善认知功能，同时减少营养不良的发生率和死亡率。

en: EAT-Lancet claimed its intention was to 'spark conversations' among all Indian stakeholders. (12 words)
cn: EAT-柳叶刀声称其意图是在所有印度利益相关者之间‘引发对话’。

en: Yet vocal critics of the food processing industry and food fortification strategies have been left out of the debate. (19 words)
cn: 然而，对食品加工行业和食品强化策略直言不讳的批评者却被排除在讨论之外。

en: But the most conspicuous omission may well be the absence of India's farmers. (13 words)
cn: 但最明显的遗漏很可能是印度农民的缺席。

en: The government, however, seems to have given the report a thumbs-up. (11 words)
cn: 然而，政府似乎对该报告给予了支持。

en: Rather than addressing chronic hunger and malnutrition through an improved access to wholesome and nutrient-dense foods, the government is opening the door for company-dependent solutions, ignoring the environmental and economic cost, which will destroy local food systems. (37 words)
cn: 政府没有通过改善获取有益健康和营养丰富的食品来解决长期饥饿和营养不良问题，而是为依赖公司的解决方案打开了大门，忽视了环境和经济成本，这将破坏当地的食品体系。

en: It's a model full of danger for future generations. (9 words)
cn: 这是一个对后代充满危险的模式。

en: Back in 1964, in his book Games People Play, psychiatrist Eric Berne described a pattern of conversation he called 'Why Don't You—Yes But', which remains one of the most irritating aspects of everyday social life. (35 words)
cn: 早在1964年，精神病学家埃里克·伯恩在他的《人间游戏》一书中描述了一种他称之为‘你为什么不——但是’的对话模式，这至今仍是日常社会生活中最令人恼火的方面之一。

en: The person adopting the strategy is usually a chronic complainer. (10 words)
cn: 采用这种策略的人通常是一个长期的抱怨者。

en: Something is terrible about their relationship, job, or other situation, and they moan about it ceaselessly, but find some excuse to dismiss any solution that's proposed. (26 words)
cn: 他们的关系、工作或其他方面有些糟糕，他们无休止地抱怨，但总能找到一些借口来拒绝任何提出的解决方案。

en: The reason, of course, is that on some level they don't want a solution; they want to be validated in their position that the world is out to get them. (30 words)
cn: 当然，原因是在某种程度上他们不想要解决方案；他们希望自己在‘世界与他们作对’这一立场上得到认可。

en: If they can 'win' the game—dismissing every suggestion until their interlocutor gives up in annoyance—they get to feel pleasurably righteous in their resentments and excused from any obligation to change. (30 words)
cn: 如果他们能‘赢得’这场游戏——驳回每一个建议，直到他们的对话者恼火地放弃——他们就能在怨恨中感到愉快的正义感，并被免除任何改变的责任。

en: Part of the trouble here is the so-called responsibility/fault fallacy. (10 words)
cn: 这里的部分问题在于所谓的责任/过错谬误。

en: When you're feeling hard done by—taken for granted by your partner, say, or obliged to work for a half-witted boss—it's easy to become attached to the position that it's not your job to address the matter, and that doing so would be an admission of fault. (46 words)
cn: 当你感到受到不公平对待时——比如被你的伴侣视为理所当然，或者被迫为一个愚蠢的老板工作——你很容易执着于这样的立场：处理这件事不是你的职责，而且这样做就等于承认错误。

en: But there's a confusion here. (5 words)
cn: 但这里存在一个混淆。

en: For example, if I were to discover a newborn at my front door, it wouldn't be my fault, but it most certainly would be my responsibility. (26 words)
cn: 例如，如果我在家门口发现一个新生儿，那不是我的错，但这肯定是我的责任。

en: There would be choices to make, and no possibility of avoiding them, since trying to ignore the matter would be a choice. (22 words)
cn: 会有选择要做，而且不可能避免它们，因为试图忽视这件事本身也是一种选择。

en: The point is that what goes for the baby on the doorstep is true in all cases: even if the other person is 100% in the wrong, there's nothing to be gained, long-term, from using this as a justification to evade responsibility. (42 words)
cn: 关键是，适用于门口婴儿的道理在所有情况下都是成立的：即使对方百分百错了，从长远来看，以此为借口逃避责任也得不到任何好处。

en: Should you find yourself on the receiving end of this kind of complaining, there's an ingenious way to shut it down—which is to agree with it, ardently. (27 words)
cn: 如果你发现自己成为这种抱怨的接收者，有一种巧妙的方法可以阻止它——那就是热情地表示同意。

en: Psychotherapist Lori Gottlieb describes this as 'over-validation'. (7 words)
cn: 心理治疗师洛里·戈特利布将这种描述为‘过度确认’。

en: For one thing, you'll be spared further moaning, since the other person's motivation was to confirm her beliefs, and now you're confirming them. (23 words)
cn: 首先，你将免受进一步的抱怨，因为对方的动机是确认她的信念，而你现在正在确认它们。

en: But for another, as Gottlieb notes, people confronted with over-validation often hear their complaints afresh and start arguing back. (19 words)
cn: 但另一方面，正如戈特利布所指出的，面对过度确认的人们常常会重新审视自己的抱怨并开始反驳。

en: The notion that they're utterly powerless suddenly seems unrealistic—not to mention rather annoying—so they're prompted instead to generate ideas about how they might change things. (25 words)
cn: 他们完全无能为力的想法突然变得不现实——更不用说相当令人恼火了——因此他们反而被促使去思考如何改变现状的想法。

en: And then, sometimes, something magical might happen, Gottlieb writes. (9 words)
cn: 戈特利布写道：‘然后，有时，一些神奇的事情可能会发生。’

en: The other person 'might realise she's not as trapped as you are saying she is, or as she feels.' (19 words)
cn: 对方‘可能会意识到她并不像你说的那样陷入困境，也不像她感觉的那样。’

en: Which illustrates the irony of the responsibility/fault fallacy: evading responsibility feels comfortable, but turns out to be a prison; whereas assuming responsibility feels unpleasant, but ends up being freeing. (29 words)
cn: 这说明了责任/过错谬误的讽刺之处：逃避责任感觉舒适，但结果却是一座牢笼；而承担责任感觉不愉快，但最终却是自由的。

en: Social distancing is putting people out of work, canceling school and tanking the stock market. (15 words)
cn: 社交距离正在使人们失业、取消学校上课并使股市暴跌。

en: It has been driven by fear, and it is creating even more fear as money problems and uncertainty grow. (19 words)
cn: 它是被恐惧所驱动的，并且随着金钱问题和不确定性的增长，它正在制造更多的恐惧。

en: However, at its core is love, and a sacrifice to protect those most vulnerable to the coronavirus effects—the elderly, people with compromised immune systems, and those whose life-saving resources would be used up by a malignant epidemic. (37 words)
cn: 然而，其核心是爱，是一种牺牲，旨在保护那些最容易受到新冠病毒影响的人——老年人、免疫系统受损的人，以及那些救命资源会被恶性流行病耗尽的人。

en: Americans make life-saving decisions every day as a matter of course. (11 words)
cn: 美国人每天都理所当然地做出挽救生命的决定。

en: We cut food into bite-sized pieces, we wear seatbelts, and we take care not to exceed the speed limit. (19 words)
cn: 我们把食物切成一口大小的小块，我们系好安全带，我们注意不要超速。

en: But social distancing is unique in that it is completely self-sacrificing. (11 words)
cn: 但社交距离的独特之处在于它完全是自我牺牲的。

en: Those who will benefit may be the elderly relatives of the random person we didn't pass in Starbucks, on the subway, or in the elevator. (25 words)
cn: 那些将受益的人可能是我们在星巴克、地铁或电梯里没有遇到的某个陌生人的年长亲属。

en: Social distancing is millions of people making hundreds of sacrifices to keep the elderly alive. (15 words)
cn: 社交距离是数以百万计的人做出成百上千的牺牲来让老年人活下去。

en: It doesn't include the temptations to run from society or make an excuse to avoid one's obligations—such as life-saving medical work or the parental obligation to buy groceries. (28 words)
cn: 它不包括逃离社会或找借口逃避自己义务的诱惑——例如救死扶伤的医疗工作或父母购买生活用品的义务。

en: What it does include is applying love through caution. (9 words)
cn: 它所包含的是通过谨慎来传递爱。

en: And in doing so, it offers an amazing opportunity for those who care about the elderly to find new ways to love them. (23 words)
cn: 通过这样做，它为那些关心老年人的人提供了一个绝佳的机会，去寻找爱他们的新方式。

en: If we're not engaged as much in our normal work or school, we have extra time to call parents and grandparents. (21 words)
cn: 如果我们不像往常那样忙于工作或学业，我们就有额外的时间给父母和祖父母打电话。

en: We can also ask elderly relatives how to best support them spiritually and use our sacrifices as an opportunity to bring us, our community and the world closer. (28 words)
cn: 我们还可以询问年长的亲戚如何在精神上最好地支持他们，并把我们的牺牲作为一个机会，让我们、我们的社区和世界更加紧密地联系在一起。

en: Picture yourself at a college graduation day, with a fresh cohort of students about to set sail for new horizons. (20 words)
cn: 想象一下自己在大学毕业典礼上，一群即将启航驶向新天地的学生。

en: What are they thinking while they throw their caps in the air? (12 words)
cn: 当他们把帽子抛向空中时，他们在想什么？

en: What is it with this thin sheet of paper that makes it so precious? (14 words)
cn: 这张薄薄的纸有什么特别之处，使它如此珍贵？

en: It's not only the proof of acquired knowledge but plays into the reputation game of where you were trained. (19 words)
cn: 它不仅是所学知识的证明，而且还涉及到你受训地点的声誉游戏。

en: Being a graduate from Harvard Law School carries that extra glamour, doesn't it? (13 words)
cn: 从哈佛法学院毕业带来了额外的魅力，不是吗？

en: Yet take a closer look, and the diploma is the perfect ending to the modern tragedy of education. (18 words)
cn: 然而，仔细一看，文凭是现代教育悲剧的完美结局。

en: Why? (1 words)
cn: 为什么？

en: Because universities and curricula are designed along the three unities of French classical tragedy: time, action, and place. (18 words)
cn: 因为大学和课程是按照法国古典悲剧的三一律设计的：时间、行动和地点。

en: Students meet at the university campus (unity of place) for classes (unity of action) during their 20s (unity of time). (20 words)
cn: 学生在20多岁的时候在大学校园（地点统一）上课（行动统一）。

en: This classical model has traditionally produced prestigious universities, but it is now challenged by the digitalisation of society—which allows everybody who is connected to the internet to access learning—and by the need to acquire skills in step with a fast-changing world. (41 words)
cn: 这种经典模式传统上造就了著名的大学，但现在它受到了社会数字化的挑战——这使得每一个连接互联网的人都能获得学习机会——以及需要与快速变化的世界同步获取技能的挑战。

en: Universities must realise that learning in your 20s won't be enough. (11 words)
cn: 大学必须认识到，在20多岁时学习是不够的。

en: If technological diffusion and implementation develop faster, workers will have to constantly refresh their skills. (15 words)
cn: 如果技术传播和实施发展得更快，工人将不得不不断更新他们的技能。

en: The university model needs to evolve. (6 words)
cn: 大学模式需要发展。

en: It must equip students with the right skills and knowledge to compete in a world 'where value will be derived largely from human interaction and the ability to invent and interpret things that machines cannot', as the English futurist Richard Watson puts it. (43 words)
cn: 它必须为学生提供正确的技能和知识，以在这样一个世界中竞争——正如英国未来学家理查德·沃森所说，‘价值将主要来自人际互动以及发明和解读机器无法做到的事物的能力’。

en: By teaching foundational knowledge and up-to-date skills, universities will provide students with the future-proof skills of lifelong learning, not just get them 'job-ready'. (23 words)
cn: 通过教授基础知识和最新技能，大学将为学生提供面向未来的终身学习技能，而不仅仅是让他们‘做好就业准备’。

en: Some universities already play a critical role in lifelong learning as they want to keep the value of their diplomas. (20 words)
cn: 一些大学已经在终身学习中发挥了关键作用，因为它们希望保持其文凭的价值。

en: This new role comes with a huge set of challenges, and needs largely to be invented. (16 words)
cn: 这一新角色伴随着一系列巨大的挑战，在很大程度上需要被创造出来。

en: One way to start this transformation process could be to go beyond the 'five-year diploma model' to adapt curricula to lifelong learning. (22 words)
cn: 启动这一转型过程的一种方式可能是超越‘五年制文凭模式’，使课程适应终身学习。

en: We call this model the lifelong passport. (7 words)
cn: 我们称这种模式为终身护照。

en: The Bachelor's degree could be your passport to lifelong learning. (10 words)
cn: 学士学位可以成为你终身学习的护照。

en: For the first few years, students would 'learn to learn' and get endowed with reasoning skills that remain with them for the rest of their lives. (26 words)
cn: 在最初的几年里，学生将‘学会学习’，并获得将伴随他们一生的推理技能。

en: For instance, physics allows you to observe and rationalise the world, but also to integrate observations into models and, sometimes, models into theories or laws that can be used to make predictions. (32 words)
cn: 例如，物理学让你观察和理性地看待世界，同时也将观察整合到模型中，有时将模型整合为可用于预测的理论或定律。

en: Mathematics is the language used to formulate the laws of physics or economy, and to make rigorous computations that turn into predictions. (22 words)
cn: 数学是用于阐述物理或经济规律的语言，并进行严格的运算以转化为预测。

en: These two disciplines naturally form the foundational pillars of education in technical universities. (13 words)
cn: 这两个学科自然构成了理工科大学教育的基石。

en: Recent advances in computational methods and data science push us into rethinking science and engineering. (15 words)
cn: 计算方法和数据科学的最新进展促使我们重新思考科学和工程。

en: Computers increasingly become principal actors in leveraging data to formulate questions, which requires radically new ways of reasoning. (18 words)
cn: 计算机日益成为利用数据来提出问题的核心角色，这需要全新的推理方式。

en: Therefore, a new discipline blending computer science, programming, statistics and machine learning should be added to the traditional foundational topics of mathematics and physics. (24 words)
cn: 因此，在传统的数学和物理基础学科之外，应该增加一门融合计算机科学、编程、统计和机器学习的新学科。

en: These three pillars would allow you to keep learning complex technical subjects all your life because numeracy is the foundation upon which everything else is eventually built. (27 words)
cn: 这三根支柱将使你能够终身学习复杂的技术学科，因为计算能力是一切事物最终建立的基础。

en: According to this new model, the Master of Science (MSc) would become the first stamp in the lifelong learning journey. (20 words)
cn: 根据这一新模式，理学硕士学位将成为终身学习旅程中的第一个印记。

en: The MSc curriculum should prepare students for their professional career by allowing them to focus on acquiring practical skills through projects. (21 words)
cn: 硕士课程应通过让学生专注于通过项目获得实践技能来为他们的职业生涯做准备。

en: Those projects are then interwoven with fast-paced technical modules learned 'on-the-fly' and 'at will' depending on the nature of the project. (21 words)
cn: 这些项目随后与根据项目性质‘即时’和‘随意’学习的快节奏技术模块相互交织。

en: If, for instance, your project is developing an integrated circuit, you will have to take a module on advanced concepts in microelectronics. (22 words)
cn: 例如，如果你的项目是开发集成电路，你将必须学习一个关于微电子学高级概念的模块。

en: The most critical skills will be developed before the project even starts, in the form of boot camps, while the rest can be fostered along with the project, putting them to immediate use and thus providing a rich learning context. (40 words)
cn: 最关键技能将以短期强化训练的形式在项目开始前就进行培养，而其他技能则可以在项目进行过程中同步培养，使其立即得到应用，从而提供丰富的学习情境。

en: In addition to technical capabilities, the very nature of projects develops social and entrepreneurial skills, such as design thinking, initiative taking, team leading, activity reporting or resource planning. (28 words)
cn: 除了技术能力之外，项目的本质还能培养社交和创业技能，如设计思维、主动进取、团队领导、活动报告或资源规划。

en: Not only will those skills be actually integrated into the curriculum but they will be very important to have in the future because they are difficult to automate. (28 words)
cn: 这些技能不仅会被实际整合到课程中，而且它们在未来将非常重要，因为它们难以被自动化。

en: After the MSc diploma is earned, there would be many more stamps of lifelong learning over the years. (18 words)
cn: 在获得硕士学位之后，多年来还会有更多的终身学习印记。

en: If universities decide to engage in this learning model, they will have to cope with many organisational challenges that might shake their unity of place and action. (27 words)
cn: 如果大学决定采用这种学习模式，他们将不得不应对许多可能动摇其地点和行动统一性的组织挑战。

en: First, the number of students would be unpredictable. (8 words)
cn: 首先，学生数量将无法预测。

en: If all of a university's alumni were to become students again, the student body would be much bigger than it is now, and it could become unsustainable for the campus in terms of both size and resources. (37 words)
cn: 如果一所大学的所有校友都再次成为学生，学生人数将比现在多得多，这在规模和资源方面对校园来说都可能变得不可持续。

en: Second, freshly graduated students would mix with professionally experienced ones. (10 words)
cn: 其次，应届毕业生将与有专业经验的学生混合在一起。

en: This would change the classroom dynamics, perhaps for the best. (10 words)
cn: 这将改变课堂动态，也许是最好的改变。

en: Project-based learning with a mixed team reflects the reality of the professional world and could therefore be a better preparation for it. (22 words)
cn: 与混合团队进行的项目式学习反映了职业世界的现实，因此可以为此做更好的准备。

en: Sound like science fiction? (4 words)
cn: 听起来像科幻小说吗？

en: In many countries, part-time studying is not exceptional: on average across OECD countries, part-time students in 2016 represented 20 per cent of enrolment in tertiary education. (26 words)
cn: 在许多国家，非全日制学习并不罕见：在经合组织国家中，2016年非全日制学生平均占高等教育入学人数的20%。

en: In many countries, this share is higher and can exceed 40 per cent in Australia, New Zealand and Sweden. (19 words)
cn: 在许多国家，这一比例更高，在澳大利亚、新西兰和瑞典可以超过40%。

en: If lifelong learning were to become a priority and the new norm, diplomas, just like passports, could be revalidated periodically. (20 words)
cn: 如果终身学习成为优先事项和新常态，文凭就像护照一样，可以定期重新验证。

en: A time-determined revalidation would ease administration for everybody. (8 words)
cn: 有确定时间的重新验证将减轻每个人的行政管理负担。

en: Universities as well as employers and employees would know when they have to retrain. (14 words)
cn: 大学、雇主和雇员都将知道他们何时需要再培训。

en: For instance, graduates from the year 2000 would have to come back in 2005. (14 words)
cn: 例如，2000年的毕业生将必须在2005年回来。

en: This could fix the main organisational challenges for the university, but not for the learners, due to lack of time, family obligations or funds. (24 words)
cn: 这可以解决大学的主要组织挑战，但对学习者来说并非如此，因为缺乏时间、家庭义务或资金。

en: Here, online learning might be an option because it allows you to save your 'travel time', but it has its limits. (21 words)
cn: 在这种情况下，在线学习可能是一个选择，因为它可以节省你的‘通勤时间’，但它也有其局限性。

en: So far, none of the major employers associated with online learning platforms such as Coursera and Udacity has committed to hire or even interview graduates of their new online programmes. (30 words)
cn: 到目前为止，与Coursera和Udacity等在线学习平台相关的主要雇主中，没有一个承诺雇用甚至面试其新在线课程的毕业生。

en: Even if time were not an issue, who will pay for lifelong learning? (13 words)
cn: 即使时间不是问题，谁将为终身学习买单？

en: That's the eternal debate: should it be the learner's responsibility, that of his employer, or of the state? (18 words)
cn: 这是一场永恒的辩论：应该是学习者的责任、雇主的责任还是国家的责任？

en: For example, in Massachusetts, the healthcare professions require continuing education credits, which are carefully evidenced and documented. (17 words)
cn: 例如，在马萨诸塞州，医疗保健行业要求继续教育学分的积累，这些学分被仔细地证明和记录在案。

en: Yet the same state's lawyers don't require continuing legal education, although most lawyers do participate in it informally. (18 words)
cn: 然而，该州的律师不要求继续法律教育，尽管大多数律师确实非正式地参与其中。

en: One explanation is that technology is less of a factor in law than it is in healthcare. (17 words)
cn: 一种解释是，技术在法律领域的影响不如在医疗保健领域那么大。

en: Europe has many scenarios, but the French and Swiss ones are interesting to compare. (14 words)
cn: 欧洲有许多不同的情况，但法国和瑞士的情况比较起来很有意思。

en: In France, every individual has a right to lifelong learning organised via a personal learning account that is credited as you work. (22 words)
cn: 在法国，每个人都有权通过个人学习账户接受终身学习，该账户随着工作而累积学分。

en: In Switzerland, lifelong learning is a personal responsibility and not a government one. (13 words)
cn: 在瑞士，终身学习是个人责任，而不是政府的责任。

en: However, employers and the state encourage continuing education either by funding parts of it or by allowing employees to attend it. (21 words)
cn: 然而，雇主和国家通过资助部分继续教育或允许员工参加来鼓励继续教育。

en: Universities have a fundamental role to play in this journey, and higher education is in for a change. (18 words)
cn: 大学在这一过程中扮演着根本性的角色，高等教育即将面临变革。

en: Just like classical theatre, the old university model produced talent and value for society. (14 words)
cn: 就像古典戏剧一样，旧的大学模式为社会培养了人才和价值。

en: We are not advocating its abolition but rather calling for the adaptation of its characteristics to meet the needs of today. (21 words)
cn: 我们不主张废除它，而是呼吁调整其特点以满足当今的需要。

en: Why does social media trigger feelings of loneliness and inadequacy? (10 words)
cn: 为什么社交媒体会引发孤独感和不足感？

en: Because instead of being real life, it is, for the most part, impression management, a way of marketing yourself, carefully choosing and filtering the pictures and words to put your best face forward. (33 words)
cn: 因为它不是真实生活，而是在很大程度上是一种印象管理，一种推销自己的方式，精心选择和过滤图片和文字，以展现你最好的一面。

en: Online 'friends' made through social media do not follow the normal psychological progression of an interpersonal relationship. (17 words)
cn: 通过社交媒体建立的在线‘朋友’并不遵循人际关系的正常心理发展过程。

en: You share neither physical time nor emotional conversations over the Internet. (11 words)
cn: 你既不共享物理时间，也不在互联网上进行情感对话。

en: You simply communicate photographs and catchy posts to a diverse group of people whom you have 'friended' or 'followed' based on an accidental interaction. (24 words)
cn: 你只是基于一次偶然的互动，将照片和吸引人的帖子发送给你‘加为好友’或‘关注’的各种人群。

en: This is not to say that your social media friends can't be real friends. (14 words)
cn: 这并不是说你的社交媒体朋友不能成为真正的朋友。

en: They absolutely can, but the two are not synonymous. (9 words)
cn: 他们绝对可以，但两者不是同义词。

en: Generally speaking, there are no unfiltered comments or casually taken photos on our social media pages. (16 words)
cn: 一般来说，我们的社交媒体页面上没有未经筛选的评论或随意拍摄的照片。

en: And, rightfully so, because it wouldn't feel safe to be completely authentic and vulnerable with some of our 'friends' whom we don't actually know or with whom trust has yet to be built. (33 words)
cn: 而且，理应如此，因为对我们实际上不了解或尚未建立信任的一些‘朋友’完全坦诚和示弱会让人感到不安全。

en: Social media can certainly be an escape from the daily grind, but we must be cautioned against the negative effects, such as addiction, on a person's overall psychological well-being. (29 words)
cn: 社交媒体当然可以成为逃离日常琐事的出口，但我们必须警惕其对一个人整体心理健康的负面影响，如成瘾。

en: As humans, we yearn for social connection. (7 words)
cn: 作为人类，我们渴望社交联系。

en: Scrolling through pages of pictures and comments, however, does not provide the same degree of fulfillment as face-to-face interactions do. (20 words)
cn: 然而，滚动浏览图片和评论的页面并不能提供与面对面互动相同程度的满足感。

en: Also, we tend to idealize others' lives and compare our downfalls to their greatest accomplishments, ending in feelings of loneliness and inadequacy. (22 words)
cn: 此外，我们倾向于理想化他人的生活，并将自己的失败与他人的最大成就进行比较，最终产生孤独感和不足感。

en: Social media can lead people on the unhealthy quest for perfection. (11 words)
cn: 社交媒体会引导人们走上追求完美的不健康道路。

en: Some people begin to attend certain events or travel to different places so that they can snap that 'perfect' photo. (20 words)
cn: 有些人开始参加某些活动或去不同的地方旅行，以便他们能拍出那张‘完美’的照片。

en: They begin to seek validation through the number of people who 'like' their posts. (14 words)
cn: 他们开始通过点赞人数来寻求认可。

en: In order for it to play a psychologically healthy role in your social life, social media should supplement an already healthy social network. (23 words)
cn: 为了让它在你社交生活中发挥心理健康的作用，社交媒体应该是对已经健康的社交网络的补充。

en: Pictures and posts should be byproducts of life's treasured moments and fun times, not the planned and calculated image that one is putting out into cyberspace in an attempt to fill insecurities or unmet needs. (35 words)
cn: 照片和帖子应该是生活中珍贵时刻和快乐时光的副产品，而不是为了填补不安全感或未满足的需求而刻意发布到网络空间的精心策划的形象。

en: Ultimately, social media has increased our ability to connect with various types of people all over the globe. (18 words)
cn: 最终，社交媒体提高了我们与全球各种类型的人联系的能力。

en: It has opened doors for businesses and allowed us to stay connected to people whom we may not otherwise get to follow. (22 words)
cn: 它为商业打开了大门，并使我们能够与我们可能无法关注的人保持联系。

en: However, social media should feel like a fun experience, not one that contributes to negative thoughts and feelings. (18 words)
cn: 然而，社交媒体应该感觉像一种有趣的体验，而不是一种助长消极想法和感受的体验。

en: If the latter is the case, increasing face-to-face time with trusted friends, and minimizing time scrolling online, will prove to be a reminder that your social network is much more rewarding than any 'like,' 'follow' or 'share' can be. (39 words)
cn: 如果是后者，增加与信任的朋友面对面的时间，减少在线滚动浏览的时间，将证明你的社交网络比任何‘点赞’、‘关注’或‘分享’都更有价值。

en: Imagine that an alien species landed on Earth and, through their mere presence, those aliens caused our art to vanish, our music to homogenize, and our technological know-how to disappear. (30 words)
cn: 想象一下，一个外星物种登陆地球，仅仅通过他们的存在，这些外星人就使我们的艺术消失，我们的音乐同质化，我们的技术知识消失。

en: That is effectively what humans have been doing to our closest relatives—chimps. (12 words)
cn: 这实际上就是人类对我们最亲近的亲属——黑猩猩——一直在做的事情。

en: Back in 1999, a team of scientists led by Andrew Whiten showed that chimps from different parts of Africa behave very differently from one another. (25 words)
cn: 早在1999年，安德鲁·惠滕领导的一个科学家团队就表明，来自非洲不同地区的黑猩猩彼此之间的行为非常不同。

en: Some groups would get each other's attention by rapping branches with their knuckles, while others did it by loudly ripping leaves with their teeth. (24 words)
cn: 一些群体用指关节敲打树枝来引起彼此的注意，而另一些群体则用牙齿大声撕扯树叶来达到同样的目的。

en: The team identified 39 of these traditions that are practiced by some communities but not others—a pattern that, at the time, hadn't been seen in any animal except humans. (29 words)
cn: 该团队确定了39种这样的传统，它们被一些社群实践而不被其他社群实践——这种模式在当时除了人类以外在任何动物身上都未被发现。

en: It was evidence, the team said, that chimps have their own cultures. (12 words)
cn: 该团队说，这是黑猩猩拥有自己文化的证据。

en: It took a long time to convince skeptics that such cultures exist, but now we have plenty of examples of animals learning local traditions from one another. (27 words)
cn: 花了很长时间才让怀疑论者相信这种文化的存在，但现在我们有很多动物相互学习当地传统的例子。

en: But just when many scientists have come to accept the existence of animal cultures, many of those cultures might vanish. (20 words)
cn: 但就在许多科学家开始接受动物文化的存在时，其中许多文化可能正在消失。

en: Ammie Kalan and her colleagues have shown, through years of intensive fieldwork, that the very presence of humans has eroded the diversity of chimp behavior. (25 words)
cn: 艾米·卡兰和她的同事们通过多年的深入实地研究证明，人类的存在本身就侵蚀了黑猩猩行为的多样性。

en: Where we flourish, their cultures wither. (6 words)
cn: 在我们繁荣的地方，它们的文化就凋零。

en: It is a bitterly ironic thing to learn on the 20th anniversary of Whiten's classic study. (16 words)
cn: 在惠滕经典研究发表20周年之际得知这一点，是一件极其讽刺的事情。

en: It's amazing to think that just 60 years ago, we knew next to nothing of the behavior of our sister species in the wild, Whiten says. (26 words)
cn: 惠滕说：‘想想就在60年前，我们对野生亲缘物种的行为还几乎一无所知，这真是令人惊讶。’

en: But now, just as we are truly getting to know our primate cousins, the actions of humans are closing the window on all we have discovered. (26 words)
cn: ‘但现在，正当我们真正开始了解我们的灵长类表亲时，人类的行为正在关上我们所有发现的大门。’

en: Sometimes in the rush to conserve the species, I think we forget about the individuals, says Cat Hobaiter, a professor at the University of St. Andrews. (26 words)
cn: 圣安德鲁斯大学教授凯特·霍贝特说：‘有时在急于保护物种的过程中，我想我们忘记了个体。’

en: Each population, each community, even each generation of chimps is unique. (11 words)
cn: ‘每个种群、每个社群，甚至每一代黑猩猩都是独一无二的。’

en: An event might only have a small impact on the total population of chimps, but it may wipe out an entire community—an entire culture. (24 words)
cn: ‘一个事件可能只对黑猩猩的总体数量产生很小的影响，但它可能消灭整个社群——整个文化。’

en: No matter what we do to restore habitat or support population growth, we may never be able to restore that culture. (21 words)
cn: ‘无论我们如何恢复栖息地或支持种群增长，我们可能永远无法恢复那种文化。’

en: No one knows whether the destruction of chimp culture is getting worse. (12 words)
cn: 没有人知道黑猩猩文化的破坏是否正在恶化。

en: Few places have tracked chimp behavior over long periods, and those that have are also more likely to have protected their animals from human influence. (25 words)
cn: 很少有地方长期追踪黑猩猩的行为，而那些有追踪的地方也更有可能保护它们的动物免受人类影响。

en: Obviously, conservationists need to think about saving species in a completely new way—by preserving animal traditions as well as bodies and genes. (22 words)
cn: 显然，环保主义者需要以一种全新的方式来思考拯救物种——通过保护动物的传统以及身体和基因。

en: Instead of focusing only on the conservation of genetically based entities like species, we now need to also consider culturally based entities, says Andrew Whiten. (25 words)
cn: 安德鲁·惠滕说：‘我们不应只关注基于基因的实体（如物种）的保护，现在我们还需要考虑基于文化的实体。’

en: A new study has drawn a bleak picture of cultural inclusiveness reflected in the children's literature available in Australia. (19 words)
cn: 一项新研究描绘了澳大利亚现有儿童文学中所反映的文化包容性的暗淡图景。

en: Dr. Helen Adam from Edith Cowan University's School of Education investigated the cultural diversity of children's books. (17 words)
cn: 来自埃迪斯科文大学教育学院的海伦·亚当博士调查了儿童书籍的文化多样性。

en: She examined the books housed in the kindergarten rooms of four day-care centers in Western Australia. (16 words)
cn: 她检查了西澳大利亚州四家日托中心幼儿园教室里存放的书籍。

en: Just 18 percent of 2,413 books in the total collection contained any representation of non-white people. (16 words)
cn: 在全部2,413本书中，仅有18%包含任何非白人的形象呈现。

en: Minority cultures were often featured in stereotypical or tokenistic ways, for example, by portraying Asian culture with chopsticks and traditional dress. (21 words)
cn: 少数族裔文化往往以刻板或象征性的方式呈现，例如，通过用筷子和传统服饰来描绘亚洲文化。

en: Characters that did represent a minority culture usually had secondary roles in the books. (14 words)
cn: 那些确实代表少数族裔文化的角色通常在书中扮演次要角色。

en: The main characters were mostly Caucasian. (6 words)
cn: 主要角色大多是白种人。

en: This causes concern as it can lead to an impression that whiteness is of greater value. (16 words)
cn: 这引起了担忧，因为它可能导致一种印象，即白种人具有更高的价值。

en: Dr. Adam said children formed impressions about 'difference' and identity from a very young age. (15 words)
cn: 亚当博士说，孩子们从很小的时候就形成了关于‘差异’和身份的印象。

en: Evidence has shown they develop own-race bias from as young as three months of age. (15 words)
cn: 有证据表明，他们从三个月大起就发展出对本民族的偏见。

en: The books we share with young children can be a valuable opportunity to develop children's understanding of themselves and others. (20 words)
cn: 我们与幼儿分享的书籍可以成为培养孩子对自己和他人理解的宝贵机会。

en: Books can also allow children to see diversity. (8 words)
cn: 书籍也能让孩子们看到多样性。

en: They discover both similarities and differences between themselves and others. (10 words)
cn: 他们发现自己和他人之间的相似之处和不同之处。

en: This can help develop understanding, acceptance and appreciation of diversity. (10 words)
cn: 这有助于培养对多样性的理解、接纳和欣赏。

en: Census data has shown Australians come from more than 200 countries. (11 words)
cn: 人口普查数据显示，澳大利亚人来自200多个国家。

en: They speak over 300 languages at home. (7 words)
cn: 他们在家里说300多种语言。

en: Additionally, Australians belong to more than 100 different religious groups. (10 words)
cn: 此外，澳大利亚人属于100多个不同的宗教团体。

en: They also work in more than 1,000 different occupations. (9 words)
cn: 他们还从事1000多种不同的职业。

en: Australia is a multicultural society. (5 words)
cn: 澳大利亚是一个多元文化社会。

en: The current overwhelming promotion of white middle-class ideas and lifestyles risks alienating children from minority groups. (16 words)
cn: 目前对白人中产阶级思想和生活方式的大量推广，有可能疏远少数族裔群体的儿童。

en: This can give white middle-class children a sense of superiority or privilege, Dr. Adam said. (15 words)
cn: 亚当博士说，这会给白人中产阶级儿童带来一种优越感或特权感。

en: A hundred years before iconic figures like Bill Gates and Steve Jobs permeated our lives, an Irish-Italian inventor laid the foundation of the communication explosion of the 21st century. (29 words)
cn: 在比尔·盖茨和史蒂夫·乔布斯等标志性人物渗透我们生活的一百年前，一位爱尔兰裔意大利发明家为21世纪的通信爆炸奠定了基础。

en: Guglielmo Marconi was arguably the first truly global figure in modern communication. (12 words)
cn: 古列尔莫·马可尼可以说是现代通信领域第一个真正的全球性人物。

en: Not only was he the first to communicate globally, he was the first to think globally about communication. (18 words)
cn: 他不仅是第一个进行全球通信的人，也是第一个从全球角度思考通信的人。

en: Marconi may not have been the greatest inventor of his time, but more than anyone else, he brought about a fundamental shift in the way we communicate. (27 words)
cn: 马可尼可能不是他那个时代最伟大的发明家，但他比任何人都更能带来我们沟通方式的根本性转变。

en: Today's globally networked media and communication system has its origins in the 19th century, when, for the first time, messages were sent electronically across great distances. (26 words)
cn: 今天的全球网络化媒体和通信系统起源于19世纪，那时信息首次通过电子方式远距离传送。

en: The telegraph, the telephone, and radio were the obvious predecessors of the Internet, iPods, and mobile phones. (17 words)
cn: 电报、电话和无线电是互联网、iPod和移动电话的明显前身。

en: What made the link from then to now was the development of wireless communication. (14 words)
cn: 将那时与现在连接起来的是无线通信的发展。

en: Marconi was the first to develop and perfect this system, using the recently-discovered 'air waves' that make up the electromagnetic spectrum. (21 words)
cn: 马可尼是第一个开发和完善这一系统的人，他利用了最近发现的构成电磁频谱的‘空气波’。

en: Between 1896, when he applied for his first patent in England at the age of 22, and his death in Italy in 1937, Marconi was at the center of every major innovation in electronic communication. (35 words)
cn: 从1896年他在英国申请第一项专利（时年22岁）到1937年在意大利去世，马可尼始终处于电子通信领域每一项重大创新的中心。

en: He was also a skilled and sophisticated organizer, an entrepreneurial innovator, who mastered the use of corporate strategy, media relations, government lobbying, international diplomacy, patents, and prosecution. (27 words)
cn: 他还是一位娴熟而老练的组织者、一位企业家式的创新者，精通企业战略、媒体关系、政府游说、国际外交、专利和诉讼的运用。

en: Marconi was really interested in only one thing: the extension of mobile, personal, long-distance communication to the ends of the earth (and beyond, if we can believe some reports). (29 words)
cn: 马可尼真正感兴趣的只有一件事：将移动、个人、远距离通信扩展到地球的尽头（如果某些报道可信的话，甚至更远）。

en: Some like to refer to him as a genius, but if there was any genius to Marconi it was this vision. (21 words)
cn: 有些人喜欢称他为天才，但如果马可尼有任何天才之处，那就是这种远见。

en: In 1901 he succeeded in signaling across the Atlantic, from the west coast of England to Newfoundland in the USA, despite the claims of science that it could not be done. (31 words)
cn: 1901年，他成功实现了跨大西洋信号传输，从英格兰西海岸到美国纽芬兰，尽管科学界声称这不可能做到。

en: In 1924 he convinced the British government to encircle the world with a chain of wireless stations using the latest technology that he had devised, shortwave radio. (27 words)
cn: 1924年，他说服英国政府用他设计的最新技术——短波无线电——建立一系列无线电台环绕全球。

en: There are some who say Marconi lost his edge when commercial broadcasting came along; he didn't see that radio could or should be used to frivolous ends. (27 words)
cn: 有人说当商业广播出现时，马可尼失去了优势；他没有看到无线电可以或应该被用于无聊的目的。

en: In one of his last public speeches, a radio broadcast to the United States in March 1937, he deplored that broadcasting had become a one-way means of communication and foresaw it moving in another direction, toward communication as a means of exchange. (42 words)
cn: 在他最后一次公开演讲之一——1937年3月对美国进行的电台广播中，他痛惜广播已成为单向的通信手段，并预见它将向另一个方向发展，即走向作为交流手段的通信。

en: That was visionary genius. (4 words)
cn: 那是远见卓识的天才。

en: Marconi's career was devoted to making wireless communication happen cheaply, efficiently, smoothly, and with an elegance that would appear to be intuitive and uncomplicated to the user---user-friendly, if you will. (30 words)
cn: 马可尼的职业生涯致力于使无线通信实现得廉价、高效、顺畅，并且以一种对用户来说直观而简单的优雅方式——如果你愿意，可以称之为用户友好。

en: There is a direct connection from Marconi to today's social media, search engines, and program streaming that can best be summed up by an admittedly provocative exclamation: the 20th century did not exist. (33 words)
cn: 从马可尼到今天的社交媒体、搜索引擎和节目流媒体之间存在着直接的联系，这种联系可以用一个公认具有挑衅性的感叹来最好地概括：20世纪并不存在。

en: In a sense, Marconi's vision jumped from his time to our own. (12 words)
cn: 在某种意义上，马可尼的远见从他的时代跳跃到了我们的时代。
