en: Marconi invented the idea of global communication---or, more straightforwardly, globally networked, mobile, wireless communication. (14 words)
cn: 马可尼发明了全球通信的概念——或者更直接地说，全球网络化、移动、无线通信。

en: Initially, this was wireless Morse code telegraphy, the principal communication technology of his day. (14 words)
cn: 最初，这是无线莫尔斯电码电报，是他那个时代的主要通信技术。

en: Marconi was the first to develop a practical method for wireless telegraphy using radio waves. (15 words)
cn: 马可尼是第一个开发出利用无线电波进行无线电报实用方法的人。

en: He borrowed technical details from many sources, but what set him apart was a self-confident vision of the power of communication technology on the one hand, and, on the other, of the steps that needed to be taken to consolidate his own position as a player in that field. (49 words)
cn: 他从许多来源借鉴了技术细节，但使他与众不同的一面是对通信技术力量的自信远见，另一方面是对巩固自己在该领域参与者地位所需采取步骤的远见。

en: Tracing Marconi's lifeline leads us into the story of modern communication itself. (12 words)
cn: 追溯马可尼的生命线将我们带入现代通信本身的故事。

en: There were other important figures, but Marconi towered over them all in reach, power, and influence, as well as in the grip he had on the popular imagination of his time. (31 words)
cn: 还有其他重要人物，但马可尼在影响力、权力和影响力方面，以及在他对当时大众想象力的掌控方面，都远超他们所有人。

en: Marconi was quite simply the central figure in the emergence of a modern understanding of communication. (16 words)
cn: 马可尼简直就是现代通信理解形成过程中的核心人物。

en: In his lifetime, Marconi foresaw the development of television and the fax machine, GPS, radar, and the portable hand-held telephone. (20 words)
cn: 在他一生中，马可尼预见了电视、传真机、GPS、雷达和便携式手持电话的发展。

en: Two months before he died, newspapers were reporting that he was working on a 'death ray,' and that he had 'killed a rat with an intricate device at a distance of three feet.' (33 words)
cn: 在他去世前两个月，报纸报道他正在研究一种‘死亡射线’，并且他‘用一种复杂的装置在3英尺外杀死了一只老鼠’。

en: By then, anything Marconi said or did was newsworthy. (9 words)
cn: 到那时，马可尼说的或做的任何事都具有新闻价值。

en: Stock prices rose or sank according to his pronouncements. (9 words)
cn: 股价根据他的声明涨跌。

en: If Marconi said he thought it might rain, there was likely to be a run on umbrellas. (17 words)
cn: 如果马可尼说他觉得可能要下雨，雨伞很可能就会被抢购。

en: Marconi's biography is also a story about choices and the motivations behind them. (13 words)
cn: 马可尼的传记也是一个关于选择及其背后动机的故事。

en: At one level, Marconi could be fiercely autonomous and independent of the constraints of his own social class. (18 words)
cn: 在某种程度上，马可尼可以极度自主，不受自己社会阶层束缚。

en: On another scale, he was a perpetual outsider. (8 words)
cn: 在另一个层面上，他是一个永远的局外人。

en: Wherever he went, he was never 'of' the group; he was always the 'other,' considered foreign in Britain, British in Italy, and 'not American' in the United States. (28 words)
cn: 无论他走到哪里，他从来都不是群体中的‘一员’；他总是‘他者’——在英国被视为外国人，在意大利被视为英国人，在美国被视为‘非美国人’。

en: At the same time, he also suffered tremendously from a need for acceptance that drove, and sometimes stained, every one of his relationships. (23 words)
cn: 同时，他也因对认同感的渴求而深受其苦，这种渴求推动着——有时也玷污着他的每一段关系。

en: Marconi placed a permanent stamp on the way we live. (10 words)
cn: 马可尼在我们的生活方式上留下了永久的印记。

en: He was the first person to imagine a practical application for the wireless spectrum, and to develop it successfully into a global communication system—in both terms of the word; that is, worldwide and all-inclusive. (34 words)
cn: 他是第一个想象出无线频谱实际应用的人，并成功将其发展成一个全球通信系统——从这个词的两个意义上说，即全球性的和包罗万象的。

en: He was able to do this because of a combination of factors—most important, timing and opportunity—but the single-mindedness and determination with which he carried out his self-imposed mission was fundamentally character-based; millions of Marconi's contemporaries had the same class, gender, race, and colonial privilege as he, but only a handful did anything with it. (54 words)
cn: 他之所以能做到这一点，是多种因素共同作用的结果——最重要的是时机和机遇——但他执行自己赋予的使命时所表现出的专注和决心，从根本上说是基于性格的；马可尼的数百万人同时代人拥有和他一样的阶级、性别、种族和殖民特权，但只有少数人做成了事。

en: Marconi needed to achieve the goal that was set in his mind as an adolescent; by the time he reached adulthood, he understood, intuitively, that in order to have an impact he had to both develop an independent economic base and align himself with political power. (46 words)
cn: 马可尼需要实现他少年时在脑海中设定的目标；到成年时，他凭直觉明白，为了产生影响，他既要建立独立的经济基础，又要与政治权力结盟。

en: Disciplined, uncritical loyalty to political power became his compass for the choices he had to make. (16 words)
cn: 对政治权力有纪律的、不加批判的忠诚成为他做出必要选择的指南针。

en: At the same time, Marconi was uncompromisingly independent intellectually. (9 words)
cn: 同时，马可尼在思想上是不妥协地独立的。

en: Shortly after Marconi's death, the nuclear physicist Enrico Fermi—soon to be the developer of the Manhattan Project—wrote that Marconi proved that theory and experimentation were complementary features of progress. (29 words)
cn: 马可尼去世后不久，核物理学家恩里科·费米——即将成为曼哈顿计划的开发者——写道，马可尼证明了理论和实验是进步的两个互补特征。

en: Experience can rarely, unless guided by a theoretical concept, arrive at results of any great significance...on the other hand, an excessive trust in theoretical conviction would have prevented Marconi from persisting in experiments which were destined to bring about a revolution in the technique of radio-communications. (46 words)
cn: 除非有理论概念的指导，经验很少能得出任何重大意义的结果……另一方面，对理论信念的过度信任会阻止马可尼坚持那些注定要带来无线电通信技术革命的实验。

en: In other words, Marconi had the advantage of not being burdened by preconceived assumptions. (14 words)
cn: 换句话说，马可尼的优势在于不被先入为主的假设所累。

en: The most controversial aspect of Marconi's life—and the reason why there has been no satisfying biography of Marconi until now—was his uncritical embrace of Benito Mussolini. (26 words)
cn: 马可尼一生中最具争议的方面——也是迄今为止没有一部令人满意的马可尼传记的原因——是他对贝尼托·墨索里尼不加批判的拥护。

en: At first this was not problematic for him. (8 words)
cn: 起初，这对他而言并不是问题。

en: But as the regressive nature of Mussolini's regime became clear, he began to suffer a crisis of conscience. (18 words)
cn: 但随着墨索里尼政权倒退本质变得清晰，他开始遭受良心危机。

en: However, after a lifetime of moving within the circles of power, he was unable to break with authority, and served Mussolini faithfully (as president of Italy's national research council and royal academy, as well as a member of the Fascist Grand Council) until the day he died—conveniently—in 1937, shortly before he would have had to take a stand in the conflict that consumed a world that he had, in part, created. (71 words)
cn: 然而，在权力圈子里度过一生后，他无法与权威决裂，并忠实地为墨索里尼服务（担任意大利国家研究委员会和皇家学院院长，以及法西斯大委员会成员），直到他于1937年去世——恰逢其时——就在他不得不在一场吞噬了他部分创造的世界的冲突中表明立场前不久。

en: Humans are fascinated by the source of their failings and virtues: This preoccupation inevitably leads to an old debate: whether nature or nurture moulds us more. (26 words)
cn: 人类对自身缺点和优点的根源着迷：这种执念不可避免地导致一场古老的辩论：先天还是后天对我们的塑造更大。

en: A revolution in genetics has poised this as a modern political question about the character of our society: if personalities are hard-wired into our genes, what can governments do to help us? (32 words)
cn: 遗传学的一场革命将这个问题定位为一个关于我们社会特征的现代政治问题：如果性格是固定在我们的基因中的，政府能做些什么来帮助我们？

en: It feels morally questionable, yet claims of genetic selection by intelligence are making headlines. (14 words)
cn: 这在道德上令人质疑，然而关于通过智力进行基因选择的说法却登上了头条。

en: This is down to 'hereditarian' science and a recent paper claimed 'differences in exam performance between pupils attending selective and non-selective schools mirror the genetic differences between them'. (28 words)
cn: 这归因于‘遗传论’科学，最近一篇论文声称‘就读于选拔性学校和非选拔性学校的学生在考试成绩上的差异反映了他们之间的基因差异’。

en: With such an assertion, the work was predictably greeted by a lot of absurd claims about 'genetics determining academic success'. (20 words)
cn: 有了这样的断言，这项研究不出所料地遭到了许多关于‘基因决定学业成功’的荒谬说法的回应。

en: What the research revealed was the rather less surprising result: the educational benefits of selective schools largely disappear once pupils' inborn ability and socio-economic background were taken into account. (29 words)
cn: 研究揭示的结果并不那么令人惊讶：一旦考虑到学生的先天能力和社会经济背景，选拔性学校的教育优势基本上就消失了。

en: It is a glimpse of the blindingly obvious—and there's nothing to back strongly either a hereditary or environmental argument. (19 words)
cn: 这让人一窥显而易见的事实——而且没有什么能够有力地支持遗传或环境的论点。

en: Yet the paper does say children are 'unintentionally genetically selected' by the school system. (14 words)
cn: 然而，该论文确实表示儿童被学校制度‘无意中进行了基因筛选’。

en: Central to hereditarian science is a tall claim: that identifiable variations in genetic sequences can predict an individual's aptness to learn, reason and solve problems. (25 words)
cn: 遗传论科学的核心是一个大胆的声称：基因序列中可识别的变异可以预测一个人学习、推理和解决问题的能力。

en: This is problematic on many levels. (6 words)
cn: 这在很多层面上都是有问题的。

en: A teacher could not seriously tell a parent their child has a low genetic tendency to study when external factors clearly exist. (22 words)
cn: 当外部因素明显存在时，老师不能认真地告诉家长他们的孩子有低遗传倾向去学习。

en: Unlike-minded academics say the inheritability of human traits is scientifically unsound. (11 words)
cn: 持不同意见的学者说，人类特征的可遗传性在科学上是站不住脚的。

en: At best there is a weak statistical association and not a causal link between DNA and intelligence. (17 words)
cn: 充其量，DNA和智力之间存在弱统计相关性，而不是因果关系。

en: Yet sophisticated statistics are used to create an intimidatory atmosphere of scientific certainty. (13 words)
cn: 然而，复杂的统计数据被用来营造一种科学确定性的恐吓氛围。

en: While there's an undoubted genetic basis to individual difference, it is wrong to think that socially defined groups can be genetically accounted for. (23 words)
cn: 虽然个体差异无疑有遗传基础，但认为社会定义的群体可以用遗传解释是错误的。

en: The fixation on genes as destiny is surely false too. (10 words)
cn: 将基因视为宿命的观念肯定也是错误的。

en: Medical predictability can rarely be based on DNA alone; the environment matters too. (13 words)
cn: 医学上的可预测性很少能仅基于DNA；环境也很重要。

en: Something as complex as intellect is likely to be affected by many factors beyond genes. (15 words)
cn: 像智力这样复杂的东西很可能受到基因以外的许多因素的影响。

en: If hereditarians want to advance their cause it will require more balanced interpretation and not just acts of advocacy. (19 words)
cn: 如果遗传论者想要推进他们的事业，就需要更平衡的解释，而不仅仅是宣传行为。

en: Genetic selection is a way of exerting influence over others, 'the ultimate collective control of human destinies,' as writer H. G. Wells put it. (24 words)
cn: 基因选择是一种对他人施加影响的方式，正如作家H.G.威尔斯所说，‘对人类命运的终极集体控制’。

en: Knowledge becomes power and power requires a sense of responsibility. (10 words)
cn: 知识变成权力，权力需要责任感。

en: In understanding cognitive ability, we must not elevate discrimination to a science; allowing people to climb the ladder of life only as far as their cells might suggest. (28 words)
cn: 在理解认知能力时，我们不能将歧视提升为一门科学；让人们只能爬到他们的细胞所暗示的高度。

en: This will need a more sceptical eye on the science. (10 words)
cn: 这需要我们对科学持更怀疑的眼光。

en: As technology progresses, we all have a duty to make sure that we shape a future that we would want to find ourselves in. (24 words)
cn: 随着技术的进步，我们都有责任确保我们塑造一个我们愿意置身其中的未来。

en: Nicola Sturgeon's speech last Tuesday setting out the Scottish government's legislative programme for the year ahead confirmed what was already pretty clear. (22 words)
cn: 尼古拉·斯特金上周二的演讲阐述了苏格兰政府未来一年的立法计划，证实了已经相当明确的事实。

en: Scottish councils are set to be the first in the UK with the power to levy charges on visitors, with Edinburgh likely to lead the way. (26 words)
cn: 苏格兰地方议会将成为英国首个有权向游客征税的议会，爱丁堡很可能率先实施。

en: Tourist taxes are not new. (5 words)
cn: 旅游税并不是新鲜事。

en: The Himalayan kingdom of Bhutan has a longstanding policy of charging visitors a daily fee. (15 words)
cn: 喜马拉雅王国不丹长期以来一直实行向游客收取每日费用的政策。

en: France's tax on overnight stays was introduced to assist thermal spa towns to develop, and around half of French local authorities use it today. (24 words)
cn: 法国引入过夜税是为了帮助温泉小镇发展，如今大约一半的法国地方当局都在使用这种税。

en: But such levies are on the rise. (7 words)
cn: 但此类征税正在增加。

en: Moves by Barcelona and Venice to deal with the phenomenon of 'over-tourism' through the use of charges have recently gained prominence. (21 words)
cn: 巴塞罗那和威尼斯通过收费来应对‘过度旅游’现象的举措最近引起了广泛关注。

en: Japan and Greece are among the countries to have recently introduced tourist taxes. (13 words)
cn: 日本和希腊是最近引入旅游税的国家之一。

en: That the UK lags behind is due to our weak, by international standards, local government, as well as the opposition to taxes and regulation of our aggressively pro-market ruling party. (30 words)
cn: 英国落后的原因在于其地方政府按国际标准而言较为薄弱，以及其激进的市场化执政党对税收和监管的反对。

en: Some UK cities have lobbied without success for the power to levy a charge on visitors. (16 words)
cn: 一些英国城市曾游说争取向游客征税的权力，但未能成功。

en: Such levies are no universal remedy as the amounts raised would be tiny compared with what has been taken away by central government since 2010. (25 words)
cn: 此类征税并非通用解决方案，因为与自2010年以来中央政府削减的金额相比，筹集的金额将微不足道。

en: Still, it is to be hoped that the Scottish government's bold move will prompt others to act. (17 words)
cn: 尽管如此，仍希望苏格兰政府的大胆举措能促使其他人采取行动。

en: There is no reason why visitors to the UK, or domestic tourists on holiday in hotspots such as Cornwall, should be exempt from taxation—particularly when vital local services including waste collection, park maintenance and arts and culture spending are under unprecedented strain. (42 words)
cn: 没有理由让来英国的游客或在康沃尔等热门地度假的国内游客免税——尤其是在垃圾收集、公园维护和文化艺术支出等重要的地方服务面临前所未有的压力之时。

en: On the contrary, compelling tourists to make a financial contribution to the places they visit beyond their personal consumption should be part of a wider cultural shift. (27 words)
cn: 相反，强制游客在个人消费之外对他们所访问的地方做出经济贡献，应该成为更广泛文化转变的一部分。

en: Westerners with disposable incomes have often behaved as if they have a right to go wherever they choose with little regard for the consequences. (24 words)
cn: 拥有可支配收入的西方人常常表现得好像他们有权利随心所欲去任何地方，而不太考虑后果。

en: Just as the environmental harm caused by aviation and other transport must come under far greater scrutiny, the social cost of tourism must also be confronted. (26 words)
cn: 正如航空和其他运输造成的环境危害必须受到更严格的审查，旅游的社会成本也必须得到正视。

en: This includes the impact of short-term lets on housing costs and quality of life for residents. (16 words)
cn: 这包括短期租赁对住房成本和居民生活质量的影响。

en: Several European capitals, including Paris and Berlin, are leading a campaign for tougher regulation by the European Union. (18 words)
cn: 包括巴黎和柏林在内的几个欧洲首都正在领导一场争取欧盟更严格监管的运动。

en: It also includes the impact of overcrowding, litter and the kinds of behaviour associated with noisy parties. (17 words)
cn: 它还包括过度拥挤、垃圾和与嘈杂派对相关行为的影响。

en: There is no 'one size fits all' solution to this problem. (11 words)
cn: 对于这个问题，没有‘一刀切’的解决方案。

en: The existence of new revenue streams for some but not all councils is complicated, and businesses are often opposed, fearing higher costs will make them uncompetitive. (26 words)
cn: 为部分而非所有地方议会提供新收入来源的情况很复杂，企业往往反对，担心更高的成本会使它们失去竞争力。

en: But those places that want them must be given the chance to make tourist taxes work. (16 words)
cn: 但那些想要征收旅游税的地方必须得到机会，使其发挥作用。

en: I'm always baffled when I walk into a pharmacy and see shelves bursting with various vitamins, extracts and other supplements, all promising to accelerate or promote weight loss. (28 words)
cn: 当我走进药店，看到货架上摆满各种维生素、提取物和其他补充剂，都承诺能加速或促进减肥时，我总是感到困惑。

en: Aisles of marketing genius belie the fact that, ultimately, weight loss is dictated by the laws of arithmetic. (18 words)
cn: 一排排的营销天才掩盖了一个事实：最终，减肥是由算术法则决定的。

en: Economist Jessica Irvine wrote a book about how she used math to help her lose more than 18 kilograms. (19 words)
cn: 经济学家杰西卡·欧文写了一本书，讲述她如何利用数学帮助自己减掉了18公斤多。

en: If calories taken in are less than calories expended, weight shall be lost, and so it is with money. (19 words)
cn: 如果摄入的卡路里少于消耗的卡路里，体重就会减轻，金钱也是如此。

en: Despite the abundance of financial products, services and solutions geared towards accumulating wealth, it all begins with the same equation: getting ahead financially requires a reduction of spending, so that income is greater than expenses. (35 words)
cn: 尽管有大量旨在积累财富的金融产品、服务和解决方案，但一切都始于同一个等式：经济上取得成功需要减少支出，使收入大于支出。

en: I was reminded of this again recently listening to an interview with Nicole Haddow, the author of Smashed Avocado, explaining how she cracked the property market at 31. (28 words)
cn: 最近，我在听《 smashed avocado》一书的作者妮可·哈道的采访时，再次想起了这一点。她解释了自己如何在31岁时成功进入房地产市场。

en: It was quite a feat, given where she had been two years earlier. (13 words)
cn: 考虑到她两年前的状态，这确实是一项了不起的成就。

en: Nicole didn't celebrate her 30th birthday as she had envisaged. (10 words)
cn: 妮可并没有像她想象的那样庆祝自己的30岁生日。

en: She was sobbing at the dinner table with her parents, with whom she had just moved back in. (18 words)
cn: 她在餐桌上和父母一起哭泣，她刚刚搬回去和他们住在一起。

en: She had no stable income, $12,000 in credit-card debt and no plan, but to her astonishment, her father, an accountant, told her that her financial plight wasn't as bad as she thought. (32 words)
cn: 她没有稳定的收入，有12,000美元的信用卡债务，也没有计划，但令她惊讶的是，她的父亲——一名会计师——告诉她，她的财务困境并没有她想象的那么糟糕。

en: He said, on her income, with some changes, she would be able to buy an investment unit within two years, which she did. (23 words)
cn: 他说，以她的收入，做一些改变，她能在两年内买一套投资房产，而她确实做到了。

en: Nicole admitted she was fortunate, as she was able to live with her parents and overhaul her spending and life—to get herself on track financially. (25 words)
cn: 妮可承认她很幸运，因为她能住在父母家，彻底改变自己的开支和生活——让自己走上财务正轨。

en: Creating a gap between her income and spending required a paradigm shift and entailed sacrifice and commitment, but by going into financial lockdown, Nicole gained financial independence. (27 words)
cn: 在她的收入和支出之间创造差距需要一种思维模式的转变，并需要牺牲和承诺，但通过进入财务封锁状态，妮可获得了财务独立。

en: Notre Dame Cathedral in the heart of Paris was within '15 to 30 minutes' of complete destruction as firefighters battled to stop flames reaching its bell towers on Monday evening, French authorities have revealed. (34 words)
cn: 法国当局透露，周一晚上，巴黎市中心的巴黎圣母院距离完全被毁只有‘15到30分钟’，当时消防员奋力阻止火焰烧到它的钟楼。

en: A greater disaster was averted by members of the Paris fire brigade, who risked their lives to remain inside the burning monument to create a wall of water between the raging fire and the two towers on the west of the building. (42 words)
cn: 巴黎消防队的成员们冒着生命危险留在燃烧的纪念碑内，在熊熊大火和建筑西侧的两座塔楼之间制造了一道水墙，从而避免了一场更大的灾难。

en: The revelation of how close France came to losing its most famous cathedral emerged as police investigators questioned workers involved in the restoration of the monument to try to establish the cause of the devastating blaze. (36 words)
cn: 当警方调查人员讯问参与纪念碑修复工作的工人，试图确定这场毁灭性大火的原因时，法国差一点失去其最著名大教堂的真相浮出水面。

en: Paris prosecutor Remy Heitz said that an initial fire alert was sounded at 6:20 pm on Monday evening but no fire was found. (23 words)
cn: 巴黎检察官雷米·海茨说，周一晚上6点20分发出了第一次火灾警报，但没有发现火灾。

en: The second alert was sounded at 6:43 pm, and the blaze was discovered on the roof. (16 words)
cn: 第二次警报在下午6点43分响起，大火在屋顶被发现。

en: More than €650 million was raised in a few hours on Tuesday as French business leaders and global corporations announced they would donate to a restoration campaign launched by the president, Emmanuel Macron. (33 words)
cn: 周二，法国商界领袖和全球企业宣布他们将向总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙发起的修复活动捐款，几小时内就筹集了超过6.5亿欧元。

en: But as the emergency services picked through the burnt debris, a row was resurfacing over accusations that the beloved cathedral, immortalised in Victor Hugo's novel, was already crumbling before the fire. (31 words)
cn: 但当紧急服务人员清理烧焦的碎片时，关于这座因维克多·雨果的小说而不朽的受人喜爱的大教堂在火灾前就已摇摇欲坠的指控再次浮出水面。

en: The cathedral is owned by the French state and has been at the centre of a years-long dispute over who should finance restoration work of the collapsing staircases, crumbling statues and cracked walls. (33 words)
cn: 这座大教堂归法国政府所有，多年来一直是关于谁应该为倒塌的楼梯、破碎的雕像和开裂的墙壁提供修复资金这一争议的中心。

en: Jean-Michel Leniaud, the president of the scientific council at the National Heritage Institute, said: 'What happened was bound to happen. (20 words)
cn: 国家遗产研究所科学委员会主席让-米歇尔·勒尼奥说：‘发生的事情是注定要发生的。’

en: The lack of adequate maintenance and daily attention to such a majestic building is the cause of this catastrophe.' (19 words)
cn: ‘对这样一座宏伟的建筑缺乏足够的维护和日常关注是这场灾难的原因。’

en: After the blaze was declared completely extinguished, 15 hours after it started, the junior interior minister, Laurent Nunez, said the structure had been saved but remained vulnerable. (27 words)
cn: 在大火开始15小时后被宣布完全扑灭后，初级内政部长洛朗·努涅斯说，建筑结构得救了，但仍然脆弱。

en: He praised the actions of the firefighters but admitted the fate of the cathedral had been uncertain. (17 words)
cn: 他赞扬了消防员的行动，但承认大教堂的命运一直不确定。

en: They saved the main structure, but it all came down to 15-30 minutes, Nunez said. (15 words)
cn: 努涅斯说：‘他们拯救了主要结构，但这完全取决于15-30分钟。’

en: In a surprise televised address on Tuesday evening, Macron said he wanted to see the cathedral rebuilt within five years. (20 words)
cn: 在周二晚上的一次意外电视讲话中，马克龙说他希望看到大教堂在五年内重建。

en: The fire at Notre Dame reminds us that we will always have challenges to overcome, Macron said, 'Notre Dame is our history, our literature, the centre of our life. (29 words)
cn: 马克龙说：‘巴黎圣母院的大火提醒我们，我们永远有挑战要克服。巴黎圣母院是我们的历史，我们的文学，我们生活的中心。’

en: It is the standard by which we measure our distances. (10 words)
cn: ‘它是我们衡量距离的标准。’

en: It's so many books, so many paintings. (7 words)
cn: ‘它承载了那么多书，那么多画。’

en: It's the cathedral of every French person, even those who have never visited it. (14 words)
cn: ‘它是每个法国人的大教堂，即使是那些从未去过的人。’

en: This history is ours and so we will rebuild Notre Dame. (11 words)
cn: ‘这段历史是我们的，所以我们将重建巴黎圣母院。’

en: It is what the French people expect; it is what our history deserves. (13 words)
cn: ‘这是法国人民的期望；这是我们的历史应得的。’

en: It is our deep destiny. (5 words)
cn: ‘这是我们深刻的命运。’

en: We will rebuild Notre Dame so it is even more beautiful than before. (13 words)
cn: ‘我们将重建巴黎圣母院，使它比以往更加美丽。’

en: I want it done in the next five years. (9 words)
cn: ‘我希望在未来五年内完成。’

en: We can do it. (4 words)
cn: ‘我们能行。’

en: After the time of testing comes a time of reflection and then of action.' (14 words)
cn: ‘考验之后是反思，然后是行动。’

en: The fire, which had started at the base of the 93-metre spire at about 6:40 pm on Monday, spread through the cathedral's roof, made up of hundreds of oak beams, some dating back to the 13th century. (37 words)
cn: 火灾于周一下午6点40分左右从93米高的尖塔底部开始，蔓延到大教堂的屋顶，屋顶由数百根橡木梁组成，其中一些可以追溯到13世纪。

en: These beams, known as la forêt (the forest) because of their density, formed the cross-shaped roof that ran the length of the central part of the cathedral. (27 words)
cn: 这些横梁因其密度而被称为“森林”，形成了贯穿大教堂中央部分的十字形屋顶。

en: As hundreds of tourists and Parisians stood and watched the flames leaping from the roof, there was shock and tears as the cathedral spire caught fire, burned and then collapsed into itself. (32 words)
cn: 当数百名游客和巴黎人站着观看从屋顶跳出的火焰时，随着大教堂尖塔着火、燃烧然后坍塌，人们感到震惊和流泪。

en: A collection of dramatic videos and photos quickly spread across social media, showing the horrifying destruction, and attracting emotional responses from people all over the world. (26 words)
cn: 一系列戏剧性的视频和照片迅速在社交媒体上传播开来，展示了可怕的破坏景象，并引起了世界各地人们的情感反应。

en: Indeed, within minutes the fire occupied headlines of every major global newspaper and television network. (15 words)
cn: 事实上，在几分钟内，这场大火就占据了全球各大报纸和电视网络的头条。

en: This is not surprising given Notre Dame Cathedral, meaning 'Our Lady', is one of the most recognised symbols of the city of Paris attracting millions of tourists every year. (29 words)
cn: 考虑到巴黎圣母院（意为‘我们的女士’）是巴黎市最公认的象征之一，每年吸引数百万游客，这并不奇怪。

en: While the world looked on, the 500 firefighters at the scene then battled to prevent the flames from reaching the two main towers, where the cathedral bells hang. (28 words)
cn: 在全世界的注视下，现场的500名消防员随后奋力阻止火焰蔓延到悬挂大教堂钟声的两座主塔。

en: If the wooden frame of the towers had caught fire, it could have sent the bells—the largest of which, the Emmanuel Bell, weighs 13 tons—crashing down, potentially causing the collapse of both towers. (33 words)
cn: 如果塔楼的木结构着火，可能会导致钟声——其中最大的“以马内利钟”重达13吨——坠落，可能导致两座塔楼倒塌。

en: Police and fire services will spend the next 48 hours assessing the 'security and safety' of the 850-year-old structure. (19 words)
cn: 警方和消防部门将在接下来的48小时内评估这座已有850年历史的建筑的‘安全状况’。

en: Nunez said: 'We have identified vulnerabilities throughout the structure, all of which still need securing.' (15 words)
cn: 努涅斯说：‘我们已经发现了整个结构的脆弱之处，所有这些都还需要加固。’

en: As a result, residents of five buildings around the northern side of the cathedral were being temporarily evacuated, he added. (20 words)
cn: 他补充说，因此，大教堂北侧五栋建筑的居民正在被暂时疏散。

en: Architects have identified three main holes in the structure, in the locations of the spire, the main hall and the upper rooms to the north of the central aisle. (29 words)
cn: 建筑师已经在结构中发现了三个主要的洞，分别在尖塔、主厅和中央通道北侧的上层房间的位置。

en: Most of the wooden roof beams have been burned, and parts of the concrete holding up the roof have collapsed. (20 words)
cn: 大部分木制屋顶梁已经被烧毁，支撑屋顶的部分混凝土已经倒塌。

en: The interior minister, Christophe Castaner, visited the cathedral on Tuesday afternoon to see the extent of the devastation. (18 words)
cn: 内政部长克里斯托夫·卡斯塔纳周二下午参观了大教堂，查看了破坏程度。

en: Ash covered the marble diamond-patterned floor and floated in large pools of grey water from the fire hoses. (18 words)
cn: 灰烬覆盖了大理石菱形图案的地板，漂浮在消防水带喷出的大片灰色水洼中。

en: Behind a heap of blackened oak beams that lay piled up where they had fallen, daylight from vast holes in the cathedral roof lit a golden cross over a statue by Nicolas Coustou, which appeared to have escaped damage. (39 words)
cn: 在一堆烧黑的橡木梁（堆在它们掉落的地方）后面，大教堂屋顶巨大洞孔透进的日光照亮了尼古拉·库斯托雕像上方的一个金色十字架，这个雕像似乎幸免于难。

en: Preliminary inspections also suggested the three ornate stained glass 'rose' windows appeared to have survived the fire, officials said. (19 words)
cn: 官员们说，初步检查还表明，三个华丽的彩色玻璃‘玫瑰’窗似乎在大火中幸存下来。

en: However, fire officers have said a complete inventory of the damage will not be possible until the cathedral structure has been deemed safe. (23 words)
cn: 然而，消防官员表示，在大教堂结构被认为安全之前，不可能对损失进行全面清查。

en: The culture minister, Franck Riester, said religious relics saved from the cathedral were being securely held at the Hotel de Ville, and works of art that sustained smoke damage were being taken to the Louvre, the world's largest art museum, where they would be dried out, repaired and stored. (49 words)
cn: 文化部长弗兰克·里斯特说，从大教堂中抢救出来的宗教文物被安全地保存在市政厅，受到烟尘损害的艺术品正在被送往世界上最大的艺术博物馆卢浮宫，在那里它们将被干燥、修复和储存。

en: Sixteen copper statues that decorated the spire had been removed for restoration only a few days before the fire. (19 words)
cn: 装饰尖塔的十六座铜像在火灾前几天被拆下进行修复。

en: Relics at the top of the spire are believed lost as the spire was destroyed. (15 words)
cn: 由于尖塔被毁，尖塔顶部的遗物据信已经丢失。

en: As well as damage from the heat, which firefighters said reached more than 800°C, experts also need to assess damage from the vast quantities of water firefighters poured into the cathedral. (31 words)
cn: 除了热力造成的损害（消防员称温度超过800°C）之外，专家们还需要评估消防员投入大教堂的大量水造成的损害。

en: One casualty of this was The Great Organ constructed in the 1730s, which was said to have escaped the flames but been significantly damaged by water. (26 words)
cn: 其中一个受害者是建于18世纪30年代的大管风琴，据说它幸免于火焰，但被水严重损坏。

en: French political commentators noted the devastating fire had succeeded where Macron had failed in uniting the country. (17 words)
cn: 法国政治评论员指出，这场毁灭性的大火在马克龙未能团结国家的地方取得了成功。

en: But criticism over the original state of the building is likely to intensify over coming days. (16 words)
cn: 但在未来几天，对该建筑原始状态的批评可能会加剧。

en: Leniaud told La Croix newspaper: 'This is not about looking for people to blame. (14 words)
cn: 勒尼奥告诉《十字架报》：‘这不是为了找人责备。’

en: The responsibility is collective because this is the most loved monument in the country.' (14 words)
cn: ‘责任是集体的，因为这是这个国家最受喜爱的纪念碑。’

en: Alexandre Gady, an art historian, agreed. (6 words)
cn: 艺术史学家亚历山大·加迪表示同意。

en: We've been saying for years that the budget for maintaining historic monuments is too low, Gady said. (17 words)
cn: 加迪说：‘多年来我们一直在说，维护历史古迹的预算太低了。’

en: The Paris prosecutor's office has opened an inquiry into 'involuntary destruction by fire', indicating they believe the cause of the blaze was accidental rather than criminal. (26 words)
cn: 巴黎检察官办公室已对‘火灾造成的非自愿破坏’展开调查，表明他们认为火灾原因是意外而非犯罪。

en: We often think of drawing as something that takes inborn talent, but this kind of thinking stems from our misclassification of drawing as, primarily, an art form rather than a tool for learning. (33 words)
cn: 我们常常认为绘画需要天赋，但这种想法源于我们对绘画的错误分类——主要将其视为一种艺术形式，而不是一种学习工具。

en: Researchers, teachers, and artists are starting to see how drawing can positively impact a wide variety of skills and disciplines. (20 words)
cn: 研究人员、教师和艺术家们开始看到绘画如何对各种技能和学科产生积极影响。

en: Most of us have spent some time drawing before, but at some point, most of us stop drawing. (18 words)
cn: 我们中的大多数人以前都花过一些时间画画，但在某个时刻，我们中的大多数人都停止了画画。

en: There are people who don't, obviously, and thank god for that: a world without designers and artists would be a very shabby one indeed. (24 words)
cn: 显然，有些人没有停止，感谢上帝：一个没有设计师和艺术家的世界确实会是一个非常简陋的世界。

en: Some argue that so many adults have abandoned drawing because we've miscategorized it and given it a very narrow definition. (20 words)
cn: 一些人认为，如此多的成年人放弃了绘画，是因为我们错误地分类了它，并给了它一个非常狭隘的定义。

en: In his book, Stick Figures: Drawing as a Human Practice, Professor D. B. Dowd argues that we have misfiled the significance of drawing because we see it as a professional skill instead of a personal capacity. (36 words)
cn: 在他的《简笔画：作为人类实践的绘画》一书中，D. B. 道德教授认为，我们对绘画的意义归类错误，因为我们将它视为一种专业技能，而不是一种个人能力。

en: We mistakenly think of 'good' drawings as those which work as recreations of the real world, as realistic illusions. (19 words)
cn: 我们错误地认为‘好’的画是那些作为现实世界的再现、作为现实幻想的作品。

en: Rather, drawing should be recategorized as a symbolic tool. (9 words)
cn: 相反，绘画应该被重新归类为一种象征性工具。

en: Human beings have been drawing for 73,000 years. (8 words)
cn: 人类已经画了七万三千年。

en: It's part of what it means to be human. (9 words)
cn: 这是作为人类意义的一部分。

en: We don't have the strength of chimpanzees because we've given up animal strength to manipulate subtle instruments, like hammers, spears, and—later—pens and pencils. (23 words)
cn: 我们没有黑猩猩的力量，因为我们放弃了动物力量来操纵精细的工具，比如锤子、矛，以及后来的钢笔和铅笔。

en: The human hand is an extremely dense network of nerve endings. (11 words)
cn: 人类的手是一个极其密集的神经末梢网络。

en: In many ways, human beings are built to draw. (9 words)
cn: 在许多方面，人类天生就是用来绘画的。

en: Some researchers argue that doodling activates the brain's so-called default circuit—essentially, the areas of the brain responsible for maintaining a baseline level of activity in the absence of other stimuli. (30 words)
cn: 一些研究人员认为，涂鸦激活了大脑所谓的默认回路——本质上是大脑中负责在没有其他刺激的情况下维持基线活动水平的区域。

en: Because of this, some believe that doodling during a boring lecture can help students pay attention. (16 words)
cn: 正因为如此，一些人认为，在枯燥的讲座中涂鸦可以帮助学生集中注意力。

en: In one study, participants were asked to listen to a list of names while either doodling or sitting still. (19 words)
cn: 在一项研究中，参与者被要求在涂鸦或静坐的同时听一列名字。

en: Those who doodled remembered 29 percent more of the names than those who did not. (15 words)
cn: 那些涂鸦的人比没有涂鸦的人多记住了29%的名字。

en: There's also evidence that drawing talent is based on how accurately someone perceives the world. (15 words)
cn: 也有证据表明绘画天赋是基于一个人对世界感知的准确程度。

en: The human visual system tends to misjudge size, shape, color, and angles but artists perceive these qualities more accurately than non-artists. (21 words)
cn: 人类视觉系统容易误判大小、形状、颜色和角度，但艺术家对这些特质的感知比非艺术家更准确。

en: Cultivating drawing talent can become an essential tool to improve people's observational skills in fields where the visual is important. (20 words)
cn: 培养绘画天赋可以成为提高人们在视觉重要领域中观察能力的重要工具。

en: Rather than think of drawing as a talent that some creative people are gifted in, we should consider it as a tool for seeing and understanding the world better—one that just so happens to double as an art form. (39 words)
cn: 与其将绘画视为一些有创造力的人所拥有的天赋，我们应该将其视为一种更好地观察和理解世界的工具——它恰好也兼作一种艺术形式。

en: Both absent-minded doodling and copying from life have been shown to positively affect your memory and visual perception, so complain loudly the next time your school board slashes the art department's budget. (32 words)
cn: 心不在焉的涂鸦和写生都已被证明对记忆力和视觉感知有积极影响，所以下次学校董事会削减艺术系预算时，请大声抱怨。

en: The car has reshaped our cities. (6 words)
cn: 汽车重塑了我们的城市。

en: It seems to offer autonomy for everyone. (7 words)
cn: 它似乎为每个人提供了自主权。

en: There is something almost delightful in the detachment from reality of advertisements showing mass-produced cars marketed as symbols of individuality and of freedom when most of their lives will be spent making short journeys on choked roads. (37 words)
cn: 广告中展示的大规模生产的汽车被作为个性和自由的象征进行营销，而它们大部分时间将花在拥堵的道路上进行短途旅行，这种与现实脱节的感觉几乎令人愉快。

en: For all the fuss made about top speeds, cornering ability and acceleration, the most useful gadgets on a modern car are those which work when you're going very slowly: parking sensors, sound systems, and navigation apps which will show a way around upcoming traffic jams. (45 words)
cn: 尽管人们对最高速度、转弯能力和加速度大惊小怪，但现代汽车上最有用的设备是那些在你开得非常慢时工作的设备：停车传感器、音响系统和导航应用程序，它们会显示绕过即将到来的交通拥堵的路线。

en: This seems to be one of the few areas where the benefit of sharing personal information comes straight back to the sharer: because these apps know where almost all the users are, and how fast they are moving almost all the time, they can spot traffic congestion very quickly and suggest ways round it. (54 words)
cn: 这似乎是少数几个分享个人信息的好处直接回到分享者身上的领域之一：因为这些应用程序知道几乎所有用户的位置，以及他们几乎一直以来的移动速度，它们可以非常迅速地发现交通拥堵并提出绕过拥堵的方案。

en: The problem comes when everyone is using a navigation app which tells them to avoid everyone else using the same gadget. (21 words)
cn: 当每个人都在使用导航应用程序，而该应用程序告诉他们避开其他使用同一设备的人时，问题就来了。

en: Traffic jams often appear where no one has enough information to avoid them. (13 words)
cn: 交通堵塞经常出现在没有人有足够信息来避开的地方。

en: When a lucky few have access to the knowledge, they will benefit greatly. (13 words)
cn: 当少数幸运儿掌握了这一信息时，他们将受益匪浅。

en: But when everyone has perfect information, traffic jams simply spread onto the side roads that seem to offer a way round them. (22 words)
cn: 但当每个人都拥有完美信息时，交通堵塞只会蔓延到那些似乎提供了绕行路线的支路上。

en: This new congestion teaches us two things. (7 words)
cn: 这种新的拥堵教会了我们两件事。

en: The first is that the promises of technology will never be realised as fully as we hope; they will be limited by their unforeseen and unintended consequences. (27 words)
cn: 第一，技术的承诺永远不会像我们希望的那样完全实现；它们将受到不可预见和意想不到的后果的限制。

en: Sitting in a more comfortable car in a different traffic jam is pleasant but hardly the liberation that once seemed to be promised. (23 words)
cn: 坐在更舒适的汽车里堵在不同的地方是令人愉快的，但很难说这是曾经似乎承诺过的解放。

en: The second is that self-organisation will not get us where we want to go. (14 words)
cn: 第二，自组织不会带我们去我们想去的地方。

en: The efforts of millions of drivers to get ahead do not miraculously produce a situation in which everyone does better than before, but one in which almost everyone does rather worse. (31 words)
cn: 数百万司机争先恐后的努力并不能奇迹般地产生一个每个人都比以前更好的局面，而是导致几乎每个人都变得更糟。

en: Central control and collective organisation can produce smoother and fairer outcomes, though even that much is never guaranteed. (18 words)
cn: 中央控制和集体组织可以产生更顺畅、更公平的结果，尽管即使是这一点也从来没有保障。

en: Similar limits can be foreseen for the much greater advances promised by self-driving cars. (14 words)
cn: 对于自动驾驶汽车承诺的更大进步，可以预见类似的限制。

en: Last week, one operated by the taxi company Uber struck and killed a woman pushing her bicycle across a wide road in Arizona. (23 words)
cn: 上周，一辆由出租车公司优步运营的自动驾驶汽车在亚利桑那州撞死了一名推着自行车穿过宽阔马路的妇女。

en: This was the first recorded death involving a car which was supposed to be fully autonomous. (16 words)
cn: 这是有记录以来第一起涉及本应完全自动驾驶的汽车致人死亡的事件。

en: Experts have said that it suggests a 'catastrophic failure' of technology. (11 words)
cn: 专家表示，这表明技术出现了‘灾难性故障’。

en: Increasingly, even Silicon Valley has to acknowledge the costs of the intoxicating hurry that characterises its culture. (17 words)
cn: 越来越多的迹象表明，即使是硅谷也不得不承认其文化所特有的令人陶醉的匆忙所带来的代价。

en: What traffic teaches us is that reckless and uncontrolled change is as likely to harm us as it is to benefit us, and that thoughtful regulation is necessary for a better future. (32 words)
cn: 交通教会我们的是，鲁莽和不受控制的变化既可能伤害我们，也可能让我们受益，而深思熟虑的监管对于更美好的未来是必要的。

en: At 43, I've reached the stage where women are warned to watch out for the creeping sadness of middle age. (20 words)
cn: 43岁时，我到了这样一个阶段——女性被警告要提防中年时期悄然袭来的悲伤。

en: We're served up an endless stream of advice on 'how to survive your 40s', as if we're in the endurance stage of a slow limp toward obscurity. (27 words)
cn: 我们被灌输源源不断的关于‘如何熬过40岁’的建议，仿佛我们正处在缓慢蹒跚走向默默无闻的忍耐阶段。

en: This is the age women start to become 'invisible'—our value, attractiveness and power supposedly diminished by the vanishing of youth. (20 words)
cn: 这是女性开始变得‘隐形’的年龄——我们的价值、吸引力和力量据称会随着青春的消逝而减弱。

en: But I don't feel like I'm fading into obscurity. (9 words)
cn: 但我不觉得自己正在变得默默无闻。

en: I feel more seen than I ever have, and for the first time in my life, I have a clear-eyed view of myself that is authentic, compassionate and accepting. (29 words)
cn: 我觉得自己比以往任何时候都更被看见，而且在我生命中第一次，我对自己有了一个清晰的、真实的、富有同情心的、接纳的视角。

en: When I look in the mirror, I'm proud of who I am—even those 'broken' parts that for so long seemed impossible to love. (23 words)
cn: 当我照镜子时，我为自己感到自豪——即使是那些长久以来似乎不可能被爱的‘破碎’部分。

en: So when advertisers try to sell me ways to 'turn back the clock', I have to suppress a laugh. (19 words)
cn: 所以，当广告商试图向我推销‘让时光倒流’的方法时，我不得不忍住笑。

en: I wouldn't go back to the crippling self-consciousness of my youth if you paid me. (15 words)
cn: 即使你给我钱，我也不愿回到年轻时那种令人崩溃的自我意识。

en: This hard-won sense of self-acceptance is one of the joys of being an older woman. (15 words)
cn: 这种来之不易的自我接纳感是成为年长女性的乐趣之一。

en: But it's a narrative often drowned out by the shame that marketers rely on to peddle us their diet pills, miracle face creams and breathable yoga pants—as if self-love is a purchasable commodity. (33 words)
cn: 但这种叙事常常被营销人员所依赖的羞耻感淹没，他们利用这种羞耻感向我们兜售减肥药、神奇面霜和透气瑜伽裤——仿佛自爱是一种可以购买的商品。

en: For some women I know, this sense of trust and self-belief later in life gave them the courage to leave dysfunctional relationships or embark on new career paths. (28 words)
cn: 对于我认识的一些女性来说，这种晚年生活中的信任感和自信给了她们离开不健康关系或开启新职业道路的勇气。

en: Others talked about enjoying their own company, of growth through adversity, deepening bonds of friendships, the ability to be more compassionate, less judgmental and to listen more and appreciate the small pleasures. (32 words)
cn: 其他人谈到享受独处、在逆境中成长、加深友谊纽带、更有同情心、更少评判、多倾听和欣赏小确幸。

en: Life past 40 is far from smooth sailing, but it's so much more than the reductive depictions we see in women's magazines and on the Hollywood big screen. (28 words)
cn: 40岁以后的生活远非一帆风顺，但它远比我们在女性杂志和好莱坞大银幕上看到的简化描绘要丰富得多。

en: Digital humans are coming to a screen near you. (9 words)
cn: 数字人类即将来到你附近的屏幕上。

en: As computer-generated imagery (CGI) has become cheaper and more sophisticated, the film industry can now convincingly recreate people on screen—even actors who have been dead for decades. (27 words)
cn: 随着计算机生成图像（CGI）变得更便宜、更先进，电影业现在可以在屏幕上令人信服地重现人物——甚至是已故数十年的演员。

en: The technology's ability to effectively keep celebrities alive beyond the grave is raising questions about public legacies and image rights. (20 words)
cn: 这项技术有效地让名人在逝世后继续‘活着’的能力，引发了关于公共遗产和形象权的质疑。

en: Late in 2019, it was announced that US actor James Dean, who died in 1955, will star in a Vietnam War film scheduled for release later this year. (28 words)
cn: 2019年底，有消息宣布，1955年去世的美国演员詹姆斯·迪恩将主演一部定于今年晚些时候上映的越战电影。

en: In the film, which will be called Finding Jack, Dean will be recreated on screen with CGI based on old footage and photographs, with another actor voicing him. (28 words)
cn: 在这部名为《寻找杰克》的电影中，迪恩将基于旧镜头和照片，用CGI技术在屏幕上重现，并由另一位演员为他配音。

en: The news was met with excitement by those keen to see Dean digitally brought back to life for only his fourth film, but it also drew sharp criticism. (28 words)
cn: 这一消息让那些渴望看到迪恩以数字方式复活、拍摄他仅有的第四部电影的人感到兴奋，但也招致了尖锐的批评。

en: This is puppeteering the dead for their fame alone, actress Zelda Williams wrote on Twitter. (15 words)
cn: 女演员泽尔达·威廉姆斯在推特上写道：‘这纯粹是为了名利而操纵逝者。’

en: It sets such an awful precedent for the future of performance. (11 words)
cn: ‘这为未来的表演开创了一个可怕的先例。’

en: Her father, Robin Williams, who died in 2014, was keen to avoid the same fate. (15 words)
cn: 她的父亲罗宾·威廉姆斯于2014年去世，他生前极力避免同样的命运。

en: Before his death, he filed a deed protecting the use of his image until 2039, preventing others from recreating him using CGI to appear in a film, TV show or as a hologram. (33 words)
cn: 在他去世前，他提交了一份契约，保护其形象使用权至2039年，防止他人利用CGI技术让他出现在电影、电视节目或全息影像中。

en: The James Dean film is a way to keep the actor's image relevant for younger generations, says Mark Roesler of CMG Worldwide, the firm that represents Dean's estate. (28 words)
cn: 代表迪恩遗产的CMG Worldwide公司的马克·勒斯勒表示，詹姆斯·迪恩这部电影是让这位演员的形象对年轻一代保持相关性的方式。

en: I think this is the beginning of an entire wave, says Travis Cloyd, CEO of Worldwide XR, one of the companies behind the digital recreation of Dean. (27 words)
cn: 参与迪恩数字再现的公司之一Worldwide XR的首席执行官特拉维斯·克洛伊德说：‘我认为这是一整波浪潮的开端。’

en: Moving into the future, we want James Dean to be brought into different gaming environments, or different virtual reality environments, or augmented reality environments, he says. (26 words)
cn: 他说：‘展望未来，我们希望将詹姆斯·迪恩带入不同的游戏环境、不同的虚拟现实环境或增强现实环境中。’

en: Other actors have been revived, with the permission of their estates, for advertising purposes: for example, a 2011 advertisement for Dior featured contemporary actress Charlize Theron alongside iconic 20th-century stars Marilyn Monroe, Grace Kelly and Marlene Dietrich. (37 words)
cn: 其他演员也在其遗产管理机构的许可下被复活用于广告目的：例如，2011年迪奥的一则广告让当代女演员查理兹·塞隆与20世纪标志性明星玛丽莲·梦露、格蕾丝·凯利和玛琳·黛德丽同台。

en: Later, Audrey Hepburn was digitally recreated for a chocolate commercial in 2013. (12 words)
cn: 后来，奥黛丽·赫本在2013年被数字重现用于一则巧克力广告。

en: In the same year, a CGI Bruce Lee appeared in a Chinese-language ad for a whisky brand, which offended many fans because Lee was widely known not to drink alcohol at all. (32 words)
cn: 同年，一个CGI李小龙出现在一个威士忌品牌的中文广告中，这冒犯了许多粉丝，因为众所周知李小龙根本不喝酒。

en: In the last five years, it's become more affordable and more achievable in a whole movie, says Tim Webber at UK visual effects firm Framestore, the company behind the Hepburn chocolate ad. (32 words)
cn: 英国视觉效果公司Framestore的蒂姆·韦伯表示：‘在过去五年里，在一整部电影中实现这一目标变得更可承受、更可行。’该公司是赫本巧克力广告的幕后制作方。

en: Framestore used body doubles with resemblance to Hepburn's facial structure and body shape as a framework for manual animation. (19 words)
cn: Framestore使用了与赫本面部结构和体型相似的替身作为手动动画的框架。

en: The process was extremely difficult and expensive, says Webber, but the technology has moved on. (15 words)
cn: 韦伯说，这个过程极其困难和昂贵，但技术已经进步了。

en: Now, a person can be animated from scratch. (8 words)
cn: 现在，一个人可以从头开始被动画化。

en: If they're alive today, you can put them in scanning rigs, you can get every detail of their body analysed very carefully and that makes it much easier, whereas working from available photographs is tricky, says Webber, who won an Academy Award for his visual effects work on the 2013 film Gravity. (52 words)
cn: 韦伯说：‘如果他们今天还活着，你可以把他们放在扫描设备中，你可以非常仔细地分析他们身体的每一个细节，这要容易得多，而根据现有照片工作则很棘手。’他因2013年电影《地心引力》的视觉效果工作获得了奥斯卡奖。

en: I also see a lot of actors today who will have the desire to take advantage of this technology: to have their likeness captured and stored for future content, says Cloyd. (31 words)
cn: 克洛伊德说：‘我还看到今天很多演员会有利用这项技术的愿望：将他们的形象捕捉并存储起来用于未来的内容。’

en: They foresee this being something that could give their estates and give their families the ability to make money from their likeness when they're gone. (25 words)
cn: ‘他们预见到这可以让他们去世后，遗产和家人都能从他们的形象中获利。’

en: A hidden hazard of digitally recreating a deceased celebrity is the risk of damaging their legacy. (16 words)
cn: 数字重现已故名人的一个隐藏风险是损害其遗产的可能性。

en: We have to respect the security and the integrity of rights holders, says John Canning at Digital Domain, a US firm that created a hologram rapper Tupac Shakur, which appeared at the Coachella music festival in 2012, 15 years after his death. (42 words)
cn: 美国Digital Domain公司的约翰·坎宁表示：‘我们必须尊重权利人的安全和完整性。’该公司曾创造了说唱歌手图帕克·沙库尔的全息影像，于2012年在科切拉音乐节上亮相，那是他去世15年后。

en: Legally, a person's rights to control the commercial use of their name and image beyond their death differ between and even within countries. (23 words)
cn: 在法律上，一个人在其死后控制其姓名和形象商业用途的权利在不同国家之间甚至国家内部都存在差异。

en: In certain US states, for example, these rights are treated similarly to property rights, and are transferable to a person's heirs. (21 words)
cn: 例如，在美国某些州，这些权利被视为类似财产权，可以转让给个人的继承人。

en: In California, under the Celebrities Rights Act, the personality rights for a celebrity last for 70 years after their death. (20 words)
cn: 在加利福尼亚州，根据《名人权利法》，名人的形象权在其去世后持续70年。

en: We've got a societal debate going on about access to our public commons, as it were, about famous faces, says Lilian Edwards at Newcastle University, UK. (26 words)
cn: 英国纽卡斯尔大学的莉莲·爱德华兹说：‘关于公众对公共资源——也就是名人面孔——的获取权，我们正在进行一场社会辩论。’

en: Should the public be allowed to use or reproduce images of famous people, given how iconic they are? (18 words)
cn: 鉴于名人的标志性地位，公众是否应该被允许使用或复制他们的形象？

en: And what is in the best interest of a deceased person's legacy may conflict with the desires of their family or the public, says Edwards. (25 words)
cn: 爱德华兹说，符合逝者遗产最大利益的做法可能与家人或公众的愿望相冲突。

en: A recreation, however lifelike, will never be indistinguishable from a real actor, says Webber. (14 words)
cn: 韦伯说，无论多么逼真，重现的形象永远不会与真实演员难以区分。

en: When we are bringing someone back, representing someone who is no longer alive on the screen, what we are doing is extremely sophisticated digital make-up, he says. (27 words)
cn: 他说：‘当我们让某人复活，在屏幕上呈现一个已故的人时，我们所做的是极其复杂的数字化妆。’

en: A performance is a lot more than a physical resemblance. (10 words)
cn: ‘表演远不止是外形上的相似。’

en: As it becomes easier to digitally recreate celebrities and to entirely manufacture on-screen identities, could this kind of technology put actors out of jobs? (24 words)
cn: 随着数字重现名人和完全制造屏幕上身份变得更容易，这种技术会让演员失业吗？

en: I think actors are worried about this, says Edwards. (9 words)
cn: 爱德华兹说：‘我认为演员们对此感到担忧。’

en: But I think it will take a very long time. (10 words)
cn: ‘但我认为这需要很长时间。’

en: This is partly because of the risk that viewers find virtual humans scary. (13 words)
cn: 部分原因是观众可能觉得虚拟人类令人害怕。

en: Edwards cites widespread backlash to the digital recreation of Carrie Fisher as a young Princess Leia in Rogue One, a trick later repeated in the recent Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker, which was filmed after Fisher's death in 2016. (40 words)
cn: 爱德华兹引用了对《侠盗一号》中凯丽·费雪以年轻莱娅公主形象数字重现的广泛抵制，这一手法在2016年费雪去世后拍摄的《星球大战：天行者崛起》中再次被使用。

en: People didn't like it, she says. (6 words)
cn: 她说：‘人们不喜欢这样。’

en: They discovered the uncanny valley. (5 words)
cn: ‘他们发现了“诡异谷”效应。’

en: This refers to the idea that when objects trying to resemble humans aren't quite perfect, they can make viewers feel uneasy because they fall somewhere between obviously non-human and fully human. (31 words)
cn: 这指的是当试图模仿人类的物体不够完美时，它们会让观众感到不安，因为它们介于明显非人类和完全人类之间。

en: That's always a danger when you're doing anything human or human-like, says Webber. (13 words)
cn: 韦伯说：‘当你在做任何与人类或类人有关的事情时，这始终是一个危险。’

en: There're a thousand things that could go wrong with a computer-generated facial performance, and any one of those could make it fall into the uncanny valley, he says. (28 words)
cn: 他说：‘计算机生成的面部表演可能出错的地方有一千处，其中任何一处都可能让它落入“诡异谷”。’

en: Your brain just knows there's something wrong. (7 words)
cn: ‘你的大脑就是知道有什么不对劲。’

en: The problem often arises around the eyes or mouth, says Webber. (11 words)
cn: 韦伯说，问题常常出现在眼睛或嘴巴周围。

en: They're the areas that you look at when you're talking to someone. (12 words)
cn: ‘那是你和别人说话时注视的部位。’

en: An unfamiliar digital human that has been created through CGI will also face the same challenge as an unknown actor: they don't have the appeal of an established name. (29 words)
cn: 一个通过CGI创建的陌生数字人类也将面临与不知名演员相同的挑战：他们没有已成名演员的吸引力。

en: You have to spend substantial capital in creating awareness around their likeness and making sure people are familiar with who they are, says Cloyd. (24 words)
cn: 克洛伊德说：‘你必须投入大量资金来建立对其形象的认知，并确保人们熟悉他们是谁。’

en: This is now starting to happen. (6 words)
cn: 这现在已经开始发生了。

en: The way you pre-sell a movie in a foreign market is based on relevant talent, he says. (17 words)
cn: 他说：‘你在海外市场预售电影的方式是基于相关的人才。’

en: I think we're a long way away from having virtual beings that have the ability to pre-sell content. (18 words)
cn: ‘我认为我们距离拥有能够预售内容的虚拟形象还有很长的路要走。’

en: Webber expects that we will see more digital humans on screen. (11 words)
cn: 韦伯预计我们将在屏幕上看到更多的数字人类。

en: It's happening because it can happen, he says. (8 words)
cn: 他说：‘它正在发生，因为它能够发生。’

en: Referring to a line from Jurassic Park, he adds: 'People are too busy thinking about what they can do to think about whether they should do it.' (27 words)
cn: 他引用《侏罗纪公园》中的一句台词补充道：‘人们太忙于思考自己能做什么，以至于没空去想自己是否应该去做。’

en: You can't see it, smell it, or hear it, and people disagree on how precisely to define it, or where exactly it comes from. (24 words)
cn: 你看不见它、闻不到它、听不见它，人们对如何精确定义它或它究竟来自何处存在分歧。

en: It isn't a school subject or an academic discipline, but it can be learned. (14 words)
cn: 它不是一门学校科目或学术学科，但它可以被学习。

en: It is a quality that is required of artists, but it is also present in the lives of scientists and entrepreneurs. (21 words)
cn: 它是艺术家所需要的品质，但它也存在于科学家和企业家的生活中。

en: All of us benefit from it and we thrive mentally and spiritually when we are able to wield it. (19 words)
cn: 我们所有人都从中受益，当我们能够运用它时，我们在心理和精神上都会茁壮成长。

en: It is a delicate thing, easily stamped out; in fact, it flourishes most fully when people are playful and childlike. (20 words)
cn: 它是一种脆弱的东西，容易被扼杀；事实上，当人们充满游戏精神和童心时，它最为繁盛。

en: Meanwhile, it works best in conjunction with deep knowledge and expertise. (11 words)
cn: 同时，它与深厚的知识和专业技能相结合时效果最佳。

en: This mysterious—but teachable—quality is creativity, the subject of a recently-published report by Durham Commission on Creativity and Education. (18 words)
cn: 这种神秘但可教的品质就是创造力，这是达勒姆创意与教育委员会最近发布的一份报告的主题。

en: The report concludes that creativity should not inhabit the school curriculum only as it relates to drama, music, art and other obviously creative subjects, but that creative thinking ought to run through all of school life, infusing the way humanities and natural sciences are learned. (45 words)
cn: 报告得出结论，创造力不仅应在戏剧、音乐、艺术和其他明显具有创造性的学科中存在于学校课程中，而且创造性思维应贯穿整个学校生活，渗透到人文学科和自然科学的学习方式中。

en: The authors, who focus on education in England, offer a number of sensible recommendations, some of which are an attempt to alleviate the uninspiring and fact-based approach to education that has crept into policy in recent years. (37 words)
cn: 专注于英国教育的作者们提出了许多合理的建议，其中一些试图缓解近年来悄然进入政策的那种枯燥乏味、以事实为基础的教育方式。

en: When children are regarded as vessels to be filled with facts, creativity does not prosper; nor does it when teachers' sole objective is coaching children towards exams. (27 words)
cn: 当孩子们被视为需要填满事实的容器时，创造力不会蓬勃发展；当教师的唯一目标是指导孩子们应对考试时，创造力也不会蓬勃发展。

en: One suggestion from the commission is a network of teacher-led 'creativity collaboratives', along the lines of existing maths hubs, with the aim of supporting teaching for creativity through the school curriculum. (31 words)
cn: 委员会的一项建议是建立一个由教师主导的‘创意合作’网络，类似于现有的数学中心，旨在通过学校课程支持创造性教学。

en: Nevertheless, it is arts subjects through which creativity can most obviously be fostered. (13 words)
cn: 然而，艺术科目才是最能明显培养创造力的学科。

en: The value placed on them by the independent education sector is clear. (12 words)
cn: 独立教育部门对它们的重视是显而易见的。

en: One only has to look at the remarkable arts facilities at Britain's top private schools to comprehend this. (18 words)
cn: 只需看看英国顶尖私立学校卓越的艺术设施就能明白这一点。

en: But in the state sector the excessive focus on English, maths and science threatens to crush arts subjects; meanwhile, reduced school budgets mean diminishing extracurricular activities. (26 words)
cn: 但在公立学校，对英语、数学和科学的过度关注有可能挤压艺术学科；同时，学校预算的减少意味着课外活动的缩减。

en: There has been a 28.1% decline in students taking creative subjects at high schools since 2014, though happily, art and design have seen a recent increase. (26 words)
cn: 自2014年以来，高中选修创造性学科的学生人数下降了28.1%，但令人欣慰的是，艺术和设计专业最近有所增长。

en: This discrepancy between state and private education is a matter of social justice. (13 words)
cn: 公立教育和私立教育之间的这种差距是一个社会正义问题。

en: It is simply wrong and unfair that most children have a fraction of the access to choirs, orchestras, art studios and drama that their more privileged peers enjoy. (28 words)
cn: 大多数孩子接触合唱团、管弦乐队、艺术工作室和戏剧的机会只是他们更优越的同龄人的一小部分，这简直是错误和不公平的。

en: As lives are affected by any number of looming challenges—climate crisis, automation in the workplace—humans are going to need creative thinking more than ever. (24 words)
cn: 随着生活受到诸多迫在眉睫的挑战——气候危机、工作场所自动化——的影响，人类将比以往任何时候都更需要创造性思维。

en: For all of our sakes, creativity in education, and for all, must become a priority. (15 words)
cn: 为了我们所有人的利益，教育中的创造力——面向所有人的创造力——必须成为优先事项。

en: Emulating your conversation partner's actions is a common human behavior classified as 'mirroring' and has been known and studied by psychologists for years. (23 words)
cn: 模仿谈话对象的动作是一种常见的人类行为，被归类为‘镜像模仿’，心理学家对此已经了解并研究了多年。

en: We all tend to subconsciously copy gestures of people we like. (11 words)
cn: 我们都倾向于下意识地模仿我们喜欢的人的手势。

en: But why do we act like this? (7 words)
cn: 但我们为什么会这样做呢？

en: As a rule, mirroring means that conversationalists enjoy their communication and that there's a certain level of agreement between them. (20 words)
cn: 通常，镜像模仿意味着对话双方享受他们的交流，并且他们之间存在一定程度的共识。

en: The topic of discussion is equally interesting for both and they know their interests meet. (15 words)
cn: 讨论的话题对双方来说都同样有趣，他们知道彼此的兴趣相投。

en: Repeating someone's behavior is typical of talented communicators, not always because the person is sympathetic, but because there is a goal to be achieved. (24 words)
cn: 重复他人的行为是优秀沟通者的典型特征，并不总是因为这个人富有同情心，而是因为有一个目标要实现。

en: This way new idols have been brought to the stage: politicians, celebrities, and other big names. (16 words)
cn: 这样，新的偶像被带上了舞台：政治家、名人和其他大人物。

en: Popular culture makes people want to look popular, and act and speak like popular people. (15 words)
cn: 流行文化让人们想要看起来受欢迎，行为和说话都像受欢迎的人。

en: Nowadays celebrities steal lyrics from each other and struggle with copyright violation accusations or straightforwardly claim themselves to be the authors, even though all the work was done by other people. (31 words)
cn: 如今，名人互相抄袭歌词，面临侵犯版权的指控，或者干脆声称自己是作者，即使所有的工作都是别人完成的。

en: Among celebrities, it's trendy nowadays to use their own speech writers as politicians do. (14 words)
cn: 在名人中，如今像政客一样使用自己的演讲稿撰写人是一种时尚。

en: The so-called 'ghostwriting' can take various forms: books, articles, autobiographies, and even social media posts. (15 words)
cn: 所谓的‘代笔’可以有多种形式：书籍、文章、自传，甚至社交媒体帖子。

en: Who is a true copycat and who gets copycatted? (9 words)
cn: 谁是真正的抄袭者，谁被抄袭了？

en: Sometimes, it is a hard nut to crack without an expert's help. (12 words)
cn: 有时，没有专家的帮助，这是一个难题。

en: But new authorship defending methods based on identifying individual writing patterns are already here. (14 words)
cn: 但基于识别个人写作模式的新作者身份保护方法已经出现。

en: Their aim is to protect intellectual property. (7 words)
cn: 它们的目标是保护知识产权。

en: Using scientific methods, some of them can define authorship with 85% accuracy. (12 words)
cn: 使用科学方法，其中一些可以以85%的准确率确定作者身份。

en: Writing is not an easy craft to master. (8 words)
cn: 写作不是一门容易掌握的技艺。

en: If you want to write like a professional without plagiarism, there are a few lessons to learn and the first one is: 'Copy from one, it's plagiarism; copy from two, it's research.' (32 words)
cn: 如果你想写得像专业人士一样而不抄袭，有几课要学，第一课是：‘抄一个人的是抄袭；抄两个人的是研究。’

en: The correct interpretation of this statement is not about copying, but rather about creating your own style. (17 words)
cn: 这句话的正确解读不是关于抄袭，而是关于创造你自己的风格。

en: When you study an author's writing style, don't stop on a single one, but explore numerous styles instead. (18 words)
cn: 当你研究一位作者的写作风格时，不要停留在一个人身上，而是要探索多种风格。

en: Examine types of sentences they use, pay attention to their metaphors, and focus on stories you feel you could write a pretty cool sequel to. (25 words)
cn: 检查他们使用的句子类型，注意他们的隐喻，并关注那些你觉得可以写出很酷续集的故事。

en: Imitation is rather paradoxical. (4 words)
cn: 模仿是相当矛盾的。

en: As an integral part of learning, it brings about positive changes, making people develop and grow. (16 words)
cn: 作为学习不可或缺的一部分，它带来积极的变化，促进人们的发展和成长。

en: However, it may do a lot of harm. (8 words)
cn: 然而，它可能造成很大的伤害。

en: Copying someone's thoughts, ideas or inventions is completely unacceptable. (9 words)
cn: 抄袭他人的思想、想法或发明是完全不可接受的。

en: It infringes on intellectual property rights of others. (8 words)
cn: 它侵犯了他人的知识产权。

en: Still, many things we do are about copying others one way or another. (13 words)
cn: 尽管如此，我们所做的许多事情都是以某种方式模仿他人。

en: So if you want to compliment someone on the work they have done and imitate it, just make sure you do it the right way to avoid committing plagiarism. (29 words)
cn: 所以，如果你想赞美某人的作品并模仿它，请确保你以正确的方式去做，以避免抄袭。

en: If you think life is wonderful and expect it to stay that way, then you may have a good chance of living to a ripe old age, at least that is what the findings of a new study suggest. (39 words)
cn: 如果你认为生活是美好的，并期望它一直如此，那么你很有可能活到高龄——至少这是一项新研究的发现所表明的。

en: That study found that participants who reported the highest levels of optimism were far more likely to live to age 85 or beyond. (23 words)
cn: 该研究发现，报告乐观程度最高的参与者活到85岁或以上的可能性要大得多。

en: This was compared to those participants who reported the lowest levels of optimism. (13 words)
cn: 这是与那些报告乐观程度最低的参与者相比而言的。

en: It is noteworthy that the findings held even after the researchers considered factors that could affect the link, including whether participants had health conditions such as heart disease or cancer, or whether they experienced depression. (35 words)
cn: 值得注意的是，即使在研究人员考虑了可能影响这种关联的因素之后——包括参与者是否患有心脏病或癌症等健康问题，或者他们是否经历过抑郁症——这一发现仍然成立。

en: The results add to a growing body of evidence that certain psychological factors may predict a longer life span. (19 words)
cn: 这些结果为越来越多的证据增添了新的佐证，即某些心理因素可能预示着更长的寿命。

en: For example, previous studies have found that more optimistic people have a lower risk of developing chronic diseases, and a lower risk of premature death. (25 words)
cn: 例如，先前的研究发现，更乐观的人患慢性病的风险更低，过早死亡的风险也更低。

en: However, the new study appears to be the first to specifically look at the relationship between optimism and longevity. (19 words)
cn: 然而，这项新研究似乎是第一个专门研究乐观与长寿之间关系的研究。

en: The researchers conceded that the link found in the new study was not as strong when they factored in the effects of certain health behaviors, including exercise levels, sleep habits and diet. (32 words)
cn: 研究人员承认，当他们将某些健康行为（包括运动水平、睡眠习惯和饮食）的影响纳入考虑时，新研究中发现的关联并不那么强。

en: This suggests that these behaviors may, at least in part, explain the link. (13 words)
cn: 这表明这些行为可能至少在一定程度上解释了这种关联。

en: In other words, optimism may foster good habits that bolster health. (11 words)
cn: 换句话说，乐观可能有助于培养促进健康的好习惯。

en: It is also important to note that the study found only a correlation, as researchers did not prove for certain that optimism leads to a longer life. (27 words)
cn: 同样重要的是要注意，该研究只发现了一种相关性，因为研究人员并未确切证明乐观会导致更长的寿命。

en: However, if the findings are true, they suggest that optimism could serve as a psychological trait that promotes health and a longer life. (23 words)
cn: 然而，如果这些发现是真的，它们表明乐观可以作为一种促进健康和延长寿命的心理特质。

en: Last week, Burberry's annual report revealed that £28.6 million worth of stock was burnt last year. (16 words)
cn: 上周，巴宝莉的年度报告显示，去年有价值2860万英镑的库存被烧毁。

en: The news has left investors and consumers outraged but comes as little surprise to those in the fashion industry. (19 words)
cn: 这一消息让投资者和消费者感到愤怒，但对时尚界人士来说并不意外。

en: The practice of destroying unsold stock, and even rolls of unused fabric, is commonplace for luxury labels. (17 words)
cn: 销毁未售出的库存，甚至整卷未使用的面料，对奢侈品牌来说是常见做法。

en: Becoming too widely available at a cheaper price through discount stores discourages full-price sales. (14 words)
cn: 通过折扣店以更便宜的价格变得过于普及，会阻碍全价销售。

en: Sending products for recycling leaves them vulnerable to being stolen and sold on the black market. (16 words)
cn: 将产品送去回收会使它们容易被盗并在黑市上出售。

en: Jasmine Bina, CEO of brand strategy agency Concept Bureau explains, 'Typically, luxury brands rally around exclusivity to protect their business interests, namely intellectual property and preservation of brand equity.' (29 words)
cn: 品牌战略机构Concept Bureau的首席执行官贾斯敏·比纳解释说：‘通常，奢侈品牌围绕排他性来保护其商业利益，即知识产权和品牌资产的维护。’

en: She stated she had heard rumors of stock burning but not specific cases until this week. (16 words)
cn: 她说她曾听说过烧毁库存的传闻，但直到本周才了解到具体案例。

en: Another reason for the commonplace practice is a financial incentive for brands exporting goods to America. (16 words)
cn: 这种普遍做法的另一个原因是向美国出口商品的品牌有经济激励。

en: United States Customs states that if imported merchandise is unused and destroyed under their supervision, 99% of the duties, taxes or fees paid on the merchandise may be recovered. (29 words)
cn: 美国海关规定，如果进口商品未使用并在其监督下销毁，则可退还该商品所缴纳的99%的关税、税款或费用。

en: It is incredibly difficult to calculate how much dead stock currently goes to waste. (14 words)
cn: 目前很难计算有多少滞销库存被浪费。

en: While there are incentives to do it, there's no legal obligation to report it. (14 words)
cn: 虽然有激励措施这样做，但没有法律义务报告此事。

en: A source, who chose to remain anonymous, shared her experience working in a Burberry store in New York in October 2016. (21 words)
cn: 一位选择匿名的消息人士分享了她在2016年10月在纽约一家巴宝莉门店工作的经历。

en: 'My job was to toss items in boxes so they could be sent to be burned. (16 words)
cn: ‘我的工作是把物品扔进箱子里，以便送去烧毁。’

en: It was killing me inside because all that leather and fur went to waste and animals had died for nothing. (20 words)
cn: ‘这让我内心非常痛苦，因为所有那些皮革和毛皮都被浪费了，动物们白白死了。’

en: I couldn't stay there any longer, their business practices threw me off the roof.' (14 words)
cn: ‘我不能再待在那里了，他们的商业行为让我无法忍受。’

en: In May this year, Burberry announced it was taking fur out of its catwalk shows and reviewing its use elsewhere in the business. (23 words)
cn: 今年5月，巴宝莉宣布将把皮草从秀场中撤出，并审查其在业务其他领域的使用情况。

en: 'Even though we asked the management, they refused to give us detailed answers as to why they would do this with their collection,' continued the source, who left her role within two weeks. (33 words)
cn: ‘尽管我们问了管理层，但他们拒绝给我们详细解答为什么要这样处理他们的系列产品。’这位消息人士继续说道，她在两周内就离职了。

en: She has since worked with another high-profile, luxury label. (9 words)
cn: 此后，她为另一家知名奢侈品牌工作。

en: In an online forum post, which asked if it's true that Louis Vuitton burned its bags, Ahmed Bouchfaa, who claimed to work for Louis Vuitton, responded that the brand holds sales of old stock for staff members twice a year. (40 words)
cn: 在一个询问路易威登是否真的烧毁其包袋的在线论坛帖子中，声称在路易威登工作的艾哈迈德·布奇法回应说，该品牌每年为员工举行两次旧库存销售。

en: Items which have still not sold after several sales are destroyed. (11 words)
cn: 经过几次销售仍未售出的商品会被销毁。

en: 'Louis Vuitton doesn't have public sales. (6 words)
cn: ‘路易威登没有公开销售活动。’

en: They either sell a product at a given price or discontinue it. (12 words)
cn: ‘他们要么以给定价格出售产品，要么停产。’

en: This is to make sure that everybody pays the same price for an item,' he says. (16 words)
cn: ‘这是为了确保每个人都为同一件商品支付相同的价格。’他说。

en: He goes on to disclose the strict guidelines around the employee sales: 'You may buy gifts for someone, but they track each item, and if your gift ends up online they know who to ask.' (35 words)
cn: 他接着透露了关于员工销售的严格规定：‘你可以为别人购买礼物，但他们会追踪每件物品，如果你的礼物最终出现在网上，他们知道该找谁。’

en: One investor commenting on the Burberry figures was reportedly outraged that the unsold goods were not even offered to investors before they were destroyed. (24 words)
cn: 据报道，一位评论巴宝莉数据的投资者感到愤怒，因为这些未售出的商品在被销毁前甚至没有提供给投资者。

en: Richemont, who owns several luxury brands, hit the headlines in May for taking back £437 million of watches for destruction in the last two years to avoid marked-down prices. (29 words)
cn: 拥有多个奢侈品牌的历峰集团在5月成为头条新闻，因为其在过去两年中回收了价值4.37亿英镑的手表进行销毁，以避免降价。

en: It's not just luxury brands either. (6 words)
cn: 这也不仅仅是奢侈品牌。

en: In October last year, a Danish TV show exposed H&M for burning 12 tonnes of unsold clothing since 2013. (19 words)
cn: 去年10月，一个丹麦电视节目曝光了H&M自2013年以来焚烧了12吨未售出服装的行为。

en: In a statement, the high street retailer defended itself by saying that the burnt clothing had failed safety tests: 'The products to which the media are referring have been tested in external laboratories. (33 words)
cn: 在一份声明中，这家高街零售商为自己辩护说，被烧毁的服装未通过安全测试：‘媒体所指的产品已在外部实验室进行了测试。’

en: The test results show that one of the products is mold infested and the other product contains levels of lead that are too high. (24 words)
cn: ‘测试结果显示，其中一件产品发霉，另一件产品含铅量过高。’

en: Those products have rightly been stopped in accordance with our safety routines.' (12 words)
cn: ‘根据我们的安全程序，这些产品已被合理地停止销售。’

en: In March, a report revealed that H&M was struggling with $4.3 billion worth of unsold stock. (16 words)
cn: 3月，一份报告显示H&M正面临价值43亿美元的未售库存困境。

en: The brand told The New York Times that the plan was to reduce prices to move the stock, arguably encouraging consumers to buy and throw away with little thought. (29 words)
cn: 该品牌告诉《纽约时报》，计划是降低价格以消化库存，这可以说是在鼓励消费者不加思索地购买和丢弃。

en: Over-production is perhaps the biggest concern for Burberry. (8 words)
cn: 过度生产或许是巴宝莉最大的担忧。

en: While there has been much outrage at the elitist connotation of burning goods rather than making them affordable, executives at the British fashion house are no doubt struggling to defend how they miscalculated production. (34 words)
cn: 尽管人们对烧毁商品而非使其价格可承受的精英主义内涵感到愤怒，但这家英国时尚品牌的高管们无疑正在努力为他们的生产误算辩护。

en: The waste has been put down to burning old cosmetic stock to make way for their new beauty range. (19 words)
cn: 这一浪费被归因于烧毁旧化妆品库存，以便为新的美容系列腾出空间。

en: However, while the value of destroyed stock is up from £26.9 million last year, it's an even more significant increase from 2016's figure of £18.8 million, highlighting that this is an ongoing issue. (33 words)
cn: 然而，虽然被销毁库存的价值从去年的2690万英镑有所上升，但与2016年的1880万英镑相比，增幅更为显著，凸显出这是一个持续存在的问题。

en: In September 2016, Burberry switched to a 'see now, buy now' catwalk show format. (14 words)
cn: 2016年9月，巴宝莉转向了‘即看即买’的秀场模式。

en: The move was a switch to leverage on the coverage of their fashion week show to make stock available immediately to consumers. (22 words)
cn: 此举是为了利用时装周秀场的报道来使库存立即面向消费者。

en: This is opposed to the traditional format of presenting to the industry, taking orders for production and becoming available in six months' time. (23 words)
cn: 这与传统的向业内展示、接受生产订单、六个月后上架的格式相反。

en: While Burberry announced 'record-breaking' online reach and engagement, there has been little evidence to suggest that the strategy has had a significant effect on sales, particularly as the hype slows across the season. (33 words)
cn: 尽管巴宝莉宣布了‘破纪录’的在线覆盖率和参与度，但几乎没有证据表明该策略对销售产生了显著影响，尤其是随着炒作在整个季度的降温。

en: In February they made adjustments to the format, dropping some catwalk items immediately and promising that others would launch in the coming months. (23 words)
cn: 2月，他们对这一模式进行了调整，立即上架部分秀场单品，并承诺其他单品将在未来几个月推出。

en: In a statement, Burberry denied that switching to 'see now, buy now' has had an impact on waste. (18 words)
cn: 在一份声明中，巴宝莉否认转向‘即看即买’模式对浪费产生了影响。

en: A Burberry spokesperson further said, 'On the occasions when disposal of products is necessary, we do so in a responsible manner. (21 words)
cn: 巴宝莉的一位发言人进一步表示：‘在必要处置产品的情况下，我们会以负责任的方式进行。’

en: We are always seeking ways to reduce and revalue our waste. (11 words)
cn: ‘我们一直在寻求减少和重新利用废弃物的方法。’

en: This is a core part of our strategy and we have forged partnerships and committed support to innovative organizations to help reach this goal.' (24 words)
cn: ‘这是我们战略的核心部分，我们已经建立了合作伙伴关系，并承诺支持创新组织以帮助实现这一目标。’

en: One such partnership is with Elvis & Kresse, an accessories brand working with reclaimed materials. (15 words)
cn: 其中一个合作伙伴关系是与Elvis & Kresse——一个使用再生材料的配饰品牌。

en: Co-founder Kresse Wesling said, 'Late last year we launched an ambitious five-year partnership with the Burberry Foundation. (17 words)
cn: 联合创始人克雷斯·韦斯林说：‘去年年底，我们与巴宝莉基金会启动了一项为期五年的雄心勃勃的合作。’

en: The main aim of this is to scale our leather rescue project, starting with off-cuts from the production of Burberry leather goods. (22 words)
cn: ‘其主要目标是扩大我们的皮革救助项目，从巴宝莉皮革制品生产中的边角料开始。’

en: We are working tirelessly to expand our solutions and would love to welcome anyone to our workshop to come and see what we are doing.' (25 words)
cn: ‘我们正在不懈努力扩大我们的解决方案，并欢迎任何人来我们的车间看看我们在做什么。’

en: At the moment, the partnership only addresses waste at the production stage and not unsold goods. (16 words)
cn: 目前，这一合作仅解决生产阶段的浪费问题，而非未售出的商品。

en: While these are honorable schemes, it makes it harder for Burberry to defend these latest figures. (16 words)
cn: 尽管这些都是值得称道的计划，但它们使巴宝莉更难为这些最新数据辩护。

en: Fifteen years ago, Burberry was at crisis point as their signature check pattern was widely imitated by cheap, imitation brands. (20 words)
cn: 15年前，巴宝莉曾处于危机时刻，因为其标志性格纹图案被廉价的仿冒品牌广泛模仿。

en: It deterred luxury consumers who found their expensive clothing more closely associated with working-class youth culture than a prestigious heritage fashion house. (22 words)
cn: 这阻止了奢侈消费者，他们发现昂贵的服装与工人阶级青年文化的关联比与著名传统时尚品牌的关联更紧密。

en: In the year 2004, at the height of over-exposure of the Burberry check, the brand's turnover was £715.5 million. (19 words)
cn: 2004年，在巴宝莉格纹过度曝光的高峰期，该品牌的营业额为7.155亿英镑。

en: Under Christopher Bailey as creative director they turned the brand around and this past year revenue hit £2.73 billion. (19 words)
cn: 在克里斯托弗·贝利担任创意总监的领导下，他们扭转了品牌局面，过去一年的收入达到了27.3亿英镑。

en: Bina believes that brands need to readdress their exclusivity tactic. (10 words)
cn: 比纳认为，品牌需要重新审视其排他性策略。

en: 'Exclusivity is starting to be challenged,' she says, 'I think that goes hand in hand with how luxury itself is being challenged. (22 words)
cn: 她说：‘排他性正开始受到挑战，我认为这与奢侈本身受到挑战是相辅相成的。’

en: Access to fashion, and the brands who police it, are becoming less and less relevant. (15 words)
cn: ‘接触时尚的机会以及监管时尚的品牌，正变得越来越不重要。’

en: Things like health, enlightenment, and social and environmental responsibility are the new luxuries. (13 words)
cn: ‘健康、启迪、社会和环境责任等事物才是新的奢侈品。’

en: These all come from within, not without. (7 words)
cn: ‘这些都来自内在，而非外在。’

en: That's the challenge that traditional luxury brands will have to contend with in the mid-to-long term future.' (17 words)
cn: ‘这是传统奢侈品牌在中长期未来必须应对的挑战。’

en: Social media is absolutely everywhere. (5 words)
cn: 社交媒体无处不在。

en: Billions of people use social media on a daily basis to create, share, and exchange ideas, messages, and information. (19 words)
cn: 数十亿人每天使用社交媒体来创造、分享和交流想法、信息和资讯。

en: Both individuals and businesses post regularly to engage and interact with people from around the world. (16 words)
cn: 个人和企业都会定期发帖，与来自世界各地的人互动交流。

en: It is a powerful communication medium that simultaneously provides immediate, frequent, permanent, and wide-reaching information across the globe. (18 words)
cn: 它是一种强大的通信媒介，同时在全世界范围内提供即时、频繁、永久和广泛传播的信息。

en: People post their lives on social media for the world to see. (12 words)
cn: 人们在社交媒体上发布自己的生活，让世界看到。

en: Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, and countless other social channels provide a quick and simple way to glimpse into a job candidate's personal life—both the positive and negative sides of it. (29 words)
cn: Facebook、Twitter、LinkedIn和无数其他社交渠道提供了一种快速简便的方式，来窥探求职者的个人生活——包括其积极和消极的一面。

en: Social media screening is tempting to use as part of the hiring process, but should employers make use of it when researching a potential candidate's background? (26 words)
cn: 在招聘过程中使用社交媒体筛选很诱人，但雇主在调查潜在求职者的背景时应该使用它吗？

en: Incorporating the use of social media to screen job candidates is not an uncommon practice. (15 words)
cn: 使用社交媒体来筛选求职者并不是一种罕见做法。

en: A 2018 survey found that almost 70% of employers use social media to screen candidates before hiring them. (18 words)
cn: 2018年的一项调查发现，近70%的雇主在招聘前会使用社交媒体筛选求职者。

en: But there are consequences and potential legal risks involved too. (10 words)
cn: 但这也会涉及后果和潜在的法律风险。

en: When done inappropriately, social media screening can be considered unethical or even illegal. (13 words)
cn: 如果使用不当，社交媒体筛选可能被视为不道德甚至非法。

en: Social media screening is essentially scrutinising a job candidate's private life. (11 words)
cn: 社交媒体筛选本质上是在审查求职者的私人生活。

en: It can reveal information about protected characteristics like age, race, nationality, disability, gender, religion, etc., and that could bias a hiring decision. (22 words)
cn: 它可能揭示受保护特征的信息，如年龄、种族、国籍、残疾、性别、宗教等，这可能会使招聘决定产生偏见。

en: Pictures or comments on a private page that are taken out of context could ruin a perfectly good candidate's chances of getting hired. (23 words)
cn: 私人页面上的照片或评论如果被断章取义，可能会毁掉一个非常好的求职者被录用的机会。

en: This process could potentially give an unfair advantage to one candidate over another. (13 words)
cn: 这一过程可能会给一个求职者带来相对于另一个求职者的不公平优势。

en: It creates an unequal playing field and potentially provides hiring managers with information that can impact their hiring decision in a negative way. (23 words)
cn: 它创造了一个不平等的竞争环境，并可能为招聘经理提供可能对其招聘决定产生负面影响的信息。

en: It's hard to ignore social media as a screening tool. (10 words)
cn: 很难忽视社交媒体作为筛选工具的作用。

en: While there are things that you shouldn't see, there are some things that can be lawfully considered—making it a valuable source of relevant information too. (25 words)
cn: 虽然有些东西你不应该看，但有些东西可以合法地考虑——这也使它成为相关信息的有价值来源。

en: Using social media screening appropriately can help ensure that you don't hire a toxic employee who will cost you money or stain your company's reputation. (25 words)
cn: 适当地使用社交媒体筛选可以帮助确保你不会雇用一名会花费你金钱或损害公司声誉的不良员工。

en: Consider the lawful side of this process and you may be able to hire the best employee ever. (18 words)
cn: 考虑这一过程的合法方面，你或许能够聘用到最好的员工。

en: There is a delicate balance. (5 words)
cn: 这其中存在着微妙的平衡。

en: Screening job candidates on social media must be done professionally and responsibly. (12 words)
cn: 在社交媒体上筛选求职者必须以专业和负责任的方式进行。

en: Companies should stipulate that they will never ask for passwords, be consistent, document decisions, consider the source used and be aware that other laws may apply. (26 words)
cn: 公司应明确规定他们绝不会要求密码，保持一致，记录决定，考虑所使用的来源，并注意可能适用的其他法律。

en: In light of this it is probably best to look later in the process and ask human resources for help in navigating it. (23 words)
cn: 鉴于此，最好在流程的后期进行，并请人力资源部门帮助指导。

en: Social media is here to stay. (6 words)
cn: 社交媒体将继续存在。

en: But before using social media to screen job candidates, consulting with management and legal teams beforehand is essential in order to comply with all laws. (25 words)
cn: 但在使用社交媒体筛选求职者之前，为了遵守所有法律，事先咨询管理层和法律团队是必不可少的。

en: In recent years, the food industry has increased its use of labels. (12 words)
cn: 近年来，食品行业增加了对标签的使用。

en: Whether the labels say 'non-GMO' or 'no sugar,' or 'zero carbohydrates', consumers are increasingly demanding more information about what's in their food. (22 words)
cn: 无论标签上写着‘非转基因’、‘无糖’还是‘零碳水’，消费者都越来越要求获得更多关于食品成分的信息。

en: One report found that 39 percent of consumers would switch from the brands they currently buy to others that provide clearer, more accurate product information. (25 words)
cn: 一份报告发现，39%的消费者会从他们目前购买的品牌转向提供更清晰、更准确产品信息的其他品牌。

en: Food manufacturers are responding to the report with new labels to meet that demand, and they're doing so with an eye towards giving their products an advantage over the competition, and bolstering profits. (33 words)
cn: 食品制造商正在用新标签来回应这份报告以满足这一需求，他们这样做是为了让自己的产品在竞争中占据优势并提高利润。

en: This strategy makes intuitive sense. (5 words)
cn: 这一策略在直觉上是合理的。

en: If consumers say they want transparency, tell them exactly what is in your product. (14 words)
cn: 如果消费者说他们想要透明度，那就告诉他们你的产品中到底含有什么。

en: That is simply supplying a certain demand. (7 words)
cn: 这只是在满足某种需求。

en: But the marketing strategy in response to this consumer demand has gone beyond articulating what is in a product, to labeling what is NOT in the food. (27 words)
cn: 但为响应这一消费者需求而采取的营销策略，已经从阐明产品中含有什么，发展到标注食品中不含有什么。

en: These labels are known as 'absence claims' labels, and they represent an emerging labeling trend that is detrimental both to the consumers who purchase the products and the industry that supplies them. (32 words)
cn: 这些标签被称为‘缺失性声称’标签，它们代表了一种新兴的标签趋势，既对购买产品的消费者有害，也对供应产品的行业有害。

en: For example, Hunt's put a 'non-GMO' label on its canned crushed tomatoes a few years ago—despite the fact that at the time there was no such thing as a GMO tomato on the market. (34 words)
cn: 例如，亨氏几年前在其罐装碎番茄上贴了‘非转基因’标签——尽管当时市场上根本没有转基因番茄这种东西。

en: Some dairy companies are using the 'non-GMO' label on their milk, despite the fact that all milk is naturally GMO-free, another label that creates unnecessary fear around food. (28 words)
cn: 一些乳制品公司在其牛奶上使用‘非转基因’标签，尽管事实上所有牛奶天然不含转基因成分——这是另一个在食品周围制造不必要恐惧的标签。

en: While creating labels that play on consumer fears and misconceptions about their food may give a company a temporary marketing advantage over competing products on the grocery aisle, in the long term this strategy will have just the opposite effect: by injecting fear into the discourse about our food, we run the risk of eroding consumer trust in not just a single product, but the entire food business. (68 words)
cn: 虽然利用消费者对食品的恐惧和误解来制作标签，可能会让公司在杂货店的竞争产品中获得暂时的营销优势，但从长远来看，这一策略将产生恰恰相反的效果：通过将恐惧注入关于我们食品的讨论中，我们冒着侵蚀消费者信任的风险——不仅是对单一产品的信任，而是对整个食品行业的信任。

en: Eventually, it becomes a question in consumers' minds: Were these foods ever safe? (13 words)
cn: 最终，这变成了消费者心中的一个问题：这些食品曾经安全过吗？

en: By purchasing and consuming these types of products, have I already done some kind of harm to my family or the planet? (22 words)
cn: 通过购买和消费这些类型的产品，我已经对我的家人或地球造成了某种伤害吗？

en: For food manufacturers, it will mean damaged consumer trust and lower sales for everyone. (14 words)
cn: 对食品制造商来说，这将意味着消费者信任受损和所有人的销售额下降。

en: And this isn't just supposition. (5 words)
cn: 而这不仅仅是推测。

en: A recent study found that absence claims labels can create a stigma around foods even when there is no scientific evidence that they cause harm. (25 words)
cn: 最近的一项研究发现，即使没有科学证据表明食品会造成伤害，‘缺失性声称’标签也会在食品周围制造污名。

en: It's clear that food manufacturers must tread carefully when it comes to using absence claims. (15 words)
cn: 很明显，食品制造商在使用‘缺失性声称’时必须谨慎行事。

en: In addition to the likely negative long-term impact on sales, this verbal trick sends a message that innovations in farming and food processing are unwelcome, eventually leading to less efficiency, fewer choices for consumers, and ultimately, more costly food products. (40 words)
cn: 除了可能对销售产生的长期负面影响外，这种文字把戏还传达了一个信息，即农业和食品加工领域的创新不受欢迎，最终导致效率降低、消费者选择减少，并最终导致食品价格上涨。

en: If we allow this kind of labeling to continue, we will all lose. (13 words)
cn: 如果我们允许这种标签继续下去，我们都将成为输家。

en: According to psychologist Sharon Draper, our clothing choices can absolutely affect our well-being. (13 words)
cn: 根据心理学家莎伦·德雷珀的说法，我们的服装选择绝对会影响我们的身心健康。

en: When we wear ill-fitting clothes, or feel over- or under-dressed for an event, it's natural to feel self-conscious or even stressed. (21 words)
cn: 当我们穿着不合身的衣服，或者对某个场合感到穿得过于正式或过于随意时，很自然地会感到不自在甚至压力山大。

en: Conversely, she says, opting for clothes that fit well and align with your sense of style can improve your confidence. (20 words)
cn: 相反，她说，选择合身且符合你个人风格的服装可以提升你的自信。

en: But can you improve your health through your current clothing, without having to dash out and buy a whole new wardrobe? (21 words)
cn: 但是，你能通过现有的服装来改善健康，而不必冲出去买一整套全新的行头吗？

en: Absolutely, says Draper. (3 words)
cn: 德雷珀说：‘当然可以。’

en: If your goal is to improve your thinking, she recommends picking clothes that fit well and are unlikely to encourage restlessness, so, avoid bows, ties and unnecessary accessories. (28 words)
cn: 如果你的目标是改善思维，她建议选择合身且不太可能引起躁动的衣服，因此要避免蝴蝶结、领带和不必要的配饰。

en: It also helps to opt for clothes you perceive as tying in with your goals, so, if you want to perform better at work, select pieces you view as professional. (30 words)
cn: 选择你认为与目标相符的衣服也有帮助，所以如果你想在工作中表现得更好，就选择你认为专业的服装。

en: Draper says this fits in with the concept of behavioral activation, whereby engaging in a behavior (in this case, selecting clothes) can set you on the path to then achieving your goals (working harder). (34 words)
cn: 德雷珀说，这与行为激活的概念相符，即参与某种行为（在这里是选择衣服）可以让你走上实现目标（更努力工作）的道路。

en: Another way to improve your frame of mind is to mix things up. (13 words)
cn: 改善心态的另一种方式是变换花样。

en: Draper says we often feel stuck in a rut if we wear the same clothes—even if they're our favorites—thus opting for an item you don't wear often, or adding something different to an outfit, such as a hat, can positively shift your mood. (43 words)
cn: 德雷珀说，如果我们穿同样的衣服——即使是我们最喜欢的——我们常常会感到陷入常规，因此选择一件你不常穿的衣服，或者在着装中加入一些不同的东西，比如一顶帽子，可以积极地改变你的情绪。
