cn: 即使他们拥有适当的资质，他们在解释方面也往往做得很少。

en: One biologist shared an intricate analogy involving a library, books, paper, a recipe, ingredients, and a cake to explain the process behind vaccines. (23 words)
cn: 一位生物学家分享了一个复杂的类比，涉及图书馆、书籍、纸张、食谱、配料和蛋糕，来解释疫苗背后的过程。

en: Any explanation that requires a written key to keep track of what each item represents is not a clear example for public consumption. (23 words)
cn: 任何需要书面说明来追踪每个项目代表什么的解释，都不是供公众理解的清晰示例。

en: Science communication is a science in and of itself. (9 words)
cn: 科学传播本身就是一门科学。

en: It requires rigorous training and instruction. (6 words)
cn: 它需要严格的培训和指导。

en: A scientist should take communication courses that can teach a person how to identify and eliminate jargon and how to develop effective analogies to explain complex concepts. (27 words)
cn: 科学家应该参加传播课程，这些课程可以教会一个人如何识别和消除术语，以及如何开发有效的类比来解释复杂概念。

en: One cannot assume communication expertise—imagine if someone just decided that they were a physicist and started trying to contribute to the field without the necessary background. (26 words)
cn: 一个人不能假定自己拥有传播专业知识——想象一下，如果有人刚刚决定自己是物理学家，并在没有必要背景的情况下开始尝试为该领域做出贡献。

en: Doing a poor job communicating science to the public will only create confusion and widen the gap between science and society, a gap that scientists are trying to close. (29 words)
cn: 向公众传播科学做得不好，只会造成混乱，并扩大科学与社会的差距——而科学家们正试图弥合这一差距。

en: The now extinct passenger pigeon has the dubious honor of being the last species anyone ever expected to disappear. (19 words)
cn: 现已灭绝的旅鸽拥有一个令人尴尬的殊荣——它是人们最意想不到会消失的物种。

en: At one point, there were more passenger pigeons than any other species of bird. (14 words)
cn: 曾几何时，旅鸽的数量比任何其他鸟类都多。

en: Rough estimates of their population went as high as five billion and they accounted for around 40 percent of the total indigenous bird population of North America in the early 19th century. (32 words)
cn: 对其种群数量的粗略估计高达50亿只，在19世纪早期，它们约占北美本土鸟类总数的40%。

en: Despite their huge population, passenger pigeons were vulnerable to human intrusion into their nesting territory. (15 words)
cn: 尽管旅鸽数量庞大，但它们对人类侵入其筑巢领地却非常脆弱。

en: Their nests were shabby things and two weeks after the eggs hatched, the parent pigeons would abandon their offspring, leaving them to take care of themselves. (26 words)
cn: 它们的巢很简陋，而且蛋孵化两周后，亲鸽就会抛弃它们的后代，让它们自己照顾自己。

en: People discovered that these baby pigeons were really tasty, and the adult birds were also quite edible. (17 words)
cn: 人们发现这些幼鸽非常美味，成年鸽也相当可口。

en: First the Native Americans and then the transplanted Europeans came to consider the birds a great delicacy. (17 words)
cn: 先是美洲原住民，然后是移居而来的欧洲人，都开始将这些鸟视为一道美味佳肴。

en: By the 1850s, commercial trapping of passenger pigeons was proceeding at an unprecedented pace. (14 words)
cn: 到了19世纪50年代，对旅鸽的商业捕捉正以前所未有的速度进行。

en: Hundreds of thousands of the birds were being harvested every day to be made into popular pigeon pies. (18 words)
cn: 每天有数十万只鸟被捕杀，用来制作受欢迎的鸽子馅饼。

en: In addition, large tracts of the pigeons' nesting territory were being cleared away for planting crops and creating pasture land. (20 words)
cn: 此外，大片的旅鸽筑巢领地被清除，用于种植作物和开辟牧场。

en: As numerous as the passenger pigeons were, they were not an infinite resource. (13 words)
cn: 尽管旅鸽数量众多，但它们并非无限的资源。

en: By the 1880s, it was noticed that the bird population had become seriously depleted. (14 words)
cn: 到了19世纪80年代，人们注意到这种鸟类的数量已经严重枯竭。

en: The last passenger pigeons killed in the wild were shot in 1899. (12 words)
cn: 最后一批在野外被杀的旅鸽于1899年被射杀。

en: Eventually those billions and billions of birds shrank to a single remaining specimen, a passenger pigeon named Martha, who died on September 1, 1914, in captivity at the Cincinnati Zoo. (30 words)
cn: 最终，那数十亿只鸟缩减为仅存的一个标本——一只名叫玛莎的旅鸽，她于1914年9月1日在辛辛那提动物园被圈养时死亡。

en: In addition to being the end of an era, it was also the first time humans were able to exactly time the extinction of a species. (26 words)
cn: 除了标志着一个时代的终结，这也是人类第一次能够精确计时一个物种的灭绝时刻。

en: As computer coding has become an increasingly sought-after skill, more K-12 schools are working it into their curriculums. (18 words)
cn: 随着计算机编程成为越来越受欢迎的技能，更多的K-12学校正在将其纳入课程。

en: Some states have considered allowing students to forgo foreign language for coding classes, despite opposition from educators. (17 words)
cn: 尽管遭到教育工作者的反对，一些州已考虑允许学生放弃外语而选择编程课程。

en: There's a debate over whether it's appropriate to teach coding in elementary schools, with fierce opinions on each side. (19 words)
cn: 关于在小学教授编程是否合适存在争议，双方意见激烈。

en: When it comes to allowing coding to fill foreign language requirements, though, most educators agree: Coding should be added to curriculums, but not at the expense of foreign language classes. (30 words)
cn: 然而，当涉及允许编程来满足外语要求时，大多数教育者都同意：编程应被加入课程，但不能以牺牲外语课为代价。

en: The idea is that computer programming is a language, allowing people to communicate with machines and programs. (17 words)
cn: 其理念是计算机编程是一种语言，允许人们与机器和程序交流。

en: It's the language of the 21st century and more valuable than a natural language, some advocates argue. (17 words)
cn: 一些倡导者认为，它是21世纪的语言，比自然语言更有价值。

en: The computer science field is growing faster than schools can keep up because of budget constraints and a lack of skills training for teachers. (24 words)
cn: 由于预算限制和缺乏对教师的技能培训，计算机科学领域的发展速度超过了学校所能跟上的速度。

en: According to the 2016 U.S. News/Raytheon STEM Index, computer science jobs have helped boost wages in the U.S., and computer-related jobs hold the top seven positions in STEM fields for highest number of workers. (34 words)
cn: 根据2016年美国新闻/雷神STEM指数，计算机科学相关工作岗位帮助提高了美国的工资水平，在STEM领域中，计算机相关工作岗位在从业人数最多的前七个职位中占据首位。

en: Foreign language interest, on the other hand, is declining for the first time since 1995. (15 words)
cn: 另一方面，对外语的兴趣自1995年以来首次出现下降。

en: The number of higher education language enrollments declined between 2009 and 2013 by more than 111,000 spots, according to the Modern Language Association of America. (25 words)
cn: 根据美国现代语言协会的数据，2009年至2013年间，高等教育语言课程注册人数减少了超过111,000人。

en: I think the opportunity to give people a choice is important, says Florida state Senator Jeremy Ring, who introduced a bill last year that would allow Florida students to choose between foreign language and coding classes for the purpose of university admissions requirements. (43 words)
cn: 佛罗里达州参议员杰里米·林说：‘我认为给人们选择的机会很重要。’他去年提出了一项法案，允许佛罗里达州学生在大学入学要求方面在外语课和编程课之间做出选择。

en: I think if you're going to give two years of language in high school, you might as well do computer coding. (21 words)
cn: 我认为，如果要在高中开设两年语言课，那不妨也开设计算机编程课。

en: The Florida bill died this year after passing 35:5 in the state Senate when the full Legislature failed to take action. (21 words)
cn: 佛罗里达州的这项法案今年在州参议院以35:5通过后夭折，因为州立法机构未能采取行动。

en: It would have been the first state to try this initiative. (11 words)
cn: 它本应是第一个尝试这一举措的州。

en: Ring says that although he will be out of office, an identical bill will be reintroduced within the next year by others on his behalf. (25 words)
cn: 林说，虽然他将离任，但其他人将在明年内代表他重新提出一项相同的法案。

en: In the speech I gave on the Senate floor, I said, 'We can be the first state to do this, or we can be the 50th state to do it. (30 words)
cn: 他在参议院发表的演说中说：‘我们可以成为第一个这样做的州，也可以成为第五十个这样做的州。’

en: It's our choice. (3 words)
cn: 这是我们的选择。

en: It's going to happen,' Ring says. (6 words)
cn: 林说：‘这一定会发生。’

en: A Kentucky bill similar to the one in Florida was met with complaints from educators, and was then amended to promote computer science education initiatives with no mention of foreign language requirements. (32 words)
cn: 肯塔基州一项与佛罗里达州类似的法案遭到了教育者的反对，随后被修改为促进计算机科学教育倡议，未提及外语要求。

en: Instead, the state will provide support for higher quality certified teachers for programming classes. (14 words)
cn: 相反，该州将为编程课程提供更高质量认证教师的支持。

en: Under the Washington bill, public universities would accept two years of computer science classes in place of two years of foreign language for admission purposes. (25 words)
cn: 根据华盛顿州的法案，公立大学在招生时将接受两年的计算机科学课程代替两年的外语课程。

en: A report detailing the opinions of state university officials is due to the Legislature by November 2017. (17 words)
cn: 一份详细说明州立大学官员意见的报告应于2017年11月之前提交给立法机构。

en: Texas passed a bill in 2013 that allows students to substitute computer coding only after they have attempted and performed poorly in a foreign language class. (26 words)
cn: 德克萨斯州于2013年通过了一项法案，允许学生只有在尝试过外语课且表现不佳之后，才能用计算机编程代替。

en: Srini Mandyam, CTO and co-founder of kid-friendly instructional coding company Tynker, believes allowing students to forgo foreign language because they struggle with it is unproductive because every subject, whether art, math or language, is a significant contribution to a well-rounded existence. (41 words)
cn: 儿童编程教学公司Tynker的首席技术官兼联合创始人斯里尼·曼迪亚姆认为，允许学生因为在外语学习上吃力而放弃外语是徒劳无益的，因为每一门学科，无论是艺术、数学还是语言，都对全面发展有着重要贡献。

en: Many students don't fare well with algebra but we never discuss eliminating it or... say chemistry is now counted as an algebra class, he said via email. (27 words)
cn: 他在电子邮件中说：‘许多学生代数学得不好，但我们从不讨论取消代数……或者说化学现在被算作代数课。’

en: We teach algebra because it's important and we should teach foreign language and coding for the same reason. (18 words)
cn: 我们教代数是因为它很重要，出于同样的原因，我们也应该教外语和编程。

en: Exposure to a wide breadth of subjects and material results in well-rounded students who are able to make informed decisions... about what they want to pursue. (26 words)
cn: 广泛接触各种学科和知识领域能培养出全面发展的学生，使他们能够就自己想要追求的目标做出明智的决定。

en: Computer science courses already fulfill a math or science high school graduation requirement in 28 states and the District of Columbia, up from only 12 states in 2013. (28 words)
cn: 计算机科学课程已经在28个州和哥伦比亚特区满足了高中毕业的数学或科学要求，而2013年只有12个州。

en: And while advocates of the bills say they should count as foreign language instead, opponents stress the importance of balancing computer and foreign language skills. (25 words)
cn: 虽然法案的倡导者说它们应被算作外语，但反对者强调平衡计算机技能和外语技能的重要性。

en: Studies show that bilingualism correlates with cognitive development, intelligence, memory and problem solving abilities, according to the American Council on the Teaching of Foreign Languages. (25 words)
cn: 根据美国外语教学委员会的研究，双语能力与认知发展、智力、记忆力和解决问题的能力相关。

en: A 2007 study showed that foreign language students outperformed their non-foreign language peers on standardized tests after only two to three years of study. (24 words)
cn: 2007年的一项研究表明，外语学生在仅学习两到三年后，在标准化考试中的表现就超过了没有学习外语的同龄人。

en: And while a 2014 report from German and American universities suggests that programmers are using language (but not mathematical) regions of the brain when understanding code, critics remain wary. (29 words)
cn: 虽然2014年德国和美国大学的一份报告表明，程序员在理解代码时使用的是大脑的语言区域（而非数学区域），但批评者仍持谨慎态度。

en: They say that regardless of cognitive functions, being monolingual is a disadvantage in the increasingly international economy, even if English has become the de facto language of business. (28 words)
cn: 他们表示，无论认知功能如何，在日益国际化的经济中，只掌握一门语言是一种劣势，即使英语已成为事实上的商业语言。

en: Our world is shrinking but its problems are really growing, says ACTFL National Language Teacher of the Year Ted Zarrow, who teaches high school Latin in Westwood, Massachusetts, and has also studied Spanish, French, German, Italian and Greek. (38 words)
cn: 美国外语教学委员会年度国家语言教师泰德·扎罗说：‘我们的世界在缩小，但问题却在真正增长。’他在马萨诸塞州韦斯特伍德教高中拉丁语，也学过西班牙语、法语、德语、意大利语和希腊语。

en: We need to find a way to put ourselves at the global table and to treat each other with mutual respect. (21 words)
cn: 我们需要找到一种方式，让自己坐到全球谈判桌上，并以相互尊重的方式对待彼此。

en: And learning languages allows us to do that because language is not part of culture, language is culture. (18 words)
cn: 学习语言让我们能够做到这一点，因为语言不是文化的一部分，语言就是文化。

en: Even with the benefits and skill sets languages provide, recruiters and employers value computer skills more. (16 words)
cn: 尽管语言提供了诸多好处和技能，但招聘人员和雇主更看重计算机技能。

en: According to the National Association of Colleges and Employers' 2016 report, study abroad and foreign language fluency were not very influential in the employee hiring processes, but 55 percent of employers looked for computer skills on applicants' resumes. (38 words)
cn: 根据全美大学与雇主协会2016年的报告，出国留学经历和外语流利度在员工招聘过程中影响力不大，但55%的雇主会在应聘者的简历中寻找计算机技能。

en: However, although 2016 computer science graduates can expect to make the second highest starting salary compared with other jobs this year, the Bureau of Labor predicts the demand for computer programmers will decrease 8 percent or by 26,500 jobs by 2024. (41 words)
cn: 然而，尽管2016年计算机科学毕业生的起薪预计位居各行业第二，但劳工局预测，到2024年，对计算机程序员的总体需求将下降8%，即减少26,500个工作岗位。

en: Ring says foreign language skills are important, but expresses doubt that school districts could work both coding and language into their curriculum in a significant way because they lack the time in the school day. (35 words)
cn: 林说外语技能很重要，但他对学区是否能在课程中充分安排编程和语言课程表示怀疑，因为他们在上学日缺乏时间。

en: Nothing against language, he says. (5 words)
cn: 他说：‘我并不反对语言学习。’

en: I just think it's something you have to start early and not just have something that you do for a couple of years in high school, he says. (28 words)
cn: 他说：‘我只是认为语言学习必须从小开始，而不仅仅是在高中花几年时间去学。’

en: Zarrow agrees that foreign language education should begin earlier, but says it is possible to work both computer programming and foreign language learning into schools evenly. (26 words)
cn: 扎罗同意外语教育应该更早开始，但他表示，学校可以均衡地安排计算机编程和外语学习。

en: He suggests an immersive, dual language program where students spend half the day in English and half the day in another language, as several schools around the country have successfully implemented. (31 words)
cn: 他建议采用沉浸式双语项目，让学生一半时间用英语，另一半时间用另一种语言，就像全国几所学校已成功实施的那样。

en: The study of language fosters a respect for diversity, a respect for ethnicity and really a respect for language, Zarrow says. (21 words)
cn: 扎罗说：‘语言学习能培养对多样性的尊重、对族裔的尊重，实际上也是对语言的尊重。’

en: Though the benefits of computer programming skills are vast, foreign language and coding experts agree that computer science should be negotiated into curriculums rather than replacing foreign language outright. (29 words)
cn: 尽管计算机编程技能的好处很多，但外语和编程专家一致认为，计算机科学应通过协商纳入课程，而不是直接取代外语。

en: Mandyam says the two skill sets are essential but unrelated. (10 words)
cn: 曼迪亚姆说，这两种技能都必不可少，但互不相关。

en: Coding is an incredibly important 21st century skill for our kids to learn, and that's why we spend so much time trying to teach it, Mandyam says via email. (29 words)
cn: 曼迪亚姆在电子邮件中说：‘编程是21世纪孩子们需要学习的一项极其重要的技能，这就是为什么我们花这么多时间试图去教它。’

en: But I believe it is the same as or even really comparable to learning a foreign language. (17 words)
cn: 但我认为它和外语学习是相同的，或者说甚至真的可以与外语学习相媲美。

en: It would be a shame to lose something so important for the sake of adding something else, even something as important as coding. (23 words)
cn: 为了增加其他东西——即使是像编程一样重要的东西——而失去如此重要的东西，那将是令人遗憾的。

en: Clearly, education leaders must figure out a way to teach both. (11 words)
cn: 显然，教育领导者必须找到一种方法来同时教授两者。

en: The U.S. and China don't agree on much these days. (10 words)
cn: 如今，美国和中国在很多问题上意见不一。

en: Germany and France share a border and a currency but are frequently at odds. (14 words)
cn: 德国和法国共享边界和货币，但经常意见相左。

en: The U.K. and India like to march to their own drum. (11 words)
cn: 英国和印度喜欢走自己的路。

en: But there's one issue on which all these countries see eye to eye: Technology companies are too big, too powerful, and too profitable. (23 words)
cn: 但在一个问题上，所有这些国家都看法一致：科技公司规模太大、力量太强、利润太高。

en: And that power is only likely to intensify, leaving governments with no choice but to confront it head-on by taking the companies to court, passing new competition laws, and perhaps even breaking up the tech giants. (36 words)
cn: 而这种力量只会进一步增强，迫使各国政府别无选择，只能正面应对——通过起诉这些公司、通过新的竞争法，甚至可能拆分科技巨头。

en: China is the latest to implement an anti-trust crackdown, unveiling anti-monopoly rules last month. (14 words)
cn: 中国是最新实施反垄断打击的国家，上个月公布了反垄断规则。

en: The draft rules followed the surprise suspension of a $37 billion stock offering by billionaire Jack Ma's Ant Group Co., making clear that no company can evade the government's regulation. (30 words)
cn: 这些规则草案是在亿万富翁马云的蚂蚁集团突然被暂停370亿美元股票发行之后出台的，明确表明没有任何公司可以逃避政府的监管。

en: The moves in China coincide with accelerating efforts in the U.S. and Europe to rein in Amazon, Apple, Facebook, and Google. (21 words)
cn: 中国的这些举措恰逢美国和欧洲加快对亚马逊、苹果、Facebook和谷歌的约束力度。

en: The big get bigger and bigger but without being better, says Andreas Schwab, a German member of the European Parliament who championed a 2014 resolution to break up Google. (29 words)
cn: 欧洲议会德国议员安德烈亚斯·施瓦布说：‘大公司变得越来越大，但并没有变得更好。’他曾在2014年支持一项拆分谷歌的决议。

en: Growing economic power, growing influence on local markets all over the world, and a growing concern of competitors and consumers altogether have made it happen now. (26 words)
cn: 不断增长的经济实力、对世界各地本地市场日益增长的影响力，以及竞争对手和消费者日益增长的担忧，所有这些因素共同促成了现在这一局面。

en: In this new anti-trust era, the old focus on pricing power no longer applies, because several of the biggest tech companies have established trillion-dollar monopolies by charging consumers next to nothing. (31 words)
cn: 在这个新的反垄断时代，过去对定价权的关注不再适用，因为几家最大的科技公司通过向消费者收取几乎为零的费用，建立了价值万亿美元的垄断。

en: Tech giants are increasingly assuming powerful positions in banking, finance, advertising, retail, and other markets that force smaller businesses to rely on their platforms to reach customers. (27 words)
cn: 科技巨头在银行、金融、广告、零售和其他市场中占据着越来越强大的地位，迫使小型企业依赖它们的平台来接触客户。

en: For years, Europe alone confronted the power of digital giants. (10 words)
cn: 多年来，欧洲独自面对数字巨头的力量。

en: Governments were alarmed that European companies were failing to match Silicon Valley's innovations or to stop Google and Facebook from vacuuming up personal data and, with that, advertising revenue. (29 words)
cn: 各国政府感到震惊的是，欧洲公司未能跟上硅谷的创新步伐，也未能阻止谷歌和Facebook大量收集个人数据，并由此获取广告收入。

en: Led by Margrethe Vestager, the European Union's competition chief, countries have sought to police the market and encourage fair play. (20 words)
cn: 在欧盟竞争事务负责人玛格丽特·维斯塔格的领导下，各国已开始寻求监管市场并鼓励公平竞争。

en: In China the crackdown has been driven at least partly by fear that the homegrown tech industry is becoming too powerful. (21 words)
cn: 在中国，这次打击行动至少部分原因是担心本土科技行业变得过于强大。

en: The country has long championed Alibaba and Tencent, but their massive accumulation of data on the Chinese citizenry is a growing concern for Beijing. (24 words)
cn: 该国长期以来一直支持阿里巴巴和腾讯，但它们对中国公民数据的大量积累正日益引起北京方面的担忧。

en: In the U.S., a new breed of anti-trust experts argues that consideration should be given to privacy, control over data, workers' rights, and the overall impact on smaller companies. (29 words)
cn: 在美国，新一代反垄断专家认为，应考虑隐私、数据控制、工人权利以及对小型企业的整体影响。

en: And the public in general have grown increasingly skeptical of social media companies. (13 words)
cn: 而且普通公众对社交媒体公司也日益持怀疑态度。

en: More than 60% say the sector has a negative effect on the country, and almost half want more regulation for social media, according to a 2020 Pew Research Center study. (30 words)
cn: 根据皮尤研究中心2020年的一项研究，超过60%的人认为该行业对国家有负面影响，近一半的人希望对社交媒体加强监管。

en: Born from the accessibility of mass air travel, modern international tourism has been popularized as 'holiday-making' in regions that offer comparative advantages of sand, sun and sea. (27 words)
cn: 现代国际旅游业源于大众航空旅行的普及，在拥有沙滩、阳光和海洋比较优势的地区被推广为‘度假’活动。

en: Travel is often portrayed as a tool for personal growth and tourism as an economic motor for destination countries and cities. (21 words)
cn: 旅行常被描绘为个人成长的工具，旅游业则被视为目的地国家和城市的经济引擎。

en: There is a tendency to assume that tourism is good for everyone involved. (13 words)
cn: 人们有一种倾向认为旅游业对所有相关方都有利。

en: Today the big bang of tourism drives over 1.2 billion tourists across international borders annually. (15 words)
cn: 如今，旅游业的大爆炸每年推动超过12亿游客跨越国际边境。

en: Many popular places are literally being loved to death. (9 words)
cn: 许多热门地方真的正被爱到毁灭。

en: Recent protests in ports of call like Venice and Barcelona against disturbances created by cruise ships show the unfortunate consequences of emphasizing quantity over quality in tourism. (27 words)
cn: 最近在威尼斯和巴塞罗那等停靠港针对游轮造成的干扰而爆发的抗议活动，表明了旅游业中重数量轻质量的不幸后果。

en: Uncontrolled tourism development has become a primary driver of social and environmental disruption. (13 words)
cn: 不受控制的旅游业发展已成为社会和环境破坏的主要驱动力。

en: Tourism studies provide much documentation of the many negative social impacts of tourism and resulting resentment that local populations direct toward visitors. (22 words)
cn: 旅游研究提供了许多关于旅游业负面社会影响的文献，以及由此产生的当地居民对游客的怨恨。

en: Antagonism toward tourists typically develops in mature, heavily visited destinations. (10 words)
cn: 对游客的敌对情绪通常出现在成熟、游客众多的目的地。

en: Protests in heavily visited destinations suggest that traditional tourism has overstayed its welcome. (13 words)
cn: 在游客众多的目的地爆发的抗议表明，传统旅游业已不受欢迎。

en: Residents often become frustrated when the benefits of tourism are not felt locally. (13 words)
cn: 当旅游业带来的好处不能在本地感受到时，居民往往会感到沮丧。

en: Although it can generate foreign exchange, income and employment, there's no guarantee that multinational hotel chains will allocate these benefits equitably among local communities. (24 words)
cn: 尽管旅游业能产生外汇、收入和就业，但不能保证跨国连锁酒店会将这些收益公平地分配给当地社区。

en: On the contrary, when people stay at large resorts or on cruise ships, they make most of their purchases there, leaving local communities little opportunity to benefit from tourist spending. (30 words)
cn: 相反，当人们入住大型度假村或游轮时，他们的大部分消费都在那里进行，当地社区几乎没有机会从游客消费中受益。

en: These forms of tourism widen economic and political gaps between haves and have-nots at local destinations. (16 words)
cn: 这些形式的旅游业扩大了旅游目的地当地富人与穷人之间的经济和政治差距。

en: In recent decades, local residents in destination communities also have found themselves negotiating new cultural boundaries, class dynamics, service industry roles and lifestyle transformations. (24 words)
cn: 近几十年来，目的地社区的当地居民也发现自己正在应对新的文化界限、阶级动态、服务业角色和生活方式的转变。

en: For example, data show that tourism activity corresponds to increased social problems as local residents adopt the behaviors of tourists. (20 words)
cn: 例如，数据显示，随着当地居民采纳游客的行为，旅游活动与日益增多的社会问题相对应。

en: What does all this mean for the everyday traveler? (9 words)
cn: 这一切对普通游客意味着什么？

en: First, all tourists should make every effort to honor their hosts and respect local conditions. (15 words)
cn: 首先，所有游客都应尽力尊重当地主人和当地条件。

en: This means being prepared to adapt to local customs and norms, rather than expecting local conditions to adapt to travelers. (20 words)
cn: 这意味着要做好适应当地习俗和规范的准备，而不是期望当地条件去适应游客。

en: Second, tourism is a market-based activity and works best when consumers reward better performers. (14 words)
cn: 其次，旅游业是一种市场导向的活动，当消费者奖励表现更好的企业时，它才能发挥最大作用。

en: In the information age, there's little excuse for travelers being uninformed about where their vacation money goes and who it enriches. (21 words)
cn: 在信息时代，游客对其度假资金流向何方、使谁受益缺乏了解是没有什么借口的。

en: Informed travelers also are better able to distinguish between multinational companies and local entrepreneurs whose businesses provide direct social, environmental, and economic benefits for local residents. (26 words)
cn: 知情游客也更能区分跨国公司那些业务为当地居民带来直接社会、环境和经济利益的本地企业家。

en: Such businesses are in love with the destination and are therefore deserving of market reward. (15 words)
cn: 这些企业热爱目的地，因此值得获得市场回报。

en: In the long run, being a responsible traveler means ensuring net positive impacts for local people and environments. (18 words)
cn: 从长远来看，做一个负责任的旅行者意味着确保对当地人民和环境产生净积极影响。

en: With the information available at our fingertips, there has never been more opportunity to do so. (16 words)
cn: 随着信息触手可及，我们从未有过如此多的机会来做到这一点。

en: During the summer, when I was a visiting poet at a residency out of state, an angry, confused woman wandered into my class and said: "I have three guns and I want to use them." (35 words)
cn: 那年夏天，我在外州的一个驻留项目担任访问诗人时，一个愤怒、困惑的女人走进我的课堂说：“我有三把枪，我想用它们。”

en: We all froze. (3 words)
cn: 我们都惊呆了。

en: It was not clear if she had the guns, but we each know that, when we teach in America, we are already in danger. (24 words)
cn: 当时并不清楚她是否真的有枪，但我们都知道，在美国教书，我们本身就处于危险之中。

en: I was dizzy with fear. (5 words)
cn: 我因恐惧而感到头晕目眩。

en: The woman, who later turned out to be a schizophrenic without access to her medications, was, by some force, wrestled out and escorted away, then put in a hospital for observation, in a step that was actually safer for everyone than any one of us pressing charges. (47 words)
cn: 后来发现，这名女子是一名精神分裂症患者，当时无法获得药物。她被几个人强行扭送出去并押送离开，随后被送往医院观察——这一做法其实比我们任何一个人提出指控都要对所有人都更安全。

en: My class went on; we talked about poems. (8 words)
cn: 我的课继续上着；我们谈论诗歌。

en: But despite the fact that the rest of our days on campus passed peacefully, I was rattled. (17 words)
cn: 尽管我们在校园里的剩余日子都平静地过去了，但我仍然心有余悸。

en: I could not shake the sense that in this country we always live at overriding risk. (16 words)
cn: 我无法摆脱这样一种感觉：在这个国家，我们始终生活在巨大的风险之中。

en: A few months later, crisis struck again. (7 words)
cn: 几个月后，危机再次降临。

en: While my husband was locking his bike to drop off our 3-year-old daughter for her preschool-aged day camp, a different woman approached. (22 words)
cn: 当我丈夫正在锁自行车，准备送我们3岁的女儿去学前日间夏令营时，另一个女人走了过来。

en: Swiftly and for no apparent reason, she bent down, picked up our daughter, and began to carry her down the street. (21 words)
cn: 她迅速且毫无明显缘由地弯下腰，抱起我们的女儿，开始沿着街道把她抱走。

en: It was so fast and confusing that my daughter barely cried. (11 words)
cn: 一切发生得如此之快且令人困惑，以至于我女儿几乎没来得及哭出声。

en: My husband, in a burst of speed, chased the woman and reclaimed our daughter. (14 words)
cn: 我丈夫以极快的速度冲上去，追上了那个女人，并夺回了我们的女儿。

en: The woman, clearly confused, retreated into the public library. (9 words)
cn: 那个女人显然神志不清，退进了公共图书馆。

en: A network of homeless people who generally know the other homeless in the area said they did not recognize the woman. (21 words)
cn: 一个由流浪者组成的网络——他们通常认识该地区的其他流浪者——表示他们不认识这个女人。

en: The woman was so clearly unwell that when she was taken into custody she was incoherent. (16 words)
cn: 这个女人明显状态很差，在被拘留时语无伦次。

en: Heartbreakingly, she called our daughter by the name of someone else's child. (12 words)
cn: 令人心碎的是，她用别人家孩子的名字来称呼我们的女儿。

en: Each part of the episode was haunting as it was terrifying. (11 words)
cn: 这段经历的每一个部分都既令人难以释怀，又令人恐惧。

en: Michael Wardian pushed forward into the penetrating arctic wind, fighting the urge to speed up. (15 words)
cn: 迈克尔·沃迪安迎着刺骨的北极风奋力前行，强忍着加速的冲动。

en: Too much effort and he would begin to sweat, which, he was told, would only increase the risk of hypothermia. (20 words)
cn: 用力过猛他就会开始出汗，而有人告诉他，出汗只会增加体温过低的风险。

en: At the 2014 North Pole Marathon, the temperature dipped to minus-22 degrees F, with a wind chill that made it feel even colder. (23 words)
cn: 在2014年的北极马拉松赛中，气温降至零下22华氏度，风寒效应让体感温度更加寒冷。

en: Along the route, armed guards wandered the large sheets of floating ice to minimize the risk of polar bear attacks. (20 words)
cn: 沿途，武装警卫在巨大的浮冰上巡逻，以最大限度地降低北极熊袭击的风险。

en: I like to do stuff that scares me, Wardian said. (10 words)
cn: 沃迪安说：“我喜欢做让自己害怕的事情。”

en: With ice frozen to his beard, Wardian crossed the finish line that April afternoon in a winning time of 4 hours 7 minutes and 40 seconds, almost two hours slower than his personal best over 26.2 miles. (37 words)
cn: 那个四月的下午，胡子冻成冰的沃迪安以4小时7分40秒的获胜成绩冲过终点线，这比他个人在26.2英里赛程中的最好成绩慢了将近两个小时。

en: The race for Wardian, however, was less about the result than overcoming his aversion to the cold. (17 words)
cn: 然而，对沃迪安来说，这场比赛与其说是关于结果，不如说是克服他对寒冷的厌恶。

en: In a few days, Wardian will once again compete in an unfamiliar territory and below-freezing temperatures. (16 words)
cn: 几天后，沃迪安将再次在陌生的地域和零下的温度中参赛。

en: He will line up Monday in Antarctica for the first leg of the World Marathon Challenge---joining 32 other adventure seekers on an unusual journey where participants travel through different time zones and climates to run seven marathons on seven continents in seven days. (43 words)
cn: 他将于周一在南极洲排队参加世界马拉松挑战赛的第一站——与另外32名冒险者一起踏上一段不同寻常的旅程，参与者们穿越不同的时区和气候，在七天之内在七大洲跑七场马拉松。

en: An elite ultra-runner, Wardian has his sights on breaking the event's record average marathon time of 3:32:25 set last January by U.S. Marine Corps captain Daniel Cartica. (27 words)
cn: 作为一名精英超级马拉松跑者，沃迪安的目标是打破去年1月由美国海军陆战队上尉丹尼尔·卡蒂卡创造的3小时32分25秒的赛事平均马拉松纪录。

en: Wardian, a 42-year-old Arlington resident, is a record-breaking racer, known in the ultra-running community for seeking tough courses and setting world records. (22 words)
cn: 42岁的阿林顿居民沃迪安是一名打破纪录的跑者，在超级马拉松圈子里以挑战艰难赛道和创造世界纪录而闻名。

en: Last year, he ran 1,254.65 miles in 47 races. (9 words)
cn: 去年，他在47场比赛中跑了1,254.65英里。

en: The World Marathon Challenge, like most of Wardian's running goals, will be about pushing his limits. (16 words)
cn: 世界马拉松挑战赛，正如沃迪安的大多数跑步目标一样，将关乎突破他的极限。

en: I love diverse and unique challenges, he said. (8 words)
cn: 他说：“我喜欢多样化和独特的挑战。”

en: I am definitely interested in seeing what I can handle and what my body can accept. (16 words)
cn: 我对看看自己能承受什么、身体能接受什么非常感兴趣。

en: That drives me. (3 words)
cn: 那是我前进的动力。

en: Something about the way Richard Donovan carried himself appealed to Wardian. (11 words)
cn: 理查德·多诺万的举止中某种特质吸引了沃迪安。

en: Perhaps it was the sense of adventure Donovan displayed when they first met at the 2010 50K Championships in Galway, Ireland, where Donovan was the race director. (27 words)
cn: 也许是因为他们在2010年爱尔兰戈尔韦的50公里锦标赛上初次见面时，多诺万表现出的冒险精神——当时多诺万是赛事总监。

en: The two hit it off, and soon Wardian was participating in Donovan's events. (13 words)
cn: 两人一拍即合，很快沃迪安就开始参加多诺万组织的赛事。

en: It was at the North Pole Marathon, a race that Donovan organizes, that Wardian first heard about the Irishman's plan for the World Marathon Challenge-a challenge that Donovan himself completed in 2009 and 2012. (34 words)
cn: 正是在北极马拉松——多诺万组织的一项赛事——上，沃迪安第一次听说了这位爱尔兰人的世界马拉松挑战赛计划——多诺万本人曾在2009年和2012年完成过这项挑战。

en: I knew that many people had a goal of running seven marathons on seven continents during any time period, Donovan, 50, said. (22 words)
cn: 50岁的多诺万说：“我知道很多人都有在任何时间段内跑完七大洲七场马拉松的目标。”

en: I felt the natural extension to this idea would be to try to achieve it within a seven-day period. (19 words)
cn: 我觉得这个想法自然而然的延伸就是尝试在七天内完成它。

en: Wardian started saving for the trip in 2014, connecting with sponsors and getting approval from his wife, Jennifer, before committing. (20 words)
cn: 沃迪安在2014年开始为这次旅行攒钱，联系赞助商，并在承诺之前获得了妻子詹妮弗的同意。

en: Registration for the event costs 36,000 euros, which covers international charter flights to each of the seven marathon locations: Union Glacier (Antarctica), Punta Arenas, Chile (South America), Miami (North America), Madrid (Europe), Marrakesh, Morocco (Africa), Dubai (Asia) and Sydney (Australia). (40 words)
cn: 该赛事的报名费为36,000欧元，涵盖前往七个马拉松地点——联合冰川（南极洲）、智利蓬塔阿雷纳斯（南美洲）、迈阿密（北美洲）、马德里（欧洲）、摩洛哥马拉喀什（非洲）、迪拜（亚洲）和悉尼（澳大利亚）——的国际包机费用。

en: The challenge is a test of both physical strength and mental fitness. (12 words)
cn: 这项挑战既是对体力的考验，也是对心理素质的考验。

en: Sleeping on a crammed plane, adjusting to different time zones and finding food to eat (Wardian is a vegetarian) would make it an exhausting trip over a month, let alone a week. (32 words)
cn: 在拥挤的飞机上睡觉、适应不同的时区以及寻找食物（沃迪安是素食者）——这些即便是用一个月的行程来完成也会令人筋疲力尽，更不用说一周了。

en: The key to a race like this is getting comfortable being uncomfortable, said Becca Pizzi, last year's women's champion. (19 words)
cn: 去年的女子冠军贝卡·皮齐说：“像这样的比赛，关键在于习惯于不舒适的状态。”

en: The highs of the race are incredibly high, and the lows incredibly low. (13 words)
cn: 比赛的高潮令人难以置信地高昂，而低谷也令人难以置信地低落。

en: Since turning it into an organized event in 2015, Donovan has attracted a variety of runners. (16 words)
cn: 自2015年将其组织成正式赛事以来，多诺万吸引了各种各样的跑者。

en: This year's challenge will feature a far more elite field, which includes Ryan Hall, America's fastest marathon runner. (18 words)
cn: 今年的挑战赛将拥有一个更为精英的阵容，其中包括美国最快的马拉松跑者瑞安·霍尔。

en: Despite his proven track record, Hall said he has no time goals and that he still suffers from the same fatigue issues that forced him to leave the professional ranks in 2015. (32 words)
cn: 尽管霍尔有着辉煌的过往成绩，但他说自己没有时间目标，并且仍然受到那些在2015年迫使他退出职业选手行列的疲劳问题的困扰。

en: Hall plans to run with his friend, Pastor Matthew Barnett of The Dream Center in Los Angeles-one of the six American men who will be competing. (26 words)
cn: 霍尔计划与他的朋友——洛杉矶梦想中心的牧师马修·巴内特一起跑，巴内特是六位参赛的美国男性之一。

en: I do not expect to run a step with Mike, but I will be excited to see how he does, said the 34-year-old Hall, who began weight-lifting after retiring. (29 words)
cn: 34岁的霍尔在退役后开始举重训练，他说：“我不指望能和迈克一起跑一步，但我会很兴奋地看他表现如何。”

en: If I finish within an hour of him in each marathon, I would be surprised. (15 words)
cn: 如果我每场马拉松完赛时间与他的差距在一小时以内，我会感到惊讶。

en: Instead, 43-year-old Petr Vabrousek, an elite Czech Ironman champion, is expected to be Wardian's closest challenger. (16 words)
cn: 相反，43岁的捷克铁人三项冠军彼得·瓦布罗塞克预计将成为沃迪安最有力的挑战者。

en: To others on the trip, simply finishing will be its own reward. (12 words)
cn: 对于这次旅程中的其他人来说，仅仅完成比赛本身就是一种奖赏。

en: Sinead Kane of Ireland is aiming to become the first blind person to complete the challenge. (16 words)
cn: 爱尔兰的希内德·凯恩的目标是成为第一位完成这项挑战的盲人。

en: And Beth Ann Telford, a 47-year-old federal government worker from Fairfax and the only American female in this year's mix, is using the event as a platform to raise money for cancer research. (33 words)
cn: 而47岁的贝丝·安·特尔福德——来自费尔法克斯的联邦政府工作人员，也是今年参赛者中唯一的美国女性——正利用这项赛事作为为癌症研究筹集资金的平台。

en: It is a cause with a personal connection to Telford, who was diagnosed with brain cancer in 2004. (18 words)
cn: 这项事业与特尔福德有着个人关联——她在2004年被诊断出患有脑癌。

en: Doing something like this is definitely the hardest challenge that I have ever done except for the chemotherapy and brain surgery, she said. (23 words)
cn: 她说：“做这样的事情绝对是我做过的最艰难的挑战，除了化疗和脑部手术之外。”

en: It is going to raise awareness...I just wanted to do something that is epic and this certainly is right up there. (21 words)
cn: 它将提高人们的意识……我只是想做一件了不起的事情，而这绝对算得上一件。

en: Wardian, too, hopes his involvement will give him a platform to promote a cause. (14 words)
cn: 沃迪安也希望自己的参与能为他提供一个推广某项事业的平台。

en: He recently became an ambassador for the United Nations Women's HeForShe initiative to fight inequalities faced by women and girls worldwide. (21 words)
cn: 他最近成为了联合国妇女署“他为她”倡议的倡导者，该倡议旨在对抗全球妇女和女童面临的不平等。

en: On a chilly December afternoon, Wardian wove through Washington's crowded sidewalks on the way home from his full-time job as an international ship broker. (24 words)
cn: 在一个寒冷的十二月下午，沃迪安在从全职工作（国际船舶经纪人）下班的路上，穿梭于华盛顿拥挤的人行道上。

en: His elastic, 6-foot frame bounced gently and efficiently off the ground with each step of the hilly six-mile trip back to Arlington. (22 words)
cn: 他6英尺高、富有弹性的身躯，在回阿林顿那六英里起伏路程的每一步中，都轻盈而高效地弹离地面。

en: This is a daily routine during the week for Wardian, who started racing professionally in 2003 and runs seven days a week, often multiple times a day. (27 words)
cn: 这是沃迪安工作日的日常，他从2003年开始职业跑步，每周跑七天，经常一天跑多次。

en: When he travels, he prefers to explore new places on his feet. (12 words)
cn: 出差时，他更喜欢用双脚探索新的地方。

en: But in some ways, Wardian still has trouble thinking of himself as a runner. (14 words)
cn: 但在某些方面，沃迪安仍然难以把自己看作一个跑者。

en: For the majority of his childhood, Wardian devoted his energy to becoming a Division I lacrosse player-a dream he realized when he was recruited to play at Michigan State University. (30 words)
cn: 在童年的大部分时间里，沃迪安都把精力投入到成为一名一级长曲棍球运动员上——这个梦想在他被密歇根州立大学招募时得以实现。

en: Once he decides to do something, he just works at it until he does it, Michael's younger sister, Mariele, said. (20 words)
cn: 迈克尔的妹妹玛丽埃尔说：“一旦他决定做某件事，他就会一直努力直到做成。”

en: Once he decides to do it, it is usually something that is going to happen. (15 words)
cn: 一旦他决定去做，那通常就是一定会发生的事情。

en: He has always been like that. (6 words)
cn: 他一直都是那样。

en: He is a very motivated individual. (6 words)
cn: 他是一个非常有动力的人。

en: It was only a year or so ago that Wardian realized that he had been a runner longer than a lacrosse player. (22 words)
cn: 大约就在一年前，沃迪安才意识到他做跑者的时间已经比做长曲棍球运动员的时间更长了。

en: It was not until he ran in the 2004 U.S. Olympic Marathon Trials ---the first of three for Wardian-that he felt that he was a legitimate runner. (27 words)
cn: 直到他参加了2004年美国奥运马拉松选拔赛——那是沃迪安三次参赛中的第一次——他才觉得自己是一名真正的跑者。

en: Now more than 10 years and numerous ultra-marathon national titles and world records later, he embraces that identity. (18 words)
cn: 如今，十多年过去，他拥有了无数超级马拉松全国冠军和世界纪录，他欣然接受了这个身份。

en: Wardian wants to see how far his legs can take him, one epic challenge at a time. (17 words)
cn: 沃迪安想看看他的双腿能带他走多远，一次一个史诗般的挑战。

en: I want to always keep doing things that are exciting, adventurous, different and most importantly, probably things I am not the best at, Wardian said, because if you are not seeking things out that are challenging and difficult for you, then you are not growing...So I hope maybe people see what I do, and say, 'Okay, I want to do something different or try something new...I am going to do something that scares me.' That is what I am hoping people will take from it. (85 words)
cn: 沃迪安说：“我想一直做那些令人兴奋、充满冒险、与众不同，而且最重要的是，可能是我并不最擅长的事情，因为如果你不去寻找那些对你来说具有挑战性和困难的事情，那么你就没有成长……所以我希望也许人们看到我所做的，然后说：‘好吧，我想做点不一样的事，或者尝试新事物……我要做点让我害怕的事。’这就是我希望人们从中得到的启示。”

en: Many people associate their self-worth with their work. (8 words)
cn: 许多人将自我价值与工作联系在一起。

en: The more successful their career, the better they feel about themselves. (11 words)
cn: 事业越成功，他们自我感觉就越好。

en: Work-related self-esteem is therefore a worthy ideal to pursue with vigor, right? (12 words)
cn: 因此，与工作相关的自尊是一个值得努力追求的崇高目标，对吗？

en: Well, not always. (3 words)
cn: 嗯，并不总是如此。

en: According to recent research, in which psychologists interviewed 370 full-time workers over a period of three weeks, the reality is a little more complicated. (24 words)
cn: 根据最近的一项研究——心理学家在三周内采访了370名全职工作者——现实要复杂一些。

en: And it involves negative as well as positive consequences. (9 words)
cn: 而且它既涉及负面后果，也涉及正面后果。

en: It is natural to be drawn towards pleasure and to step away from pain. (14 words)
cn: 被快乐吸引、远离痛苦是人之常情。

en: In the workplace, if that pleasure comes from a triumph which swells our self-respect, people will try to repeat the accomplishment. (21 words)
cn: 在职场中，如果这种快乐来自一次提升我们自尊的胜利，人们就会试图重复这种成就。

en: But repeating that accomplishment is often not realistic, which can lead to severe negative emotional consequences when it does not reoccur. (21 words)
cn: 但重复那种成就往往不现实，当它没有再次发生时，就可能导致严重的负面情绪后果。

en: This form of motivation is widely regarded as a negative type of motivation. (13 words)
cn: 这种动机形式被广泛认为是一种负面的动机类型。

en: It can hinder other more positive motivation types, such as completing a task purely because it is fulfilling or enjoyable. (20 words)
cn: 它会阻碍其他更积极的动机类型，例如纯粹因为任务有成就感或令人愉快而完成它。

en: What consumes the employee instead is a pressing need to feel mighty and sure of themselves. (16 words)
cn: 取而代之消耗员工的是一种迫切的需求——感到自己强大而自信。

en: They then take on only tasks and objectives which serve that ego-driven need. (13 words)
cn: 于是他们只承担那些服务于这种自我驱动需求的任务和目标。

en: As a result, to avoid feelings of shame and worthlessness associated with failure, they extend themselves to such a degree that there is a subsequent adverse effect on their well-being. (30 words)
cn: 结果，为了避免与失败相关的羞耻感和无价值感，他们过度透支自己，以至于随后对他们的幸福感产生了不利影响。

en: This internal pressure to succeed at all costs demands a lot of effort. (13 words)
cn: 这种不惜一切代价取得成功的内部压力需要付出大量努力。

en: It depletes their energy, culminating in disproportionate levels of damaging sentiment. (11 words)
cn: 它消耗了他们的精力，最终导致不成比例的破坏性情绪。

en: Those negative emotions mount into heightened anxiety, impacting their ability to make the most of their personal life. (18 words)
cn: 这些负面情绪累积成加剧的焦虑，影响了他们充分利用个人生活的能力。

en: Their desire to avoid feeling inferior ends up making them feel inferior when it comes to their diminished capacity for friendship and leisure. (23 words)
cn: 他们避免自卑的愿望，最终却在友谊和休闲能力下降时让他们感到自卑。

en: They end up dissatisfied both at work and outside of it. (11 words)
cn: 他们最终在工作中和工作中都不满意。

en: But thankfully, for those people compelled almost entirely by this specific form of motivation, the news is not all bad, or bad at all. (24 words)
cn: 但值得庆幸的是，对于那些几乎完全被这种特定动机形式驱使的人来说，消息并不全是坏的，甚至一点也不坏。

en: The study also discovered several positive outcomes that can actually outweigh the harmful ones. (14 words)
cn: 该研究还发现了几种实际上可能超过有害结果的积极结果。

en: Though these types of employees are motivated by the desire to avoid negative consequences, they are also motivated by the excitement of pursuing emotional rewards. (25 words)
cn: 尽管这类员工的动机是避免负面后果，但他们也受到追求情感回报的兴奋感的驱动。

en: This excitement makes pursuing goals enjoyable and stimulates pleasure and pride that would result from success. (16 words)
cn: 这种兴奋感使追求目标变得愉快，并激发成功所带来的快乐和自豪感。

en: An effect of the positive motivation is that it neutralizes the existence of negative motivation. (15 words)
cn: 积极动机的一个效果是它中和了消极动机的存在。

en: Sure, it affects people's personal lives to what could be deemed an unhealthy extent, because leisure activities are often seen as a part of life that must be sacrificed to manage work and family demands. (35 words)
cn: 当然，它会对人们的个人生活产生一种可被视为不健康程度的影响，因为休闲活动常被视为必须牺牲以应付工作和家庭需求的那部分生活。

en: However, the way people feel about their work has less to do with whether they are motivated by the preservation of self-esteem but more with the fact that they are simply motivated. (32 words)
cn: 然而，人们对工作的感受，与其说是与他们是否被维护自尊所驱动有关，不如说是与他们仅仅是被驱动这一事实有关。

en: Degradation of the world's natural resources by humans is rapidly outpacing the planet's ability to absorb the damage, a recent UN environmental study has found. (25 words)
cn: 联合国最近的一项环境研究发现，人类对世界自然资源的破坏正迅速超出地球吸收损害的能力。

en: The study concludes that without radical action the level of prosperity that millions of people in the developed world count on will be impossible to maintain or extend to poorer countries. (31 words)
cn: 该研究得出结论，如果不采取激进措施，发达国家数百万人所依赖的繁荣水平将无法维持，也无法扩展到较贫穷的国家。

en: Water scarcity is the curse of some of the poorest regions on Earth, leaving developing countries increasingly unable to feed themselves, and causing hardship for millions of people. (28 words)
cn: 水资源短缺是地球上一些最贫困地区的祸根，使发展中国家越来越无法自给自足，并给数百万人带来苦难。

en: There appears little prospect of this desperate situation being remedied without radical action being taken. (15 words)
cn: 如果不采取激进行动，这种绝望局面似乎没有什么补救的前景。

en: Water resources are under increasing threat from population growth, climate change, rapid urbanization, rising levels of consumption, and the degradation of lands that previously provided a natural replenishment of water resources. (31 words)
cn: 水资源正面临来自人口增长、气候变化、快速城市化、消费水平上升以及曾经提供水资源自然补充的土地退化的日益严重的威胁。

en: The rate of damage to the natural environment was found to increase globally, despite concerted efforts to persuade governments to take measures to improve the condition. (26 words)
cn: 尽管各方共同努力说服政府采取措施改善状况，但全球自然环境的破坏率仍在上升。

en: If current trends continue, and the world fails to improve patterns of production and consumption, then the state of the world's environment will continue to decline, warned UN executive director Achim Steiner. (32 words)
cn: 联合国执行主任阿希姆·施泰纳警告说：“如果当前趋势持续，世界未能改善生产和消费模式，那么全球环境状况将继续恶化。”

en: He said the tools for improving the environment for millions of people existed in developed countries, but were in danger of not being used. (24 words)
cn: 他说，改善数百万人环境的工具在发达国家存在，但面临不被使用的风险。

en: The study found that basic measures to tackle some of the key causes of environmental damage were still not being taken. (21 words)
cn: 该研究发现，应对环境破坏的一些关键原因的基本措施仍未得到实施。

en: These included measures to reduce air pollution, to control the damage to marine eco-systems, which can have a huge effect on fish stocks on which hundreds of millions of people depend; and to curb the degradation of land where modern agricultural methods were pursued without regard to the longer-term consequences. (50 words)
cn: 这些措施包括：减少空气污染；控制对海洋生态系统的破坏——这可能对数亿人依赖的鱼类资源产生巨大影响；以及遏制土地退化——在这些土地上，现代农业生产方式不顾长期后果而进行。

en: Despite the recent global agreement on cutting greenhouse gas emissions, global carbon output continues to rise. (16 words)
cn: 尽管最近达成了关于削减温室气体排放的全球协议，但全球碳排放量仍在持续上升。

en: This will put a long-term strain on the ability of developing economies to feed their own people. (17 words)
cn: 这将对发展中经济体养活自己人民的能力造成长期压力。

en: Climate change is aggravated by the emissions of greenhouse gases from chemical and natural fertilisers used in agriculture which increased by more than a quarter between 2000 and 2010. (29 words)
cn: 气候变化因农业中使用的化学和天然肥料排放的温室气体而加剧，这些气体在2000年至2010年间增加了超过四分之一。

en: Other problem areas identified in the report included glaciers, which provide vital water resources for millions of people, but which are shrinking as the climate warms. (26 words)
cn: 报告中指出的其他问题领域包括冰川——为数百万人口提供重要水资源，但随着气候变暖而正在缩小。

en: In rich countries, these problems have built up over decades and centuries while economic growth was pursued at the expense of the environment. (23 words)
cn: 在富裕国家，这些问题在几十个世纪里累积起来，而经济增长是以牺牲环境为代价的。

en: Subsequent efforts to remedy the environment have met with partial success. (11 words)
cn: 随后修复环境的努力取得了部分成功。

en: But in developing countries, the path of future development has more potential to change, which has encouraged international institutions to devise more sustainable growth pathways that are supposed both to alleviate poverty and preserve the environment. (36 words)
cn: 但在发展中国家，未来发展的道路有更大的改变潜力，这鼓励了国际机构设计更可持续的增长路径，这些路径既应缓解贫困，也应保护环境。

en: The task of the global strategist of a business is to build a platform of capabilities derived from the resources, experiences and innovations of units operating in multiple locations, to transplant those capabilities wherever appropriate, and then to systematically upgrade and renew them—ahead of the competition. (46 words)
cn: 企业全球战略家的任务是建立一个能力平台，这些能力来源于在多个地点运营的部门的资源、经验和创新，在适当的地方移植这些能力，然后系统地升级和更新它们——领先于竞争对手。

en: Apple is an outstanding case of a company whose unique capabilities give it a worldwide competitive advantage, particularly with respect to its ability to build platforms from a product base that integrates functional and aesthetic design. (36 words)
cn: 苹果公司是一个杰出的案例，其独特的能力赋予了它全球竞争优势，尤其是在其从整合了功能和美学设计的产品基础上构建平台的能力方面。

en: Apple has been able to leverage and exploit its California-based design and marketing advantages successfully throughout the world. (18 words)
cn: 苹果公司已经能够成功地将其位于加利福尼亚的设计和营销优势在世界各地加以利用和开发。

en: IKEA is another such case. (5 words)
cn: 宜家是另一个这样的案例。

en: The do-it-yourself furniture and houseware company first developed a compelling set of capabilities to design, manufacture and ship furniture at low cost and sell it in a novel way in Sweden. (31 words)
cn: 这家DIY家具和家居用品公司首先开发了一套引人注目的能力，以低成本设计、制造和运输家具，并在瑞典以新颖的方式销售。

en: Later, IKEA successfully reproduced this formula in many other countries. (10 words)
cn: 后来，宜家在许多其他国家成功地复制了这一模式。

en: By contrast, Telefónica, a Spanish telecommunications company that is now the world's fifth largest telecom by revenues, first developed its special advantage abroad. (23 words)
cn: 相比之下，西班牙电信公司Telefónica——如今按收入计算是全球第五大电信公司——首先在海外发展其特殊优势。

en: In 1989 and 1990, Telefónica had the opportunity to enter Chile and Argentina, countries that shared many institutional and cultural characteristics with its home country but that were undergoing more rapid market reform. (33 words)
cn: 在1989年和1990年，Telefónica有机会进入智利和阿根廷，这两个国家与其母国有许多制度和文化上的共同特征，但正在经历更为迅速的市场改革。

en: Throughout the 1990s, Telefónica took what it learned in Chile and Argentina about reconstructing former state-owned telecoms to other Latin American countries that were privatizing their state telecoms and deregulating their telecom markets. (33 words)
cn: 在整个20世纪90年代，Telefónica将其在智利和阿根廷学到的关于重建前国有电信公司的经验，带到了其他拉丁美洲国家——这些国家正在对其国有电信公司进行私有化，并放宽对其电信市场的管制。

en: These examples might lead the reader to believe that creating a global advantage is an easy task. (17 words)
cn: 这些例子可能会让读者相信，创造全球优势是一件容易的事。

en: But many other instances of expensive failed experiments suggest that creating a lasting global advantage actually requires a great deal of strategic and operational finesse. (25 words)
cn: 但许多其他昂贵的失败实验实例表明，创造持久的全球优势实际上需要大量的战略和运营技巧。

en: Our research suggests that global winners typically create and sustain their international presence through a systematic process of exploiting, renewing and enhancing their core capabilities. (25 words)
cn: 我们的研究表明，全球赢家通常通过系统性地开发、更新和增强其核心能力来创造和维持其国际影响力。

en: What do we lose when natural spaces and species disappear? (10 words)
cn: 当自然空间和物种消失时，我们失去了什么？

en: Increasingly, research has shown that as species and ecosystems vanish, it also chips away at our ability to preserve what remains—because we no longer understand what we are losing. (29 words)
cn: 越来越多的研究表明，随着物种和生态系统的消失，它也削弱了我们保护剩余事物的能力——因为我们不再理解我们正在失去什么。

en: You probably see it all the time. (7 words)
cn: 你可能经常看到这种情况。

en: The neighbor who puts pesticides on his lawn rather than deal with annoying bees. (14 words)
cn: 那个在草坪上喷洒杀虫剂而不是对付烦人的蜜蜂的邻居。

en: The politician who votes against wildlife protection because she has never seen a wolf in the wild. (17 words)
cn: 那个投票反对野生动物保护的政客，因为她从未在野外见过狼。

en: The corporation that wants to bulldoze the habitat of a rare frog. (12 words)
cn: 那个想要推平稀有青蛙栖息地的公司。

en: At best this can be termed 'the extinction of experience,' where our cultural and natural histories fade from our memories and therefore our reality. (24 words)
cn: 往好里说，这可以被称为‘经验的灭绝’——我们的文化和自然历史从我们的记忆中消失，因此也从我们的现实中消失。

en: At its worst it becomes something even more concerning: 'biophobia,' the fear of living things and a complete aversion to nature. (21 words)
cn: 往坏里说，它变成了更令人担忧的东西：‘生物恐惧症’——对生物的恐惧和对自然的完全厌恶。

en: This is not the fiction of living in a cold, empty dystopia. (12 words)
cn: 这不是生活在冰冷、空虚的反乌托邦的虚构故事。

en: Sadly, it is becoming a way of life for too many people—especially children. (13 words)
cn: 可悲的是，它正在成为太多人——尤其是儿童——的一种生活方式。

en: A recent study in Japan paints a striking portrait of this problem. (12 words)
cn: 日本最近的一项研究描绘了这一问题的惊人图景。

en: A survey of more than 5,300 school children in the Tochigi Prefecture examined their perception of 14 local insect species and one spider. (23 words)
cn: 一项对栃木县5,300多名学龄儿童的调查，考察了他们对14种当地昆虫和1种蜘蛛的看法。

en: The results? (2 words)
cn: 结果如何？

en: A collective 'ew!' (3 words)
cn: 集体的‘噁！’

en: Most of the students saw the species as things to dislike or fear, or even as sources of danger. (19 words)
cn: 大多数学生将这些物种视为不喜欢或害怕的东西，甚至视为危险的来源。

en: The less experience the students had with nature, the more negative their feelings. (13 words)
cn: 学生对自然的体验越少，他们的负面情绪就越多。

en: The results were published earlier this year in the journal Biological Conservation. (12 words)
cn: 研究结果于今年早些时候发表在《生物保护》期刊上。

en: Lead researcher Masashi Soga with the University of Tokyo says the study stemmed from observations about today's nature-deficient children. (19 words)
cn: 东京大学的首席研究员曾根雅史表示，这项研究源于对当今缺乏自然的儿童的观察。

en: Humans inherently avoid dangerous organisms such as bees, but children these days avoid even harmless insects such as butterflies and dragonflies, he says. (23 words)
cn: 他说：“人类天生会避开蜜蜂等危险生物，但如今的孩子甚至连蝴蝶和蜻蜓等无害昆虫也避开。”

en: I have long wondered why so many of today's children react like this. (13 words)
cn: 我一直很好奇，为什么当今这么多孩子会有这样的反应。

en: Although the children's reactions were somewhat expected, the new study did contain an unexpected finding: Many of the surveyed children revealed that their parents also expressed fear or disgust of the same animals. (33 words)
cn: 尽管儿童的反应在一定程度上是可以预料到的，但这项新研究确实包含了一个意想不到的发现：许多接受调查的儿童透露，他们的父母也对同样的动物表现出恐惧或厌恶。

en: In fact these parental emotions were strong enough to overwhelm any positive experiences the children might have gained from direct experiences in nature. (23 words)
cn: 事实上，这些父母的情绪强烈到足以压倒孩子们可能从直接自然体验中获得的任何积极体验。

en: As Soga and his coauthors wrote in their paper, 'Our results suggest that there is likely a feedback loop in which an increase in people who have negative attitudes towards nature in one generation will lead to a further increase in people with similar attitudes in the next generation.' (49 words)
cn: 正如曾根和他的合著者在论文中所写：‘我们的研究结果表明，可能存在一个反馈循环，其中一代人对自然持负面态度的人增加，将导致下一代人中具有类似态度的人进一步增加。’

en: And that is possibly the greater threat posed by extinction of experience. (12 words)
cn: 而这可能是‘经验灭绝’所带来的更大威胁。

en: Soga suggests the generational loss—a condition previously dubbed environmental generational amnesia—could chip away at our societal ability to preserve what we are losing. (23 words)
cn: 曾根认为，代际损失——一种此前被称为‘环境代际遗忘’的状况——可能会削弱我们社会保护我们正在失去之物的能力。

en: I believe that increased biophobia is a major, but invisible, threat to global biodiversity, Soga says. (16 words)
cn: 曾根说：“我认为生物恐惧症的加剧是对全球生物多样性的一个重大但无形的威胁。”

en: As the number of children who have biophobia increases, public interest and support for biodiversity conservation will gradually decline. (19 words)
cn: 随着患有生物恐惧症的儿童数量增加，公众对生物多样性保护的兴趣和支持将逐渐下降。

en: Although many conservation biologists still consider that preventing the loss of wildlife habitat is the most important way to conserve biodiversity, I think preventing increased biophobia is also important for conservation. (31 words)
cn: 尽管许多保护生物学家仍然认为防止野生动物栖息地丧失是保护生物多样性最重要的方式，但我认为防止生物恐惧症加剧对保护也很重要。

en: What is to be done about this? (7 words)
cn: 对此该如何应对？

en: The paper makes several recommendations, the most obvious of which is that children should experience nature more often. (18 words)
cn: 该论文提出了几项建议，其中最明显的是儿童应该更经常地体验自然。

en: The authors also suggest establishing policies to guide these natural experiences and increasing educational programs about the natural world. (19 words)
cn: 作者还建议制定政策来引导这些自然体验，并增加关于自然世界的教育项目。

en: Helping parents to see species around them in a new light would make a difference, too. (16 words)
cn: 帮助父母以新的眼光看待周围的物种也会有所作为。

en: And, of course, maintaining support for preserving the wild spaces where these 'scary' creatures live is the most important thing of all. (22 words)
cn: 而且，当然，持续支持保护这些‘可怕’生物所栖息的野生空间，是所有事情中最重要的。

en: That is a point reinforced by another recent study, which found that wild spaces located within urban areas and the plants and animals that thrive in them—are particularly important for human health and well-being. (34 words)
cn: 这一点得到了另一项近期研究的支持，该研究发现，位于城市区域内的野生空间以及在其中繁衍生息的动植物——对人类健康和福祉尤为重要。

en: Published in the journal Frontiers in Sustainable Cities, the study examined attitudes toward Discovery Park, the heavily forested 534-acre public park in Seattle, Washington. (24 words)
cn: 该研究发表在《可持续城市前沿》期刊上，考察了人们对华盛顿州西雅图市占地534英亩、森林茂密的公共公园——探索公园的态度。

en: It found that the public had the most appreciation for—and gained the most value from—the wildest parts of the park. (20 words)
cn: 研究发现，公众对公园中最野生的部分最为欣赏——并从中获得了最大的价值。

en: I have seen whales, seals, fish, eagles, shorebirds and many other sea creatures in their natural habitat, one survey participant wrote. (21 words)
cn: 一位调查参与者写道：“我在它们的自然栖息地见过鲸鱼、海豹、鱼类、鹰、滨鸟和许多其他海洋生物。”

en: Coming here with people has allowed me to connect and talk with them about conversation that simply does not happen in everyday life, wrote another. (25 words)
cn: 另一位写道：“与他人一起来到这里，让我能够与他们建立联系，谈论那些在日常生活中根本不会发生的对话。”

en: The participants reported that their most valuable experiences in the park included encountering wildlife, walking through open spaces, exploring the beach and finding beautiful views. (25 words)
cn: 参与者报告说，他们在公园中最有价值的体验包括邂逅野生动物、穿越开阔空间、探索海滩和寻找美丽景色。

en: We saw that a large majority of participants' interactions, especially their most meaningful interactions, depended on Discovery Park's relative wildness, says lead author Elizabeth Lev, a master's student in the University of Washington's Human Interaction with Nature Lab. (38 words)
cn: 华盛顿大学人类与自然互动实验室的硕士生、首席作者伊丽莎白·莱夫说：“我们发现，绝大多数参与者的互动，尤其是他们最有意义的互动，都依赖于探索公园相对的野生状态。”

en: This is only possible because the park is relatively wild. (10 words)
cn: 这之所以可能，仅仅是因为公园相对野生。

en: After all, you cannot enjoy watching birds if there are no birds to follow; gaze at the sunset if it is obscured by skyscrapers; or stop and smell the flowers if they do not have room to grow. (38 words)
cn: 毕竟，如果没有鸟可追随，你就无法享受观鸟；如果日落被摩天大楼遮挡，你就无法凝视日落；如果花没有生长空间，你就无法停下来闻花香。

en: And yet even this long-protected space could someday become less hospitable to nature. (13 words)
cn: 然而，即使是这个长期受到保护的空间，有朝一日也可能变得对自然不那么友好。

en: Over the past few years a lot of people and organizations have suggested developing parts of Discovery Park or the neighboring area. (22 words)
cn: 在过去几年里，许多人和组织都建议开发探索公园或邻近地区的部分区域。

en: Most recently a plan proposed building 34 acres of much-needed affordable housing and parking spaces adjacent to the park, bringing with them noise, traffic and pollution. (26 words)
cn: 最近，一项计划提议在公园附近建造34英亩急需的经济适用房和停车位，随之而来的是噪音、交通和污染。

en: If anything like that happened, both the park and the people of Seattle could lose something vital. (17 words)
cn: 如果发生类似的事情，公园和西雅图人民都可能失去至关重要的东西。

en: And that would continue the trend of chipping away at Seattle's—and the world's—natural spaces, leaving just tiny pocket parks and green-but-empty spaces that offer little real value to wildlife, plants or people. (32 words)
cn: 而这将继续削弱西雅图——以及全世界——自然空间的趋势，只留下微小的袖珍公园和绿色但空荡荡的空间，对野生动物、植物或人类几乎没有真正的价值。

en: It is true that any interaction with nature is better than none, but I do not want people to be satisfied with any small bit of grass and trees, Lev says. (31 words)
cn: 莱夫说：“诚然，任何与自然的互动都比没有好，但我不希望人们满足于任何一小片草地和树木。”

en: We have been in this cycle of environmental generational amnesia for a long time, where the baseline keeps shifting and we do not even realize what we are losing until it is gone. (33 words)
cn: 我们长期以来一直处于这种环境代际遗忘的循环中，基准线不断变化，我们甚至直到失去时才意识到我们正在失去什么。

en: If we can get people to understand how much meaning and value can come from having more experiences with more wild forms of nature, then maybe we can stop this cycle and move toward conserving and restoring what we have left. (41 words)
cn: 如果我们能让人们理解，从更野生形式的自然中获得更多体验能带来多少意义和价值，那么也许我们就能停止这个循环，并朝着保护和恢复我们所剩之物迈进。

en: Building this understanding in an ever-more fearful and disconnected world may be the biggest challenge. (15 words)
cn: 在一个日益恐惧和脱节的世界中建立这种理解，可能是最大的挑战。

en: Peter Kahn, the senior author of Lev's paper and the director of the Human Interaction with Nature Lab, made several suggestions for bridging this gap in his 2011 book, Technological Nature. (31 words)
cn: 莱夫论文的资深作者、人类与自然互动实验室主任彼得·卡恩，在他2011年出版的《技术自然》一书中，提出了若干弥合这一差距的建议。

en: They echo the recommendation about getting children into nature, but also include telling stories of how things used to be, imagining what things might be like in the future, and developing a common language about nature, 'a way of speaking about wild and domestic interaction patterns, and the meaningful, deep and often joyful feelings that they generate.' (57 words)
cn: 它们呼应了关于让孩子接触自然的建议，但也包括讲述过去事物的故事，想象未来事物可能的样子，以及发展一种关于自然的共同语言——‘一种谈论野生和家养互动模式，以及它们所产生的有意义、深刻且常常令人愉悦的感受的方式。’

en: No matter what techniques we use, this growing field of research illustrates that saving nature requires encouraging people to experience it more often and more deeply. (26 words)
cn: 无论我们使用什么技术，这一不断发展的研究领域表明，拯救自然需要鼓励人们更频繁、更深入地体验自然。

en: That calls for additional research—Lev and her coauthors have published a toolkit that other municipalities can follow to study the value of their own wild spaces—and clear communication of the results. (31 words)
cn: 这需要额外的研究——莱夫和她的合著者已经发布了一个工具包，其他城市可以参照该工具包来研究自己野生空间的价值——以及清晰的结果沟通。

en: If we can continue to show people the benefits of these wild spaces, Lev says, 'maybe people will begin to see more value in keeping these areas undeveloped—for the sake of our mutual benefit.' (34 words)
cn: 莱夫说：“如果我们能继续向人们展示这些野生空间的益处，也许人们会开始看到保持这些区域未开发状态的更大价值——为了我们共同的利益。”

en: Some people in the US have asserted that forgiving student loan debt is one way to stimulate the economy and give assistance to those in need. (26 words)
cn: 美国一些人声称，免除学生贷款债务是刺激经济和援助贫困者的一种方式。

en: One government proposition is to eliminate $10,000 of debt for 'economically distressed' students. (13 words)
cn: 一项政府提案是为‘经济困难’的学生免除10,000美元的债务。

en: Some in US Congress have gone so far as to suggest forgiving up to $50,000 in debt per student borrower, but does forgiving student debt necessarily correlate to helping the economically disadvantaged? (32 words)
cn: 美国国会中的一些人甚至提议免除每位学生借款人高达50,000美元的债务，但免除学生债务是否必然有助于帮助经济困难群体呢？

en: The answer is no. (4 words)
cn: 答案是否定的。

en: This policy is just giving money away to universities and the most affluent students in attendance. (16 words)
cn: 这项政策只是把钱送给大学和在读的最富裕的学生。

en: Federal Reserve data reveals that the highest-income 40 percent of households owe approximately 60 percent of outstanding student debt, while the lowest 40 percent owe just under 20 percent. (29 words)
cn: 美联储数据显示，收入最高的40%的家庭欠约60%的未偿学生债务，而收入最低的40%的家庭所欠债务略低于20%。

en: This could be due to a combination of factors: students from high-income households are more likely to go to expensive colleges, less likely to receive financial aid, and more likely to have high incomes post-graduation. (35 words)
cn: 这可能是多种因素共同作用的结果：来自高收入家庭的学生更有可能进入昂贵的大学，更不可能获得经济援助，并且毕业后更有可能获得高收入。

en: Plus, the majority of student debt is held by graduate degree earners, who earn approximately 25 percent more than their undergraduate counterparts. (22 words)
cn: 此外，大部分学生债务由研究生学位持有者承担，他们的收入比本科生高出约25%。

en: Clearly, giving free reign to banks to forgive student debt is a step in the wrong direction. (17 words)
cn: 显然，放任银行免除学生债务是朝着错误方向迈出的一步。

en: Other proposals for broader, long-term student loan plans have some fundamental problems. (12 words)
cn: 其他关于更广泛、长期的学生贷款计划的提案存在一些根本性问题。

en: One idea is to cancel student debt only for undergraduate degrees and for students making less than $125,000. (18 words)
cn: 一个想法是只取消本科学位且收入低于125,000美元的学生的学生债务。

en: This attempts to address the fact that Congress' previously mentioned student loan forgiveness plan largely helps out the wealthy, but is an adverse incentive for universities to keep raising tuition and for students to choose to major in low-earning degree programs. (41 words)
cn: 这试图解决这样一个事实：国会此前提到的学生贷款免除计划在很大程度上帮助了富人，但却对大学不断提高学费和学生选择低收入的学位专业产生了不良激励。

en: Colleges have no reason to make their programs more affordable if they believe students will just take out more debt. (20 words)
cn: 如果大学相信学生只会借更多的债，它们就没有理由让自己的项目更加负担得起。

en: And, students will feel more comfortable making the irresponsible decision to go tens of thousands of dollars in debt to major in impractical or idealistic subjects if they know their loans will be forgiven. (34 words)
cn: 而且，如果学生知道他们的贷款将被免除，他们就会更放心地做出不负责任的决定——为了主修不切实际或理想主义的学科而背负数万美元的债务。

en: This is especially concerning given the pandemic has rendered a college education practically worthless. (14 words)
cn: 考虑到疫情使大学教育几乎变得毫无价值，这一点尤其令人担忧。

en: Students are paying tens of thousands of dollars per year to live at home and be lectured on the Internet. (20 words)
cn: 学生们每年支付数万美元，却只能待在家里听网络讲座。

en: Do we really want to tell colleges that they can get away with providing below-average service for an outrageous cost? (20 words)
cn: 我们真的想告诉大学，它们可以以离谱的价格提供低于平均水平的服务而安然无恙吗？

en: In the case of any of these student debt plans, working-class Americans who chose not to or could not afford to go to college will be subsidizing the education of the professional class. (33 words)
cn: 在实施任何这些学生债务计划的情况下，选择不上大学或上不起大学的美国工薪阶层，将补贴职业阶层的教育。

en: Plumbers and retail workers will be paying for the degrees of doctors and lawyers. (14 words)
cn: 水管工和零售业工人将为医生和律师的学位买单。

en: The US government's effort to help those in debt is commendable but is this really the solution that will help the poor financially recover? (24 words)
cn: 美国政府帮助负债者的努力值得称赞，但这真的能帮助穷人实现经济复苏吗？

en: If there is one rule that most parents cling to in the confusing, fast-changing world of kids and media, it is 'No screens before age 2.' (26 words)
cn: 如果说在混乱、快速变化的儿童与媒体世界中，大多数父母坚持一条规则，那就是‘2岁前不看屏幕’。

en: As of today, that rule has been thrown out the window. (11 words)
cn: 而如今，这条规则已被抛诸脑后。

en: The American Academy of Pediatrics, which first issued that recommendation back in 1999, has extensively updated and revised its guidelines for children and adolescents to reflect new research and new habits. (31 words)
cn: 美国儿科学会于1999年首次提出该建议，现已广泛更新和修订了其儿童和青少年指南，以反映新的研究和新的习惯。

en: The new guidelines, especially for very young children, shift the focus from WHAT is on the screen to WHO else is in the room. (24 words)
cn: 新指南，尤其是针对幼龄儿童的指南，将关注点从屏幕上有什么转向房间里还有谁。

en: And in doing so, they raise some intriguing points about the future of learning from media. (16 words)
cn: 在这样做的过程中，它们提出了一些关于从媒体学习之未来的有趣观点。

en: For babies younger than 18 months, AAP still says no screens at all are the best idea—with one notable exception: Live video chat. (23 words)
cn: 对于18个月以下的婴儿，AAP仍然说不看屏幕是最好的选择——但有一个明显的例外：实时视频聊天。

en: Surveys indicate that families already popularly believe that 'Face time does not count', or at least that the benefit of virtual visits with grandparents or other relatives outweighs the potential cost of exposing babies to the laptop or smartphone. (39 words)
cn: 调查表明，家庭已经普遍认为‘FaceTime不算屏幕时间’，或者至少与祖父母或其他亲属进行虚拟拜访的好处，超过了让婴儿接触笔记本电脑或智能手机的潜在代价。

en: The AAP does not cite positive evidence that infants actually get something out of this kind of 'conversation', the way that they clearly do from live social interaction. (28 words)
cn: AAP没有引用正面证据表明婴儿实际上从这种‘对话’中有所收获，就像他们显然从现场社交互动中所获得的那样。

en: But there is some observational research that infants as young as six months old are emotionally engaged by playing live peekaboo with Grandma online. (24 words)
cn: 但有一些观察性研究表明，年仅六个月大的婴儿会通过与奶奶在线玩实时躲猫猫游戏而产生情感投入。

en: For infants and toddlers, ages 15 months to 2 years old, there is limited evidence from a couple of very small studies that they can learn new words from educational media, if and only if parents are watching alongside them, repeating what the video says and/or drawing attention to what is on the screen. (54 words)
cn: 对于15个月至2岁的婴幼儿，来自几项非常小的研究的有限证据表明，他们可以从教育媒体中学习新单词，但前提是父母必须在旁边观看，重复视频所说的内容以及/或者引导他们注意屏幕上的内容。

en: In other words, treating a video or an app like a picture book is the best bet. (17 words)
cn: 换句话说，把视频或应用程序当作图画书来对待是最佳选择。

en: The flip side of this is that many studies have actually shown poorer language skills correlated with earlier solo viewing of 'educational' videos. (23 words)
cn: 另一方面，许多研究实际上表明，较早独自观看‘教育’视频与较差的语言技能相关。

en: There is also research that shows language delays in children who watch more TV and start watching earlier. (18 words)
cn: 还有研究表明，看更多电视且更早开始看电视的儿童存在语言延迟。

en: In both cases, the problem seems to be media replacing interaction with people. (13 words)
cn: 在这两种情况下，问题似乎都在于媒体取代了与人的互动。

en: For this reason, the new AAP guideline has changed from 'avoid all screens under age 2' to 'avoid solo media use in this age group.' (25 words)
cn: 出于这个原因，AAP的新指南已从‘避免2岁以下接触任何屏幕’改为‘避免该年龄段独自使用媒体’。

en: For preschoolers ages 2 to 5, there is more evidence that they have the ability to transfer knowledge from screens to the real world, including early literacy and math. (29 words)
cn: 对于2至5岁的学龄前儿童，有更多证据表明他们有能力将屏幕上的知识转移到现实世界，包括早期识字和数学。

en: For this age group, AAP recommends no more than an hour a day of screen use. (16 words)
cn: 对于这一年龄段，AAP建议每天使用屏幕不超过一小时。

en: And, just as with younger children, they want care-givers to take part in screen time: 'Co-view with your children, help children understand what they are seeing, and help them apply what they learn to the world around them.' (38 words)
cn: 而且，就像对待更小的孩子一样，他们希望照顾者参与屏幕时间：‘与孩子一起观看，帮助孩子理解他们正在看的内容，并帮助他们将所学应用于周围的世界。’

en: American colleges and universities are using 64 percent less coal than they did a decade ago, burning 700,000 tons last year, down from 2 million tons in 2008, the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) said in a report released yesterday. (40 words)
cn: 美国能源信息署（EIA）在昨日发布的一份报告中称，美国高校的用煤量比十年前减少了64%，去年燃烧了70万吨，低于2008年的200万吨。

en: All 57 schools that were burning coal in 2008 are using less now, and 20 have abandoned coal completely, EIA found. (21 words)
cn: EIA发现，2008年所有57所用煤的学校现在用煤量都减少了，其中20所已完全弃用煤炭。

en: Most universities have turned to natural gas as a replacement, with state funding backing the fuel switch. (17 words)
cn: 大多数大学已转向使用天然气作为替代燃料，州政府资金支持了这种燃料转换。

en: While academic institutions use less than 0.1 percent of U.S. coal burned for power, campus coal use has a history dating back to the 1800s when access to power was scarce. (31 words)
cn: 尽管学术机构用煤量不到美国发电用煤总量的0.1%，但校园用煤的历史可以追溯到19世纪，当时电力供应十分匮乏。

en: Many universities still operate their own power plants. (8 words)
cn: 许多大学仍然运营自己的发电厂。

en: The Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978 encouraged more electricity generation by allowing institutions to sell surplus power to utilities. (21 words)
cn: 1978年的《公共事业监管政策法案》允许机构向公用事业公司出售多余的电力，从而鼓励了更多的发电。

en: But EIA noted many coal-fired universities have signed onto the American College and University Presidents Climate Commitment, which was launched in 2007. (22 words)
cn: 但EIA指出，许多燃煤大学已经签署了2007年启动的《美国学院与大学校长气候承诺》。

en: About 665 schools are part of the program, which aims to slash greenhouse gas emissions. (15 words)
cn: 约有665所学校参与了该计划，该计划旨在大幅削减温室气体排放。

en: Thirty percent of the participants have pledged to be carbon neutral within 20 years. (14 words)
cn: 30%的参与学校承诺在20年内实现碳中和。

en: The Sierra Club's Beyond Coal campaign, which also leads campaigns for universities to withdraw their investments in coal and other fossil fuels, lists 22 schools that have pledged to move 'beyond coal,' including Clemson University, Indiana University, Ohio University, Penn State University, the University of Louisville and the University of Tennessee, Knoxville. (52 words)
cn: 塞拉俱乐部发起的‘超越煤炭’运动——同时也领导大学撤资煤炭和其他化石燃料的运动——列出了22所承诺‘超越煤炭’的学校，包括克莱姆森大学、印第安纳大学、俄亥俄大学、宾夕法尼亚州立大学、路易斯维尔大学和田纳西大学诺克斯维尔分校。

en: The largest coal use reductions at colleges were in Michigan, Missouri, Tennessee and Indiana. (14 words)
cn: 大学用煤量减少最多的州是密歇根州、密苏里州、田纳西州和印第安纳州。

en: Indiana's universities alone cut coal consumption by 81 percent between 2008 and 2015. (13 words)
cn: 仅印第安纳州的大学在2008年至2015年间就削减了81%的煤炭消耗量。

en: During the same period, Michigan made an 80 percent cut and Tennessee cut back by 94 percent at state institutions. (20 words)
cn: 同期，密歇根州削减了80%，田纳西州的州立机构削减了94%。

en: In 1913, classical music sparked a riot in Paris. (9 words)
cn: 1913年，古典音乐在巴黎引发了一场骚乱。

en: Igor Stravinsky was introducing his revolutionary 'Rite of Spring' ballet to the world, with its discordant melodies and unorthodox choreography, and the purists in the crowd expressed their disapproval loud and clear. (32 words)
cn: 伊戈尔·斯特拉文斯基正在向世界介绍他革命性的芭蕾舞剧《春之祭》，其不和谐的旋律和非传统的编舞，人群中的纯粹主义者毫不含糊地表达了他们的不满。

en: It might have been classical music's version of the time Bob Dylan went electric at the Newport Folk Festival. (19 words)
cn: 这或许是古典音乐版的鲍勃·迪伦在纽波特民谣音乐节上用电吉他的时刻。

en: The noise, fighting, and shouting in the audience got so loud, NPR's music reporter Miles Hoffman said of the Stravinsky debut, that the choreographer had to shout out the numbers to the dancers so that they knew what they were supposed to do. (43 words)
cn: NPR的音乐记者迈尔斯·霍夫曼谈到斯特拉文斯基的首演时说：‘观众中的噪音、打斗和喊叫声越来越大，编舞者不得不向舞者大声喊出节拍数字，好让他们知道自己该做什么。’

en: It is difficult to imagine a similar disturbance occurring today within America's sacred symphony halls. (15 words)
cn: 很难想象今天在美国神圣的交响乐厅内会发生类似的骚动。

en: In fact, it is hard to picture any kind of disruptive activity at all (unless someone's cell phone happens to go off, and then you would better watch your back). (30 words)
cn: 事实上，很难想象有任何干扰活动（除非某人的手机碰巧响了，那你最好小心点）。

en: A mannerly aura hangs over most classical proceedings, and many of the genre's biggest supporters would have it no other way. (21 words)
cn: 一种彬彬有礼的氛围笼罩着大多数古典音乐活动，许多该流派的最大支持者也希望如此。

en: Today, Western audiences for classical music and opera and ballet are almost always well dressed, older, respectful, achingly silent and often very wealthy (one has to be able to afford most tickets). (32 words)
cn: 如今，西方古典音乐、歌剧和芭蕾舞的观众几乎总是衣着考究、年长、彬彬有礼、安静得令人窒息，而且往往非常富有（必须能负担得起大部分门票）。

en: But as many of America's most storied 'highbrow' institutions struggle financially—the Philadelphia Orchestra's much-publicized rebound from bankruptcy is just one recent example—classical music fans and theorists are wondering how the medium can weave itself into the 21st century's cultural fabric without sacrificing its integrity. (44 words)
cn: 但正如美国许多最负盛名的‘高雅’机构面临财务困境——费城交响乐团备受瞩目的破产后反弹只是最近的一个例子——古典音乐爱好者和理论家们正在思考，这种艺术形式如何在不牺牲其完整性的前提下融入21世纪的文化结构。

en: For example, should we feel OK 'clapping' during classical music events, even if nobody else is? (16 words)
cn: 例如，即使在古典音乐活动中没有其他人鼓掌，我们鼓掌是否合适？

en: Why should not we cheer for something great, like we do at a rock concert? (15 words)
cn: 我们为什么不能像在摇滚音乐会上那样为精彩的东西欢呼呢？

en: The Huffington Post recently ran a Great Debate on this issue and many commenters came out on the side of silence. (21 words)
cn: 《赫芬顿邮报》最近就这一问题进行了一场大讨论，许多评论者站在了保持安静的一边。

en: There is no more rewarding experience in life than being part of an audience where everybody is leaning forward in silence, thoroughly carried away by a great performance of a masterpiece, one commenter wrote. (34 words)
cn: 一位评论者写道：‘生活中没有比成为观众席中的一员更令人受益的体验了——每个人都默默前倾，完全被一部杰作的精彩表演所陶醉。’

en: Why is it so difficult for folks to develop an appreciation and understanding for the mannerisms and traditions of classical music? asked another. (23 words)
cn: 另一位问道：‘为什么人们如此难以培养对古典音乐风度和传统的欣赏与理解？’

en: The truth is that classical music audiences were not always so polite. (12 words)
cn: 事实是，古典音乐观众并非一直如此礼貌。

en: Robert Greenberg, an award-winning composer, said that when Beethoven first performed his 7th Symphony, audiences forced the orchestra to perform encores of certain movements immediately, applauding wildly. (27 words)
cn: 获奖作曲家罗伯特·格林伯格说，当贝多芬首次演奏他的《第七交响曲》时，观众迫使乐团立即重演某些乐章，并疯狂鼓掌。

en: And in the last few decades, he said, many audiences at opera performances have abandoned pretenses, yelling 'Bravo' when they feel like it. (23 words)
cn: 他说，在过去的几十年里，许多歌剧表演的观众已经放弃了矜持，在他们想喊的时候大喊‘Bravo’。

en: I do not think there is anything wrong with an audience showing their enthusiasm for a proper moment by applauding, showing their joy, Greenberg said, noting that the stuffiness in concert halls is 'one aspect of contemporary concert etiquette' he does not understand. (43 words)
cn: 格林伯格说：‘我认为观众在适当的时刻通过鼓掌表达热情、展现喜悦并没有什么不妥。’他指出，音乐厅里的拘谨是‘他无法理解的当代音乐会礼节之一’。

en: Instead of waiting half an hour to show enthusiasm, why not show it every eight or nine minutes? (18 words)
cn: 与其等半小时才表达热情，为什么不每八九分钟就表达一次呢？

en: Until the rules about behavior and clothing change, it is hard to imagine multitudes of young people filling concert halls on their own accord. (24 words)
cn: 在行为规范和着装规则改变之前，很难想象大批年轻人会自愿涌入音乐厅。

en: They are probably more likely to head to Central Park to watch a free performance with a bottle of wine and their friends. (23 words)
cn: 他们可能更倾向于带着一瓶酒和朋友去中央公园看免费演出。

en: I think anyone should be able to come into a performance dressed any way they like, and be comfortable any way they like, sitting in that seat ready to enjoy themselves, Greenberg said. (33 words)
cn: 格林伯格说：‘我认为任何人都应该可以穿着他们喜欢的任何服装进入演出场所，以他们喜欢的任何方式感到舒适，坐在座位上准备享受。’

en: Because it is enjoyable. (4 words)
cn: 因为这是令人愉快的。

en: Greenberg stressed that he does not want people to start respecting the music less, and he is not suggesting that we 'dumb down' the experience. (25 words)
cn: 格林伯格强调，他不希望人们开始不尊重音乐，他也不建议我们‘降低’体验的难度。

en: Rather, it is about opening up 'access'. (7 words)
cn: 相反，这是关于开放‘准入’。

en: When operas first instituted subtitles during shows, he said, many purists did not like the idea, believing that the audience should instead study the works before attending. (27 words)
cn: 他说，当歌剧首次在演出中引入字幕时，许多纯粹主义者并不喜欢这个想法，认为观众应该在观看前先研究作品。

en: But now it is commonplace to find titles on the seatback in front of you—choose a language, sit back, and understand what is going on. (25 words)
cn: 但现在，在你前方的座椅靠背上看到字幕已经很常见——选择一种语言，坐下来，理解正在发生的事情。

en: Allison Vulgamore, president of the Philadelphia Orchestra, is certainly looking to the future. (13 words)
cn: 费城交响乐团总裁艾莉森·沃尔加莫尔无疑在展望未来。

en: She says certain 'classics concerts' dedicated to the old masters will always exist, but not every program has to feature Beethoven and Brahms—or even a stage and seats. (28 words)
cn: 她说，专门献给老一辈大师的某些‘经典音乐会’将永远存在，但并非每个节目都必须以贝多芬和勃拉姆斯为主——甚至不一定需要舞台和座位。

en: We are trying to introduce different kinds of concerts in different ways, she said. (14 words)
cn: 她说：‘我们正试图以不同的方式推出不同类型的音乐会。’

en: We are an interactive society now, where people like to learn. (11 words)
cn: 我们现在是一个互动型社会，人们喜欢学习。

en: As the Philadelphia Orchestra rebounds from its financial straits, it is also aiming to experiment, without alienating the loyalists. (19 words)
cn: 随着费城交响乐团从财务困境中复苏，它也旨在进行实验，同时不疏远忠实支持者。

en: Vulgamore pointed to Cirque de la Symphonie, a recent offering in which jugglers and acrobats interacted with musicians. (18 words)
cn: 沃尔加莫尔提到了‘交响马戏团’——最近的一场演出，其中杂耍演员和杂技演员与音乐家互动。

en: An upcoming collaboration with New York City's Ridge Theatre, meanwhile, will feature a 'suspended dance installation' and other theatrical elements occurring in conjunction with an orchestral piece. (27 words)
cn: 与此同时，即将与纽约市里奇剧院合作的一场演出，将呈现‘悬挂舞蹈装置’和其他戏剧元素，与管弦乐作品同时进行。

en: The orchestra also continues to offer $25 annual memberships to Philadelphia students, who can buy rush tickets to every concert on the schedule. (23 words)
cn: 乐团还继续向费城学生提供25美元的年度会员资格，他们可以购买每场音乐会的折扣票。

en: Students line up for the concerts they want, and we get roughly 300 or 350 kids a night coming to these. (21 words)
cn: 学生们排队等待他们想要的音乐会，我们每晚大约有300或350个孩子来参加。

en: They take any of the open seats available, 5 minutes before the concert starts, Vulgamore said. (16 words)
cn: 沃尔加莫尔说：‘他们在音乐会开始前5分钟占据任何空座。’

en: It is like the running of the bulls, that energy when the doors open. (14 words)
cn: 这就像奔牛节一样，开门时的那种能量。

en: Greenberg thinks that youthful energy needs to be harvested. (9 words)
cn: 格林伯格认为，年轻人的活力需要被充分利用。

en: Conductors do not have to be arrogant and untouchable—they can be accessible. (12 words)
cn: 指挥家不必傲慢和不可接近——他们可以平易近人。

en: Perhaps there could even be a 'bit of humor' about them, he suggested, and an abandoning of pretension within the high-art institutions themselves. (23 words)
cn: 他建议，或许他们甚至可以有一些‘幽默感’，并且在高雅艺术机构本身中放弃做作。

en: On one hand, these organizations are all saying the same thing: we want more general audiences, to break down cultural barriers, he said. (23 words)
cn: 他说：‘一方面，这些机构都在说同样的话：我们想要更多的普通观众，打破文化壁垒。’

en: But then they come up with some very snooty thing that makes you crazy. (14 words)
cn: 但随后他们又提出一些非常目中无人的东西，让人抓狂。

en: John Terauds, a critic who has covered Toronto's classical music scene extensively, also wants to do away with the stuffiness. (20 words)
cn: 广泛报道多伦多古典音乐界的评论家约翰·特罗兹也想消除这种拘谨。

en: He suggested that the warmer an audience is, the better the musicians themselves will respond. (15 words)
cn: 他建议，观众越热情，音乐家们的反应就越好。

en: But the producer or organizer has to let everyone know it is OK, he said. (15 words)
cn: 他说：‘但制作人或组织者必须让每个人知道这没问题。’

en: It is OK to enjoy yourself. (6 words)
cn: 享受自己是没问题的。

en: At the Toronto Symphony Orchestra, for example, conductor Peter Oundjian often stops between pieces, taking a moment to talk about the composer or the music in a very amiable way. (30 words)
cn: 例如，在多伦多交响乐团，指挥彼得·奥德吉安经常在曲目之间停下来，用非常和蔼的方式谈论作曲家或音乐。

en: And some nights, Terauds said, 'at least a third' of the audience consists of students who have purchased cheaper tickets. (20 words)
cn: 特罗兹说，有些晚上，‘至少三分之一’的观众是购买了便宜票的学生。

en: On these nights, the energy of the room drastically shifts. (10 words)
cn: 在这些夜晚，整个大厅的氛围发生了巨大变化。

en: It becomes a less intimidating place. (6 words)
cn: 它变成了一个不那么令人望而生畏的地方。

en: Back in February, Terauds wrote on his blog about how going to classical performances can be intimidating. (17 words)
cn: 早在二月份，特罗兹就在他的博客上写到，去听古典音乐会可能会让人望而生畏。

en: Certain people 'think they have to dress up,' he wrote. (10 words)
cn: 他写道：‘某些人认为他们必须盛装打扮。’

en: They think they have to know something about the music before they go. (13 words)
cn: 他们认为在去之前必须对音乐有所了解。

en: And, I am sure, sitting in a seat, trembling in fear that this might be the wrong time to applaud, is also one of the factors. (26 words)
cn: 而且，我敢肯定，坐在座位上，因为害怕这可能不是鼓掌的时机而颤抖，也是因素之一。

en: Everyone in the classical world agrees on the need for increased 'accessibility,' but achieving it is often easier said than done. (21 words)
cn: 古典音乐界每个人都同意需要提高‘可及性’，但实现起来往往说起来容易做起来难。

en: Nowadays, there are unknown, unorthodox opera singers wowing viewers on TV programs like 'America's Got Talent' and 'The Voice'. (19 words)
cn: 如今，有一些不知名的、非传统的歌剧歌手在《美国达人秀》和《好声音》等电视节目中让观众惊叹。

en: What can higher institutions do with any of that? (9 words)
cn: 高雅机构能利用这些做什么呢？

en: And if they appeal to these outlets, do they risk compromising the integrity or the intelligence of the music? (19 words)
